characters.introText:
Quick Answers
		
		
	
	
			
				
					What role did Bibi Dong play in the revival of the Blue Lightning Tyrant Dragon Clan?
						
				
				
					
						Bibi Dong, a disciple of the Supreme Pontiff, crossed paths with Yu Xiaogang following his expulsion from the Blue Lightning Tyrant Dragon Clan. Despite this, Bibi Dong did not contribute directly to the clan's revival. The resurgence of the Blue Lightning Tyrant Dragon Clan was spearheaded by Yu Xiaogang and Liu Erlong, leading to its enduring status as an ancient Great Clan over 20,000 years later.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What is the significance of Bibi Dong being the first and last Empress of the Spirit Empire?
						
				
				
					
						Bibi Dong, as the Supreme Pontiff of the Spirit Hall, established the Spirit Empire following the fall of the Seven Treasure Glazed Tile Clan and the Blue Lightning Tyrant Dragon Clan. She self-proclaimed as the inaugural and final Empress of the Spirit Empire, which extended over territories previously under the Spirit Hall and various minor kingdoms and duchies. The Spirit Empire ceased to exist by the conclusion of DD1.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					How did Bibi Dong's past influence Liu Erlong's decisions?
						
				
				
					
						Near death, Bibi Dong revealed the truth about her past with Yu Xiaogang, including how Qian Xunji had forcibly separated them and prevented her from being with him. After learning what Bibi Dong had endured and that she had continued to love Yu Xiaogang, Liu Erlong became even more determined to remain with Yu Xiaogang despite the obstacles surrounding their relationship.
					
					
						Provided by: Community
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What was Bibi Dong's position in the Spirit Hall?
						
				
				
					
						In the Spirit Hall, Bibi Dong served as the Supreme Pontiff. As a strategist, she owned a full set of spirit bones. She mentored Hu Liena, viewing her as a daughter. Tang San, who held her responsible for his mother's demise, was a significant adversary during her tenure.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom

Appearance[]
She was a beautiful lady with an appearance of a 20 year old despite being more than 50 due to being a high-level Titled Douluo. She had fair skin and perfect complexion with an aura of noble radiance. She dressed in black gilt-lined luxurious robes, wearing a nine tipped purple gold crown with a more than two meter long scepter in her hand, inlaid with countless precious stones.
characters.appearance:
Following the end of the preliminaries, she was reported about Tang San's cultivation speed by Salas.

She was informed about Tang San being the descendant of the Clear Sky Clan and having Twin Martial Souls including the Clear Sky Hammer by Sa Lasi.

She revealed to Yu Xiaogang that she already knew about Tang San and had sent people to assassinate him when he asked how she overcame the danger of cultivating Twin Martial Souls. She told Yu Xiaogang that Tang San was lucky after learning about the failure of Yue Guan and Gui Mei. She became emotional after he left.

She was present as the VIP during the matches of the Finals.

She had already ordered Hu Liena, Xie Yue, and Yan to cripple or kill Tang San in the tournament after the Elder Hall unanimously decided that he had to die. She was accompanied by Chen Xin, Yue Guan, Gui Mei, and Ning Fengzhi to the VIP podium before the 5th round. After the Shrek Seven Monsters did not kneel to her, Yue Guan informed her about Tang San. She praised Tang San for learning Yu Xiaogang's manners and revealed the Soul Bones that would be awarded to the tournament champions. She encouraged the participants to show their best and become champions before declaring the start of the 5th round.

She asked Yu Xiaogang why he forfeited the three-way match on behalf of Shrek Academy's Team but was refuted. She protected Yu Xiaogang by addressing him as an Elder of the Martial Soul Hall. She was provoked by Liu Erlong, causing her expression to briefly change. She recognized the tactic used by the Shrek Seven Monsters as a Seven-in-One Martial Fusion and wondered if it was the result of Yu Xiaogang's teachings. She was shocked when Tang San used the Clear Sky Hammer Avatar despite having Level 43 Soul Power.

She instructed the members of the Martial Soul Hall Academy's Team on how to break the Seven-in-One Martial Fusion of the Shrek Seven Monsters and assured them that Tang San would not be able to use the Clear Sky Hammer Avatar for some time. She commented that although Yu Xiaogang could not cultivate to higher levels due to his mutated Martial Soul, he was still capable of creating new tactics for the match. She stopped Gui Mei from killing Yu Xiaogang when he suggested it because Yu Xiaogang possessed a Rank 1 Martial Soul Hall Token. She was not surprised that Yu Xiaogang had changed the Shrek Seven Monsters' formation for the match.

She was glad to see the Shrek Seven Monsters enveloped by the Chaos Fog. She was shocked when six members of the Shrek Seven Monsters flew out of the Chaos Fog to confront the rest of the Martial Soul Hall Academy's Team.

She was glad to see Tang San's injuries after the Chaos Fog dissipated due to the Charm Demon's de-fusion. She was frustrated when Tang San poisoned members of the Martial Soul Hall Academy's Team with the fragments of the Eight Spider Lances, as it did not violate the tournament rules. She was warned by Dugu Bo that even he could not detoxify the Eight Spider Lances' poison and that the poisoned members would die if she delayed any longer. She weighed the situation and declared the Martial Soul Hall Academy's Team's loss. She recognized Xiao Wu as a Soul Beast when the Yearning Heartbroken Red fell from her body, exposing her true energy signature.

She became glad about Xiao Wu's identity, which overshadowed the Martial Soul Hall Academy's Team's defeat. She congratulated the Shrek Seven Monsters for becoming champions and signaled Tang San to detoxify the poisoned members of the Martial Soul Hall Academy's Team. She offered Tang San a chance to join the Martial Soul Hall when he went to pick up the Soul Bones, but he rejected it, causing her to decide to kill him in the future. She was shocked to see Tang San had another Soul Bone when he took out the Fantasy Wisdom Skull for Ning Rongrong. After the Shrek Academy's group distributed the Soul Bones, she ordered Yue Guan and Gui Mei to capture Xiao Wu. She threatened Ning Fengzhi with the Seven Treasure Glazed Tile Clan after he tried to intervene. She revealed Xiao Wu's identity as a Soul Beast in human form after Yu Xiaogang presented the Rank 1 Martial Soul Hall Token to formally ask her. She asked Xiao Wu if she was the Soul Beast who escaped their hunt years earlier. She was stunned by Yu Xiaogang's actions before ordering Yue Guan and Gui Mei to capture Xiao Wu and kill anyone who resisted. She revealed the Soul Rings of her Death Spider Emperor to suppress Dugu Bo with her Soul Power when he tried to take Tang San and Xiao Wu away. She called for reinforcements from the Elder Hall after Tang Hao revealed himself.

She, Yue Guan, Gui Mei, and four other Titled Douluos were forced by Tang Hao to protect the Supreme Pontiff Palace instead of attacking him. She told the Titled Douluos that it was not time to target Tang Hao and ordered the Shrek Academy's group to leave Martial Soul City immediately, as she decided to endure longer to make people underestimate the Martial Soul Hall.

Quick Answers
		
		
	
	
			
				
					What is the most distinctive feature of Dai Mubai's appearance?
						
				
				
					
						The most distinctive feature of Dai Mubai's appearance is his four-pupiled eyes that are deep blue in color, giving off an aura of intensity. He also often carries a lazy expression on his face.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What is the significance of Dai Mubai's twin pupils?
						
				
				
					
						The twin pupils of Dai Mubai, a character in the Light Novels, bear his unique spirit mark. When these pupils become deep blue, they evoke a sense of a formidable killing machine, symbolizing his immense power and combative spirit.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What kind of impression does Dai Mubai's gaze give off?
						
				
				
					
						The gaze of Dai Mubai, a character known for his strength and impulsiveness, is characterized by deep blue pupils that evoke the image of a lethal machine. His eyes also exhibit a red-hot radiance, contributing to an imposing and threatening demeanor.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom

Appearance[]
Dai Mubai is a handsome man tall with broad shoulders, a head of long golden hair unrolling behind him, falling down nearly to his waist with no curls. He gives off a powerful impression.
characters.appearance:
Upon the activation of his Martial Soul, his entire body’s skeleton makes cracking sounds, muscles abruptly swelling, filling out the clothes to the point of bursting. Every muscle under the clothes becomes exceedingly distinct.

The full head of blonde hair in a second changes to alternating black and white, white constituting the majority, in its several black locks especially clear. On his forehead appears four faint lines, three horizontal and one vertical, just right to form the character for "king."

His hands changes the most, to no less than twice the size compared to before changing with white fur covering the entire back of the hand. From the ten fingers short dagger-like talons continuously stretch out, each talon like the edge of a knife, length no less than eight centimeters, glimmering with a dim dazzling gleam.

His body slowly bent over, four pupils all becoming thoroughly deep blue, giving people a feeling like of a killing machine.
characters.personality:
He met Tang San and Xiao Wu in the Rose Hotel, when he took a pair of Twins there. He asked the receptionist to call the Manager after the latter gave Tang San and Xiao Wu the room reserved for him. He refused to reason with Tang San. He challenged Tang San and Xiao Wu for the Room after he realized that they were both Soul Masters. He told the Manager to bill him for the damages after Xiao Wu cursed him. He was defeated by Tang San when both of them were not using their Martial Souls, and told the latter that he would give the Room to them, but he still wants to see his full strength. He activated his White Tiger and stated his status as courtesy. He was shocked to see that Tang San's Martial Soul was the Blue Silver Grass before agreeing with the latter that there were no trash Martial Souls, only trash Soul Masters. He used his White Tiger Barrier and his White Tiger Intense Light Wave to counter the Blue Silver Bind. He was restrained by the Blue Silver Parasite after his counter. He complemented Tang San that the latter's Blue Silver Grass was good, before using his White Tiger Vajra Transformation to break free.

Tang San tried to restrain him again using the Blue Silver Bind. He tore apart the Blue Silver Bind and explained to Tang San about the effects of the White Tiger Vajra Transformation, and the fact that the latter's poison was not enough to harm him. He deactivated his White Tiger and told Tang San and Xiao Wu that they can take his name after reaching the Shrek Academy, before telling them that he guessed their destination due to their age and Soul Power.

characters.introText:
Quick Answers
		
		
	
	
			
				
					What are the core skills that Tang San learnt from the Tang Sect in Soul Land?
						
				
				
					
						In Soul Land, Tang San mastered several Tang Sect techniques. These encompass the Mysterious Heaven Technique, Purple Demon Eyes, Disorder Splitting Wind Hammer, and Ghost Shadow Perplexing Track. The Tang Sect's core skills revolve around hidden weapons, poison, and agility. Tang San also utilized his Blue Silver Emperor Spirit, Mysterious Heaven Technique, and Hidden Weapon Techniques, which synergize with his control type grass spirit to manipulate battlefield conditions.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					How does Tang San's past life influence his rebirth in the Clear Sky Clan?
						
				
				
					
						Tang San's rebirth in the Clear Sky Clan is heavily influenced by his past life. His father, Tang Hao, assigns him the task of fulfilling his own unaccomplished goals and revitalizing the Clear Sky Clan. Tang San's abilities are acknowledged by the clan, resulting in his induction. Tang Hao secretly protects him, ensuring his past doesn't create issues. Tang San's feats, including overcoming Tang Hu and challenging the Seventh Elder, contribute to the Clear Sky Clan's resurgence.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					Who are Tang San's parents in the Soul Land series?
						
				
				
					
						In the Soul Land series, Tang San's biological parents are Tang Hao and Ah Yin. They hold crucial positions, with Tang Hao serving as the Douluo Planar Lord and Ah Yin functioning as the Douluo Life Core. Together, they oversee Tang San's extensive 10,000-year plan.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What role does Tang San play in the Douluo Dalu series?
						
				
				
					
						In the Douluo Dalu series, Tang San serves as the main protagonist. He was once the Supreme God King in the divine realm and the central character of Soul Land 1. Following the demise of his wife, Xiao Wu, Tang San took his own life and reincarnated as a slave on Falan Planet, all the while preserving the memories of his past life. He is also known for his protective nature, especially towards his father.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What is the significance of Tang San's connection to the Blue Silver Empress?
						
				
				
					
						Tang San, a character from Soul Land, carries the bloodline of the Blue Silver Empress. This lineage allows him to transform his spirit from Blue Silver Grass to Blue Silver Emperor, a process facilitated by the Blue Silver King. Additionally, Tang San's mother, linked to the Blue Silver Empress, grants him a crown at the Blue Silver Palace. This transformation and inheritance significantly enhance Tang San's abilities.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom

Appearance[]
He used to have long, brown hair tied into a ponytail and brown eyes, but after he "died" and became a child, he has short, black short hair and dark blue eyes that can turn purple-紫极魔瞳.
characters.appearance:
He used to have long, brown hair tied into a ponytail and brown eyes, but after he "died" and became a child, he has short, black short hair and dark blue eyes that can turn purple-紫极魔瞳.

After growing up, Tang San's dark hair has lightened to blue, thanks to his Blue Silver Emperor abilities awakening. His hair is much longer, and he wears it tied back in a low ponytail, with bangs framing a neat, handsome face. He's tall and dresses well. He's always seen wearing his storage belt, the Twenty Four Moonlight Bridges.
characters.personality:
Tang San possesses a very calm and serene personality. He is good-willed, thoughtful of others, and completely selfless towards close friends. He habitually calculates his options before taking action. As a person of two lives, since childhood, he possessed the maturity of an adult. His thirst for knowledge is astounding as in his previous life, and that thirst for knowledge was the reason he committed suicide. He deeply loves his parents and has a deep regard for his friends, especially Xiao Wu. He would selflessly put himself in front of danger to help his precious ones. Tang San is shown to be an intellectual and cool-headed person in combat, carefully calculating the chances of events during the battle and even sometimes after the battle. He rarely comes unprepared into a fight.

He harbors a dark egoistic personality from his experience in first life in Tang Sect. This dark side is expressed as he eliminates, dissipates, or renders those who oppose him dead or imbecile if they're considered as enemies who can no longer be reconciled with (by Tang San's standards). We see part of this out-of-character moment when he confronts Huo Yuhao in the Yin-Yang Love Querying Valley and tears him into shreds several times, testing to see if he was worthy for his daughter.

After becoming a father, he seems to like spoiling his daughter, but is shown to be much more stern with his son. Due to the restrictions of the God Realm, he cannot help them directly, but he provides as many benefits to them as he can. He coddles his daughter with affection and presents to her many opportunities for training. For his son, he couldn't leave much, but played a major role in mentoring him on the usages and cautions of his Golden Dragon King powers, and then protecting him through the Seagod Trident.
characters.history:
Prior to his rebirth in Soul Land (Douluo Dalu), he was a member of the Outer Sect of the Tang Sect. Tang Sect was a school of assassins who specialized in Poisons and Hidden Weapon. Among the Tang Sect Outer Sect disciples, he was the third most senior and therefore came to be known as Tang San. Even among them, he was considered a genius not seen in two hundred years. Wanting to know the secrets of the Tang Sect that was only taught only to the Inner Sect disciples, he broke into their sacred place stealing the knowledge. Having read and mastered its contents, knowing he committed a crime, he committed suicide by jumping off the Hell's Peak

Upon his birth in Soul Land, (Douluo Dalu) he realized that he retained his memories from his previous life. Coincidentally he was named Tang San. He was raised by his father Tang Hao who was an alcoholic and a blacksmith, he was a spirit master too (Douluo) in the village of the Holy Spirit.
characters.trivia:
Tang San was 29 years old when he committed suicide, before his rebirth in Douluo Continent.

Tang San's birthday is on January 11th, making his Western Zodiac sign the Capricorn.

After killing the Datura Snake, Tang San considered killing Grandmaster in case he saw his Mysterious Heaven Skills. After getting used to his current world, Tang San freely showed off his Mysterious Heaven Skills.

Tang San is believed to be the only person who has absorbed a limit surpassing Spirit Ring in Soul Land 1.

The Tang Sect Logo is embedded in all the weapons produced by Tang San.

Tang San's fake name of choice when keeping a low profile is Tang Yin, after his mother, Ah Yin.

Tang San is capable of doing Perfect Mimicry Cultivation, which is only possible at 70th rank.

Tang San has an innate domain and acquires another in Slaughter City.

Tang San is named after his mother Ah Yin. Ah Yin is named as Third Sister as the third youngest member of Tang Hao's group when they are still young.

Tang San has a political conflict with the God of Destruction during Tang San's rise as a God King in the God Realm.

Tang San breaches the Heavenly Jewel Change World under the jurisdiction of Destruction when he was looking for an heir, but Zhou Weiqing refuses to inherit the Asura God position.

Tang San knows Rong Nianbing, the God of Emotions, before he learns about Huo Yuhao.

Tang San has a habit of touching his hair whenever he is nervous.

His personality type is a strategist. He came up with many schemes against his son-in-law through his daughter. He also was able to predict and plan against the abyssal invasion 20,000 years in advance.

Tang San is an extremely overprotective father and can be amazingly petty.

According to Xiao Wu in Soul Land 2.5, Tang San is a great cook but is terrible at making soup. (It tends to blow up in his face, literally.)  This does not stop him from constantly trying to make soup.

Tang San excels in musical talent, as taught by his aunt in the Moon Pavilion. He's especially skilled with the harp. (Light Novel Chapter 143)

In Soul Land I Chapter 316, the author makes a mistake when it comes to the number of rings on Tang San's Clear Sky Hammer, saying that there is a 10th ring. But in the text after that saying that there is only nine of them, with several different instances where there is only nine of them in the same chapter.

Tang San's number in Slaughter City is 9528.

characters.introText:
Quick Answers
		
		
	
	
			
				
					What led to Tang San's rebirth in Soul Land 5?
						
				
				
					
						Tang San's rebirth in Soul Land 5 occurred after his wife Xiao Wu's death, leading him to commit suicide. He was reborn as a slave on the Falan Planet, retaining his previous life's memories in his divine consciousness. His reincarnation was permitted by the Falan Planet's planar lord, following Tang San's pledge to restore his cultivation without causing harm to the planet.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					Who was Tang San's wife in his previous life?
						
				
				
					
						Tang San, the main protagonist of Soul Land 5, was married to Xiao Wu in his former life. Following her death, he sacrificed his life and was reborn on Falan Planet. Retaining his past memories, he embarked on a quest to find his reincarnated wife in his new existence.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					How did Tang San's physical condition change after his rebirth?
						
				
				
					
						Post-rebirth, Tang San's physical condition underwent substantial transformations. His body was refined by the Mysterious Heaven Technique and Body Sect's refining method, leading to changes in his skin and overall appearance. His aura also transformed, and his skin darkened due to sun exposure at Crescent Island. Moreover, the secondary awakening of his spirit, transitioning from Blue Silver Grass to Blue Silver Emperor, enhanced his attractiveness.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What is the significance of Tang San's divine consciousness in Soul Land 5?
						
				
				
					
						In Soul Land 5, Tang San, reborn as a slave on Falan Planet, retains his divine consciousness from his past life as the Supreme God King. This consciousness, holding his past memories, is key to his spiritual core formation and cultivation towards the god rank. Through his Heavenly Spirit Eye, Tang San can control various elements, with the degree of control varying with his cultivation level.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What was Tang San's status in the divine realm before his rebirth?
						
				
				
					
						Tang San, prior to his rebirth in 'Soul Land 5', was a prominent member of the Tang Sect's Outer Sect, renowned for his exceptional skills in poisons and hidden weapons. He held the third highest rank among his peers and was recognized as a two-century genius. In the divine realm, he was the Supreme God King. Following his wife Xiao Wu's demise, he relinquished his divine status and underwent a rebirth, emerging as a slave on Falan Planet.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom

Appearance[]
Human[]
He was born with a fragile and slender body. He had been malnourished for a long time, causing his reborn body to be completely malnourished. Even his cries were very weak. Despite this, due to his cultivation, he had a pretty lean stature and could still grow up healthy. He had black hair and would usually appear in commoner garbs.
characters.appearance:
He was born with a fragile and slender body. He had been malnourished for a long time, causing his reborn body to be completely malnourished. Even his cries were very weak. Despite this, due to his cultivation, he had a pretty lean stature and could still grow up healthy. He had black hair and would usually appear in commoner garbs.

After breaking through to Tier 7, he looked like a 14 or 15 year-old boy despite he was only 10, and had obviously grown up a little. He was already nearly 1.8 meters tall. The slender figure was not particularly strong, but it had a strange temperament. His appearance had changed, becoming more like himself in his previous life. This was brought by divine consciousness's influence.

At 12 years, he had grown like 17 or 18 years old, and his appearance had become more and more handsome, which is 70% or 80% similar to his previous life. Even the color of his hair had changed to sea blue.

After creating the Golden Body Change, his figure had changed too much, and his appearance had also changed although it was a little familiar. He became nearly two meters tall. There was no special bulge in his muscles, but he had extremely beautiful lines. As long as his qi and blood run, the surface of the skin would immediately have a dark golden glow. His weight was also ten times heavier than before.

After he broke through to the god level, his appearance became the same as his previous life.
characters.personality: He has a strong personality built from his experiences in his previous life. He is a wise and decisive person who always plans ahead for any possibility. He tends to keep mysteries and hold secrets to himself, only revealing what is necessary at the time to others. He is a man of polar attitudes, mostly being empathetic and generous towards those who he favors, and extremely vengeful and petty towards his true enemies, hardly ever showing any indifference. He displays most of his passion in his love, expressed mostly towards his lover, both in his previous life and in his new life.
characters.history:
As a former god king, Tang San gave up everything to go after his reincarnated wife. Finally, he received the induction touch before the divine consciousness nearly died, so he came to this world.

No matter how strong he used to be, he was also reborn, now he is just a baby. The most precious were the memories of his previous life, and the saddest thing was that no matter how strong those memories were, they couldn't change his frail and slender body. Now he must figure a way to survive in this new world and find his wife's new reincarnation so they will not be separated again.
characters.trivia:
Tang San has also absorbed the following bloodlines and their brands, but never retained them or their ability for some reason or another:
Flame Tiger King (From Zhang Haoxuan)

Dark Crow King/Vampire Crow King

Red-Crowned Crane

As an egg, "Jingjing" took up one of the brand slots in his dantian, he couldn't draw any powers from it nor did he have the power of its bloodline. However, it is thanks to Jingjing that inspired Tang San to form some of his abilities like the Bipolar Domain. Before he broke through to the god levels of tier 10, she has made an agreement and chose to stay by Tang San's side in order to ascend to the god realm along with him. It isn't until he inherits the Crystal Emperor's Pillar that he fully unlocks her full powers.

Since he managed to retain his Divine Spark after reincarnating into Falan, he was not only able to keep his memories, but also a small portion of his godking powers, being able to unleash a short burst of divine power in a desperate situation when needed. While this may have been a radical, but valid option since his new birth, but also a major weakness, as it comes at the cost of what little divine consciousness he has left and sacrificing his comparatively fragile body.
This is later resolved after he formed his spiritual core, and cultivated towards the god rank, being able to generate divine consciousness.

Tang San felt the affinity between himself and various elements through the Heavenly Spirit Eye. With his cultivation level, he can naturally control all elements. But the degree of affinity is different.

					What is the meaning of Xiao Wu's name in Chinese?
						
				
				
					
						In Chinese, Xiao Wu translates to 'tiny dancer' or 'small flourish'. Xiao signifies 'tiny, young, few', while Wu stands for 'dance/dancing, brandish, wield, flourish'.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					Who is Xiao Wu married to in the story?
						
				
				
					
						In the narrative, Xiao Wu is wedded to Tang San. Their marriage is accepted by Tang San's father, Tang Hao, who himself was married to a spirit beast turned human. Xiao Wu and Tang San have a child, Tang Wuling.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What kind of creature is Xiao Wu originally?
						
				
				
					
						Originating as a Soft Boned Rabbit, Xiao Wu is a creature with a lifespan exceeding 100,000 years. Her evolution sees her becoming a 2nd Class God, specifically the Rabbit Goddess. She is married to Sea God Tang San.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What is the significance of Xiao Wu's transformation into a 2nd Class God?
						
				
				
					
						The transformation of Xiao Wu to a 2nd Class God signifies a major power enhancement. It grants her complete control over spirit fusion abilities and marks her ascension from a 1st Class God, a shift associated with vast power and influence. This change, though, could potentially impact the spirit realm.

Every Abyssal Evil Sickle possessed the abilities that surpassed mankind’s Title Douluos.
characters.appearance: Its appearance was only slightly similar to that of a human being, having a head and four limbs. However, its pair of forearms were completely different from a human’s. Its forearms were two giant sickle-shaped blades glimmering with dark yellow radiance. Moreover, this ‘human’ was about five meters in height. It had a pair of folded wings that appeared extremely thin on its back, but its movements were unusually swift.

characters.title: Abyssal Mammoth
characters.introText: The Abyssal Mammoths lived on the thirteenth level of the abyssal plane. They were relatively fewer in number, but their offensive and defensive abilities were outstanding. They were one of the main fighting forces of the abyssal creatures on the battlefield.
characters.appearance:
They were giant bull-like abyssal creatures, over a hundred meters in length. They wreaked havoc with their enormously long horns and their entire bodies were covered in incredibly thick and heavy scales.

Judging by their defense, they were not as powerful as the Guardian Longhorn Beetles, but the beetles were far weaker than them in offensive power. The biggest difference between them and the Guardian Longhorn Beetles was that they were incapable of flying.

characters.title: Abyssal Mantis
characters.introText: The Abyssal Mantes looked rather similar to praying mantes, but they were not completely the same. The mantes in the Douluo Continent had long, slender bodies that moved swiftly. Moreover, they could fly.
characters.appearance:
The Abyssal Mantes looked rather similar to praying mantes, but they were not completely the same. The mantes in the Douluo Continent had long, slender bodies that moved swiftly. Moreover, they could fly.

These Abyssal Mantes did not have any wings, but they possessed thick, strong legs that allowed them to leap. Every Abyssal Mantis was about three meters in length, but its pair of large axe-like front legs were over two meters long. Their bodies were short, thick and heavy, and their ability to jump was shocking. Their striking speed was exceedingly quick as well.

characters.title: Abyssal Spirit Dragon
characters.introText: The Abyssal Spirit Dragon was absolutely terrifying creature under the Spirit Monarch. Each of them was a deadly opponent. Even the clan heads from after the thirtieth level of the abyssal plane could not compare to the might of one abyssal Spirit Dragon.
characters.appearance:
It looked like a gigantic lizard. Its head was especially huge and took up almost one-third of its body length. It was over fifty meters long, which was considered a massive size among the abyssal creatures. It’s four limbs were thick and strong as it crawled on the ground. It was completely covered in densely arranged gray and black scales.

Its most distinguishing feature was its eyes. Its bulging eyes were made up of countless segments on the inside emitting a ghastly blue glow.
characters.history: The number of the Abyssal Spirit Dragons were very rare. They appeared and fought with the powerhouses of the Douluo Continent in the war.

characters.introText: Ah Ruheng’s tall and huge with an unusually bulky figure was definitely a rarely seen one as compared to ordinary people. His height exceeded two point five meters and the width of his shoulders was at least twice of an ordinary person. His arms were barren and thus revealed muscles that could only be described as terrifying. The blood vessels on those muscles appeared so outrageous that they were akin to snakes on his skin. characters.appearance:
Ah Ruheng’s tall and huge with an unusually bulky figure was definitely a rarely seen one as compared to ordinary people. His height exceeded two point five meters and the width of his shoulders was at least twice of an ordinary person. His arms were barren and thus revealed muscles that could only be described as terrifying. The blood vessels on those muscles appeared so outrageous that they were akin to snakes on his skin. He is notable for his completely bald head and naturally sharp face.

Ah Ruheng, a man with a tall and muscular build, had a well-proportioned appearance. He was not as handsome as Tang Wulin, but he still had thick brows and big eyes filled with masculinity. He stood over there with his massive frame as he naturally exuded virtuous morality.

His body size rapidly doubled. Soon after that, a layer of bright red color emerged on the surface of his body. The bright red was not the color of flames but was more similar to fresh blood. The bright red color made him appear unusually terrifying. A layer of densely-arranged striation had also appeared on his bright red skin.

The body covered by bright red skin was charging forward with great strides accompanied by tyrannical energy. Every step he took was akin to a war hammer that was knocking against the competition stage and producing violent booming sound. It was as if his pair of eyes shimmering with golden radiance were shooting out countless murderous gleams. His aura was so powerful that the thick blood essence had condensed into the form of a huge human that was tens of meters tall behind his back.

Among Ah Ruheng’s eight soul rings, the first, second, and third soul ring shone at the same time. His body underwent another round of explosive growth. The golden scripts on his body seemed to have come alive. A giant illusory shadow lit up behind him, resembling an enlarged version of himself that was more than a hundred meters tall. Suddenly a massive pressure weighed upon the golden giant dragon like a lofty mountain. He raised his right hand and a peculiar scene appeared. His fist enlarged instantaneously. In the blink of an eye, it attained a diameter of three meters.

(Second Awakening): His body suddenly contracted inward. He looked as if his entire person was forged out of gold. His height was reduced to three meters.

(Third Awakening - Martial Soul Avatar Ring 7): Ah Ruheng’s chest rose and fell. His strong heartbeats had instantly suppressed the cheers of the entire stadium. Once this heart sounded, it meant that his combat strength would be raised to the extremes.

After he had cultivated the Body Sect’s Innate Secret Technique to its highest level, the Golden Body Arhat, his appearance changed once more.

A peculiar hum that sounded like a hymn rose into the air all of a sudden. A wheel of light became illuminated behind Ah Ruheng abruptly. The glowing wheel looked almost solid, and its shape seemed to be complementing the beauty of his background. Meanwhile, a thick and heavy blood essence gushed out from his body suddenly when the wheel rose behind him.

His entire body turned gold and red as if he had been cast in gold. His eyes had even become an exceedingly dazzling golden color. At this point, he no longer looked like a human being anymore. He stood over there like a celestial being or a buddha.
characters.personality:
Ah Ruheng is simple, but arrogant as the heir of the Body Sect and its complete cultivator of the innate secret technique. Because of successfully completing the technique, his brain development seemed to be stunned which resulted in him being foolish with deficiencies in his temperament as a side-effect. His fighting style is hot-blooded and masculine. He likes to wear only his elastic pants for most of his clothes are usually destroyed during battle, therefore, Ah Ruheng has a habit of carrying clothes with him.

Ah Ruheng's upbringing under chef Mu Ye and the Body Sect's Innate Secret Technique has made him a glutton on the level of Tang Wulin.

He speaks unruly and is prideful of his Body Sect's quenching result, his Spirit Body. This deep pride is to the level of declining to prioritize upgrading his Battle Armor to 4-word because his Spirit Body Golden-class (Leakproof Golden Body) has higher defense. Ah Ruheng also likes to do actives which use the body, such as learning mecha piloting. He likes to brag about his younger brother disciple Wulin.

Ah Ruheng is highly mature because of the extreme willpower required to advance with the pain during the practice of his Body Sect's innate secret technique. He is also open minded, acknowledging his resulting training as the Body Sect's heir would leave him a body that needs an extremely tough woman to handle to have descendants, therefore, his requirements for his spouse are simple and realistic.

Ah Ruheng is slow, but not stupid, and possesses high wisdom and intelligence to straightforward his schemes.

characters.introText:
Quick Answers
		
		
	
	
			
				
					What is the significance of Ah Yin's transformation into a human?
						
				
				
					
						Ah Yin, a Spirit Beast of 100,000 years, transforms into human form prematurely. This change marks her overcoming the first 'stage' of the Trial, a test involving the confrontation and punishment of human greed. Her transformation is also her rebirth, observed by numerous human spirit forms of elder Blue Silver Grasses. Ah Yin, of royal descent, carries the purest lineage of the Blue Silver Grass. Post-transformation, she expresses gratitude to her 'people' for aiding her rebirth.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What is the relationship between Ah Yin and Tang Hao?
						
				
				
					
						Ah Yin, the wife of Tang Hao, loved him profoundly. She sacrificed her life to save Tang Hao when he was critically injured in a fight against Spirit Hall, also preventing her capture by them. Tang Hao's love for Ah Yin was unwavering, even after discovering she was a 100,000-year-old spirit beast. He fought for her and was left grief-stricken and purposeless after her demise.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					How does Ah Yin ascend to the Douluo Divine realm?
						
				
				
					
						Ah Yin, a Spirit Beast of the Blue Silver Grass lineage, ascends to the Douluo Divine realm through a rebirth process. This involves overcoming a Trial's first stage, where she punishes human greed and prescribes punishments for graver wrongdoings. During her rebirth, older Blue Silver Grasses' human spirit forms witness her transformation. Emerging from a cocoon amidst a beam of light, Ah Yin thanks her 'people' for aiding her rebirth. She also absorbs energy from the Dragon God soul.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What does it mean for Ah Yin to become the Life Core of the Douluo Planet?
						
				
				
					
						As the sleeping Douluo Planet Life Core, Ah Yin is the life energy source for the Douluo Planet, maintaining its vitality. She is Tang Xuanyu's great-grandmother, sent by Tang San to protect him. However, her role as Life Core doesn't guarantee godhood, to avoid depleting the Eternal Tree's energy.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom

Appearance[]
Human Form[]
Ah Yin is a pale, stunningly beautiful woman with long silver-blue hair, around the age of 30. Her features are lovely, with cool blue eyes, perfect skin, and rosy lips. She favors flowing white and blue clothing, sometimes decorated with vines and flowers using her Blue Silver Empress.

She favors flowing white and blue clothing, sometimes decorated with vines and flowers using her Blue Silver Empress.
characters.personality:
She had been re-cultivating as a Soul Beast in the cave behind the waterfall where Tang San trained his Disorder Splitting Wind Hammer, and had tried to communicate with him when he assimilated the Mind Condensing Wisdom Skull.

Her cultivation accelerated under the influence of Tang San's Blue Silver Domain, surprising Tang Hao as the increase surpassed her own cultivation from the past 20 years. She transmitted her motherly love to Tang San by using her longest vines to touch him and Tang Hao. She continued comforting Tang Hao and Tang San as the past was revealed.

She urged Tang San to assimilate the Blue Silver Emperor Right Leg.

She was delighted by the environment of the Ice and Fire Yin Yang Well upon arriving there. Tang San replanted her in the optimal location, and she stopped him from using more than a single drop of his blood to nourish her. After taking root, her cultivation accelerated significantly.

She sensed Tang San's life was in danger through their connection via the Blue Silver Domain, then realized Xiao Wu had initiated her Sacrifice when Tang San's life force strengthened too rapidly.

She was happy when Tang San and Xiao Wu visited her and Tang Hao. She consoled Xiao Wu, understanding the price of the Sacrifice, and was saddened to learn the events that led to it. She and Tang Hao agreed to Tang San and Xiao Wu's engagement. She created two rings from her vines as engagement rings for Tang San and Xiao Wu.

She was able to manifest a projection of her human form by the time Tang San returned from Sea God Island. She sensed his arrival, and her leaves moved excitedly. When they met, she told Tang San not to cry and calmed him down. She was shocked when Tang San declared his intention to revive Xiao Wu, realizing that he had already reached the rank of Titled Douluo. Her leaves began growing rapidly when Tang San activated his Blue Silver Emperor, after which she asked about his Soul Ring configuration. She calmed down after Tang San briefly explained the origins of his Soul Rings. She chided Tang Hao for boasting about how much Tang San resembled him.

She and Tang Hao witnessed Tang San’s process of reviving Xiao Wu. Her cultivation reached the 10,000+ years under the effects of the Sea God’s Light. She initially refused when Tang San offered to help her complete her re-cultivation but became excited upon hearing that he would also help Tang Hao regrow his limbs.

She told Tang San that although he could help her re-cultivate, the process must not harm him; otherwise, she preferred cultivating at her own pace to reach 100,000 years Level. She absorbed energy from the Blue Silver Grasses of the Sunset Forest through Tang San’s Blue Silver Domain, accelerating her cultivation. She worried about the Blue Silver Grasses’ consumption but felt relieved when Tang San used the Sea God’s Light to nourish them. Her cultivation increased by 20,000 years in two hours before Tang San rested. The process was repeated five times over ten days, raising her cultivation to 100,000 years Level, after which she took the initiative to form a cocoon to regain her Human Body.

She awoke three days later in her Human Body and provided life energy feedback to the Blue Silver Grasses, hoping to help them cultivate faster. She revealed that she had not only restored her previous abilities but had also used energy from the Blue Silver Grasses to condense her 7th Soul Ring and become a Soul Saint, completing her Human Transformation. Her Spiritual Power had also reached the peak of her original cultivation as a 100,000 years Level Soul Beast. At Tang Hao’s insistence, the family remained at the Ice and Fire Yin Yang Well for another three days to consolidate her cultivation before leaving for Clear Sky Castle.

She privately supported Tang San’s suggestion to beat up the Elders to retrieve Tang Hao’s Soul Bones and permanently leave the Clear Sky Clan if they refused to return them peacefully. She waited in the Outpost Village of Clear Sky Castle with Tang Hao and Xiao Wu after they were denied entry to the Castle.

She and Tang Hao were personally welcomed back into the Castle by Tang Xiao. She followed Tang Hao in paying her respects to his father.

She became emotional upon seeing Tang Hao with his recovered limbs. She hugged Tang Hao and cried after his cultivation recovered to its peak, then informed him that Tang San and Xiao Wu had already left for Heaven Dou City.

characters.personality: She is usually quite quiet and reserved.
characters.history: She possesses a martial soul mimicry. If the first soul ring that a soul master obtained was identical to their martial soul, there was a chance that he or she could cultivate a martial soul projection. A martial soul projection wouldn’t give too much of a power-up to a soul master; it mainly changed a soul master’s fighting style. An ordinary beast soul master would use their martial soul to strengthen a particular area of their physical body, then fight using that. On the contrary, a soul master who had a martial soul projection would command their projections to fight for them. The comparative load on their bodies would be lighter, and this made it easier for their companions to protect them. However, there were very glaring flaws to this fighting style. This is because their physical bodies would be comparatively weaker. Thus, it was necessary for a soul master to carefully command their projection to protect themselves. An Lengye, who possessed the Frost Bear, should’ve been assault-type soul masters. However, the fact that her clan was relatively powerful made it so that she chose to cultivate a martial soul projection during the earliest parts of their cultivation. This allowed her to become a control-type soul master instead, and made her part of the ‘Twin Mistresses of Fire and Ice’ with Fei Yuyan.

She met Ye Yinzhu soon after he left seclusion, when she hired the mercenary group he happened to join to escort her to the Milan Empire. The Ancient Golden Tree is rarely seen in the world. It is a tree that contains the aura of light and life.

The Golden Tree is the greatest asset and the most important foundation of Shrek Academy. Many souls of Shrek Academy’s seniors have stayed within the Tree. Beyond that, it could absorb the origin energy of heaven and earth from its surroundings and consolidate it into its center. characters.introText:
Quick Answers
		
		
	
	
			
				
					What powers does the Angel God possess in the Douluo Divine Realm?
						
				
				
					
						The Angel God, formerly a first-class god in the Douluo Divine Realm, is Qian Renxue. This entity can harness power from the Sun. Inheriting the Angel God role requires the Seraphim Spirit and passing the Angel God Nine Trials. The Angel God uses the Angel Sword and wears the Angel Sacred Armor.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What is the significance of Ultimate Light for the Angel God?
						
				
				
					
						Ultimate Light is crucial for the Angel God, the Ruler of Skies. It merges the Holy Attribute with solar power, producing a golden light that subjects targets to intense heat and dissolves their Divine Power. This ability amplifies the Angel God's strength and speed, establishing them as a dominant force in the sky.

Description[]
The Angel God is the former first class god of the Douluo Divine Realm. Its power is mainly based on Holy power (Sacred element), that is, just like Ultimate Fire and Ultimate Ice, this would be Ultimate Light, consisting purely of celestial divine power. Although the elements of Light and Holy combat darkness, only the Holy element is completely effective against all evil, death and related energies, being able to purify and extinguish it with just a touch.

She was the one to express her desire to pursue the immortal God Rank to Poseidon, eventually leading to their clash over the Angel Sword. She and Poseidon respected each other as friends, however a conflict of interests separated their paths.

characters.history:
He was a member of the Holy Spirit Cult who hijacked the soul train going from Shrek City to Heaven Dou City. He tortured Mo Lan and interrogated her on Tang Wulin’s location until Tang Wulin arrived in the carriage saving him the trouble of finding him. He used his Phosphor Fire Soul Refinement on Mo Lan, causing her to suffer and comatose.

Tang Wulin’s spiritual attack wasn’t effective against him since the disparity between their spiritual power was significant and rather counterattacked him. Although Tang Wulin was injured, he used his Golden Dragon Terror Claw to injure him that made him furious. He decided not to let him die easily and tortured him also using his Phosphor Fire Soul Refinement on him, invading his spiritual sea. Suddenly, the Golden Trident mark on Tang Wulin’s forehead was stimulated, the Golden Dragon Spear appeared and sucked his life force away until he died.

Quick Answers
		
		
	
	
			
				
					Who did Asura pass his god position to in the Douluo Divine Realm?
						
				
				
					
						The former Asura God, known as Asura, transferred his divine position in the Douluo Divine Realm to Tang San, then embarked on a journey across the Universe.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What is the physical appearance of Asura compared to the first generation Sea God?
						
				
				
					
						Asura, while slender, stands taller than Poseidon, and is enveloped in a dark red magic pattern. His blood-red eyes and the icy atmosphere created by his strong murderous aura are distinctive features. His armor, also covered with dark red magic patterns, adds to his intimidating presence.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What is the aura around Asura described as in the Soul Land wiki?
						
				
				
					
						Asura's aura is characterized by a chilling, lethal atmosphere, enveloped in a dark red magic pattern. His body is encased in this dark red light, with an armor adorned with matching magic patterns. His eyes are blood-red. Despite his role in killing, Asura upholds a balance between light and darkness, embodying both righteousness and evil.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					Where did Asura go after passing down his god position?
						
				
				
					
						Post relinquishing his divine status, Asura embarked on a journey across numerous universes from the Divine Realm. His mission was to identify a worthy successor using his Law Executor’s God Power. Despite Tang Chen's efforts to succeed him through the Asura God Trials, he was unsuccessful due to corruption within the trials.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What is the significance of the dark red magic pattern on Asura's body?
						
				
				
					
						Asura's dark red magic pattern represents his power and position. It's tied to his lethal aura that can create a chilling environment. The pattern emerges when Asura unleashes his Martial Soul, turning his body into a blood-red radiance. This change enables him to execute potent attacks, like a sword strike capable of slicing through the cosmos. Although responsible for death, Asura embodies both good and evil, positioned between the Gods of Light and Darkness.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom

Appearance[]
His figure is a bit slender compared to the tall and burly first generation Sea God. However, he is taller than Poseidon, with a substantive murderous aura condensed into an icy atmosphere, and the whole body is wrapped in dark red magic pattern. The dark red light surrounds his body. He wears an armor covered with dark red magic patterns and has a pair of blood red eyes.
characters.appearance: He was among the first humans to ascend to the Divine Dragon Realm from the Douluo Planet and created his own Divine Position as the Asura God. He eventually became a God-King level powerhouse cultivating in the Divine Dragon Domain, and his divine tool, the Asura Sword evolved to the level of an Ultra Divine Tool. He left the Slaughter City in the Douluo Planet just before ascending to nurture potential successors.
characters.personality: He was among the first humans to ascend to the Divine Dragon Realm from the Douluo Planet and created his own Divine Position as the Asura God. He eventually became a God-King level powerhouse cultivating in the Divine Dragon Domain, and his divine tool, the Asura Sword evolved to the level of an Ultra Divine Tool. He left the Slaughter City in the Douluo Planet just before ascending to nurture potential successors.
characters.history: Asura sets up his divine inheritance assessment in the Slaughter City in different worlds within the jurisdiction of Douluo Divine Realm. Tang Chen was already a Rank 99 Limit Douluo when he found the breath of divinity in the City of Killing, whose strength and abilities had been recognized by Asura, thereby bestowing him the Asura God Trials. Moreover, the first to seventh trial had been easily passed. However, Rakshasa God, the God of Evil Obsession who is also called the Dark God of Slaughter, had interfered with Tang Chen's inheritance and changed the original form of Slaughter City in Douluo Continent. The place that was once a plain world of killing slowly degenerated. Wherever evil lies, the spirit of Asura God has been constantly being eroded and contaminated with countless impurities. Rakshasa God did it in order to prevent his heir from completing the Nine Tests of Asura God. Thus, the Three-Headed Bat King was successful in poisoning Tang Chen's heart. Not until when he accidentally met Tang San, with the divine power of Sea God's Light, the evil in his heart was purified and he was released from the shackles of Rakshasa God, eventually passing the 8th Trial: Earn Approval of Asura Sword. However, it was already too late for Tang San's great-grandfather to complete the last step due to his declining life energy. Therefore, he passed on successorship to his great-grandson by leaving the Asura Sword to Bo Saixi.

characters.appearance: Aude is a middle-aged man in a purple gown.
characters.personality: Aude shows much contempt on people dressed poorly or with a low-class manner. He has a big temperament.
characters.history: After being informed by the assistants of the Moon Pavilion, he rudely ordered Tang Hao and Tang San to leave and instructed the guards to escort them out. He was shocked when Tang San crippled the arms of two Soul Ancestor guards with ease. He activated his Ghost King Vine, revealing himself to be a Soul Emperor with the optimal Soul Ring configuration, but was stunned by the Soul Rings of Tang San's Blue Silver Emperor. He realized that he was suppressed to about 70% of his full strength due to the combined effects of the Blue Silver Emperor's suppression over plant-type Martial Souls and the Deathgod Domain's suppression of Soul Power. After learning the identities of Tang Hao and Tang San, he accepted the gag order regarding the incident.
characters.trivia: Aude fights Tang San with his vines and gets strangled by the latter. Tang Yuehua is seen extending her Noble Circle Domain with a harp, dissolving the Deathgod Domain in the process.

						Star Anise employs the Ice Coagulation ability to form and attract ice elements, enhancing the star anise spirit's capabilities in manipulating ice for diverse tactical uses.

					What is the significance of Bai He's white hair?
						
				
				
					
						Bai He's white hair is significant as it reflects both his name's meaning, 'white,' and his advanced age, being over 70. It symbolizes his wisdom and experience as a Spirit Douluo ranked at 82+.

					What role does Bai He play in the Clear Sky Clan reunion?

					How does Bai He react to meeting Tang San?

Appearance[]
He is an old man who has a slim built but seems extremely well proportioned. He has snow white long hair that hangs over his back and a rosy face which gives him a younger appearance.
characters.appearance:
He led the entourage of the Speed Clan to the Mansion of the Defense Clan for the biennial meeting of the four Single Attribute Clans and was welcomed by Niu Gao and Tai Tan. He was informed about Huyan Zhen's visit and its future implications. He was introduced to Tang San by Tai Tan, before Tang San explained the properties of the Godly Zhuge Crossbow and Niu Gao vouched for them.

He was impressed by the Godly Zhuge Crossbow and ordered 200 units before asking the price, misunderstanding the quoted value as the price for all 200 units instead of one. He became angered after realizing the mistake, before Tang San told him the price paid by the Seven Treasure Glazed Tile Clan and Tai Tan vouched for it. He was tempted by Tang San's bet. His expression turned ugly upon realizing that Tang San had continuously dodged Bai Chenxiang by a small margin. He agreed with Ma Hongjun that Bai Chenxiang would not be able to touch Tang San even if the time was doubled. He chided Bai Chenxiang when she tried to challenge Tang San to a long-distance speed contest. He accepted Tang San's challenge, with the condition that if he lost, the Speed Clan would join the Tang Sect and receive Hidden Weapons. He and Bai Chenxiang felt bloodline suppression when Ma Hongjun activated the Fire Phoenix. He agreed to Tang San's challenge on the condition that he would lead the Speed Clan to leave the Tang Sect if it joined the Martial Soul Hall in the future. He was surprised that Tang San possessed Teleportation.

He was shocked that Tang San could use Teleportation over 100 times within a quarter of the time limit without showing signs of Soul Power depletion and decided to go all out. He forcibly compressed the size of his Needle Tailed Swift Avatar for greater acceleration before using Swirling Swift to create identical clones. He was shocked by the Soul Ring configuration of Tang San's Blue Silver Emperor. He cornered Tang San with his clones, leaving him no space to teleport. He was shocked to see Xiao Wu's Soul appear during the spar and witness the effects of Nothingness. He admitted defeat, as Swirling Swift did not increase his speed but only the effective area in which he could use it, before Tai Tan and Niu Gao told him and Tang San to consider the match a tie. He was shocked to learn that Tang San was Tang Hao's son and asked Tai Tan and Niu Gao whether they had known from the start. He agreed to lead the Speed Clan to join the Tang Sect only if Yang Wudi led the Breaking Clan to join as well. He warned Tang San that convincing Yang Wudi would not be easy. His mood improved after Tang San hinted that he would teach the Speed Clan the Ghost Shadow Perplexing Track.

He found Tang San on the roof the next morning and asked about Tang Hao. He berated Tang Hao's bad habits hearing about the Soul Bones. He revealed to Tang San that his older sister was the latter's grandmother making him his granduncle. He told Tang San about Yang Wudi's nature and gave him the Crystal Blood Dragon Ginseng to lure Yang Wudi in the Tang Sect, and told him to treat it as a meeting gift.

He was chatting with Yang Wudi when Tang San and Ma Hongjun arrived at the meeting hall. He was shocked by Yang Wudi's proposal for the four Single Attribute Clans to form a Sect and fight the Martial Soul Hall. He tried to calm Yang Wudi after the latter became furious upon learning Tang San's identity and attempted to leave. He was shocked when Tang San challenged Yang Wudi to a bet, as he had already learned about Tang San's bets against Tai Tan and Niu Gao.

He was shocked when Tang San activated the Eight Spider Lances for the battle and learned that it was an External Soul Bone. He witnessed the battle between Tang San and Yang Wudi and became worried for Tang San when it became dangerous. He thought that Tang San wanted to show his full capability before revealing the Crystal Blood Dragon Ginseng to Yang Wudi.

He closed his eyes in fear as Xiao Wu's Soul executed Eight Stage Drop on Yang Wudi. He wondered how he would fare against Eight Stage Drop himself. He and Niu Gao supported Yang Wudi after he fainted from his injuries. He continued pouring his Soul Power into Yang Wudi's body to stabilize him. He, Niu Gao, and Tai Tan discussed Tang San, Yang Wudi, and their future prospects.

He described the appearance of the Crystal Blood Dragon Ginseng to Yang Wudi to convince him to join the Tang Sect, as he was not confident in Tang San's persuasion. He was shocked to see Tang San lead Xiao Wu to the meeting hall. He asked Tang San about the Crystal Blood Dragon Ginseng when Tang San presented an Aromatic Silk Beauty to Yang Wudi. He feared Yang Wudi would lash out over the broken promise, but was shocked to see him overjoyed. He asked Yang Wudi if the Aromatic Silk Beauty was better than the Crystal Blood Dragon Ginseng. He led the Speed Clan's entourage back home before the entire Speed Clan traveled to Heaven Dou City.

He had sent the descendants of the Speed Clan throughout the Heaven Dou City to scout for information after settling down. He, Bai He, and Yang Wudi received the group when they returned from Gengxin City with Lou Gao.

He was shocked when Tang San formally introduced Oscar, Ma Hongjun, and Ning Rongrong. He was alarmed to hear that Xiao Wu was a 100,000+ years Level Soul Beast and shocked that she had used Sacrifice to save Tang San. He agreed with Tang San's arrangement for the various Halls and Tai Tan's additional proposal.

Her appearance was somewhat ordinary compared to other beauties, but there was always a faint smile on her face. characters.history:
She was the purest saint in the galaxy. Her mission was to abolish poverty and the social system on every planet. She was the great talent of the light element superpower, but initially not part of the Holy Alliance of manipulators. She met Tian Hen on his home planet near the beginning of her mission and fell in love with him upon making contact with him, despite being aware of their opposing power's elements. She eventually was elected to become the president of the whole galactic alliance. She inherited the will and power of the ancient god of light.

She was Tian Hen's first lover. When Tian Hen was confused about what to do with all of his love interests, she revealed that she knew he would be to important and occupied to show only her attention, so she allowed them to have an open relationship for the sake of his happiness. Despite their mutual feelings, their conflicting goals led her to be the last to marry Tian Hen and become his wife.

She appeared beside Tian Hen before the integration of the seven divine realms and asked worriedly about the Space Speed which was to integrate with other divine realms.
characters.trivia:
She had the highest popularity in the Sky Speed Star Mark World, being the galaxy's renowned Saintess as well as eventually becoming its president.

Her contracted Holy Beast was an alicorn named Mu.

characters.introText:
Quick Answers
		
		
	
	
			
				
					What is the significance of Bai Xiuxiu being a 100,000 years Demon Spirit Great White Shark?
						
				
				
					
						As a 100,000 years Demon Spirit Great White Shark, Bai Xiuxiu belongs to one of the top three overlords of the sea, recognized for their exceptional speed and tracking abilities. Despite being less powerful than the Demonic Whales and Evil Spirit Orcas, the Great White Shark clan is the fastest among oceanic spirit beasts. Their clan is also entrusted with the protection of the Seagod Island.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					How does Bai Xiuxiu become the life core of the twin planets?
						
				
				
					
						Bai Xiuxiu becomes the life core of the twin planets by inheriting the Planetary Cores of Long Tianyang. These cores, located in Tianyang Lake on both the Heavenly Dragon Planet and Heavenly Horse Planet, are her essence origin cores. An additional core, won in an auction by Prime Minister Tianhe, is later returned. The cores evolve over years of dimensionality evolution to become the life core of the twin planets.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What is unique about Bai Xiuxiu's physical appearance in her human form?
						
				
				
					
						In her human form, Bai Xiuxiu stands tall, with her gray-blue hair cascading down to the ground, much like Xiao Wu. Her eyes mirror the same gray-blue hue, and her fair skin emits a soft gray-blue glow. She possesses a tall, straight nose and sharp, angular features, which, rather than being obtrusive, lend her a distinctive, exotic charm.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What level of Soul Beast is Bai Xiuxiu?
						
				
				
					
						In the Soul Land series, Bai Xiuxiu achieves the Hyper Douluo Soul Rank of 95+ in the third installment. She further advances to the Limit Douluo level with a Soul Rank of 99+ in the fourth installment.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom

Her skin was not pale white, but instead an extremely healthy rosy white to that of a baby. And her deep and dark blue eyes; its clear and limpid color that gave a hint of naivety.

When Lan Xuanyu, Liu Feng and Qian Lei were in the middle of one their simulation trials, she was summoned by Lan Xuanyu using Qian Lei’s summoning gate. She helped them defeat the Lava Hounds before disappearing back into the gate.
characters.trivia:
Long Tianyang had Tang Xuanyu promise to raise Bai Xiuxiu to the rank of God King after creating the divine realm in exchange for resurrecting Bai Xiuxiu.

Dong Qianqiu is I Qiyi (爱奇艺)'s Literature department's manager's real name, also one of TJSS's friend. TJSS used her real name in SL4, in China, there are many Soul Land series's hentai fanfics (色情同人小说), Qianqiu is SL4's heroine so many readers wrote her in these, so Qianqiu's prototype doesn't like her real name in these hentai fanfics, so TJSS change heroine's name as Bai Xiuxiu.

characters.history:
The Bear Lord was present with the other Spirit Beasts within the center of the Great Star Dou Forest when the Silver Dragon King woke up beneath their feet. At first, he thought the humans were attacking them, but Di Tian calmed him down. He was then sent flying when the Silver Dragon King released her aura. Later on, he and some other spirit beasts followed Gu Yuena out of the forest and integrated into human society.

After Gu Yue and Tang Wulin were restrained by an evil spirit master, he appeared and severely injured her. Although he wanted to kill her, Gu Yue didn't allow because she said the enemy of the enemy was a friend.

Chapter 530 novel - Chapter 298 manhua

The Bear Lord and five other hundred thousand year spirit beasts went with Gu Yuena to the Dragon Clan Graveyard to retrieve the soul core (Dragon God's Heart) of the Dragon God. He and the others waited by the space gate they created to get into the graveyard while Gu Yuena went to get the core.

After Tang Wulin left the blood god army, he attacked him. Unfortunately, he got injured with the Ion Beam of Long Yuxue even with his strong defense and cultivation.

characters.title: Behemoth
characters.introText: The Behemoths are Spirit Beasts that are not native to the Douluo Planet but to Zither's Emperor World.
characters.appearance:
They are over ten meters tall, and their bodies are even stronger than the Eight Armed Divine Demons. With sharp claws popping out from their hands and bloodshot eyes, their hair are as hard as iron.

Silver Behemoths are more muscular than the Black Iron Behemoths. The appearance is similar to that of human, with iron grey hair all over the body, a pair of strong arms and sharp claws at the front.

Adult Golden Behemoths are over 18 meters tall, and each of them exudes a terrifying aura as deep as the abyss and hell.
characters.history:
As early as in ancient times, when there was no human being, the Dragon Clan ruled the whole continent, and then with the strength of the Dragon Clan, it gradually broke through the restrictions of the world and became a God. At that time, there was also a clan that had been fighting with the Dragon Clan, the Behemoth Clan. Behemoths hunt and kill Dragons, and even use the Dragon as food to improve themselves. The strong among them are no less powerful than the Dragon.

For a time, the Behemoth Clan was so powerful that even some of them had risen into the Divine Realm. The Dragon God worried about its expansion, and ordered the Dragon King under his command to encircle Behemoths. Almost obliterate Behemoths from the Divine Realm and the Douluo Planet.

Dark Gold Fear Claw Bear inherited some of the Behemoth bloodline.

characters.introText:
Quick Answers
		
		
	
	
			
				
					What is the significance of Bi Ji's status among the Savage Beasts?
						
				
				
					
						Bi Ji, the fourth of the Ten Savage Beasts of the Star Dou Forest, is significant due to her compassionate nature and unique abilities. After a thousand-year cultivation, her life energy attracted many spirit beasts. Instead of resenting them, she healed their injuries, leading some to remain by her side. As her powers grew, she worked to prevent wars among spirit beasts and maintain peace in the Great Star Dou Forest, earning the loyalty of more spirit beasts over time.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					Why is Bi Ji known as the kindest Spirit Beast?
						
				
				
					
						Bi Ji, recognized as the kindest Spirit Beast, is an Emerald Swan with healing abilities. Despite being targeted by other spirit beasts, she displayed no resentment. She would plead for mercy for her defeated predators and treat their wounds. This compassionate behavior led some healed spirit beasts to remain with her, enhancing her reputation for kindness.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					How does Bi Ji's healing ability compare to other spirit beasts?
						
				
				
					
						Bi Ji's healing prowess surpasses other spirit beasts. Her abilities have amplified due to the energy-rich food provided by the beasts she healed. Her life energy amplified after a millennium of cultivation, boosting her healing capabilities. She is recognized for her role in healing wounded spirit beasts during conflicts in the Great Star Dou Forest, with many opting to remain with her post-healing, aiding her development and safety.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					Why is Bi Ji not adept at fighting despite being one of the Ten Great Savage Beasts?
						
				
				
					
						Bi Ji's lack of fighting skills stems from her focus on healing and peacekeeping among spirit beasts in the Great Star Dou Forest. As her abilities developed, she dedicated her efforts to preventing wars and healing injured beasts. Even when targeted by other spirit beasts, she showed no resentment, often healing those who sought to harm her. Her dedication to peace and healing, rather than combat, explains her lack of fighting prowess.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What is the physical description of Bi Ji in her human form?
						
				
				
					
						Bi Ji's human form is characterized by a slender and well-balanced figure with jade-green hair and eyes. She has wings that appear to be crafted from gems, radiating a dazzling, vibrant green filled with life energy. Her enchanting presence is so captivating that it seems to diminish the colors around her. Bi Ji is renowned for being the kindest spirit beast.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom

characters.history:
Bi Ran, Wu Yuhan and Lei Jun participated in the Skysea Tournament. He is the captain of Skysea Academy's secondary team. He and his team met Class Zero during the round-robin round of the spirit master team competition.

At the start of the match, Bi Ran charged straight toward Tang Wulin with Wu Yuhan and Lei Jun behind him. Initially surprised by Wulin's purple spirit ring, they formed a pincer attack on him. Bi Ran was last to clash with Wulin. His Iron Wave Shield combined with his first spirit skill was hit with Wulin's Heavy Silver Hammer, forcing him to take a step back. He was then hit with the golden dragon claw. Bi Ran was sent flying while Bluesilver Grass converged on him. He used most of his spirit power to keep the shield intact. Feeling overwhelmed, he activated his third spirit skill, while the bluesilver grass trapped him. He was continuously assaulted by Wulin's golden dragon claw, pouring spirit power into his shield to keep it from breaking, until the referee ended the match.

Bi Ran struggled to stand up, his right arm still quivering from the strength of Tang Wulin’s strikes. He faintly heard Xie Xie mumble to himself, “Three rings isn’t that great after all.” He nearly coughed up blood at those words.

He is also a skilled tactician, who is constantly thinking of strategies and assessing each situation as it comes. His sharp mind and dedication have earned him awe and recognition from his peers and enemies alike.

He is shown to be shrewd and calculating in the Star Duo Forest Arc, where he considers letting his opponent, Niu Yiwei, live if he paid enough gold in exchange, and bargains to drive their price up further.

He has straightforward character. All he is pursuing is strength.

characters.appearance:
The Bloody Baboons have powerful physical strength, and Bloodlust is their innate skill. Bloodlust allows them to immediately boost their offensive and defensive capabilities. Their heads are their vital point.

Bloody Baboons were soul beasts that were extremely hard to deal with. They moved in packs, even as their individual fighting strength was also relatively formidable. They were known as beings who had bronze skin and steel bones. They had strong defensive capabilities, and they had immense strength powerful enough to strangle a tiger to death with their bare hands. They were highly resistant to soul power of any element, and their black fur, which was as tough as metal, was their best defensive trait. What was even more frightening was their innate skill, Bloodlust: once it was used, their defensive and offensive capabilities would be boosted exponentially, while they would lose the ability to feel pain and would no longer fear death.

Bloody Baboons were naturally cruel and fierce, and they were also very intelligent.

Each stripe was silver, showing strange silver lines. The texture was different. But they were all like grimaces, very penetrating. Even though its body was small, it gave people the feeling of being extremely dangerous.

characters.title: Bluefin Tuna
characters.introText: The Bluefin Tuna was one meter in length, thick and solid. It weighed over fifty kilograms and dark blue colored. The head of a thousand years one was about half a meter.
characters.appearance:
The Bluefin Tuna was one meter in length, thick and solid. It weighed over fifty kilograms and dark blue colored. The head of a thousand years one was about half a meter.

It’s the best kind of fish oil and its flesh was popular for its aroma and delicacy. It had a lot of collagen because it swam in the deep sea, and the area around the cheekbones was packed full of it. The collagen, when combined with its tender flesh, bursts with flavor on the tongue. It was able to nourish the body, limbs and bones.

It was one of the best and most popular dishes in the coastal region like Skysea City. To ensure that the inner meat stayed tender and juicy, it was protected by a thick coating of salt. Furthermore, because the bluefin tuna was bulky, it needed at least a centimeter of coating; any thinner and the taste would suffer, no matter how much shorter the cooking time would be. After cracking a thick layer of salt, it revealed the tender white meat beneath.
