					What is the significance of Bo Saixi's golden crown and scepter in Soul Land?
						
				
				
					
						In Soul Land, Bo Saixi is recognized by her golden crown and scepter. The crown, resembling a halo, complements her golden scepter, forming part of her unique attire that includes a white and red gown with silver adornments. She also wields a silver staff, topped with a purple jewel, for combat and daily use. The precise significance or abilities of these items remain unspecified.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					How does Bo Saixi's calm and collected personality influence her actions in the story?
						
				
				
					
						Bo Saixi, a character in the Soul Land wiki, is recognized for her calm, collected demeanor. Her rationality and responsibility in critical situations, coupled with her fearless defense of her subordinates and territory, contribute to a peaceful region. Her devotion to world protection is evident in her efforts to nurture new leaders and warriors, and her ultimate sacrifice for the chosen Poseidon heir's ascension.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What is the symbolism behind Bo Saixi's ocean blue hair and eyes in Soul Land?
						
				
				
					
						The ocean blue hair and eyes of Bo Saixi in Soul Land represent her profound bond with the sea. Her status as an Ultimate Douluo with a divine spirit martial soul grants her a special relationship with the ocean, enabling her to harness its power. Her blue features, likened to the depths of the sea, mirror her serene aura, composed nature, and the extent of her sea control.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					How does Bo Saixi's tranquil aura impact her interactions with other characters in Soul Land?
						
				
				
					
						In Soul Land, Bo Saixi's tranquil aura significantly influences her interactions. Her calm demeanor, rationality, and kindness earn her respect. She fiercely protects her territory and subordinates, fostering peace. She tirelessly cultivates new warriors and leaders, even selflessly sacrificing herself for Poseidon's chosen heir.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What are some key moments that showcase Bo Saixi's experiences of the ancients in Soul Land?
						
				
				
					
						Bo Saixi, a key character in Soul Land, has deep connections with the ancients. She prays to Poseidon, the sea god, and shares the history of the Ocean and the Sea Tribes' war for control. Poseidon, then at Level 99, traveled the ocean to end this conflict. Bo Saixi also reveals an alternative path to godhood - gaining the approval of a current God who wishes to step down. She informs San that completing Poseidon’s God Trials will make him the Sea God. Additionally, she prepares for a devastating war between Angel, Rakshasa, and Sea.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom

Appearance[]
 	 	 	 		 			 		 		 		 	 
Bo Saixi is an incredibly beautiful woman. She wears a white and red gown with long sleeves, adorned with wrought silver. Her golden crown is shaped like a halo around her head, matching her golden scepter. Her ocean blue hair falls like water down her back and to the ground. Her clear blue eyes seem deeper than the oceans, and their depths seem to encompass the experiences of the ancients.
characters.appearance:
She reached the base of the Sea God Mountain just in time as Tang San pointed out the trap in the Trial to the rest of the group. She praised Tang San for figuring out the secret of the Trial, stating that she would not confirm anything the group had yet to figure out themselves. She agreed to Tang San's request to arrange food and water for the group for the entire year and told them that they could use the water from the Ring Sea. She revealed that she had come to provide Ma Hongjun with the mandatory God-given Soul Ring, as he had reached the bottleneck of Level 60. After Ma Hongjun flirted with her out of habit, she soaked him in the Ring Sea. She explained the God-given Soul Rings to the group and watched over Ma Hongjun while he assimilated one as his 6th Soul Ring. She quickly left for the Sea God Temple after Ma Hongjun's clothes burned to ashes during the assimilation.

Three months into the Trial, she appeared before the group when Tang San reached Level 70 and provided him with the mandatory God-given Soul Ring. She was shocked by his endurance as he increased the limit to 100,000+ years Level. She left for the Sea God Temple when he gained complete control over the energy of the Soul Ring.

She appeared before the group 11 months into the 1st Trial to provide Dai Mubai with the mandatory God-given Soul Ring when he reached Level 70. She informed the group that Bai Chenxiang had gained Purple Level authority by exceeding the limits of Yellow Level Trial.

She monitored Tang San's progress during his final attempt. She commented that the Asura Hell could forcefully break the Sea God's Light. She appeared before the group to provide Ning Rongrong and Zhu Zhuqing with their mandatory God-given Soul Rings after Tang San completed his 1st Trial. She advised them to always work as a group for subsequent trials. She informed the Shrek Seven Monsters that they could visit the Sea God Temple if they defeated her at full strength, which would also indicate the completion of six trials in total.

characters.title: Break Evil Dragon
characters.introText: The Break Evil Dragon belonged to a special Dragon Clan. In fact, the dragon was not under the control of the Dragon God but was considered foreign within the Dragon Clan. It was born and bred in heaven, formed from the condensation of heaven and earth’s vital energy. Although it was part of the Dragon Clan, it was not considered a purebred of the Dragon Clan either. In any case, it was equipped with the ability to break evil.
characters.appearance: It is a giant white dragon.
characters.history: After the Break Evil Dragon awakened from a deep sleep, it met the first ancestor of the Qiangu Clan. It was about to devour the first ancestor but it felt that it was about to die of old age soon so it entered into a contract with the Qiangu Clan. It transformed into a dragon soul that was infused into his Spirit and transformed its ordinary staff spirit into the Coiling Dragon Staff. It would unleash its unyielding spirit regardless of how powerful its enemy was. It was capable of enabling the master of the Coiling Dragon Staff to express abilities beyond himself. The unyielding consciousness of the Unyielding Staff Technique and even the method to damage and control law had all been created after the Qiangu Clan’s powerhouses studied the Break Evil Dragon on the Coiling Dragon Staff for many generations.

characters.history:
He beat up Ma Hongjun because of a prostitute.

He was lured by Xiao Wu to a remote alley before she used her Charm to confuse him, and used her Eight Stage Drop to break several bones in his body. After Xiao Wu is finished, Ma Hongjun goes back to roast his cock.

He called out to E Kao and Tian Ya when they reached the vicinity. He declared his intention on having revenge after he was castrated by Tian Ya.

He, E Kao and Tian Ya joined the border patrol to rob travelers. They stopped an entourage containing Tang San, Ma Hongjun, Tai Tan, Tai Long and four other Soul Kings of the Strength Clan. He became furious when Ma Hongjun revealed he was the one who burnt his cock, and they started fighting.

He was internally injured after Ma Hongjun burned his Heavenly Gauze Twin Covers and tried to flee, only to be forced to continue the fight. He was surprised that Ma Hongjun spared his life. He acted as a transvestite to disgust the entourage into leaving the area.

He was forced to destroy his martial soul and soul power by Qian Renxue. This was later revealed to be a simulation which was the first of three parts of the 8th Trial of the Angel God Trials.
characters.trivia:
Both in the Light Novel and in the Donghua, the Abilities of his first two Soul Rings were only described, but not named.
Thus the names used are tentative.

His Soul Power was close to Level 50 during his introduction, mentioned much later.

His Soul Power by the year 2650 was similar to Ma Hongjun's (Level 57).

In the Donghua, his martial soul was changed from a bra to a pair of claws.

Instead of fighting over a prostitute, Ma Hongjun was trying to stop Bu Le from assaulting a female receptionist from the Great Spirit Arena.

He was tied up on a Pole at the Entrance of the Suotuo City's Martial Soul Branch Hall, with a Confession Letter hanging from his Neck, with Tian Ya and E Kao finding him the next day.
In the Light Novel, he was found by Tian Ya and E Kao just after the Shrek Seven Monsters leave.

His Martial Soul and and Spirit Rings were permanently disabled by Qian Renxue in a simulation as part of the the Judgement.

characters.history:
She encountered the Shrek Seven Monsters and Zhao Wuji in the Star Dou Forest and told them to stop when Ao Sika was about to kill the Phoenix Tail Crest Serpent. She revealed her Soul Rings when she and Meng Yiran revealed themselves to the group. She was shocked to see that Zhao Wuji was a Soul Saint, as she tried to intimidate the group by revealing herself to be Soul Emperor. She respectfully asked Zhao Wuji to give the Phoenix Tail Crest Serpent to Meng Yiran. She told Zhao Wuji that they found the Phoenix Tail Crest Serpent first and had been following it.

She revealed that there were three injuries on the body of the Phoenix Tail Crest Serpent which were caused by her Serpent Cane, after Ao Sika asked her to prove that they had found it first. She revealed that Meng Yiran had reached Level 30 and needed the Soul Ring from it, as high quality Serpent Type Soul Beasts were rare. She revealed her name and stated that her husband was Meng Shu to intimidate Zhao Wuji before stating her assumption that the members of the Shrek Seven Monsters were too young to assimilate a 1,000+ years Level Soul Ring. She asked Zhao Wuji his name seeing that he was shocked at her identity. She was shocked to know Zhao Wuji's identity, and asked him to leave the Phoenix Tail Crest Serpent with her. She asked Zhao Wuji his reason for not leaving the Phoenix Tail Crest Serpent with her. She asked Zhao Wuji to confirm that one of the Shrek Seven Monsters had already reached Level 30. She was shocked to see the configuration of Soul Rings on the Shrek Seven Monsters, before asking Zhao Wuji about the one who had reached Level 30. She proposed to let Ao Sika and Meng Yiran fight to determine the one who would get to kill the Phoenix Tail Crest Serpent. She was shocked to learn that Ao Sika was a Food System Soul Master and asked the latter if he belonged to any Clan. She planned to pull Ao Sika into her Clan to support Meng Yiran after hearing that he was an independent Soul Master. She was shocked to learn that Tang San was already at Level 29 when he proposed to fight in Ao Sika's place, before she agreed to let him fight. She and Zhao Wuji positioned themselves near Meng Yiran and Tang San when their battle changed to a confrontation of Soul Power.

She proposed to Zhao Wuji to act together and separate the Soul Powers of Meng Yiran and Tang San as the latter gained the advantage, admitting the loss. She positioned herself behind Meng Yiran, used her Soul Power as protection and forcefully stopped her Soul Power channeling. She stabilized Meng Yiran and assisted the latter to cultivate a little. She told Zhao Wuji that she would remember the event. She told Meng Yiran that they would talk after finding Meng Shu, before leaving the area to heal Meng Yiran elsewhere.

She along with Meng Shu and Meng Yiran reached Tang San's location after he killed the 2,000+ years Level Man Faced Demon Spider. She told Meng Shu about the previous event. She was shocked that Tang San alone could kill the Man Faced Demon Spider. She stated that it was impossible for them to defeat a 10,000+ years Level Titan Giant Ape, even if they fight together. She told Meng Shu that they had to leave the forest before the Titan Giant Ape gets irritated. She consulted with Meng Shu after Zhao Wuji told the latter about Yu Xiaogang. She remembered her history with Meng Shu when Ao Sika told Meng Yiran to kiss Tang San if she lost. They tried to understand the expression on the faces of the Shrek Academy's group after Meng Yiran proposed the contest.

She was shocked when she observed Tang San's actions of firing the knives. They left the area to find another Soul Beast for Meng Yiran's 3rd Soul Ring. They discussed about the Shrek Seven Monsters after leaving the area.

She was present with Meng Shu at the Tournament. She joined Meng Shu to confront Luo Diyala for attacking children. She was forced to retreat by Yue Guan.

(DONGHUA ONLY) She and Meng Shu use their Martial Soul Fusion, the Serpent Dragon Joint Assault, to fight against Yue Guan for a while, before they are forced to leave after Meng Yiran's life is threatened.

characters.history:
He was only mentioned. As a Level 98 Super Douluo, he had a duel with Level 99 Limit Douluo Qian Daoliu but he was completely suppressed and had injuries inflicted to him. He eventually succumbed to his injuries and died.

Chen Jianjun was a formidable Spirit Master who attained the rank of 98-Super Douluo through his cultivation prowess. Driven by a thirst for formidable opponents, he sought out a renowned swordsman known as "the Immortal Sword." His quest led him to the Western Stone Kingdom, where he spent years among its people. Despite their natural inclination towards becoming Swordmasters, he observed they lacked the resolve for combat, instead treating the sword as a mere tool for crafts and labor.

Upon informing the island's Elder that he couldn't locate the Immortal Sword, Chen Jianjun prepared to depart with his son. However, the Elder revealed another potential adversary who could satisfy his desire for battle: "Angel's Sword," who considered the Western Stone Kingdom a threat. Soon after this revelation, they were ambushed by five Spirit Douluos dispatched by Angel's Sword. Dispatching them swiftly, Jianjun left his son Chen Xin behind to train, setting off on a new journey to confront both Angel's Sword and the Immortal Sword.

Years later, under the Giant Sword Mountain, Chen Jianjun encountered an elderly man who revealed himself as both "Angel's Sword" and "the Sword Immortal." Their clash was fierce and monumental. In a critical chapter of the main story (Manhua Chapter 173), it was revealed that Chen Jianjun suffered a decisive defeat at the hands of the old man, who turned out to be  Qian Daoliu , the esteemed elder of the Spirit Hall and the pinnacle of human cultivation at Rank 99.

characters.appearance:
He was an old man with a prominent nose, deep-set eyes, a stern expression and the three stars of a general on his shoulders was seated upon the main seat. His aura was as deep as the abyss and it felt like he was too profound to be fathomable. The oppressive atmosphere in the command post was mostly coming from him.

The person was dressed in an extremely simple patterned robe. His attire looked to be from the generation when soul devices had not been invented. His silver hair was combed neatly which revealed his high ideals. His hands were clasped behind his back, and he had a rather perplexed expression on his face.

It was an old man with a head full of gray hair. He would come to the sports field at the first glimmer of dawn every day. He brought along a huge broom and would sweep the sports field in front of the academy’s main building. He swept from dawn until the sun was high in the sky before he had completed the sweeping duty. It was the same every day. He was dressed in plain attire as well. It was always the simplest of robes.
characters.personality:
He had a strong sense of justice and moral compass.

He was not only a leader, but he was like a father and a teacher to the War Gods although had always been very strict with them.
characters.history:

characters.personality: She has became insane. Although she is daring to do anything to achieve her goals, she is also very wise.
characters.history:
At a certain point, she did temporarily suspended devouring planets when the Douluo Divine Realm was connected to Douluo Planet. This was not to be erased by true God Kings for her devouring behavior.

It was revealed in SL4 that Abyssal realm was 40% of Crimson Domain's power. When the abyss invaded the Douluo Planet and was devoured by Douluo's life core, it was a blow to her. It took 10,000 years for her to restore her vitality. She launched an invasion into the Dragon-Horse Galaxy in an attempt to swallow the life cores of Long Tianyang and evolve.

She first tried to swallow the life core of the Heavenly Horse Planet but was stopped by Tang Xuanyu, Gu Yuena, and the Seventh Fleet of the Douluo Federation. Though she retreated, she successfully swallowed the life core of the Tianhe Planet with the help of the Yukong Clan. By doing so, she reached the rank of Quasi-God King.

When she attempted to swallow the life core of the Heavenly Dragon Planet the next time, Douluo Federation and Dragon Horse Federation became an ally and resisted her attack. She tried to withstand and absorb the attack power of Douluo Federation’s space fleets to become a God King which destroyed all her divine weapons along with all creatures from the Crimson Realm. She successfully absorbed and became the Crimson God King.

After she became the God King, she launched an attack once more. All out efforts from the Douluo Federation and Dragon Horse Federation were all in vain in front of the true power of the God King. The Super Human Cannon from the fusion of Ling Zichen and Yi Zichen caused a certain degree of damage to her. The Dragon God Transformation from the fusion of Tang Wulin and Gu Yuena also caused some delay to her to let their son Tang Xuanyu to succeed the inheritance of the Dragon God. She was killed in an instant when Tang Xuanyu appeared and used his ultra divine weapon, Dragon God Spear.

characters.title: Cyborg Warriors
characters.introText: Cyborg Warriors are the guards from the Sin Planet, directly under the city lord’s authority and only move around outside the city. No guards are allowed in the city. Their extortion quota is fixed. So, they’re looking for troubles and asking for benefits in the forest outside the city.
characters.appearance:
This was a product of modern technology. Some people would implant soul devices into their bodies in order to increase their strength, allowing them to become a part of their body and achieve the goal of strengthening themselves. These people were known as cyborgs and the soul devices on their body were also known as implants.

From a certain point of view, a cyborg with implants could no longer be considered a normal human being. The Douluo Federation obviously had this technology, but it was only allowed to be used on disabled people. Ordinary people were not allowed to install implants and use them to replace their body parts.

Cyborgs were much stronger than ordinary people. Especially when some soul masters got implants, they even had the combat power of a small mecha. Of course, implants were also divided into different levels and ranks. Powerful implants were also extremely expensive.

Naturally, there were no restrictions like Douluo Federation on the Sin Planet. The implants were very popular here because without strength, there was no possibility of survival. Hence, the weaker ones all had implants. This was also one of the important sources of income for the seven city lords of the Sin Planet. In terms of research on implants, Sin Planet was even ahead of the Douluo Federation.

He is lonely and arrogant, and in his eyes, he can only move forward. His arrogance makes him disdain to cooperate with those so-called teammates at all in the team battles. He also values his life more, not from cowardice, but from fear of the future life of his precious person as a widow.

He is not only powerful, but also extremely calm, not a reckless person. He seems to be a born warrior. In the course of the battle, he can face it calmly no matter what changes.
characters.history:
Big Cat participated in the team battle to earn a lot of money so that he could support his clan which had a lot of ligers with poor health. His wife also suffered a miscarriage and was at a worsened condition. He met Team Shrek in the final 10th battle. He single-confronted Tang San. Many guessed he would win easily but he lost instead. Tang San asked him that if he wanted to become a God, he could spare his life and help him. Afraid of losing his life, he chose to surrender his life to Tang San which means he would become a slave. But Tang San only asked him to become his ally. Not only his almost dying wife, Kitten was saved by Tang San but also all the liger clan members including him were cured by fusing the two conflicting bloodlines into one bloodline. The Liger Clan finally became the ally of Tang San.

Later, he participated in the Ancestral Court Elite Competition with Tang San. He advanced to the final and lost to Mei Gongzi.

After the Ancestral Court Elite Competition, he was backed up by the Golden Lion Clan and successfully broke through to Tier 10.

He also participated in the Battle of the Emperors together with Tang San and Mei Gongzi. He finally revenged the enemy of the Golden Lion Clan, Hong Hong, and fulfilled his promise of getting the God Killing Sword.

Its entire body, that was thicker than water barrels, was covered with greenish-blue scales and there was a pair of huge claws under its belly. characters.appearance:
It was a giant python with a length of more than a hundred meters. Its entire body, that was thicker than water barrels, was covered with greenish-blue scales and there was a pair of huge claws under its belly. The more bizarre thing was that it had a colossal bull head that was at least 4 meters in diameter and eyes about the size of lanterns.

It was a huge azure dragon.

He was a middle age man who is tall, burly and vigilant with a head full of long azure hair draped over his impressively wide shoulders. His eyes were actually azure too. He exuded a solemn aura.
characters.history:
He and Er Ming remained concerned about Xiao Wu's mental state during the five years she stayed under their protection following the end of the Continental Elite Young Soul Master Tournament. To relieve her boredom, he asked Xiao Wu about her experiences in the human world. He became angered when Er Ming mentioned that some Soul Masters had escaped after discovering Xiao Wu and remarked that Xiao Wu's Mother would not have been killed if he and Er Ming had been there, before changing the subject to avoid upsetting her. He and Er Ming then listened to Xiao Wu recount her adventures as a Soul Master.

He and Er Ming became alert when Tang San's Blue Silver Domain expanded into their area, allowing them to detect his foreign Spiritual Power. They immediately launched a spiritual counterattack, which also alerted Tang San to their presence.

He attacked Yue Guan after Er Ming blasted Gui Mei away. He told Er Ming to kill everyone of the group as he applied his Slowing Domain on them. He and Er Ming were restrained by the Bipolar Static Domain due to them underestimating Yue Guan and Gui Mei.

He and Er Ming broke free from the Bipolar Static Domain after noticing Xiao Wu's Sacrifice, then charged toward her, ignoring the exhausted Yue Guan and Gui Mei. He asked Xiao Wu whether her Sacrifice was worth it, and she answered yes. Xiao Wu spiritually informed him and Er Ming of the battle before they attacked the members of the Martial Soul Hall after the Sacrifice was complete. They watched as Tang San saved Xiao Wu's life by feeding her the Yearning Heartbroken Red, then remained by Tang San and Xiao Wu's side.

He agreed to let Tang San take Xiao Wu, telling him to return to him and Er Ming if he encountered any danger in the future. After Tang San left, he and Er Ming discussed Xiao Wu and Tang San.

He and Er Ming were being hunted for over a month by Bibi Dong and six Martial Soul Hall Elders. They were severely injured and poisoned during the pursuit, unable to shake off their hunters despite killing one of the Titled Douluos. As their strength continued to decline, they began to despair over their inability to kill more of their pursuers. Upon sensing Tang San’s arrival, they prepared a stronger counterattack.

They were grateful to Tang San for killing Gui Mei. After he blocked Bibi Dong’s attack, he concealed them inside the Vast Sea Protective Barrier. They used their Slowing Domain at full power to restrain Bibi Dong and her group, supporting Tang San’s Blue Silver Domain. Xiao Wu led them away from the battlefield after Tang San assured her that he would escape.

Xiao Wu encouraged them to hold on, stating that Tang San might be able to detoxify the poison in their bodies. They consoled her, saying that she and Tang San had prevented Bibi Dong from killing them, but the Death Spider Emperor’s poison could not be detoxified. They informed Tang San that their final wish was Xiao Wu’s revival. They were shocked by Tang San’s resolve to revive Xiao Wu when they saw him extract the Soft Boned Rabbit Left Arm from his body. He controlled the Sacrifice to produce the Sky Azure Bull Python Right Arm, which was assimilated into Tang San’s right arm, while the resulting Soul Ring was assimilated into his Blue Silver Emperor as its 9th Soul Ring.

His and Er Ming’s corpses were stored by Tang San inside the Wishful Hundred Treasure Purse before the latter left the Star Dou Forest.
characters.trivia:
In the manhua, the spirit beast is called the Green Ox Python of The Heavens.

Da Ming is considered to be the most powerful Spirit Beast in the Star Dou Forest.

Da Ming calls Er Ming "Second Oldest."

He and Er Ming could have killed Tang San due to their hatred for humans, but the memory transmitted to them by Xiao Wu prevented them from doing so.

Both Er Ming and Da Ming were in love with Xiao Wu, but never tried to steal her away to avoid hurting each other. They eventually agreed to give her up to Tang San, seeing he was truly worthy of her.

Sky Azure Bull Python Da Ming had never completed his long-cherished wish in his lifetime. After sacrificing himself to become Tang San’s spirit ring, he finally succeeded and evolved into Sky Azure Dragon.

Quick Answers
		
		
	
	
			
				
					What role does Dai Weisi play in the Star Luo Empire?
						
				
				
					
						Dai Weisi, an Imperial prince of the Star Luo Empire, is the main successor to the throne. He has a contentious relationship with his brother, Dai Mubai, whom he frequently bullied. His role is prominent during the Continental Advanced Spirit Master Academy Elite Tournament Finals, where he competes against Shrek Academy and is taken aback by Dai Mubai's growth.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					How does Dai Weisi's appearance compare to Dai Mubai?
						
				
				
					
						Dai Weisi looks very similar to his brother, Dai Mubai, sharing long golden hair and a similar face. He is taller than Dai Mubai and has eyes with a purple lustre. Despite these similarities, their relationship is strained due to family customs.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					Why was Dai Weisi arranged to marry Zhu Zhuyun?
						
				
				
					
						Dai Weisi was arranged to marry Zhu Zhuyun since childhood due to the customs of their Royal Family. This betrothal aimed to strengthen alliances within the Star Luo Empire, with Dai Weisi being a prime candidate for the throne.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What is the significance of Dai Weisi's purple pupils?
						
				
				
					
						Dai Weisi's purple pupils are associated with the Purple Demon Eye technique, which enhances vision and spiritual power. This method, linked to the Tang Sect, uses purple qi from the rising sun to confuse or stun opponents and is divided into four stages.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					How does Dai Weisi's personality influence his actions?
						
				
				
					
						Dai Weisi's arrogance and pride shape his actions, leading him to bully his brother, Dai Mubai, and attempt to thwart his growth. His deviousness is shown by leaking opponents' abilities to gain favor. His vanity drives him to alter others' appearances, except for Dai Mubai.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom

He has long golden hair draped over his shoulders and back. He has face with a lazy expression, a pair of pupils with a purple lustre, but not really double pupils. His appearance resembles Dai Mubai to at least seventy percent, only his stature was even taller.
characters.appearance:
He was the Captain of the Main Team of the Star Luo Imperial Academy for the tournament. The team won the 2nd-round match after skipping the 1st round due to being one of the seeded teams. They were matched up against the Shrek Academy's Team in the 3rd round. He tried to undermine Dai Mubai's confidence and mocked the latter for being a playboy. He was shocked to discover that Dai Mubai was a Soul Ancestor and was filled with killing intent. He tasked Zhu Zhuyun with defeating Tang San, while he himself charged to attack Dai Mubai and Xiao Wu.

He was blasted back toward the rest of his team after Xiao Wu counterattacked. He was stunned by the Blue Silver Spike Formation alongside the rest of his team, apart from Zhu Zhuyun. They were stunned once again by the amplified Phoenix Roar Air Strike before they were hit by the White Tiger Meteor Shower. He sobered up by the time Dai Mubai and Zhu Zhuqing used their Hell White Tiger. He was knocked out after his shoulder was broken by the Hell White Tiger's attack. He woke up when the Shrek Seven Monsters won the match.

He was deposed as the Crown Prince of the Star Luo Empire when Dai Mubai becomes a Spirit Emperor, before the latter visits the Shrek Academy five years later.

He remained as the alternative to Dai Mubai as the successor when the latter decided to go to the Sea God Island for training.

characters.introText:
Quick Answers
		
		
	
	
			
				
					What is the significance of Dai Yueheng's golden hair and light blue eyes?
						
				
				
					
						The golden hair and light blue eyes of Dai Yueheng signify his Golden Dragon and Three Eyed Golden Lion bloodlines. These features represent the Golden Dragon's intense golden glow and the Three Eyed Golden Lion's crystal yellow radiance. The blue in his eyes denotes a link to the light dragon race, underlining his potent heritage.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					How does Dai Yueheng's personality contrast with his brother Dai Huabin's?
						
				
				
					
						Dai Yueheng, also known as Yaoheng, is more distant and reserved, contrasting with his brother Dai Huabin's aggressive and envious nature. Huabin's frequent plotting and rage, particularly towards Yuhao, starkly contrasts with Yueheng's calm demeanor.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What role does the small cat with tiger-like features play in Dai Yueheng's story?
						
				
				
					
						Da Mao, a small cat with tiger-like features, is a key character in Dai Yueheng's story. Born with the twin bloodlines of the Golden Lion and Golden Holy Tiger, Da Mao is a member of the Golden Liger Clan. His unique lineage led to his social exclusion. He later allies with Tang San. Da Mao is described as a wild cat with a small frame, greenish-black fur with a tiger-like pattern, and purplish-red eyes.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					How has Dai Yueheng's time in the military with his father influenced his character?
						
				
				
					
						Dai Yueheng's military experience alongside his father, a Titled Douluo, instilled in him a strong work ethic and a drive to overcome challenges. His father's injuries spurred him to shoulder his father's burdens, reflecting his deep love and respect. This upbringing fostered an unyielding character, ready to confront obstacles head-on.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					Who are the other members of the Shrek Seven Monsters that Dai Yueheng is a part of?
						
				
				
					
						During Dai Yueheng's generation of the Shrek Seven Monsters, the other members included Ma Xiaotao, Ling Luochen, Gongyang Mo, Chen Zifeng, Yao Haoxuan, and Xi Xi.
					
					
						Provided by: Community

characters.history:
She is Huo Yuhao 's daughter who appears in SL4.5, and she meets with Yi Chen in Shrek.

Tang Wutong already conceived her when she returned to Douluo in the Great Circle of Gods. Regarding the surnames, according to Huo Yuhao’s dictation, Dai Ying followed Yuhao’s father, Dai Hao, with the surname Dai, and Dai Ying’s younger brother followed Yuhao’s mother, Huo Yun'er, with the surname Huo.

She overheard Dai Ying's father saying he could have been exempt and questioned it. Later on, when selecting a course to take, Yuhao thought she might fit in the Awakening Department. However, she was adamant about joining the Life and Death Department.

During the first test administered by Lan Mengqin, she adapted to it with ease. Her change and aura seemed to be rather smooth and soft. She was disadvantaged due to not being allowed to fly during the second exam. She was in the second round and proposed to race Yi Chen. She was first to leave the shore. As she noticed Yi Chen catching up to her, she tried to attack him, but he dodged, and she ended up spraying the Lake's water into the air and disrupting the other contestants.

As she caught up to him, she unleashed what seemed to be her parent's first Martial Soul Fusion skill. She hit Yi Chen with it, rather embarrassingly tearing his clothes and slowing him down significantly. She ended up finishing in 1st place.

She became the disciple of Ah Dai in the Life and Death Department. She volunteered for it, and despite being discouraged by Ah Dai, she persevered through, wanting to learn the secrets of Life and Death.
characters.trivia:
Dai means "wear, put on, bear, honor, support" (戴).

Ying means "luster of gems" (莹).

When she first met Tang Wulin during the Continental Elite Young Soul Master Tournament, she hated him. She participated in the single, duel and team Competitions. In the single, she was plotted against Tang Wulin in top 32 and she lost.

But later, she fell in love with Tang Wulin who disguised as White Three during the adventure of the Tang Scet to the Dragon Valley.

She went to the Shrek Academy as the exchanged student together with Long Yue. Many people believed Tang Wulin was dead in the Dragon Valley but she refused to believe and waited him. She expressed her feelings towards him during the Sea God Fated Blind Date. But he chose Gu Yue instead.

When Tang Wulin came to the Star Luo Continent as the head of Tang Sect for the negotiation and distribution of the weapons, she asked her father, Dai Tianling, to arrange the marriage proposal to Tang Wulin. But Tang Wulin declined the proposal which led to the Battle of the Five Gods.

After the negotiation was over, she drugged Tang Wulin to have sex. But Gu Yuena appeared suddenly and they made love for the entire night, she was under the bed crying the whole night instead.

When the Abyssal Plane invaded the Douluo Continent and started the war, she helped the Douluo Continent with the navys of the Star Luo Continent though it was not effective.

characters.introText: The Dark Demon Evil God Tiger is extremely powerful. In Douluo Continent legends, it is a mutation that occurred as an Evil God descended on the White Tiger, turning the White Tiger's light attribute into darkness attribute, producing black wings of corruption, as well as scorpion tail-like Evil God Hook.
characters.appearance: It is a black giant tiger, pure black all over, without a speck of other color. It is no less than eight meters long, bulging with muscle, maybe weighing more than three thousand jin. The 'king' mark on his forehead is also black, but a different shade of black from its fur, a black as gloomy as mist. Its red eyes brim with viciousness, but the most peculiar feature is its tail. The tail is much longer compared to ordinary tiger-type Spirit Beasts, it greatly resembles a scorpion's tail formed from countless bone joints with a giant hook attached that is oriented upward, and it glints with a cold light.
characters.history:
It was an old enemy of the Forest Kings, Da Ming and Er Ming. Both sides had fought several times, and even if Da Ming and Er Ming successfully drove it out of the Star Dou Forest, that was all they managed. They couldn’t directly kill it. After Da Ming and Er Ming sacrificed themselves for Tang San, it came back to the Star Dou Forest. But it met with Tang San and fought with him. It died in the end and became Tang San’s spirit ring.

After it was killed, its soul crystal traveled through time and space to the world of Zhou Weiqing, and was just absorbed by this unawakened, dying Heavenly Jewel Master. Zhou Weiqing was gifted by its soul crystal and obtained six elements (Evil, Darkness, Space, Time, Thunder, Wind) alongside the Strength attribute, saving his life and propelling the youngster's talents to a heavenly envied genius. Consequently, the Evil element law of the Heavenly Jewel Plane caused Zhou Weiqing to take the virginity of some women and attracted others, leading him to form a harem. As Zhou Weiqing improved his cultivation, various Dark Demon Evil God Tiger abilities were inherited. Eventually it entered the Douluo Divine Realm alongside Zhou Weiqing similar to Tian Meng. Unexpectedly, its most hated enemy Tang San became the "boss" of its bearer Zhou Weiqing.

It participated in the Battle of the Gods to create the Great God Circle.

characters.appearance:
When they're born, they were less than a meter long with pitch black fur.

At the thousand years, they were more than 3 meters in length. They were very burly, and their black fur seemed to emit a slight golden glow. Their claws were extremely long as they reached more than two feet in length.

At ten thousand years of cultivation, they are a terrifying figure greater than seven meters in height.
characters.personality:
According to Shrek Academy’s records, Dark Gold Terrorclaw Bears grew up the fastest during their first year. They would grow to about two meters tall after their first year, and would possess fearsome fighting strength. They would enter a plateau in growth afterwards, and their growth speed would be normal. However, they were complete carnivores, and their abilities would be boosted in tandem with the strength of the soul beasts they consumed.

A Dark Gold Terrorclaw Bear with three thousand years of cultivation was often not even a thousand years old, because it relied on consuming other soul beasts to boost its own strength. Naturally, the prerequisite was that they didn’t meet any soul beasts more powerful than they were, as there were hardly any mighty soul beasts that would just let them grow up.

characters.history:
As one of the four great heavenly kings of the Holy Spirit Cult, the Darkness Hummingbird exploited his daughter as a tool to be used. He had cultivated his daughter since young. He ensured she would be accepted into Shrek Academy as a student to gather information.

After years, he fought with Wu Zhangkong for his daughter and ended killing her. He left without helping his own daughter.

During the war between the Douluo Continent and the Abyssal Plane, he was confronted by Wu Zhangkong who always wanted to avenge his lover. He was finally killed by Wu Zhangkong.

characters.title: Datura Snake
characters.introText: The Datura Snake is a serpentine Spirit Beast. They have incredibly aggressive character, and they are practically guaranteed to launch an attack when they encounter humans.
characters.appearance:
The Datura Snake’s cultivation age is related to the size and color of its body. Prior to the 1000 years rank, its body is ink green and grows 1 meter in length for every 100 years of cultivation. When it approaches the 1000 years bottleneck, its body length is close to 10 meters.

Once it breaks through the 1000 years bottleneck, its power condenses as it continuously casts off its skin. This process changes the body colour from ink green to pink, while the body length shrinks back to 1 metre. Afterwards, its body length begins to increase once again at the rate of 1 meter per every 100 years of cultivation. Once it reaches the 2000 years, the Datura Snake will shrink back again while its pink color gains a darker shade.

A 10,000+ years old Datura Snake will change into a yellow color.

characters.introText: The Envoy of the Death God is the leader of the group of bandits, known as the Envoys of the Death God (Hand of Death).
characters.appearance: He was shrouded in a black robe. He had a slender build, and his facial features were hidden.
characters.personality: He was an evil and crafty person, who also had a cautious nature.
characters.history:
He first appeared when the Shrek Guardians went on a mission to eliminate the Hand of Death bandits from the Ming Dou Mountain Range. During this period of confrontation between the Envoys of the Death God and the Shrek Guardians, he caused the dead bodies of the bandits to explode leading to the death of Yao Haoxuan and gravely injuring the official team of the Shrek Seven Devils. This wasn’t the first time he’d encountered such a situation, but as long as he didn’t die, it wouldn’t take long before a brand new bandit group would rise up once more.

After Elder Xuan showed up to the tragic scene, he retreated and took Huo Yuhao hostage, which incentivized Electrolux to intervene by temporarily taking control over Huo Yuhao's body. Electrolux made him lose control over his 12 corpse slaves by making them regain a portion of their former consciousness; he couldn’t even make them self-destruct. All of the 12 corpse slaves launched frenzied attacks towards the Envoy of the Death God, who’d been temporarily stunned by Huo Yuhao’s Spiritual Shock under Electrolux's control. He suffered an evil backlash and in this short period of time, he was ripped apart by his twelve corpse slaves. When he died, the 12 corpse slaves began to rot and disappear at an astonishing rate.

characters.appearance:
Deep Sea Demonic Whale King - Beast Form

The Deep Sea Demon Whale King had a body over two hundred meters in length- Its tail alone was 200m. Its whole body shined like a sapphire and there were two huge eyes on its head. However, its left eye had been damaged which made the whale blind on its left side. Each eye had a diameter of nearly three meters.
characters.history:
He first appeared and attacked Tang San’s group when they entered his territory after Haider plotted against them. At the end of the rope, Tang San tried his best to devour his enemy with his Eight Spider Lances before he died. But, Poseidon’s avatar appeared and scared away the Deep Sea Demonic Whale King so that he failed to kill them.

But, he and Tang San had to cross their path since he was one of Tang San‘s Sea God Trials to become the Sea God. He also strived to become a Demon God after defeating Tang San. Another wish he had was to become the new Sea God after devouring Tang San. In the end, he was killed by Tang San with the help of Asura God’s power and gave him a pure Golden spirit ring which already filled with Asura God's divine power.
characters.trivia:
Although he could possibly rival the strength of the Angel God during the events of SL1, Snow Empress stated that Deep Sea Demonic Whale King still wasn't Di Tian’s match.

Tang San thought that although the Deep Sea Demonic Whale King was stronger than Bo Saixi, he wouldn’t be stronger than Qian Renxue. But it was mentioned that it was wrong and in the deep sea, God ranked Qian Renxue might not be able to kill him.

After his duel with Poseidon, he completed the process of turning a dragon which didn’t mean he became a dragon but should mean that he successfully crossed one million years instead.

characters.personality: She was as gentle as a lamb and lived a carefree life in the sea where no one dared to come near at the time under her husband's protection. After her husband died, the deeply-ingrained hatred and heartfelt longing remained in the depths of her heart even after ten thousand years!
characters.history:
She opened the abyssal passage and guided the abyssal creatures not to help them, but to use them to complete her terrifying Blood River God Killing Great Array which was full of evil. She killed all the clansmen of Demon Spirit Great White Shark Clan except Bai Xiuxiu who went out to help Tang Wulin to kill the Evil Spirit Orca King. She fought with Chen Xinjie and also killed him that led the suicide of Long Yeyue.

She was supposed to be the Sea God Seventh Trial of Tang Wulin but she retreated without a fight because she thought it was Tang San who once killed her husband. Later, she faced Tang Wulin after he had passed all the Sea God Trials and knowing the death of Chen Xinjie and Long Yeyue. She appeared in the third battle of Human and Abyssal Plane and fought with him. She was finally killed by Abyssal Sage who used her to descend into the Douluo Continent instead of being used.

It possessed an extremely aggressive nature, just like the Man-Faced Demon Spider, and it was considered an outcast in the world of soul beasts.
characters.appearance:

characters.title: Devouring Dragon
characters.introText: The Devouring Dragon, also known as a Mini-Tyrant Dragon, is very similar to Tyrant Dragon in terms of its appearance. However, it is easy to tell them apart from their sizes. A Devouring Dragon is very good at defense, but it is different from a Tyrant Dragon in the sense that its innate spirit skill was extremely domineering. Its innate spirit skill is called Devouring Heaven and Earth. It is innately bloodthirsty; it can recover its energy and evolve by devouring its enemy after killing it.
characters.appearance:
Devouring Dragon has thick scales covering its entire body. Its lower limbs are extremely thick, and it moves in an upright manner. Its upper limbs are short and small. It only has three fingers on each limb, but it has sharp claws that shines with cold light.

The thick scales on its body are dark blue, and there are at least three layers of them. They looks extremely thick. It is four meters in height, and seems extremely muscular. Its head is also unusually large, and occupies one-third of its body. It drags a thick, three meter-long tail behind it.

characters.title: Diamond Baboon
characters.introText: A Diamond Baboon was a power-type soul beast, one of the most powerful ape-types. In fact, its strength even surpassed that of the Titan Giant Ape. The greatest of Diamond Baboons stood over forty meters tall, a true goliath of a beast with strength to match its size. They were hailed as one of the freaks of the soul beasts world. Few possessed greater physical strength than a Diamond Baboon, and it could definitely claim to be the king of strength. The Diamond Baboon’s might lay in its pure strength, and strength led to terrifying speed. This earned it the title of King of the Jungle.
characters.appearance:
A Diamond Baboon was a power-type soul beast, one of the most powerful ape-types. In fact, its strength even surpassed that of the Titan Giant Ape. The greatest of Diamond Baboons stood over forty meters tall, a true goliath of a beast with strength to match its size. They were hailed as one of the freaks of the soul beasts world. Few possessed greater physical strength than a Diamond Baboon, and it could definitely claim to be the king of strength. The Diamond Baboon’s might lay in its pure strength, and strength led to terrifying speed. This earned it the title of King of the Jungle.

Yet the Titan Giant Ape remained superior, not because of its strength or abilities, but because of its intelligence! In comparison, the Diamond Baboon was all brawn and no brains, and therein lay its greatest weakness.

Ape-type soul beasts were generally smarter than other soul beasts, but Diamond Baboons went against this trend. In fact, some wondered if they even had brains. They possessed violent dispositions, were fond of slaughtering others, and seemed to act based on instinct alone. Apart from their monstrous strength, they only possessed a single soul skill, Enrage! As the name suggested, it produced effects similar to that caused by Xu Lizhi’s red bean buns. Unlike bloodthirst, however, Enrage only boosted the user’s body, not their soul power, and even granted a greater boost of strength that could reach as high as fifty percent!

As a power-type soul beast, it possessed formidable strength, speed, and physical defense. In exchange for having no long-ranged abilities, it was unparalleled at close quarters.
characters.history:
A Diamond Baboon appeared when Tang Wulin, Gu Yuena, Xie Xie, Xu Lizhi, Xu Xiaoyan, Yue Zhengyu, and Yuanen Yehui challenged the Tower Attack at the Spirit Pagoda. It got angry as soon as it saw Yuanen Yehui and charged right at her without any regard to its own safety.

A Diamond Baboon was within the crowd of ten thousand year old spirit beasts that the Thorn Dragon brought with him when he returned to Tang Xuanyu. It chose not to become any of the Shrek Academy first grade students spirit soul. But it made itself the Contracted Spirit Beast of Tang Xuanyu by absorbing the Gold Silk Ape.

characters.introText: She is not very beautiful in the dragon’s aesthetics, but in Dragon God's heart, she is the most beautiful one.
characters.appearance: She is not very beautiful in the dragon’s aesthetics, but in Dragon God's heart, she is the most beautiful one.
characters.personality:
She is gentle and kind. Since the Dragon God's childhood, she was always behind him, paying for him silently. Silently supported everything about him.When he was in danger, she would appear beside him desperately, guarding him with everything she had, silently gave everything for him.

Dragon God brought her to his side and announced that she was the mistress of the dragons, His regular wife, and His only wife. But she has never changed, she is still so gentle and kind. Taking care of everything about him, she also silently made her own contribution to the Dragon Race.

When he was tired, she still guarded him. Every moment, she encouraged him and gave Dragon God the warmth of home.
characters.history:
She was by Dragon God side before he became the lord of the clan. She was older than him. He used to call her Elder Sister all the time. The love in his youth was accompanied by age Grow and increase. Even if there are so many powerful clansmen and so many outstanding female dragons, they have never obtained him from beginning to end. Because in his heart, there is only the “Elder Sister” who treated him every time because of fighting with the tribe when he was a child.

Later, the Dragon God grew up, and he began to show his bloodline talent. The bloodline evolved in continuous sublimation, step by step surpassing the strong in the clan, and defeated one opponent after another, relying on himself. Powerful strength also holds a place in the universe. He is the first existence among the dragon clan to break through to the level of the God King. To this end, he has worked hard for thousands of years. When he became the God Realm, he was finally recognized by all the dragon races and became a true God King.

When he succeeded in establishing the Divine Dragon Realm and became a generation of God Kings, he held her hand in front of all the dragons and walked onto the throne of the hall. Amidst the envy and jealousy of all the outstanding female dragons, Dragon God brought her to her side and announced that she was the mistress of the dragons, his regular wife, and his only wife.

However, her bloodline level is too weak compared to Dragon God. Therefore, despite the union, the descendants were never born. This was also secretly criticized by the powerful dragons, and it was not until the dragon gods discovered that they were together, and in anger, they killed several broken mouth dragons before they were finally suppressed. No one dared to say more.

The problem of the Dragon God having no descendants still arises. As the Lord of the God Realm, although theoretically speaking, it will last forever. However, during that period, the Divine Dragon Realm was not strong enough, and it often faced the invasion of other God realms.The dragon god leads the group of dragons to fight. Rumors are still inevitable. What the dragons worry most is, if one day, their king falls, what should they do? Who can inherit the mantle of the Dragon God?

The internal instability of the dragon clan, how could she as the Dragon God's Wife not know? Therefore, without the Dragon God’s knowledge, she secretly forcibly became pregnant. When the Dragon God discovered it, it was too late

After all, she gave birth to a Son for the Dragon God, but the powerful Dragon God bloodline drained all of her life force at the last moment. No matter what the Dragon God uses, he cannot prolong her life. The mother of the dragon clan/The Wife of the Dragon God was wiped out because of her life exhaustion.

characters.introText:
Quick Answers
		
		
	
	
			
				
					What is the significance of Du Busi's dark green hair in the Body Sect?
						
				
				
					
						The dark green hair of Du Busi in the Body Sect symbolizes his exceptional ability to manipulate every aspect of his body and release his inherent power. His spirit domain amplifies his body's overall capabilities. His transformation into a green entity further underscores his mastery over poison.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What character traits make Du Busi an arrogant and prideful person?
						
				
				
					
						Du Busi is arrogant, prideful, reckless, headstrong, obstinate, and conceited. Despite these traits, he is also an honorable man. Elder Mu noted that his temperament was similar to that of his elder brother, Du Bisi.
					
					
						Provided by: Community
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What role does Du Busi play in the Busi Bodies Academy?
						
				
				
					
						Du Busi, recognized as Body Douluo, held a significant role at the Busi Bodies Academy. His unique ability allowed him to control every aspect of his body, utilizing muscle contractions for defense and controlling his limbs for powerful attacks. He seldom relied on his rings, instead, his spirit domain amplified his bodily capabilities. Du Busi also possessed the ability to control poison. His elder brother, Du Bisi, previously led the Ontology or Body Sect.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					Who is Elder Mu in relation to Du Busi and how does he view him?
						
				
				
					
						Elder Mu, recognized as Mu En and one of the Twin Holy Dragons, had an encounter with Du Busi, an evil soul master. Elder Mu apprehended Du Busi but chose to release him, given that his evil aura was not intense and he hadn't inflicted harm on others. He offered Du Busi an opportunity to live, advising him to remain concealed.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom

Description[]
Du Busi was the Sect Master of the Body Sect.
characters.appearance:
He was a huge old man. His dark green hair flowed freely behind his back. He didn’t have hair on top of his head. In other words, he was bald.

This elder’s complexion was red and smooth like a baby’s. He didn’t have many wrinkles either. The only way one could tell his age was through the look in his dark green eyes which seemed as if he had experienced the vicissitudes of life.
characters.personality: He was an arrogant and prideful person. According to Elder Mu, he was reckless, headstrong, obstinate and conceited but he was still an honorable man and had the same temper just like his elder brother, Du Bisi.
characters.history:
He first appeared at Shrek Academy with other powerful soul masters to confront Elder Xuan after he beat up two of his Sect members, Lang Ya and Yu Tao when they decided to forcefully take Huo Yuhao to the Body Sect during the Continental Advanced Academy Soul Dueling Tournament.

He was one of the Titled Douluos to participate in the assassination of Xu Tianran. He sacrificed his life to severely injure him. Before his death, he gave Huo Yuhao the methods of Body Sect cultivation.

characters.introText: Du Leisi is an old man and member of White Tiger Duke's Mansion. He has accompanied the White Tiger Duke through several different fronts, and obtained outstanding achievements. Besides his great power, he also possesses the title of Viscount in the Star Luo Empire.
characters.appearance: He's an old man with a cold expression.
characters.history: He’d accompanied the White Tiger Duke through several different fronts, and had obtained outstanding achievements. Besides his great power, he also possessed the title of Viscount in the Star Luo Empire. The reason he calls Dai Yueheng ‘young master’ rather than ‘young duke’ was due to the Dai Family’s strict rules. For one to inherit the duke’s title, they needed to be the most outstanding out of all of the the Duke’s consanguineous sons. Therefore, even though he’d already grown up, Dai Yueheng still needed to rely on his own ability to inherit the title. This was also why the other two sons of the Dai Family were trying so hard to become stronger, as they were the only two sons of the Duke’s main wife. As for the sons of concubines, only Huo Yuhao existed. However, at this point, even the White Tiger Duke himself must’ve forgotten about him.

characters.introText:
Quick Answers
		
		
	
	
			
				
					What is Dugu Bo's title in the world of Douluo?
						
				
				
					
						In the Douluo universe, Dugu Bo carries the title of Titled Douluo, specifically known as the Poison Douluo. He is globally acknowledged as the top Poison Spirit Master. His prowess is unparalleled among Titled Douluo in group attacks, though he shows less skill in solo battles against his peers. Professionally, Dugu Bo serves as the Adviser and Honorary Dean of Shrek Academy, an Elder of Tang Sect, and an Adviser to the Heaven Dou Empire.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					Why are Dugu Bo's one on one combat skills considered lacking?
						
				
				
					
						The perception of Dugu Bo's combat skills as lacking stems from his cautious and intelligent approach. He refrains from needless risks, including battles with stronger opponents. His combat style, like his personality, is comparable to a snake, only retaliating when provoked. He avoids conflict unless directly threatened or offended.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What role does Dugu Bo play in Shrek Academy?
						
				
				
					
						In Shrek Academy, Dugu Bo is a pivotal character. Initially intending to eliminate Tang San, his plans change when Tang San identifies his health issue. Dugu Bo then serves as a protector, alerting Tang San to potential dangers from Martial Hall. He also engages in combat, leveraging his full power to counter Shrek Academy. When Tang San is targeted, Dugu Bo intervenes, demonstrating his allegiance to the academy and its students.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					How does Dugu Bo's physical appearance contribute to his character?
						
				
				
					
						Dugu Bo's appearance is a key part of his character. He's slender, with dark green hair and beard. His emerald-like eyes and grey robes give him a phantom-like aura. A green snake tattoo wraps around his left arm, neck, and torso, symbolizing his association with poison and snakes. His appearance mirrors his ruthless, cunning personality.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What is the significance of Dugu Bo joining the Tang Sect?
						
				
				
					
						Dugu Bo's choice to join the Tang Sect signifies a change in his independent lifestyle. He had never been part of a clan due to his love for freedom. Yet, he joined Tang Sect, reflecting his trust in San. Dugu Bo planned to retire in the Tang Sect, indicating he viewed it as a secure and comfortable place. His inclusion brought his expertise to the sect, potentially enhancing its strength.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom

Appearance[]
(Light Novel) He is slender, and looks like a javelin. His hair and beard are dark green, and his eyes shimmer like emeralds. His whole presence feels illusory, like a phantom. He wears only simple and unadorned grey robes with his hands tucked into his sleeves. He has beryl eyes, green fingernails, eyes as ice cold and vicious as a viper.
characters.appearance:
His poison abilities are so powerful, they've been killing the people around him all his life. When he was young, his father was killed by his poison. When he was an adult, his wife was killed. When he was older, his son died of the poison as well. Dugu Yan, his granddaughter, is his only living family member.

At some point in time he was saved by Xue Xing, who recruited him as the Guardian Douluo of the Heaven Dou Empire. His association with Xue Xing earned Dugu Yan a spot to study in the Heaven Dou Imperial Academy.

Due to the nature of his Martial Soul, he had been suffering a long time from its poisonous effects. The poison in his body causes aching over two ribs, one that gradually grows stronger, flaring up around noon and midnight and late every night, approximately around midnight, the top of his head and heart feeling like they're stabbed with thousands of needles, causing his whole body to spasm for at least an hour.

characters.introText: Dugu Xin was a slender boy with long, light teal hair. He is the only child of Dugu Bo and his wife, and the eventual father of Dugu Yan.
characters.history: Dugu Xin was born on the day his mother died, from the combined stress of childbirth and prolonged exposure to her husband's poisonous body. He was raised by his father, and trained harshly his entire life to counteract the terrible side effects of their family's signature spirit, the Jade Phosphor Serpent. Despite his training, and the help of his increasingly powerful father, Dugu Xin spent much of his life in terrible pain. By the age of 15, all five of his major organs had been infested with poison, but he was able to survive to the age of 35 thanks to his father's obsessive love and care. He died on the very day Dugu Bo attained Rank 90, the threshold that would have allowed him to save his son's life.
characters.trivia:
Dugu Xin was born with poisonous hued hair, meaning he'd already been poisoned in the womb like his daughter, Dugu Yan.

Dugu Xin was one of the few people Dugu Bo ever loved, and was mourned more than even his wife.

Dugu Xin told his daughter stories about how Dugu Bo's poison was the best in the world, which is why he trained so hard to be like him.

characters.appearance:
In the Light Novel, she possesses a pair of green eyes that gives people a somewhat strange feeling, with a kind of bewitching charm. Her fingernails are painted green. She has red hair.

In the Manhua, Dugu Yan has long teal hair, and blue eyes.

In the Donghua, Dugu Yan has short purple hair and green eyes.

A rhomboid green scale is formed on her forehead when she activates her Jade Phosphor Serpent. Both of her legs fuse together, becoming a thick serpent tail, relying on the serpent tail to prop up her upper body, causing her to sway.
characters.personality:
Dugu Yan used to be a happy, innocent child, who brought light and love into the lives of her family. However, after her father's death, Dugu Yan became more twisted and aloof, and more sure of her own superiority over others, believing only the strong could survive in this world. She is powerful, sensuous, and cold towards others, only reverting to her relaxed and happy personality around her beloved grandfather, the Poison Douluo Dugu Bo.

She looks down on others, especially the weak and those not born to nobility. She has a sharp tongue and a quick temper, known for quick retorts and devastating comebacks. She is very proud, and hates to lose, but has a great respect for those she acknowledges as stronger than her, such as her teacher Qin Ming. She is shown to hold back her tongue around her teacher, acknowledging his superior strength and knowledge, and openly wants to become a Spirit Emperor before age 34, just as he once did.

She cares greatly for Yu Tianheng and is also one of the only people other than Tang San to get along with Dugu Bo.

characters.trivia:
In the Light Novels, it is implied Dugu Yan could be pregnant by Yu Tianheng, just before the Continental Advanced Spirit Master Academy Elite Tournament.

Dugu Yan's personality seems to have changed drastically after the death of her father, going from sweet happy and kind to an aloof, poisonous arrogance.

Dugu Bo plotted to trick Tang San and Dugu Yan into entering a relationship with each other, even joking about using an aphrodisiac on Tang San to ensure Dugu Yan became pregnant, since that would make a shotgun wedding a necessity. He only dropped the matter after Tang San pointed out Dugu Yan was already in a relationship with a talented Spirit Master, and could be pregnant already. This conversation was cut from the Manhua and Donghua.

Her legs do not fuse into a serpent tail in the Donghua.

The Manhua never explicitly confirmed Dugu Yan's relationship with Yu Tianheng, despite it being common knowledge in the Light Novels, mentioned in passing by several members of the Heaven Dou Imperial Team, Tang San, and Dugu Bo himself.

Dugu Yan was born with the poison hued hair, unlike her initially brown haired grandfather, as a result of being poisoned in the womb.

He and Tian Ya were searching for Bu Le when they were called out by the latter. He was shocked to see Bu Le's injuries.

He, Bu Le, and Tian Ya joined the Border Patrol to rob travelers. They stopped the entourage containing Tang San, Ma Hongjun, Tai Tan, Tai Long, and four other Soul Kings of the Strength Clan to rob them. He and Tian Ya attempted to assist Bu Le but were restrained by Tang San from interfering.

He was surprised by Tang San's abilities despite the latter's lack of Soul Rings and decided to retreat. Together with Tian Ya, he used his strongest abilities in an attempt to rescue Bu Le and escape.
characters.trivia:
His 6th Soul Ring was not a 10,000+ years Level Soul Ring in the Novel.
His 6th Soul Ring was a 10,000+ years Level Soul Ring in the next chapter itself.

In the Donghua, it was a 10,000+ years Level Soul Ring.

His Soul Power was lower than Tang San's (Level 66.5).

characters.appearance:
The Earth Fire Lizards were fire attributed soul beasts that thrived in large groups. Ordinarily, a pack would consist of only 20 to 30 lizards. They were vary in size with the smallest being over a meter. Their skin was brown with faint red stripes that glowed and circulated like magma.

They possessed extremely strong defenses and lived near volcanoes. They had their own fire element abilities and were said to be able to transform into Earth Fire Dragons when they surpassed ten thousand years in cultivation. Earth Fire Dragons were of the Eastern Dragon species and were considerably strong soul beasts. On some occasions, they would evolve into Earth Fire Scarlet Dragons, its True Dragon Form. The Earth Fire Lizards’ only flaw was that they were not very fast.

characters.title: Earth Fire Python
characters.introText: The Earth Fire Python is a subspecies of Dragon. When an Earth Fire Python cultivated to the ten thousand-year level, it had abilities equal to a Flood Dragon. It was powerful and had shocking defensive capabilities.
characters.appearance:
The Earth Fire Python is a subspecies of Dragon. When an Earth Fire Python cultivated to the ten thousand-year level, it had abilities equal to a Flood Dragon. It was powerful and had shocking defensive capabilities.

Its Torso Bone was the best of the best and was suitable for fire type soul masters. It could greatly increase one’s control of the fire elements and at the same time, strengthen one’s bloodline. For a suitable soul master, it was enough to become one’s core.

characters.title: Earth Fire Scarlet Dragon
characters.introText: The Earth Fire Scarlet Dragon was a mutated soul beast, evolving into the True Dragon. Its foundation was a Earth Fire Lizard mutated into the Earth Fire Scarlet Dragon instead of evolving into Earth Fire Dragon after ten thousand years. Scarlet Dragon was the prime example of a real dragon with fire properties; it was between a Fire Dragon and a Red Dragon.
characters.appearance:
It was a gigantic soul beast. It towered over 30 meters and dragged along a huge tail. It stood upright, its pair of thick, strong legs and its tail supporting its body, making it look as though it was capable of running extremely fast. And there was even a pair of small wings on its back. The wings were not large and were obviously insufficient in supporting it to fly. Regardless, they continued to flap as it moved. This movement reduced the sluggishness of its movements by lessening its body weight to a certain degree and allowing it to move at its current speed.

It had a gigantic mouth, gigantic eyes, a slender body, and spikes that extended from the back of its head all the way down to the end of its tail. It was covered with dark red scales that caused the air around a 10 meter range of its body to be distorted with ripples. One could only imagine the high temperature emitted from its body.

characters.appearance:
The Silverwolf is a special spirit beast in the Sun Moon Empire. It’s a metal element soul beast, but it’s not any ordinary soul beast. It’s very difficult to deal with, and it feeds on Mithril. The Silverwolf needs to consume massive amounts of Mithril to break through its own bottleneck like humans need a soul ring when they reach a bottleneck.

The Silverwolf is so strong because it possesses the six elements of water, fire, earth, wind, light and darkness. It’s able to unleash the powers of any element depending on its will. That’s why it’s so difficult to deal with. There’s practically no element that can curb it. Once it becomes a Silverwolf King after ten thousand years, another rare and advanced element will be added to it. At the hundred thousandth year, it will gain another element. The only fortunate thing is that it can only unleash the most basic attacks of each element, even though it possesses many elements.

There’s a rumor that a Silverwolf King appeared in the past with cultivation of ten thousand years. It managed to resist two Soul Douluo before escaping with injuries. A Silverwolf Emperor with a hundred thousand year cultivation and above has never appeared before. A Silverwolf’s fur and bones are extremely useful materials for making soul tools with, while their meat is quite delicious, and can strengthen the body of a spirit master.

characters.title: Emerald Swan
characters.introText: The Emerald Swan is a healing-type soul beast. They are extremely rare, even on the verge of extinction, and are considered rarer than Dark Gold Terror Claw Bear
characters.appearance:
The Emerald Swan is a healing-type soul beast. They are extremely rare, even on the verge of extinction, and are considered rarer than Dark Gold Terror Claw Bear

The primary reason for their near-extinction is their extreme fragility, especially during their youth. As they are filled with natural and pure life energy, they are easily targeted as prey and considered great nourishment to any soul beast. Because they leak life energy during their infancy, they often must rely on the protection of other powerful soul beasts or groups to survive.

Adult Emerald Swans possess "heaven-defying" healing capabilities, allowing them to secrete Life Water (生命之水) to treat the injuries of other beasts. Being the bird typed soul beast, they carry a thin bloodline of Phoenix and, with sufficient cultivation, can amplify their phoenix bloodline.

Their biological makeup is defined by a concentration of pure life energy. A hundred-thousand-year-old Emerald Swan contains life energy comparable to a piece of Life Gold roughly 1,000 times smaller than the swan's actual body. Consequently, their soul rings and soul bones are of such immense value to healing-type soul masters that they have historically been the target of organized human hunting plans.

As someone whose days were numbered, this was his top priority. However, the type of heaven-and-earth treasure used in this formula was incredibly rare and precious. Spirit Beast[]
This was an existence like a mountain, black fur all over its body faintly twinkling with luster under the weak illumination of the moon and stars, even though it was four limbed, the height of its shoulders already at least outstripped seven meters. If it stood upright, the height might be over fifteen meters. On the surface, this was an existence both like monkeys and a black orangutan, apart from a pair of lantern sized eyes with a yellow crystal like luster its whole body was pitch black. At night if it didn’t move, even its body would look indistinct.
This big animal’s body was actually too majestic, its condition unimaginably awesome, not only was its body enormous, but all over its entire body it was covered with muscles even tougher than granite, protruding like little hills.

characters.personality:
He appeared before the group from the Shrek Academy after noticing Xiao Wu's energy signature. Zhao Wuji respectfully offered to lead the students to retreat, which he ignored. He was attacked by Zhao Wuji to let the students escape. He was then targeted by the rest of the students. He roared when his head was pushed back by the attack from Zhao Wuji, to blast the students back. He jumped and positioned himself between the students, ignored the rest and caught Xiao Wu. He became serious when Zhao Wuji used the Vigorous Vajra Bear Avatar, and punched the latter back after evading the attack, before he roared once again. He retreated taking Xiao Wu into the forest, ignoring Zhao Wuji's attack.

He was told by Xiao Wu that he should not have found her and taken her. He stopped rushing and put Xiao Wu on the ground. He was told by Xiao Wu to observe from a distance if he detected her energy signature in the future, before he was asked about Da Ming. He was told by Xiao Wu to guard her during the process of generating her 3rd Soul Ring. He roared to prevent the other Soul Beasts from entering the range of 1 km.

He left Xiao Wu in the vicinity of the Shrek Academy's group and left.

He and Da Ming remained concerned about Xiao Wu's mental state during the five years she stayed under their protection following the end of the Continental Elite Young Soul Master Tournament. He warned Xiao Wu not to leave the Star Dou Forest for the time being, as she had not yet reached the Mature Phase and they could protect her better within the forest, especially since some Soul Masters had escaped after discovering her presence. He and Da Ming then listened to Xiao Wu recount her adventures as a Soul Master.

He and Da Ming became alert when Tang San's Blue Silver Domain expanded into their area, allowing them to detect his foreign Spiritual Power. They immediately launched a spiritual counterattack, which also alerted Tang San to their presence.

Xiao Wu was on his shoulders when the Martial Soul Hall's group reached the center of the Star Dou Forest. He let Xiao Wu climb down, blocked Gui Mei using his Gravity Control Domain while ignoring Yue Guan's attack. He suddenly decreased the gravity around Gui Mei to disorient the latter before blasting him away. He charged at the group after Da Ming applied the Slowing Domain on them and told him to kill them all. He and Da Ming were restrained by the Bipolar Static Domain due to them underestimating Yue Guan and Gui Mei.

He and Da Ming broke free from the Bipolar Static Domain after noticing Xiao Wu's Sacrifice, then charged toward her, ignoring the exhausted Yue Guan and Gui Mei. Enraged, he created a shockwave at the site of Xiao Wu's Sacrifice, destroying everything nearby. Xiao Wu spiritually informed him and Da Ming of the battle before they attacked the members of the Martial Soul Hall after the Sacrifice was complete. They watched as Tang San saved Xiao Wu's life by feeding her the Yearning Heartbroken Red, then remained by Tang San and Xiao Wu's side.

He tested Tang San's character by telling him the conditions to completely revive Xiao Wu and was satisfied with his response. He was hesitant to let Tang San take Xiao Wu with him. After Tang San left, he and Da Ming discussed Xiao Wu and Tang San.

characters.trivia:
Er Ming calls Da Ming "Big Brother".

In the Donghua, he noticed the signal flare created by Tang San out of Yan's attack, but not mentioned in the Novel.

He and Da Ming could have killed Tang San due to their hatred for humans, but the memory transmitted to them by Xiao Wu prevented them from doing so.

Both Er Ming and Da Ming were in love with Xiao Wu, but never tried to steal her away to avoid hurting each other. They eventually agreed to give her up to Tang San, seeing he was truly worthy of her.

His soul rings were mentioned as 8 Black and 1 Red in SL2 Chapter 415-1.

characters.title: Eternal Tree
characters.introText: The Eternal Tree is the nucleus or the life core of the Douluo Planet. It was born when Tang Wulin planted the Life Seed, which was given to him by the Ancient Golden Tree, in the deepest and center part of the Sea God Lake. After absorbing the energy from the Abyssal Plane, it evolved and was named as the Eternal Tree.
characters.appearance:
It is a gigantic tree, an existence like a sky pillar, towering into the clouds and straight into the sky. Its height is at least more than 3,000 meters, even taller than the Spirit Pagoda's Headquarter. It is green gold in color with green gold lights floating around. More importantly, the lower part of the trunk actually grows in the huge circular blue lake called the Sea God Lake. The trunk and roots of the tree can be seen from miles away and the giant crown akin to a huge umbrella is as large as the entire Sea God Lake.

There are many buildings surrounding the Sea God Lake. Between the buildings, there are all kinds of trees and plants, and a little further away, there is an endless forest. In the middle of a large forest is a circular city, called Shrek City.
