characters.title: Evil Dark Demon
characters.introText: The Evil Dark Demon was the Leader of the Pirates in the Kind Death God World. As their leader, he slaughtered passing merchants on the sea and committed many evil deeds with the other pirates.
characters.appearance: He was dressed similarly to Ge Lisi, and he also covered his whole body with a large black cloak. He was very tall, and his strong body was faintly visible under the cloak. There was no fluctuation of magic elements in him, and he was not a magician.
characters.history: After he tried to escape with the other pirates during a fight with Ge Lisi, Huo Zhanji and the other members of the Blue Silver Team triggered a side mission to annihilate all the pirates. He was killed by Huo Zhanji in a single move.

Quick Answers
		
		
	
	
			
				
					What makes the Evil Emperor one of the strongest spirit beasts?
						
				
				
					
						The Evil Emperor's strength among spirit beasts is due to his superior spiritual power, ranking first among the top 10 Great Beasts. His reign as Overlord of the Evildemon Forest in the Sun Moon Empire and his lifespan of nearly 800,000 years further attest to his power. His control over fortune, which is desired by other emperors, and his influence over the fate of the monster-spirit continent, ensuring their dominance, contribute to his strength.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What is the significance of the Evil Emperor's 81 tentacles?
						
				
				
					
						The Evil Emperor is a massive being with a single blood-red eye and 81 tentacles. Each tentacle, about 500 meters long, glows with a bright-silver light and has an eye similar to the Evil Emperor's. These tentacles enhance the Evil Emperor's formidable presence and powers.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					How long has the Evil Emperor lived and where does he reside?
						
				
				
					
						The Evil Emperor, identified as Evileye Tyrant, has a lifespan of around 800,000 years. His residence is in Soul Land, recognized for his potent capabilities and his rank as a 3rd Class God.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What is the appearance of the Evil Emperor?
						
				
				
					
						The Evileye Tyrant Emperor, or Evil Emperor, has a unique and intimidating appearance. His body resembles a human, but his face is lizard-like, covered in colorful flakes that can burst into fragments. His eyes, always in motion, emit an eerie light. As a spirit beast nearing 800,000 years in cultivation, he possesses vast spiritual power.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What is the spiritual power of the Evil Emperor compared to other Great Beasts?
						
				
				
					
						The Evil Emperor, or Evileye Tyrant Emperor, is the most powerful spirit beast in terms of spiritual power. With nearly 800,000 years of cultivation, he can utilize numerous spiritual-type spirit skills. Among the top 10 Great Beasts, he ranks second but surpasses all in spiritual power. He reigns as the Overlord of the Evildemon Forest in the Sun Moon Empire.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom

It was a colossal blood red eye with a diameter of more than 300 meters. There was a total of eighty-one tentacles that poked out from him, each of them around five hundred meters long, and wriggling in the air. It was like a dark-red whip. characters.personality: Being the second strongest spirit beast, he was very arrogant and had complete trust in his strength. He also didn’t want to be bothered with unimportant things. Moreover, he wasn’t some kind soul.
characters.history: After his son Evileye Tyrant King was killed by Huo Yuhao, he tried to avenge him. But Huo Yuhao escaped. He later met Huo Yuhao who came to destroy the Holy Spirit Cult and fought with him. He thought he could kill him. But in the end, he was killed and became the 9th spirit ring of Huo Yuhao. He also gave him the external spirit bone, an external vertical eye. Being close to the age of 800,000 years, his consciousness resided in the spirit bone although he was killed. When Huo Yuhao inherited the position of God of Emotions, there were only six spirit souls and needed one more for seven emotions. He eventually became the seventh spirit soul.
characters.trivia:
His 800,000 years Thunder Tribulation was about to happen before he was killed by Huo Yuhao. He wasn’t confident of successfully making it through even if he was at his peak.

Although he became the seventh spirit soul of Huo Yuhao, he wasn’t summoned like other six spirit souls to fight other gods later on.

characters.title: Evil Eye
characters.introText: The Evil Eye is a very powerful soul beast. An Evil Eye with cultivation exceeding ten thousand years could be considered an Evileye Tyrant. Their abilities differ greatly depending on their cultivation. Evileye Tyrants are very special because they can only produce skulls and no other Spirit Bones.
characters.appearance: These Spirit Beasts have very strange appearances. They drift in the air and look like something akin to a balloon, with a huge eye in the center taking up most of their body. They also have long tentacles that hang from their body, which supports their body in the air. Behind their eyes are their mouths.
characters.history: They originally didn’t exist in the Douluo Continent, they are natives of the Sun Moon Continent. A few thousand years ago, the strongest Evileye Tyrant, known as the Evileye Tyrant King, once entered the Great Star Dou Forest. At that point in time, Daydream was also in the Great Star Dou Forest. There was a huge fight between the Evileye Tyrant King and the Beast God Di Tian, who is one of the Ten Great Savage Beasts. The two beasts fought for three days and three nights before the Beast God managed to defeat the Evileye Tyrant King due to his superior cultivation. At that point, the Evileye Tyrant King tried to kill Skydream before he left. However, the voice of a mysterious existence suddenly sounded and scared him off.

After it was killed by Tang San, it became the spirit ring of his Clear Sky Hammer and gave a right arm spirit bone that was later absorbed by Dai Mubai.

characters.title: Evil Soul Master
characters.introText:
Quick Answers
		
		
	
	
			
				
					What dark methods do Evil Soul Masters use to gain power?
						
				
				
					
						Evil Soul Masters employ dark methods like using infant remains, draining soul energy from others, and sacrificing human blood to gain power. These practices boost their cultivation speed but often result in mental instability and martial soul distortion. The more talented a soul master, the more destructive they become on this path.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					How do Evil Soul Masters differ from regular Spirit Masters?
						
				
				
					
						Evil Soul Masters differ from regular Spirit Masters due to the corruption of their martial souls, which often belong to categories like blood-sucking or undead-like. This corruption accelerates cultivation speed but risks sanity loss. They use dark methods to boost strength, leading to faster Spirit Power development than regular Spirit Masters, though cultivation becomes harder at higher ranks.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What is the role of darkness in Evil Soul Masters' abilities?
						
				
				
					
						Darkness is central to Evil Soul Masters' abilities, enhancing their strength through dark methods like draining soul energy or human sacrifices. These practices enable powerful techniques, such as 'Heavenly Demon Devour,' which absorbs life force. However, this reliance on darkness often distorts their martial soul, leading to mental instability.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					Why do Evil Soul Masters develop Spirit Power faster?
						
				
				
					
						Evil Soul Masters increase their Spirit Power faster by using dark methods that boost their cultivation speed beyond that of normal Spirit Masters. Despite this advantage, advancing to higher ranks becomes difficult. The accelerated growth often causes distortion in their martial souls, potentially affecting their mental stability.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What are the consequences of using dark methods for Evil Soul Masters?
						
				
				
					
						Dark methods for Evil Soul Masters speed up cultivation but distort the martial soul, causing severe mental effects. Many become bloodthirsty or overwhelmed by darkness. The power boost can lead to massive casualties, like a Soul Emperor who destroyed a village. Methods include using infant remains, draining soul energy, and human sacrifices.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom

Description[]
The Evil Soul Masters are Soul Masters with Evil or Darkness element type Spirit, but they use a dark method to increase their strength. These dark methods are for example: use the remains of an infant to cultivate, drain a Spirit Master's body of their soul energy, sacrifice the blood of humans, or etc. These methods of training allow the Dark Spirit Masters to develop their Spirit Power much faster than the normal Spirits Masters, even spirit beast turned human are not as fast. But it becomes harder for them to cultivate the higher rank they reach. Also they are stronger than normal spirit masters at the same cultivation rank.

characters.title: Evil Spirit Orca
characters.introText: The Evil Spirit Orcas were oceanic Spirit Beasts. They were regarded as one of the top overlords of the ocean  together with the Demonic Whale and Demon Spirit Great White Shark. They were all extremely savage fellows of the ocean. Besides the Deep Sea Demonic Whale King who could awe them somewhat, they had always been rampaging without fear in the ocean. And besides the Deep Sea Demon Whales, the strongest would be the Evil Spirit Orcas. Unlike the Demonic Whales, they lived in flocks. The Evil Spirit Orca flock had around three hundred overall, approximately two hundred adults.
characters.appearance:
Adult Evil Spirit Orcas are twenty to twenty five meters long that is twice the size of the Demon Spirit Great White Sharks. They have robust bodies, sharp teeth, as well as formidable abilities of all kinds. One Evil Spirit Orca is enough to fight two of Devil Spirit White Sharks to a standstill.  There are blue-black stripes on their bodies that act as highly effective camouflage in the sea. What is more terrifying are the powerful auras that they emit.

When they reach the hundred thousand years, they grow over a hundred meters in length. The stripes on the body become dark red and the body emanates thick blood essence fluctuation.

characters.history:
She possesses a martial soul mimicry. If the first soul ring that a soul master obtained was identical to their martial soul, there was a chance that he or she could cultivate a martial soul projection. A martial soul projection wouldn’t give too much of a power-up to a soul master; it mainly changed a soul master’s fighting style. An ordinary beast soul master would use their martial soul to strengthen a particular area of their physical body, then fight using that. On the contrary, a soul master who had a martial soul projection would command their projections to fight for them. The comparative load on their bodies would be lighter, and this made it easier for their companions to protect them. However, there were very glaring flaws to this fighting style. This is because their physical bodies would be comparatively weaker. Thus, it was necessary for a soul master to carefully command their projection to protect themselves. Fei Yuyan, who possessed the Blaze Tiger, should’ve been assault-type soul masters. However, the fact that her clan was relatively powerful made it so that she chose to cultivate a martial soul projection during the earliest parts of their cultivation. This allowed her to become a control-type soul master instead, and made her part of the ‘Twin Mistresses of Fire and Ice’ with An Lengye.

She had originally competed against An Lengye for the position of vice-captain, but she finally understood that the gap between them was simply too vast during the match against Shrek Academy.

characters.history:
Feng Ling first appeared at the Underground Soul Engineer Competition of the Sun Moon Empire, where she met Huo Yuhao and attempted to recruit him as a Holy Son for the Holy Spirit Cult. In her capacity as Deputy Cult Master, she also presented an award to Huo Yuhao.

She participated as the second fighter in the 1v10 gambling battle between the Sun Moon Empire and Huo Yuhao, where she was ultimately defeated and captured.

During the final confrontation at the Holy Spirit Cult headquarters in Evildemon Forest, Feng Ling faced Tang Wutong and was completely overpowered, forced to retreat repeatedly under the overwhelming difference in their strength. In a desperate gambit, Zhongli Wu activated the Holy Spirit Cult's forbidden secret technique, fusing his and Feng Ling's abilities by burning vast quantities of resentful spirits they had accumulated. This fusion temporarily elevated Zhongli Wu to Limit Douluo level attack power, but the technique proved unsustainable due to rapid energy depletion.

Ultimately, Zhong Liwu fell to a joint attack by Huo Yuhao and Tang Wutong. Soon after, Feng Ling perished alongside him.

characters.introText: Feng Xiaotian is described in the Light Novels as a handsome person.
characters.appearance:
Feng Xiaotian is described in the Light Novels as a handsome person.

In the Manhua, he's a slender, fair skinned young man with flowing black hair, and teal eyes. He wears crisp, white clothing, and carries himself with the air of a noble. Feng Xiaotian often carries a single red rose to better pose with, often placing it in his mouth to make dramatic entrances.

In the Anime, Feng Xiaotan has windswept silver hair, and violet eyes. He wears teal and black battle robes.

With the activation of his Martial Soul a layer of faint cyan light rushes out of his body. Along with the appearance of the cyan light, his body clearly change. With the sound of cracking bones, his muscles and bones swell simultaneously, his body growing larger. His long hair is also rendered cyan, and most peculiarly, a wolf’s head protrudes from his left shoulder.

In the manhua, Feng Xiaotian's hair turns white, and he's surrounded by vicious gale winds.
characters.personality:
Feng Xiaotian is a cheerful person, often encouraging others, interacting happily. He also has a single minded dedication, a straightforward personality, and good sense. He's incredibly vain, proud, and somewhat shallow.

He's also known to be quite devious when it comes to his own goals, even going so far as to leak the battle abilities of his opponents to their enemies to further his own relationship with Huo Wu.

In the anime, he's seen adjusting the appearances of everyone he sees, making them prettier versions of themselves. Dai Mubai was the only one not subject to this treatment, getting a fistbump instead.
characters.history:
Following the Blazing Academy's Team's defeat against Shrek Academy's Team, he arrives at the resting areas of the Blazing Academy members, promising to take revenge on their behalf. He pointed out that although Tang San was immune to fire, he may not be immune to wind. He was confronted by Huo Wu about his feelings for her, and was told that she would date him if he defeated Tang San.

He encouraged the Shrek Academy's Team before their match against the Blue Sunshine Academy's Team and told them not to lose before facing his team. He explained his reasoning to his teammates causing them to be speechless. He tried to console Huo Wu after the host's comments during the introduction for the match. He was shocked when the Shrek Academy's Team broke the Seven Asura Dreamland, only to be consoled when Tang San declared that it was not a Martial Soul Fusion.

He was depressed when his team was matched up against the Shrek Academy's Team, but the latter forfeited the match due to injuries. He continued visiting the Shrek Academy's Team for pep talk before every match. He hinted to the Shrek Academy's Team that the team from the Martial Soul Hall Academy was too strong. He watched the match between the Shrek Academy's Team and the Skywater Academy's Team commenting that he only managed to defeat the latter by blowing them off the stage.

He apologized to Huo Wu for not getting the chance to defeat Tang San in the Preliminaries, and assured her to defeat the latter in the Qualifiers.

He witnessed Huo Wu kissing Tang San after the end of the sixth round and was infuriated.

He proposed to Tang San to decide the match between their academies in a single bout after they were matched up in the 13th Round. He told Tang San that the losing party won't bother Huo Wu in the future, only to be told by Tang San that he had no relationship with her. He consulted the rest of his team before entering the stage for the fight against Tang San.

He briefly introduced himself to Tang San before the start of the fight. He exchanged a few blows with Tang San before initiating his Storm Wind Demon Wolf’s Thirty Six Successive Chops. The first two of his chops were tested by Tang San, before he was countered by the Clear Sky Hammer after the fourth chop. He was suppressed by the Disorder Splitting Wind Hammer and broke his own wings before the 19th chop to save himself. He was shocked to hear the identity of the Clear Sky Hammer and admitted the loss for the Godwind Academy's Team. He was surprised when Tang San insisted that he had nothing to do with Huo Wu.

During the journey to the Martial Soul City he apologized to Huo Wu for his loss against Tang San, before they discussed about the team from the Blazing Academy joining the team of the God Wind Academy for the Finals. He pointed out that the tournament committee would not allow them to merge teams. He promised to accompany Huo Wu and told her that he won't make decisions for the rest of his team. The convoy from the Heaven Dou Empire was ambushed along the way to the Martial Soul City 10 days into the journey. He led his team to block the ambush.

He realized Ning Rongrong's identity after the ambushers were forced to retreat, as his team was nearby, and was shocked that she was still hidden by the Shrek Academy.

He participated in the first rounds of the finals, and his team won easily due to having Soul Ancestors from the Blazing Academy mixed in. The team skipped the 3rd round as the highest-placed team after Shrek Academy's Team from the Heaven Dou Qualifiers still active in the tournament. He was shocked to see the full Shrek Seven Monsters lineup facing the Main Team of the Star Luo Imperial Academy in the 3rd round and that they were all Soul Ancestors.

He witnessed the Shrek Seven Monsters defeat the Main Team of the Star Luo Imperial Academy and the Martial Soul Hall Academy's Team defeat the Heaven Dou Imperial Academy's Main Team. The team advanced to the 5th round after easily winning their 4th-round match. He tried to hide from Tang San after the latter realized that God Wind Academy's Team had colluded with the Martial Soul Hall Academy's Team to exhaust Shrek Academy's Team before the Grand Finale.

God Wind Academy's Team forfeited the three-way match after Shrek Academy's Team forfeited. Assisted by Huo Wu, he flew up at the start of the match against Shrek Academy's Team. He used his Storm Wind Demon Wolf’s Thirty Six Successive Chops to stop the Shrek Seven Monsters from completing their Seven-in-One Martial Fusion but was knocked out of the stage by a single blow from Tang San's Clear Sky Hammer.

He arrived at Shrek Academy as the leader of the Four Elements Academy, formed by combining the Blazing Academy, God Wind Academy, Sky Water Academy, and Thunderclap Academy. Choosing a time when Flender, Yu Xiaogang, Liu Erlong, and Zhao Wuji were away, they defeated Shao Xin, Lu Qibin, and Li Yusong. Failing to recognize Tang San's new appearance, he spoke only to Ma Hongjun. He felt threatened by Oscar when the latter arrived. He challenged the Shrek Seven Monsters to a 4-v-4 battle, stating that Dai Mubai, Tang San, and Zhu Zhuqing were absent, before noticing that Xiao Wu was not well. After consulting with the others, he, Huo Wu, and Huo Wushuang stepped forward. He was shocked when Tang San revealed his identity. He explained that the Four Elements Academy wanted to rent space within Shrek Academy for its students after recently moving to Heaven Dou City. He was shocked by the Soul Rings of Tang San's Blue Silver Emperor. From the start of the battle, he, Huo Wu, and Huo Wushuang were suppressed by Tang San.

He was prevented from using his Storm Wind Demon Wolf’s Fifty Four Successive Chops twice by Tang San, causing him to waste Soul Power. He admitted defeat after Tang San threatened to use the Disorder Splitting Wind Hammer. He told Huo Wu and Huo Wushuang to lead the others back, but allowed Huo Wu to stay for the meeting. He admitted that the Four Elements Academy caused trouble to draw out the Shrek Seven Monsters and revealed his intention to rent space. He revealed that the Thunderclap Academy lost 80% of its strength due to the destruction of the Blue Lightning Tyrant Dragon Clan, while the other three elemental academies lost more than 40% of their teachers and students after refusing to join the Martial Soul Hall. His words garnered Ning Rongrong's sympathy, but Tang San refused his offer. He and Huo Wu left Shrek Academy with the intention of visiting again to meet with Flender.

The Four Elements Academy was forced to merge into the Shrek Academy due to the presence of Gu Rong and Dugu Bo during the meetings with Flender.

He participated in the Continental War and led the Spirit Masters of the Shrek Academy (erstwhile Four Elements Academy) into the battle to block the Spirit Masters of the Martial Soul Empire after Tang San destroyed Bibi Dong's physical body along with a portion of the walls of the Jialing Pass using the Sea God Trident, lowering enemy morale.
characters.trivia:
His appearance doesn't change during his Martial Soul Activation.

He led the Soul Masters of the Shrek Academy to support Xue Ye's retreat.
He was not mentioned during the coup.

In the novel, he was the first person to show his own self created spirit ability, while in the manhua, the Shrek Seven Devils already created and used their own self created spirit abilities.

In the manhua he is more straightforward about his feelings toward Huo Wu.

characters.title: Fifteen Ton Ant
characters.introText: The Fifteen Ton Ants or Thousand Catties Ants are a kind of spirit beast with extremely tenacious vitality. Their defensive capabilities are outstanding, capable of resisting attacks. Moreover, their strength is extremely outstanding, far disproportionate to their size. As a kind of Spirit Beast, they have no spirit abilities of their own.
characters.appearance:
Ten-year cultivation Fifteen Ton Ants would be around ten centimeters long, with just one pair of teeth that could break solid things. Hundred-year cultivation Fifteen Ton Ants won’t be more than twenty centimeters. Finally, at thousand-year cultivation, they have the chance to grow to one chi. If Fifteen Ton Ants cultivate past ten thousand years, they grow to be around two chi. At thirty thousand years they reach one meter.

Ninety thousand year Fifteen Ton Ant has a three-meter-long body that is covered with a dull golden carapace, with six solid and powerful segmented legs. On its head are six eyes, two large and four small, that release a dark green light. Each has a pair of huge transparent wings on their backs, clearly able to fly. There are also two protruding sword-like teeth and at the same time two solid forelimbs, a bit like the giant claws of scorpions, but not completely, even more like three needles tied together. Swinging them left and right, besides the dull golden color, they also have a particular green layer.

characters.personality: He was scheming and selfish. But later his personality changed.
characters.history:
He wanted to monopolize the Tree Ancestor Body and denied Jin Miaosen to inherit the true power of Tree Ancestor saying she was a girl. When Tang San who disguised as Jin Miaolin appeared, he also objected. But later he obediently followed Tang San who created miracles again and again.

He was sent to the City of the Fiery Sunflower Clan after Tang San’s proposal of the Blue Gold Tree Clan as a neutral clan was successfully approved.

characters.title: Flame Lion
characters.introText: The Flame Lions or the Blazing Demon Lions were one of the strongest soul beast races on land. They had powerful abilities to control fire element. They are very good at both melee and long-range attacks. The difference between the cultivation of 1,000 years and the 100 years is that the flame rising from the 100 years is red, while the flame rising from the 1,000 years is orange.
characters.appearance:
The Flame Lions or the Blazing Demon Lions were one of the strongest soul beast races on land. They had powerful abilities to control fire element. They are very good at both melee and long-range attacks. The difference between the cultivation of 1,000 years and the 100 years is that the flame rising from the 100 years is red, while the flame rising from the 1,000 years is orange.

The head lion of a pack was the Flame Lion King that was equivalent to a thousand-year soul beast. As for the remaining lionesses, every one of them had the cultivation of a hundred-year soul beast at least, if not a thousand-year level. They were able to become so powerful simply because they had very few natural predators in the forest.

characters.title: Flame Lion King
characters.introText: The Flame Lion King is the king of soul beasts. It is a fiery lion with fiery red hair and a distinct flaming mane, which is extremely dazzling. Just standing there, there is a feeling of flames rising all over its body, with even a thousand year old Flame Lion King able to distort air with the flame from its fur.
characters.appearance: The Flame Lion King is the king of soul beasts. It is a fiery lion with fiery red hair and a distinct flaming mane, which is extremely dazzling. Just standing there, there is a feeling of flames rising all over its body, with even a thousand year old Flame Lion King able to distort air with the flame from its fur.
characters.history:
During the Freshmen Assessment, Huo Yuhao scared one into fleeing, absolutely suppressing it with ultimate ice.

During the Riot Ascension Platform of Spirit Pagoda, Tang Wulin’s group encountered a 1,000 years Flame Lion King with its kins.

During the Beast Fighting in the Forest Luo Planet, a 10,000 years Flame Lion fought against Liu Feng and lost.

characters.title: Flame Lion King (SL5)
characters.introText: He attended the special high level meeting, held by Wang Qing when Lin Ximo came to the Kerry City to fight. He didn’t support Wang Qing.
characters.appearance: It is a flame lion.
characters.history: He attended the special high level meeting, held by Wang Qing when Lin Ximo came to the Kerry City to fight. He didn’t support Wang Qing.

characters.title: Flash Leopard
characters.introText: It is a flash leopard that is slender, about two meters high, but not majestic. There is a faint gloomy light in its narrowed eyes, and the fangs under the lips protrude downward. The seemingly thin body has strong muscles, showing strong vitality.
characters.appearance: It is a flash leopard that is slender, about two meters high, but not majestic. There is a faint gloomy light in its narrowed eyes, and the fangs under the lips protrude downward. The seemingly thin body has strong muscles, showing strong vitality.
characters.history: He participated in the Kerry City's Collision Competition. He won four games in a row but was killed by Tang San who was a human vassal.

characters.title: Flash Leopard King
characters.introText: He is not far from the god level, and he has always been hoping to lead the ethnic group to a higher level after breaking through the god level. He is also extremely cautious in everything.
characters.appearance: It is a flash leopard.
characters.personality: He is not far from the god level, and he has always been hoping to lead the ethnic group to a higher level after breaking through the god level. He is also extremely cautious in everything.
characters.history: He was assassinated by Tang San and Mei Gongzi.

characters.introText: He is a middle aged man in his fifties. He is tall and his face is very characteristic, chin somewhat prominent, cheek bones very wide, in addition a bit aquiline nose. He gives off a somewhat devious feeling. On his face is a set of black framed crystal glasses, frames with a kind of rigid squares. He has an average figure.
characters.appearance: He is a middle aged man in his fifties. He is tall and his face is very characteristic, chin somewhat prominent, cheek bones very wide, in addition a bit aquiline nose. He gives off a somewhat devious feeling. On his face is a set of black framed crystal glasses, frames with a kind of rigid squares. He has an average figure.
characters.personality: He is a deeply prideful person. He is very strict but also cares for each of his students. He is selfless when it comes to love. He is considerate of others to a certain degree. However he also cares much for money, not hesitating to find ways to earn it by putting others in embarrassing situations.
characters.history:
He was resting on his chair when Tang San and Xiao Wu enter his shop. He told Tang San that piece of the Plate Crystal Gold was priced at 100 Gold Soul Coins after the latter asked about it. He told Tang San and Xiao Wu to either buy it at that price or leave the shop. He increased the price to 200 Gold Soul Coins after Tang San paid 100 Gold Soul Coins. He stated the final price at 500 Gold Soul Coins after Tang San asked him if he wouldn't change it further.

He offered Tang San to pay 200 Gold Soul Coins before paying the rest at 10 Gold Soul Coins per month with a 10% interest. He recognized the Twenty Four Moonlight Bridges on Tang San and asked him about it. He offered the Plate Crystal Gold to Tang San for free after realizing that the latter was Yu Xiaogang's student. He was handed over 200 Gold Soul Coins by Tang San along with the promise of monthly payment for the remainder. He inwardly asked Yu Xiaogang if the latter won't hide from him this time as his student had come for the Shrek Academy.

He arrived when Tang Hao challenged Zhao Wuji, and was called out. He signaled Zhao Wuji to shut up before activating his Owl and revealing his Soul Rings as respect to Tang Hao addressing the latter with his Title. He was complemented by Tang Hao for establishing the Shrek Academy before he tried to diffuse the situation. He complied when Tang Hao told him to stand aside. He covered his eyed not daring to look at Tang Hao beating up Zhao Wuji. He was cursed at by Zhao Wuji for standing aside when he was asked. He told Zhao Wuji that if Tang Hao really had bad intentions, they would had died even if both of them joined forces. He told Zhao Wuji that the latter was lucky to get instructions from a Titled Douluo who was similar to him.

He called the students to assemble the next day. Tang San and Xiao Wu recognized him as the owner of the Shop in the Suotuo City, who tried to scam them. He heard Ao Sika telling Tang San that he was famous for holding grudges and glared at him. He welcomed the students to the Academy and told them to hand over the fees to Li Yusong for the year. He instructed Dai Mubai to inform the new students about the regulations of the Academy, and told every student to rest and prepare themselves to their peak, before instructing Ao Sika and Ning Rongrong to follow him as they were exceptions. He reminded the rest to prepare themselves as they may even die. He ignored Tang San and Xiao Wu staying back and told Ao Sika and Ning Rongrong to run 20 laps around the village. He told Tang San to follow him after Ao Sika and Ning Rongrong left for their task. He asked Tang San about Yu Xiaogang. He was given a letter from Yu Xiaogang, before he stated that the latter had finally thought of contacting him. He told Tang San not to let Yu Xiaogang down.

He asked Ao Sika whether he and Ning Rongrong had completed the training task. He asked Ao Sika that he wanted to know whether the both of them completed it, after the latter stated that he did it. He sealed Ao Sika's Soul Power and told him to run another 20 laps for lying to him for Ning Rongrong's sake, before asking the other students about the reasoning. He stated that Ao Sika lied to him, and lying was one of the worst habits. He asked Ning Rongrong whether she finished the task given in the morning, before stating that she ran to Suotuo City, had a meal, roamed around before returning to find Ao Sika. He told Ning Rongrong that the punishment for her actions if she had done the same in the battlefield was death. He told Ning Rongrong that she had two choices, first, to be expelled from the Academy, second, to obey the rules of the Academy and stay. He told Ning Rongrong to leave the Academy when she started arguing with him. He ordered Dai Mubai to pack Ning Rongrong's belongings and get her to leave using any means necessary. He told Ning Rongrong that even though Seven Treasure Glazed Tile Pagoda was the best among the Auxiliary System Martial Souls, it would be humiliated by her. He told Ning Rongrong that every other student in the Academy was stronger than her, and they would be more effective on the battlefield, she could only serve as cannon fodder. He gave Ning Rongrong the examples of the other students to compare to her, before asking Zhu Zhuqing about her goal for coming to the Academy. He revealed that Ao Sika had Innate Full Soul Power as a Food System Soul Master, when Ning Rongrong tried to drag the latter down. He told Ning Rongrong that Ao Sika could possibly surpass the Seven Treasure Glazed Tile Clan to become the best among the support class. He told Dai Mubai to stop when the latter asked him if he could carry out the earlier order. He told Dai Mubai to find Ao Sika and relay to him that the punishment was cancelled, and let him comfort Ning Rongrong. He took the remaining students to Suotuo City for their first class in the Great Spirit Arena of the City. He told the new students about the general curriculum the Academy would follow. He told the new students about the general information of the Great Spirit Arenas and told them that they need to reach the Silver Soul Badge before graduation. He ordered Dai Mubai and Ma Hongjun to inform the new students about their record in the Great Spirit Arena.

He told the new students about the classifications of matches, before leading them to register for the fights. He left the new students with Dai Mubai and went to the betting center of the Great Spirit Arena to bet on the students.

He asked about Oscar after not seeing him in the Plaza the next day. He told Tang San to call Ao Sika to the plaza as the class required him. He asked Ao Sika if wanted to run laps again as punishment. He congratulated Ao Sika on behalf of the Academy for reaching Level 30. He told the students that the topic of the class was to consume at least one of the Sausages produced by Ao Sika. He told the new students that it was part of the adaptability training for them, as they may even be required to consume insects in the future. He told Ao Sika to start producing Sausages.

He told Zhu Zhuqing that if she would have to complete the task if she wanted to defeat Dai Mubai in the future, when she was the only one reluctant to consume the Sausages, revealing to her that he knew about their backgrounds. He told the students to treat Ao Sika as their logistics supply in the future, before telling them to prepare themselves for the next day, as Zhao Wuji would lead them to the Star Dou Forest for Ao Sika to obtain his 3rd Soul Ring; Zhao Wuji won't step in unless necessary as it would be an experience for all of them.

He was told about the events of the Star Dou Forest by Zhao Wuji after the latter returned. He proposed that next time there would be four teachers accompanying the students for their hunting of Soul Rings. He and Zhao Wuji were perplexed about the identity of the Soul Beast that could induce fear to Er Ming. He told Yu Xiaogang to help him teach the students, after they discussed about Ao Sika's 3rd Soul Ring. He stated that they would have to wait for Tang San to reach Level 40 for him to accompany the latter to hunt for Soul Rings.

He asked Yu Xiaogang if he was implying that the Eight Spider Lances was a Soul Bone. He mentioned that it was a pity that Liu Erlong was not there, when Yu Xiaogang decided to stay in the Shrek Academy. He told Yu Xiaogang that he would travel the continent after the students had graduated, before asking the latter to accompany him. He and Yu Xiaogang discuss about Liu Erlong. He told Yu Xiaogang that Zhao Wuji was beaten up due to Tang San. He was shown the Rank 1 Martial Soul Hall Token by Yu Xiaogang and told that Tang San had Twin Martial Souls.

He commented that the financial condition of the Academy could not afford exotic ingredients for the students and told Yu Xiaogang that he had no objections if the latter wanted to sponsor it. He agreed to let Yu Xiaogang having full control over the curriculum of the students. He introduced the new students and Yu Xiaogang to the rest of the Academy personnel. He declared that Yu Xiaogang would have full control over the curriculum of the students and told the teachers to work with the latter. He told Ma Hongjun, Ning Rongrong and Zhu Zhuqing to cultivate hard to reach Level 30 after congratulating Ao Sika, Tang San and Xiao Wu for becoming Soul Elders.

He asked Yu Xiaogang whether the punishment for the students was too heavy, as they were forbidden from using Soul Power. He reminded Yu Xiaogang about the limitations of the Academy's funds.

He informed Yu Xiaogang that the funds of the Academy had been spent completely. He asked Yu Xiaogang about the second stage of the training, after the latter stated that expenses of the second stage would be bourn by the students themselves.

He and Zhao Wuji accompanied Yu Xiaogang to bring the students to Suotuo City for the second stage of their training. He approved of Yu Xiaogang's plan to have the students pay their expenses for living in the city, while he arranged for himself, Zhao Wuji and Yu Xiaogang to stay at his shop to supervise the training. He and Zhao Wuji went to spectate the matches of Dai Mubai, Ma Hongjun and Zhu Zhuqing.

He along with Zhao Wuji and Yu Xiaogang were happy about the results of the battles of the day.

The Shrek Seven Monsters registered their victory and left the Great Spirit Arena along with him, Yu Xiaogang and Zhao Wuji. He told the Shrek Seven Monsters not to lose the reputation of the Academy if someone bullied them. He lamented to Yu Xiaogang about Ma Hongjun being behind Tang San. He agreed to treat Yu Xiaogang to a drink when the latter asked for it. He continued to bet on the members of the Shrek Seven Monsters and earn money throughout the month.

He and Zhao Wuji were invited over by the staff of the Great Spirit Arena along with the Shrek Seven Monsters, after Manager Ao made a deal with Yu Xiaogang. He told Yu Xiaogang that the latter should have waited for him to work out the financial aspects of the deal. The group discussed about the members of the Emperor Team based on the information provided by the Great Spirit Arena. He commented that the Blue Lightning Tyrant Dragon as a Martial Soul was exclusive to the Blue Lightning Tyrant Dragon Clan, and the Black Turtle as a Martial Soul was similar to the Blue Lightning Tyrant Dragon in terms of defense. He was satisfied when Tang San asked for complete control over the tactics.

He spotted Qin Ming in the VIP stands and told Zhao Wuji that they had nothing to fear in the match. He told Yu Xiaogang that he would tell him after the match.

He chided the Shrek Seven Monsters reminding them that they were weaker than the Emperor Team in direct match. He was happy to meet Qin Ming, when the latter came to visit. He introduced Yu Xiaogang and the Shrek Seven Monsters to Qin Ming. He revealed that Yu Tianheng was Yu Xiaogang's nephew, after the latter refused Qin Ming's greeting. He revealed that Qin Ming was the first graduate of the Shrek Academy, before telling the latter that Dai Mubai, Tang San and Xiao Wu broke his record of being the fastest to reach Level 30. He told Qin Ming that the teachers would separate after the graduation of the Shrek Seven Monsters, before complementing the latter for teaching the Emperor Team. He told Qin Ming that they would celebrate their meeting after many years.

He told the Shrek Seven Monsters to settle the matters of the Great Spirit Arena, and told Zhao Wuji and Qin Ming to follow him. He, Zhao Wuji and Qin Ming were talking when the Shrek Seven Monsters returned to the hotel. He told Qin Ming that Ma Hongjun had been in the Academy since 11, while Tang San, Xiao Wu, Ning Rongrong and Zhu Zhuqing were enrolled this year.

He was shocked to see Ma Hongjun ordering the most expensive dishes of the restaurant. He refused to let the Shrek Seven Monsters go to the Heaven Dou Imperial Academy. He told Yu Xiaogang to be clear about his plans. He objected to Yu Xiaogang's plan hearing Qin Ming point out that the Shrek Seven Monsters would be declared as graduates of the Heaven Dou Imperial Academy. He was stunned hearing the questions posed by Yu Xiaogang. He commented that the Heaven Dou Imperial Academy would become the location of retirement of the teachers of the Shrek Academy, before he told Yu Xiaogang and Zhao Wuji to discuss with Qin Ming about the details. He left the restaurant after that. He asked Ma Hongjun about the latter's problem. He told Ma Hongjun not to console him. He became glad by Ma Hongjun's analogy. The teachers and the Shrek Seven Monsters returned to the Shrek Academy the next day. He sent the Shrek Seven Monsters to rest before gathering the remaining teachers of the Shrek Academy for a meeting about the future.

He told the Shrek Seven Monsters to follow his speed during the journey, caught Yu Xiaogang and started moving. He told Yu Xiaogang that reaching the Heaven Dou City as fast as possible would reduce their expenditure during the journey. He slowed down after the Shrek Seven Monsters depleted their Soul Power in less than 2 hours since the start of the journey. He consumed few Sweet Peas during the journey when he was exhausted. The group ran about 400 km in day. He booked a hotel for the night and divided the three rooms for teachers, male students and female students. The group reached Silves City the next day. He booked 5 rooms in an expensive hotel and treated the rest to a lavish meal. He ordered the Shrek Seven Monsters to participate in a team battle in the Great Spirit Arena of the Silves City. He told the Shrek Seven Monsters to keep their reward money. He was shocked when the staff at the Great Spirit Arena stated that the Shrek Seven Monsters would not be able to compete in a match. He refused the offer of the staff to let the Shrek Seven Monsters participate in Level Surpassing Challenge, before he was convinced by Yu Xiaogang.

He bet 30,000 Gold Soul Coins on the Shrek Seven Monsters, after the odds increased sufficiently, and tried to prevent others from betting on the same to avoid dropping the odds. He asked Yu Xiaogang about the effectiveness of the Hidden Weapons created by Tang San. He was shocked hearing Yu Xiaogang's analysis. He earned 600,000 Gold Soul Coins from his bet as the betting odds had increased to 1:20. He and Yu Xiaogang gathered the teachers after the match. He agreed to Yu Xiaogang's suggestion to be the one to comfort the Shrek Seven Monsters.

The group traveled at a much slower pace for the next few days to let the Shrek Seven Monsters return to normal. He was confused about the location of the Heaven Dou Imperial Academy and asked the opinions of the rest of the teachers. He commented that the founder of the Heaven Dou Imperial Academy was like him when he heard that it was situated outside the Heaven Dou City. He asked Ning Rongrong if she was sure that they had reached the Heaven Dou Imperial Academy stating that it was a mountain. The group was stopped from entering the Heaven Dou Imperial Academy by a group of students led by the Fourth Prince of the Heaven Dou Empire, Xue Beng. He grew suspicious about the Heaven Dou Imperial Academy after Dai Mubai beat up the students blocking them. The group was then escorted inside the Heaven Dou Imperial Academy by Sun Buyu after confirming their identity. He asked the teachers about their opinions of the Heaven Dou Imperial Academy after Sun Buyu left them at a parlor. He asked Qin Ming whether the latter had made proper arrangements. The group was arranged to rest for the night by Qin Ming with each person receiving their own room. He was happy to hear that the teachers of the Shrek Academy would possibly earn 3,000 Gold Soul Coins monthly. The group was led to the Board of Education of the Heaven Dou Imperial Academy by Qin Ming.

He formally introduced himself to Meng Shenji, Bai Baoshan and Zhi Lin after they received the group from the Shrek Academy in formal robes. He formally introduced the teachers of the Shrek Academy to Meng Shenji, Bai Baoshan and Zhi Lin, before noticing that they were more interested in the Shrek Seven Monsters. The group was led inside the Board of Education by Meng Shenji to have a proper meeting. He witnessed Tang San undergoing Zhi Lin's test and was worried about the potential harm. He told Meng Shenji, Bai Baoshan and Zhi Lin that the Shrek Seven Monsters were the last batch as well as the most talented students of the Shrek Academy, and he wants them to eventually become Titled Douluos surpassing the achievements of the teachers.

He tried to negotiate with the Imperial Prince of the Heaven Dou Empire, Xue Xing, but the latter insisted on having the Poison Douluo: Dugu Bo test them. He led the group from the Shrek Academy out of the Heaven Dou Imperial Academy after thanking Meng Shenji, Bai Baoshan and Zhi Lin for their hospitality. He rejected Ning Rongrong's offer about going to the Seven Treasure Glazed Tile Castle. He suggested resting in the Heaven Dou City before deciding their future.

The group came across an advertisement of the Blue Tyrant Academy by the city gate of the Heaven Dou City. He asked Qin Ming about the background of the Blue Tyrant Academy. He decided to lead the Shrek Academy to join the Blue Tyrant Academy to obtain the qualifications for the Shrek Seven Monsters to participate in the Continental Elite Young Soul Master Tournament, and take revenge on the Heaven Dou Imperial Academy in the tournament. He informed the staff responsible for recruitment that if the teachers accept the job, the Shrek Seven Monsters should also be admitted. He told Qin Ming to be the first during the recruitment test. He told the teachers of the Shrek Academy to reveal their Soul Rings since Soul Masters at Soul Emperor or above were exempted from tests. He activated his Owl, revealed his Soul Rings and formally introduced himself. The group was led to the Dean of the Blue Tyrant Academy, Liu Erlong after the teachers overwhelm the examiners. He stopped Yu Xiaogang from running away. He asked Liu Erlong about her well being after they met and revealed to her that he had led the Shrek Academy to find work under her. He revealed to the teachers of the Shrek Academy about Liu Erlong being the final corner of the Golden Iron Triangle. He told Liu Erlong about the events leading to their meeting. He was shocked when Liu Erlong gave him the Blue Tyrant Academy and proposed to rename it as the Shrek Academy.

He went to the Heaven Dou Imperial Academy to find Meng Shenji, Bai Baoshan and Zhi Lin, obtained the information that Dugu Bo's cultivation cave was located in the Sunset Forest, before leading Yu Xiaogang and Liu Erlong there. He, Yu Xiaogang and Liu Erlong discussed about the goal of the kidnapping and speculated Tang San's eventual fate. They were attracted by a large Soul Power fluctuation and deduced it belonging to Dugu Bo, before they rushed over. They tried to negotiate with Dugu Bo about Tang San. They initiated their Martial Soul Fusion to generate the Light Holy Dragon, and expel the poison of Dugu Bo's poison formation as a result.

The Light Holy Dragon continued overpowering the Jade Phosphor Serpent Emperor Avatar due to Dugu Bo trying to keep the damage to a minimum. They depleted much of their Soul Power defending against the Medusa's Gaze. They triggered the Light Holy Dragon Avatar by spitting blood after the Light Holy Dragon was petrified. They were frozen in place when Dugu Bo used Time Freeze, defeating them, completely depleting their Soul Power. He told Dugu Bo that Tang San's father was someone the latter can't afford to offend, and that the had already prepared people to search for the latter in case accidents. They were shocked to see Tang San alive when he reach the location.

He asked Dugu Bo if they could visit Tang San in between when they were told that the latter would be returned in six months. They were permitted to visit Tang San and given antidotes to protect against the poison formation. They remained within the poison formation to recover their Soul Power and discussed about Tang San and Dugu Bo.

He and Yu Xiaogang visited Tang San twice during the next six months and were surprised to see the relation between the latter and Dugu Bo.

He along with Yu Xiaogang, Liu Erlong, Zhao Wuji, Shao Xin, Lu Qibin and Li Yusong to welcome Dugu Bo when the latter came with Tang San, and prevent accidents. They were shocked to hear that Dugu Bo would become the advisor of the Academy. After Yu Xiaogang's signal, he even offered the position of the Dean to Dugu Bo, only to be refused. He led Dugu Bo inside the Academy and attended to the latter.

He arranged for the meals of the Shrek Seven Monsters and Yu Xiaogang while they were cultivating after taking the Immortal Herbs. He even posted Zhao Wuji and Lu Qibin to guard them. He informed Tang San when Dugu Bo brought Dugu Yan along. He was relieved when Dugu Bo left with Dugu Yan. He and Liu Erlong accompanied Dai Mubai and Yu Xiaogang to the Sunset Forest to hunt for Soul Rings.

He, Yu Xiaogang, Liu Erlong and Dai Mubai returned five days after Tai Tan and Ning Fengzhi's visit. He, Yu Xiaogang and Liu Erlong were given an account of the events by Zhao Wuji. He signaled Liu Erlong to prevent her from following Yu Xiaogang who left for a chat with Tang San. He suggested Liu Erlong to be nice to Tang San for Yu Xiaogang.

He declared to the Shrek Seven Monsters to hunt for the Soul Beasts themselves as a training, and the teachers won't act unless absolutely necessary, as the hunt would be considered as the first part of their graduation test, with the second stage being the Continental Elite Young Soul Master Tournament. He told the Shrek Seven Monsters that they have to be the champions to graduate from the Academy. The Shrek Seven Monsters were accompanied by Yu Xiaogang, him, Liu Erlong and Zhao Wuji for the hunt. He asked Yu Xiaogang to either give Tang San to him as disciple or make Tang San a teacher in the Academy.

He and Zhao Wuji sealed their hearing when Liu Erlong was seducing Yu Xiaogang. He rebuked Yu Xiaogang when the latter tried to alert him, and was kicked towards Zhao Wuji. He heard Zhao Wuji's complain the moment he unsealed his hearing and kicked the latter hard. He prayed for the Giant Earth King witnessing Liu Erlong violently attacking it.

He volunteered to guard Ma Hongjun during the assimilation, as the latter was his disciple. He and Zhao Wuji cleared the area of the pieces of the Giant Earth King in the night. The group was surrounded by a nest of Pink Maidens led by a Pink Queen, while searching for other suitable Soul Beasts. The encirclement of the Pink Maidens followed the group as they tried to break out.

He pulled the group along to break out of the encirclement after the rest had consumed Flying Mushroom Sausages and connected using Blue Silver Grass. He suggested about leaving the area as killing the Pink Maidens would be troublesome. He chided Ma Hongjun to start cultivating to recover Soul Power after the latter knocked out the Pink Queen. He and Yu Xiaogang discussed about the Phoenix Cry Air Strike, and Ma Hongjun's disadvantages. They also discussed about the weakness of the Blue Silver Grass, and possible countermeasures, including visiting Bibi Dong. The group discussed about the effects of Ao Sika's Stimulating Pink Sausage. The group continued searching for suitable Soul Beasts for the next two days without finding any.

He asked for Yu Xiaogang's suggestion hearing Tang San's proposal and its related dangers. The group reached the vicinity of the Ice and Fire Yin Yang Well and prepared themselves. He, Liu Erlong and Zhao Wuji remained on alert when the Shrek Seven Monsters engaged the 3,000 - 5,000 years Level Phantom Tiger in combat. They blocked the other Soul Beasts which had appeared due to the Aromatic Silk Beauty from interfering with the Shrek Seven Monsters. Their strength, speed and Soul Power was amplified by Ning Rongrong by 40% for a few moments, after which they retreated inside the Poison Formation. He was scared by the fact that 30 Soul Beasts having cultivation of over 3,000+ years Level were attracted by the Aromatic Silk Beauty, with 7 of them having cultivation over 10,000+ years Level, and the strongest having a cultivation of 30,000+ years Level. He was told by Tang San to use the Flying God Claw along with Liu Erlong and Zhao Wuji to drag the suitable Soul Beasts inside the Poison Formation.

He, Liu Erlong and Zhao Wuji practiced using the Flying God Claw. He helped Liu Erlong and Zhao Wuji to pull the 4,000+ years Level Unicorn Armoured Beast inside the Poison Formation. He praised Tang San for his ambition and targeted the 10,000+ years Level Pit Demon Spider King, together with Zhao Wuji. They were shocked when the Pit Demon Spider King dodges the Flying God Claw and instead sent its Spider Web over along.

He pursued the Pit Demon Spider using his Owl Avatar and captured it with Tang San's help, before they returned to the Poison Formation. He had cut of the limbs of the Pit Demon Spider to prevent it from running away. He was surprised about the lack of severe injury on Xiao Wu and helped her restart her breathing. He then informed Tang San that Xiao Wu was fine.

He congratulated Liu Erlong for taking Xiao Wu as her adoptive daughter. He brought Yu Xiaogang away for a chat about the latter's relationship with Liu Erlong.

He convinced Yu Xiaogang to love Liu Erlong spiritually without any physical acts, while pondering that they would eventually do it. He led the rest of the group away to give Yu Xiaogang and Liu Erlong some privacy. The group waited inside the poison formation waiting for Tang San. He urged the group to leave the next day as they had achieved their objectives. The rest of the group apart from Xiao Wu was trapped inside individual Blue Silver Prisons by Tang San. The group discussed about the Blue Silver Prison and it applications. The group returned to the Shrek Academy to prepare for the Continental Elite Young Soul Master Tournament. He, Yu Xiaogang and Liu Erlong recruited Tai Long, Huang Yuan, Jing Ling and Jiang Zhu into the Shrek Academy's Team for the Tournament.

He promised the members of the Shrek Academy's Team 30% of the income from the sponsors to make them wear the uniform. The Team came into conflict with the Blue Sunshine Academy's Team inside the Great Spirit Arena, and he stopped Ma Hongjun from escalating the situation noticing that Shi Nian was a part of the other side. He explained about Shi Nian to the group.

He left to find sponsors for the Shrek Academy after the team decimated the Heaven Dou Imperial Academy's Second Team.

He led the Shrek Academy's Team into the Great Spirit Arena wearing a matching uniform, and with advertisements on it, as he had found sponsors for the Academy. The group discussed about the countermeasures hearing that their opponent was the Elephant Armored Academy's Team. He objected about the sponsorship when Yu Xiaogang suggested dropping the match.

He, Yu Xiaogang and Liu Erlong listened in on the tactics without interfering.

He started plotting about the means to gain the most advantage of the rising popularity of the Shrek Academy's Team. The group encountered the Blue Sunshine Academy's group while going to the stands to watch the match between the teams of the Thunderclap Academy and the Elephant Armored Academy. He also dumped the team uniform of the Shrek Academy's Team into the market capitalizing on their reputation.

The group was alerted about Tang San's danger by Xiao Wu, and they left the Great Spirit Arena to search. The group reached the Academy and ascertained that Tang San had not reached there, before spreading out to search.

He became worried about the team after the Blue Sunshine Academy's Team initiated their Seven Asura Dreamland, but was stopped by Yu Xiaogang from rushing out. The group returned to the Academy under the pretext of treatment. He arranged for the aftermath of the match, telling the rest of the team to hide for the time being, and telling Tang San to deny any knowledge of what happened during the match.

He was shocked to see Ning Fengzhi and Sa Lasi being part of the Investigation Committee. He had already warned Ning Rongrong from appearing as it could cause negative results. He led Yu Xiaogang and Liu Erlong to welcome the Investigation Committee into the Shrek Academy. He acted about not knowing anything about the match in front of the investigation committee and prevented them from interrogating the team. He acted to threaten Sa Lasi that they would visit the Supreme Pontiff Palace for redressal if the latter disqualified them. He let Tang San be questioned after Yu Xiaogang took out the Rank 1 Martial Soul Hall Token, only to be refused.

The group reached the Heaven Dou Imperial Hunting Grounds for the Qualifiers and were taken to their allocated spot to rest. He was shocked by Ning Fengzhi's offer to send more children of the Seven Treasure Glazed Tile Clan to study in the Shrek Academy, before understanding the reason and signaled Yu Xiaogang to accept it. He asked Tang San for the real identity of Xue Qinghe and was shocked to hear that the latter was the Crown Prince.

He drew the lot for the second match and obtained the Blazing Academy's Team as the opponent. He rushed to the stage when Tang San bore the burnt of the Brilliant Sun.

He rejected Tang San's desire to participate in the matches after healing for 3 days.

He led the group of the Shrek Academy to be part of the convoy for the journey to the Martial Soul City. The convoy from the Heaven Dou Empire was ambushed along the way to the Martial Soul City 10 days into the journey. He prevented Liu Erlong from fighting by pointing out that the ambush was pre-planned. He ordered the group to defeat their opponents while conserving Soul Power.

He and Liu Erlong were having trouble dealing with two Soul Kings, before they were shocked to see Luo Diyala and two Soul Saints appear. They were then forced to engage the Soul Saints, who made sure the battle won't end quickly.

He shook of the Winged Tiger Soul Saint and caught Liu Erlong after she was injured by Yue Guan. He remained on alert till Yue Guan and Gui Mei were forced to retreat by Dugu Bo and Chen Xin.

The group sans Xiao Wu and Liu Erlong reached the Martial Soul City three days before the start of the Finals. He and Dugu Bo remained vigilant due to the attack on Tang San.

He went to draw the lots for the 1st round of the Finals.

He drew the Blazing Academy as the opponent in the 1st round and the latter forfeited the match. They were shocked seeing members of the Blazing Academy's Team appearing as participants of the Godwind Academy's Team. He went to the tournament committee for explanation and was told that it did not violate any rules. He witnessed Dai Mubai and Zhu Zhuqing narrate their past and the dangers they faced, when the team were matched up against the Main Team of the Star Luo Imperial Academy.

He supported Dai Mubai after the end of the match. He witnessed the Martial Soul Hall Academy's Team decimating the Main Team of the Heaven Dou Imperial Academy.

He and Liu Erlong guarded the room while Yu Xiaogang set the tactics for the Shrek Seven Monsters' match against God Wind Academy's Team. He accompanied the group to watch the match.

He encouraged the Shrek Seven Monsters before the Grand Finale, telling them that he was proud of their achievements, that they would all graduate regardless of the match's outcome, and that they should prioritize their own safety over victory.

He was shocked by Tang San's injuries after the Chaos Fog dissipated due to the Charm Demon's de-fusion.

He, Yu Xiaogang, and Liu Erlong rushed to the stage to support Tang San after Ning Fengzhi healed his injuries. He was shocked to learn that Xiao Wu was a Soul Beast in Human Form. He led the Golden Iron Triangle in initiating their Martial Soul Fusion and declared his intention to protect Xiao Wu while telling the students to leave and hand over Shrek Academy to Zhao Wuji if the Golden Iron Triangle failed to escape.

He was not knocked out during Tang Hao's confrontation against 7 Titled Douluos of the Martial Soul Hall as he was a Soul Saint. They stopped their Martial Soul Fusion after Bibi Dong allowed the Shrek Academy's group to leave Martial Soul City and woke the remaining students with help from Dugu Bo, Ning Fengzhi, and Chen Xin. He told Ning Fengzhi to take Ning Rongrong back as the students had graduated, while Shrek Academy would face suppression from the Martial Soul Hall in the near future. He became emotional when Ma Hongjun stated his intention to return to Shrek Academy after travelling the continent for a few years to help him. He told the students that Shrek Academy would always be their home.

He and Yu Xiaogang refused Xue Ye's proposal to merge Shrek Academy with the Heaven Dou Imperial Academy.

He had already become a Soul Douluo of Level 83 in the five years following the tournament due to his improved mood. He was lazing around when Zhao Wuji brought Dai Mubai, Tang San, Ma Hongjun, Ning Rongrong, and Zhu Zhuqing to him, causing him to become excited. He and Ma Hongjun hugged each other upon meeting, before he was shocked by Tang San's appearance. He was shocked upon hearing Tang San's experiences over the past five years. He asked the students about their strength before asking about Oscar. He was shocked by the cultivations of Dai Mubai, Tang San, Ma Hongjun, Ning Rongrong, and Zhu Zhuqing. He reprimanded Ma Hongjun for being the weakest, while being secretly proud.

He proposed to Dai Mubai, Tang San, Ma Hongjun, Ning Rongrong, and Zhu Zhuqing that they showcase their strength to the academy to motivate the other students. He commented that students who became depressed after seeing the strength of the Shrek Seven Monsters should be expelled from the academy. He tasked Liu Erlong with arranging it.

He argued with Liu Erlong before she threatened to take part in his place while leaving all her work to him. He understood why Dai Mubai and the others were wearing masks before introducing the purpose of the exhibition match to the students. He told Dai Mubai and the others to announce their ages and Soul Power. When Zhao Wuji asked if they should go easy, he reminded him of his first meeting with Tang San. He was shocked to see Zhao Wuji restrained within multiple layers of Blue Silver Emperor Prisons.

He heard Tang San's instructions to Dai Mubai and Zhu Zhuqing and tried to attack Tang San, only to be met by a 30 m-diameter Blue Silver Emperor Spider Web. He tried to cut through it but failed. He inwardly cursed, not wanting to face the aftermath of the collision between Zhao Wuji's attack and the Hell White Tiger Intense Light Wave in midair. As he tried to land, Purple God Light struck him, forcing him to remain airborne. He was blasted 100 m away by the aftermath of the collision. He was surprised that Tang San could fly and agreed to his suggestion to end the match before telling them to give him face. He declared the match over after Tang San and the others agreed to admit defeat. He asked Ma Hongjun and Tang San about their future plans and was pleased with Ma Hongjun's answer before Dai Mubai revealed Ma Hongjun's true intention. He told the Shrek Seven Monsters they could return to the academy at any time and would leave Shrek Academy in their care once they became Titled Douluos.

He received Ning Fengzhi and Gu Rong upon their arrival before sending Shao Xin to call the others. He was shocked to hear that the Seven Treasure Glazed Tile Castle had been destroyed. He escorted Ning Fengzhi when he left Shrek Academy.

He and Liu Erlong discussed Yu Xiaogang, the survivors of the Blue Lightning Tyrant Dragon Clan, and the situation on the continent.

He was informed by Tang San about Xiao Wu's Sacrifice and Dugu Bo's warning. He assured Tang San that the Academy would support him to the fullest extent possible.

He, Tang San, Ma Hongjun, Ning Rongrong, Yu Xiaogang, Liu Erlong, Zhao Wuji, Shao Xin, Li Yusong, and Lu Qibin celebrated Oscar's return.

He, Yu Xiaogang, Liu Erlong, and Zhao Wuji were leading a group of students who had reached Level 30 to obtain their new Soul Rings when the Four Elements Academy, formed by combining the Blazing Academy, God Wind Academy, Sky Water Academy, and Thunderclap Academy, came to Shrek Academy to cause trouble.

He was shocked to see that Xiao Wu had regained her human form. He bragged about absorbing the Four Elements Academy into the Shrek Academy and revealed that Dugu Bo presided over the second meeting alongside Gu Rong. He proposed that Tang San induct the future graduates of the Shrek Academy into the Tang Sect. He was shocked to learn that Xue Ye was on the verge of death.

He was told by Tang San to remain alert for the possibility of a coup.

He, Yu Xiaogang, and Liu Erlong reached the Heaven Dou Imperial Palace just after Tang San had exhausted his Soul Power. They initiated their Martial Soul Fusion to transform Luo Sanpao into the Light Holy Dragon, forcing She Long to retreat with Qian Renxue and Ci Xue from the inner palace. The Light Holy Dragon decimated two-thirds of the Martial Soul Hall's Soul Kings, while the rest escaped. He revealed that the Soul Masters of Shrek Academy had subdued the Soul Masters affiliated with the Heaven Dou Imperial Clan before taking a detour to avoid the Martial Soul Hall's Soul Masters and reach the palace.

The group met with the Tang Sect forces and the survivors of the Seven Treasure Glazed Tile Clan before retreating to Shrek Academy. He, Yu Xiaogang, Ning Fengzhi, Chen Xin, Gu Rong, Tang San, Liu Erlong, Tai Tan, Niu Gao, and Bai He discussed Qian Renxue, the Seraphim, and the Angel Sacred Armor.

They were informed by Yang Wudi that Xue Ye would only live for another 2–5 years due to the damage caused by the poison. The Golden Iron Triangle accompanied Xue Ye to regain control of the Imperial Palace.

He, along with the other teachers of Shrek Academy, Ning Fengzhi, Chen Xin, Gu Rong, and the Elders of the Tang Sect, sent off the Shrek Seven Monsters and Bai Chenxiang on their journey to Sea God Island.

He followed the Heaven Dou Empire’s Army to lead the Shrek Academy’s Soul Masters in the war against the Martial Soul Empire.

He followed Chen Xin in his Owl Avatar, thinking it was an enemy attack, but was surprised to realize that Tang San and Xiao Wu had come to join the war. He was surprised that Tang San was a Titled Douluo and informed him about his and Yu Xiaogang’s positions in the Heaven Dou Empire.
characters.trivia:
He refrained from participating in matches of the Great Spirit Arena himself and earn money due to his arrogance.

The land of the original Shrek Academy was bought by him.

He spent his own money to increase the decorations of the room claimed by Dugu Bo.

He had issued a snot-green colored standard uniform for the Shrek Academy.

There was no mention of him promising the Students a cut of the money raised from the Advertisements.

The Light Holy Dragon was easily suppressed by Bibi Dong and forced to defuse before Tang Hao appeared.

His originally flat butt was a lot bigger than before. His hips were also lifted upwards, and when juxtaposed with the two perky humps protruding from his chest, he appeared to possess a perfect body. characters.title: Ge Long

infobox.Aliases: Nine Lives Divine Dragon Marshal Ge Long

characters.introText: Ge Long was the Heaven Dou Empire’s pillar. He was also number one in the empire, chief commander of the three armies. He was also a spirit master, in the prime of his life in his fifties, and to have reached the Spirit Douluo level at such an age was quite remarkable.
characters.appearance: He wore Heaven Dou silver armor, embracing a three tined helmet.
characters.personality:
Especially with events that happened at Jialing Pass, it was shown that he was arrogant as a Marshal and quite a stubborn person.

At first, he wasn’t particularly concerned nor impressed with Tang San, who was very young and had higher rank than him. Although Ge Long ranked lower, his status in the military was second only to Emperor Xue Beng. Later, he was surprised that the capabilities and powers of Tang San was powerful enough to kill a strong defense spirit master with one shot.
characters.history:
In the donghua, Ge Long was summoned to the camp by Emperor Xue Beng, to plan the recapture of Jialing Pass. Tang San offered to help guard the army's supply line against destruction squads sent by Bibi Dong. After all the enemies were eliminated, Ge Long dismissed the Shrek Seven Devils, wanting to take credit for their hard work.

Due to Ge Long's neglect, the camp's foods and drinks were poisoned by the Hornet Sect right afterwards. Many soldiers suddenly collapsed in the last second as they were crossing the Lima Plains. In the second battle, again, despite Yu Xiaogang warning it might be a trap, Ge Long still insisted on chasing after the enemy, which resulted in a lot of soldiers losing their lives.

characters.introText: Ghost Sovereign lead the terrorist attack on Shrek Academy. Dozens of Dark Spirit Masters, two Godkiller-ranked fixed soul ammunition, and other fixed soul ammunitions were smuggled into Shrek City. characters.history:
Ghost Sovereign lead the terrorist attack on Shrek Academy. Dozens of Dark Spirit Masters, two Godkiller-ranked fixed soul ammunition, and other fixed soul ammunitions were smuggled into Shrek City. They hid within a hotel and begin charging the soul ammunition using soul power and their own blood.

The next day, they fired multiple 7th-ranked and above fixed soul ammunitions at Shrek Academy from the outer city. They then switched to ground detonations, killing many civilians in the outer city. One of the Godkiller-ranked fixed soul ammunition was detonated above Shrek Academy. The other was detonated at the Tang Sect headquarters.

Ghost Sovereign and eight Title Douluo showed up above Shrek Academy sitting cross-legged on a purple skull 1000 meters long and started a battle with Yun Ming. The giant purple skull shot dark purplish flames from its mouth and it clashed with the aura of Yun Ming’s spear. When they saw Yun Ming unleash his Godhood tablet, they ran away quickly. They were horrified, facing the power of a fallen god. The purple skull was swallowed whole by Yun Ming's attack. Only the Ghost Sovereign and one Title Douluo survived the attack, but were gravely injured.

He received a call from Qiangu Dongfeng asking why Yun Ming was alive. Ghost Sovereign told him about the incident involving the Darkness Phoenix and assured him that Yun Ming is not alive. He criticized Dongfeng for not upholding his part of the agreement in starting a war when he brought it up. To prevent Shrek Academy from rising up again, he told Dongfeng to delay their rebuilding.

In the war between the Douluo Planet and the Abyssal Plane, their Holy Spirit Cult betrayed the Douluo Planet and stood side with the Abyssal Plane. In the final battle of life and death, he was allotted against Ya Li. Ya Li hated him to gut since he was the one murdering her husband Yun Ming. Even though he was stronger than her, Ya Li sacrificed herself and also dragged him to die.

characters.title: Ghost Vine
characters.introText: The Ghost Vine is a kind of exceedingly horrifying plant system spirit beast, it has extremely powerful nerve poison, one need only be stung by one of its piercing thorns, and poison would immediately circulate, until dissolving into pus and becoming the Ghost Vine’s fertilizer. What spirit masters fear the most is the ghost vine’s parasitic ability. When it attacks, it would by its own accord send out countless minute seeds directly attaching to the victim’s body, These seeds absorb sufficient nutrients and grow on the host’s body spreading a nerve poison in a short period of time.

characters.title: Ghost Wolf
characters.introText: The Ghost Wolf or the Nether Wolf lives in groups. They are innately suspicious in nature and do not like to attack head-on. Instead, they prefer to exploit their target’s weaknesses. The wolves are extremely patient spirit beasts and are proficient in seeking opportunities. To the extent that they are willing to go through mutual attrition with their prey until the prey tires itself out or expose a weakness.
characters.appearance: It is a wolf about 1.6 meters in length, and the whole body is iron gray, and the green light is its eyes. It has lightning-shaped mark on its head and large canine fangs. The body structure of a wolf and a dog are very similar. They are known as the copper-headed iron-boned bean curd waist. Their waist is the most fragile vital part of the whole body. After 1,00 years, its forehead has a lock of golden hair.
characters.history:
Yu Xiaogang and Tang San encountered a group of 10 years Ghost Wolves in Nuoding City's Spirit Hunting Forest while in search for Tang San's first spirit ring.

Huo Yuhao and He Caitou fought a thousand years Spectre Wolf for their soul tool department test at the Beast Dueling Area in Shrek Academy. It was killed by Huo Yuhao as its skull was pierced by the dark golden blades of his Dark Gold Terror Claw Bear's right palm bone.

Tang Xuanyu’s group met a group of Ghost Wolves in the Douluo World.

characters.title: Giant Palmed Black Tiger
characters.introText: The Giant-Palmed Black Tiger is a ferocious spirit beast that is adept in melee. Tigers are typically highly regarded within the forest, but very few tigers can go further after reaching a hundred thousand years. It is because tigers are innately domineering and overbearing, and after breaking through a hundred thousand years, they are likely to threaten the ruler’s sovereignty.
characters.appearance:
The tiger's whole body is pitch black like ink, only there is a white king character on its forehead. The body is five meters long.

Although it is dying, it can still be seen that it was strong in its heyday. The bones are very thick, especially the four tiger palms, which are particularly generous.
