characters.introText: The God of Creation, also known as the Creator God or Creation God, is a primordial divine existence associated with the creation of worlds, planes, life, and divine order throughout the interconnected cosmology of Tang Jia San Shao's works. He existed near the beginning of the present universe alongside his twin counterpart, Austin Griffin, whose fundamental nature was Destruction. Whereas Austin Griffin embodied the principle capable of bringing creation to an end, the God of Creation continuously opened new planes, populated them with life, established divine systems, and left behind powers and artifacts that continued to influence the universe long after his original individual existence ceased.
characters.appearance:
Within the Douluo Divine Realm, the God of Creation is remembered as the primordial source from which its foundational divine powers originated. According to the creation legend preserved in Douluo Dalu: God Realm's Legend, Creation divided his own power while forming the Divine Realm. Life and Kindness established the positive foundation of the realm, while Destruction and Evil formed their opposing counterparts. Asura, representing slaughter and order, occupied the central position that regulated these forces. Creation and Order consequently became fundamental principles governing the Divine Realm.

After the Divine Realm was completed, Creation transformed into five seeds: Kindness, Evil, Life, Destruction, and Asura. Over countless years, these seeds gradually developed their own consciousness and became the five original Supreme Gods of the Divine Realm: the Goddess of Kindness, God of Evil, Goddess of Life, God of Destruction, and Asura.

Kindness and Evil correspond to thought, emotion, and the opposing tendencies of consciousness, while Life and Destruction represent the generative and destructive forces through which the Divine Realm exists and transforms. Asura stands between them and regulates the order of the realm. Together, the five Supreme Gods represent differentiated divine powers originating from the Creator's primordial power rather than ordinary descendants produced through biological reproduction.

The reunion of Life and Destruction can reproduce Creation Power. When these mutually opposing powers return toward their common origin, they generate the force associated with the original creation of the Divine Realm. Creation Power can return existing structures toward a primordial state and establish the conditions for renewed creation, demonstrating the cyclical relationship between creation and destruction.
characters.trivia:
Austin Griffin is the God of Creation's twin brother and destructive counterpart. The two represent the complementary principles of Creation and Destruction.

The Eternal Lord is a trace of the God of Creation's divine consciousness preserved within the Divine Throne of Eternity and Creation.

Within the Douluo Divine Realm, Creation's power became the five seeds of Kindness, Evil, Life, Destruction, and Asura, which eventually developed into the five original Supreme Gods.

Another account describes Creation dividing himself into one hundred gods that governed different planes.

True Creation Saint Energy is normally exclusive to the God of Creation and contains effectively endless Creation power.

Creation's apparent death was later revealed to be his assimilation into the Universal Origin, through which his Source Will continued existing throughout the universe.

The shared cosmology describes a complete dimensional cycle in which zero-dimensional existence evolves through increasingly higher dimensions until ten-dimensional space collapses back into zero-dimensional space, beginning creation anew.

characters.title: Goddess of Love
characters.introText: Legend had it that in the God Realm, after the Goddess of Love was betrayed by her love, her grief made her insane, and she descended into the mortal world. Heaven and earth were inverted, and the sun and moon became a lake.
characters.history: After she was betrayed and killed by her lover, Qing Lang, she became a vengeful evil spirit that possessed her body and became the Evil God. She created the Yin Yang Love Querying Valley and tried to exterminate those who entered the valley. She made Wang Dong'er and Wang Qiu'er fight to death, saying that only a winner could be together with Huo Yuhao. Tang San tried to stop her because it involved his daughter, Wang Dong'er. However, due to the law of the Divine Realm, only a portion of his power was allowed to descend to the mortal world. Hence, He summoned Yi Lai Ke Si who was the Necromantic Holy Magic God. She was finally killed after Yi Lai Ke Si fused with Huo Yuhao and used the power of purification.

characters.title: Gods
characters.introText: In the Douluo World, every single existence, whether they be planets or living things/energy bodies purpose is to undergo evolution. Which done by rising to dimensions which is the difference between ordinary creature and those who evolve. By raising one existence to a higher-dimension, they will began to understand the existence of multidimensional space they all live in. This is why it's possible for planets like the Douluo Dalu, Crimson Plane and Dragon Horse Planet to contain life energy above the universe itself. All of them have broken through from the 3-Dimension and into the 4th-Dimension.
characters.appearance:
In the Douluo World, every single existence, whether they be planets or living things/energy bodies purpose is to undergo evolution. Which done by rising to dimensions which is the difference between ordinary creature and those who evolve. By raising one existence to a higher-dimension, they will began to understand the existence of multidimensional space they all live in. This is why it's possible for planets like the Douluo Dalu, Crimson Plane and Dragon Horse Planet to contain life energy above the universe itself. All of them have broken through from the 3-Dimension and into the 4th-Dimension.

True Gods can only remain on mortal worlds for at most 100 years since they reach that state, before they had to ascend to the Divine Realm.

The Douluo World universe is a multi-dimensional universe which is divided into ten levels, each level is represented by dimensions. From one-dimensional to the 10th-dimension which means the Douluo Dalu World is a universe that is different from other normal universes. Not only is it's a universe that is made up of infinite amount of higher-dimensional parallel spaces. But also a Ten-dimensional universe or point that contains infinite space-time, contains all dimensional universes, all possibilities, all time and all everything. It's noted that a grain of sand in this ten-dimensional universe would be no different than a infinite large universe.

They live in the Divine Realms which is a higher-dimensional universe that starts out as a 4th-Dimensional space and grows into a 5th-Dimensional plane that can cover a even wider universe than itself, which controls an infinite amount of lower-dimensional spaces. God Kings acts as the core of the God Realms for them to grow into a 5th-dimensional universe. This is where the gods anchor their existence so the whole Douluo multi-dimensional universe won't suppress and try to destroy them.

Their lifespan is unlimited if they have a god position which is an anchor to the God Realm and is their coordinate that keeps their existence in the Divine Realm. One can attain the strength of a God by either being born with divine consciousness, have an inheritance of a god position, which is in limited numbers, or cultivate until you break the limit of the rank of the world.

But to be a True God, one would need a God's Position, Strength of a God, and turn their energy into Immortal Qi. The ranks of gods are divided into God Officer, Third Class God, Second Class God, First Class God which are all part of the 4th-Dimensional hierarchy, with First Class having control over all 4th-Dimensional spaces.

The realms above the divine level in the lower planes are: God level, True God level, Super God level, Half-Step God King, Quasi-God King and God King. The 10th rank is the God level, the 11th rank is the True God level, the 12th rank includes the Super God level, Half-Step God King and Quasi-God King, and the 13th rank is the God King realm. The 10th God level ranges from level 100 to 109, and is also known as a 3rd Class God without a divine position in the lower realm. The 11th True God level ranges from level 110 to 119, and is also known as a 2nd Class God without a god position. The 12th Super God level ranges from level 120 to 129, and is also known as a 1st Class God without a god position. Half-Step God King ranges from level 130 to 139, and still falls under the 12th rank but far exceeds an ordinary Super God level. Quasi-God King ranges from level 140 to 149, corresponding to the top level God in the divine realm, close to the God King. The 13th level is the God King, whose level is above 150.

In the divine realm, the realms above the divine level are: God Officers, 3rd Class Gods, 2nd Class Gods, 1st Class Gods and the realm of God Kings.

While Mortals and normal planets are only 3rd-Dimensional beings, Gods themselves are beings who have broken through the 4th-Dimensional space. These being absorbs and accommodates an infinite amount three-dimensional spaces. Beings who just become Gods are God Officers, existences who are above ordinary creatures with life energy equal to the universe, being know as Universal Lifeforms. They can easily perceive and control these three and fourth-dimensional spaces while also being able to teleport anywhere in them.

Gods are usually banned from interfering with the mortals and forced to leave their home world because their presence is too strong. With just their presence alone being able to affect the normal order of their original dimension. They are also beings who defy the heavens, transcending beyond destiny and causality of their plane and lower dimensions. Them staying in their original dimension will cause a toll on it even while suppressed and will lead to its destruction. Gods are also very hard to kill as their qi keeps them in peak condition until they have no energy, they have very high resistance with their powers and can regenerate as long as they have their divine soul.

As a 4th-Dimensional being, they are not affected by anything a 3rd-dimensional being can do and requires one to be on their level of existence and be unbound by lower and their own dimensional effects to affect them. It's also impossible to calculate and plan against a god unless you are at a similar level or higher, since it won't have any effect on them.

First Class Gods are at the top of the 4-Dimensional Hierarchy, having mastered all of the 4-Dimensional spaces. They are able to feel the presence of the multi-dimensional spaces.

Then above them are God Kings who are 5th-dimensional beings who control and are made out of 5-Dimensional spaces. Spaces that accommodates and holds an infinite number of 4-D spaces and lower-dimensional spaces. A God King has the ability to see the fate of others who aren't in the same rank and their law is considered the true laws of the 10-Dimensional Universe. God Kings are known as Lord of The Universe for being rulers of their own higher-dimensional universe and beings who dominate their own universe.

And just as how a mortal can't affect a True God, a God King can't be affected by the abilities and planning of those below them, such as First Class Gods and below because of the difference in dimension. The only way to affect a God-King is for lower level gods to have a divine weapon that can bring them on the same level as a God King, reaching the same higher-dimension as a God King or a higher-dimension than them. However, there are exceptions to this rule, such as Huo Yuhao harming God King Tang San with his soul skill.

A Divine Realm can be made by a God King who can convert Immortal Qi from the multi-universe and planets to form the higher-dimensional realm. They make the laws and concepts for their Divine Realm, having complete control over the rules and spaces in it. There is a new Divine Realm which is ruled by the Great God Circle consisting of "15 God Kings (十二神王)".

A Godking is immensely powerful as it was stated by the author during a casual conversation in the Chinese Forums that when conditions are right, a Godking is capable of creating a pocket universe that can support life like the Divine Realm. While not explicitly stated, one can assume that a Supreme Godking is a Godking who has accomplished this.

The Supreme God-King is a God Rank above the God-King. The only example of the Supreme God-King was the Dragon God. A God-King, who has absorbed the core of their God Realm, fusing themselves to it, is sometimes called the Supreme God-King, not because they are the real Supreme God-King but because they reach the cultivation somewhat near to the Supreme God-King. As the Supreme God-King, they have full control over their realm, able to change the rules and laws of it to fit their desires or needs similar to the Planar Lord of a realm. They are also able to siphon power from the realm core, allowing them to increase their strength and abilities. This also means if the God Realm was a higher-dimension than the Supreme God-King, they would be able to boost their strength to that level.

They can also leech energy from the realm to heal themselves or restore their energy and unleash divine punishment on anyone inside of the realm. Even if the Supreme God King is killed, they can simply revive themselves with their God Realm energy because they are fused to it. This is why one must either steal the Realm Core or destroy the God Realm itself to fully kill the Supreme God King. All of this can be done even if the Supreme God-King isn't inside of their God Realm since the core is fused inside of them. The Supreme God-King can also siphon strength from everything in the God-Realm, including other Gods and their Divine Weapons. It's also called the King of God-Kings because some of those gods whom they can siphon power from are also God-Kings themselves.

There are individuals who can break the limit of the world, but are not True Gods because they lack a God’s Position and Immortal Qi. They are called Wild Gods. Both can only be made and absorbed in a Divine Realm, so their lack of being a real God makes them have a Limited Lifespan and Weaker Strength. In Soul Land 4, the life limit of human spirit masters who became gods was 1000 years, thanks to the efforts of the life school in the Shrek Academy. Those with unique bloodlines can live a lot longer. The Dragons of the Dragon-Horse Galaxy can live approximately 3000-4000 years.

When the wild gods come to the real divine realm and are moistened by the immortal spirit, their bodies will evolve and reorganize, and their cultivation will decline by one level.

Immortal Qi is the energy that flows within a Divine Realm and one of the components that makes up a Divine Realm. The Immortal Qi is actually a form of life energy, which is just sublimated to a very high level of life energy, which can be described as divine life energy. It is used by actual Gods as energy the same way spirit masters use spirit power, being able to suppress and nullify all mortal powers. As Immortal Qi is an energy that comes from a higher-dimension than spirit power of a spirit master. Immortal Qi is needed for a God to fully utilize their full powers and it's why False God aren't as strong as True Gods with Immortal Qi. As they are still utilizing the lower dimensional energy, leading them to be limited and weaker when compared to True Gods. Immortal Qi is also required for a God to unleash a divine weapon full power.

A God-King even without a God Realm can generate Immortal Qi by themselves, being able to strip it from the universe and planets around them. One of the reason why a God-King has the ability to create a God-Realm and why they are needed for it creation. It is also used to nature planets within the divine realm. Immortal Qi is a higher stage of energy. It is stronger than the Life Energy stored in the Eternal Tree.

An individual develops a Divine Consciousness once they reach Godhood. Their spiritual realm reaches the Divine Origin Realm before they reached Godhood. Once they become a god, the spirit sea transforms into a divine consciousness, becoming golden and granting them the Divine Sense, that can't be noticed or sense by those without one. Their Divine Consciousness also allows them to summon and draw on their power no matter where they are. A divine sense is able to cover a dimensional range, allowing them to control and manipulate their own higher-dimensional spaces and the lower ones.

As a First Class-God, they gained a better grasped over higher-dimensional spaces. Allowing them through the Space-Folding ability, to instantly appear anywhere their divine senses covers.

Once one enters the god level, becoming a higher-dimensional existence and a life-form on the universal level. One will gain layers of invulnerability that would further set them apart from ordinary creatures and further show why they are the strongest creatures in their original universe.

Those in the God Level cannot be harm or calculated by by lower-dimensional beings. Meaning if one isn't in the same dimension or higher than them, it's impossible for them to affect and hurt them.

Those in the God Level cannot be harm or affected by those who are still bound by the dimensional effects of the same dimension and lower even if they are as strong a God or stronger. For example, a God can't be harm by those who are still affected by the 3-Dimensional and 4th-dimensional affects. This is known as the dimensional reduction and suppression a God gains after their breakthrough.

Those in the God Level cannot be harmed by those whose abilities haven't reach the Origin Level. As the Origin Level is a God Level characteristic, one needs to reach if they don't wish to be suppressed by a God, meaning they their abilities need to be equal to the purity of the natural element and reach the conceptual level.

These are the three layers one must bypass for them to harm or affect a God because of the nature of a God. But Gods who have gained Immortal Qi also has another layer which elevates them above other Gods who lack Immortal Qi.

Gods with Immortal Qi can't be harm by lower-dimensional energy with them being able to disperse and shattered the attacks of other gods without Immortal Qi.

A God Position is concept that anchors itself in the Fifth Dimensional God Realm, becoming apart and fusing with the God Realm itself. It's because of this that Gods are able to live forever because their existence is tied to the realm on a fundamental level. With a God Position a God King won't be suppressed or destroyed by DD Multi-Dimensional Universe that destroys all God-King without one. Also a God without a God Position is generally weaker than those with one, as the position grants them a amplification in their abilities, as well as more control over the heaven and earth. But also because a God Position makes the god a hundred times stronger after making one and some benefits.

Deity Suppression:  A God Position grants a god the ability to suppress those without one using the power of the heavens. It call downs a bolt of lightning that strikes the enemy, inflicting their consciousness with the feeling of a giant hand falling from the sky and crushing them. It induces a panic attack, shortness of breath, chest tightness, a feeling of inferiority as if he they shouldn't be fighting against the God existence and cowardly emotion. The enemy will feel like it's impossible to compete and everything around them will feel like it's repelling them.

Deity Domain: God can turn an area into their own domain. For example, Sea God is able to connect with the sea and turn it into his domain, allowing him to draw faith from not only the sea but creatures living inside. In one domain, they can utilise the faith energy of the domain to suppress their foe, use the domain own energy source and amplify their own strength.

Deity Punishment:  It's divine punishment condensed by the power of faith that is transformed by a God Position. It's a power that only those with a God Position utilise by calling upon the higher will of the 5th-dimension to summon golden lightning that suppress and devour anything it touches.

A God can't have more than one God Position because the two concept they embody will start to clash with each other. Usually leading to the God exploding from the two positions clashing. But it's possible to make a certain position through the combination of multiple concepts, such as the Emotion God position that fused all Seven Emotions to make the God of Emotion. Tang San was able to inherit two god positions by having Xiao Wu act as a carrier for one of the god positions when he is not using it.

There can't be the same God Position in the same Divine Realm unless both are at a different level. Like the Goddess of Light and The Godking of Light who embodies the same power but at different rank. Or if they are just similar to each other, embodying apart of the concept with another one.

Some god positions are Only One In Universe, a unique God Position crafted from one blood being unique and not see anywhere else in the entire universe. This means only that person dominate the laws and concept of their position throughout the entire universe, infinite dimensions and parallel spaces. The Dragon God is one of these positions.

Not every god possesses a law; only those who reach the level of God King can truly possess the laws of the universe. The laws of the universe are like officials of the universe, a kind of power that governs the universe. For example, Sea God Tang San's law is related to the sea. No matter which plane or planet he is on, any world connected to the sea can be influenced and used by him. This is the law of the Sea God. On the Falan Planet, when one reaches the level of a King (Tier 10), they touch the law and upon reaching the level of an Emperor (Tier 12), they touch the rules. This signifies reaching the upper limit of the current plane. However, one cannot touch too much; otherwise, they risk becoming integrated into the rules themselves.
characters.personality:
Gods refer to pure and immortal creatures whose strength is equal to the elements of heaven and earth. They are divided into two categories: creatures born in the divine realm, and those who cultivate to become gods. Gods often have halos behind their heads to prove their identity, that is, divine rings. Gods from different realms and different positions have divine rings of different colors. For example, in the Douluo Divine Realm, second class gods have five divine rings, the divine rings of first-level gods are seven, god kings have nine divine rings, and the colors of gods and spirits are all gradients of the original colors of the gods. The further inward, the lighter the color. The divine ring of the Supreme God King is a nine-color halo.

Creatures born in the divine world have the right to live there permanently, but they may not have a divine position. Those who cultivate to become gods in the subordinate planes must rely on their own understanding of the great way of heaven and earth, obtain a certain position in the divine realm according to their ability attributes and cultivation level, and then arrive at the divine world with the light of guidance, obtain permanent residence in the divine world, and become immortal and indestructible under the nourishment of the immortal qi.

When a god passes on his position to others, he loses the power given by the position, but his own attributes as a god remains unchanged, and it does not affect his continued life in the divine realm. A god-level powerhouse is not a real god. When a god-level powerhouse cannot obtain the status of a god because his plane has no protection from the gods, he can only stay in his original plane and cannot enter the divine realm to become a real, immortal god.

The throne of God, also known as the seat of God, is the position of God in the divine realm. It is also the coordinate of the divine realm's ability to control the five-dimensional space, which can give Gods the power to control specific areas. The divine position will affect the character of the god to a certain extent. For example, when Tang San uses the Sea God position, he gives people a sense of moderation and peace, while when he uses the Asura God position, he will be affected by a strong murderous intent, and thus fight more calmly.

Even if a God King doesn’t have a super divine weapon, they would at least possess something comparable to one (pseudo-super divine weapon). A First Class God, in extremely rare cases, might have a top-tier divine weapon that could reach the level of a super divine weapon. A Second Class God is generally equipped with a divine weapon. Some Third Class Gods have divine weapons, while some do not. For God Officers, only a very small number of their weapons can be considered divine weapons.

Note: The divine weapons mentioned here are based on the standards of the Divine Realm, which are completely different from the standards of the lower realms. In fact, every planet has different standards, but the standards of the God Realm are the strictest.

Authority is the power and strength given to a God by a certain God to control a specific area. There are two known types of authority: divine realm authority and cosmic origin authority.

It refers to the control of the power of water, fire, earth, wind, light, darkness, space and other elements in the divine realm and its lower planes. For example, the authority of the Sea God controls the water element. The authority of the Fire God controls the fire element.

The power that controls the origin of the universe is not restricted by the space of the divine realm and can be used throughout the entire universe. Only gods who have reached the level of divine king can control the authority of the origin of the universe.

characters.title: Gold Silk Ape
characters.introText: The Gold Silk Ape, also called the Gold Silk Devil Ape, was extremely eye-catching with its golden fur. With sunlight beaming down at it, it made it as though the ape was emitting light. It had a stature of about two meters tall with long and lanky arms. Whenever it jumped, it looked like a golden beam of light. It was extremely fast and would occasionally vault by relying on the large tree branches to change direction. Its arms were like iron hammers.
characters.appearance:
The Gold Silk Ape, also called the Gold Silk Devil Ape, was extremely eye-catching with its golden fur. With sunlight beaming down at it, it made it as though the ape was emitting light. It had a stature of about two meters tall with long and lanky arms. Whenever it jumped, it looked like a golden beam of light. It was extremely fast and would occasionally vault by relying on the large tree branches to change direction. Its arms were like iron hammers.

The gold fur on its body was not only beautiful but also had extremely strong defense capabilities. The Gold Silk Ape was also able to shoot out its furs like rays of light the size of a hair. It had a formidable close- and mid-range ability. But ordinarily, Gold Silk Apes treasured their own fur and would never release them so easily.
characters.history:
A Gold Silk Ape appeared in the second test of Lan Xuanyu to enter in Shrek Academy. He gained its trust by helping it obtain a purple zoysia. They then fought with three Gold-eyed Leopards gaining a Skull Bone. After that, it evolved from 1,000 years to 3,000 years. Discovering Lan Xuanyu's dragon god bloodline, it accompanied him out of the Douluo World simulation world. However it is not a contracted spirit soul and Lan Xuanyu didn't need one, so it began to gradually disappear.

Vajra Baboon Eating Gold Silk Ape

During the trip to Elf Planet, while looking for a solution to preserve the Gold Silk Ape's life, it was suddenly eaten by a Vajra Baboon with over 90,000 years cultivation. It promised that it would merge their memories together, and allow Lan Xuanyu to summon him whenever he need via a spatial gate. The spatial gate can either be summoned the Thorn Dragon or when Lan Xuanyu obtains his space element soul ring.

characters.title: Golden Bear

It was the most defensively resolute and strongest among the four soul beasts, namely; Golden Panther, Golden Lion and Golden Tiger that attacked Huo Yuhao and He Caitou during the soul tool department test in Shrek Academy's Beast Dueling Area. Quick Answers
		
		
	
	
			
				
					What is the martial soul of Golden Crocodile Douluo?
						
				
				
					
						Golden Crocodile Douluo's martial soul is the Golden Crocodile King, a power attack system beast spirit with a golden bloodline, recognized as a pinnacle beast spirit.

					What level is Golden Crocodile Douluo in the Douluo universe?
						
				
				
					
						Golden Crocodile Douluo holds the title of Rank 98 Super Douluo in the Douluo universe. He is linked to the Spirit Hall and Spirit Empire and wields the Golden Crocodile King spirit, a power attack system beast spirit.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What role did Golden Crocodile Douluo play in the battle of the two gods?
						
				
				
					
						Golden Crocodile Douluo played a key role in the battle at Jialing Pass during the battle of the two gods. He arrived in time to help repel an attack by using his golden crocodile tail to deflect Tang San's Sea God Trident, saving Bibi Dong. Despite his efforts, he was later defeated and killed by Xiao Wu's spirit skill.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					How did Tang Hao defeat Golden Crocodile Douluo?

His simple yet powerful movements, combined with his merging with intense black light, allowed him to overpower Golden Crocodile Douluo.

					Who convinced Golden Crocodile Douluo of their power?

						Provided by: Fandom

characters.introText:
Quick Answers
		
		
	
	
			
				
					What powers does the Golden Dragon King inherit from the Dragon God?
						
				
				
					
						The Golden Dragon King inherits the Dragon God's tremendous physical power, including extraordinary strength, endurance, defense, and destructive power. It also possesses the Time Element and inherited the Dragon God's negative thoughts, madness, and resentments. Its physical strength and durability are comparable to those of the original Dragon God.
					
					
						Provided by: Community
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What is the significance of the Golden Dragon Spear?
						
				
				
					
						The Golden Dragon Spear is a divine weapon created from one of the Golden Dragon King's forty-nine rib bones and was originally part of its body. It can only be properly wielded by someone possessing a Golden Dragon Martial Soul or bloodline. The spear possesses immense destructive power and sharpness and can absorb energy to strengthen itself and its wielder.
					
					
						Provided by: Community
					
					
				
			
			
				
					How does the Golden Dragon King embody the evil thoughts and resentments of the Dragon God?
						
				
				
					
						When the Dragon God divided, the Golden Dragon King inherited its negative thoughts, madness, and evil emotions, together with the blood and resentment of the fifteen deceased God Kings, Dragon Clan members, and other gods that the Dragon God had sealed within its body. These influences became part of the Golden Dragon King's nature.
					
					
						Provided by: Community
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What physical characteristics distinguish the Golden Dragon King?
						
				
				
					
						The Golden Dragon King is an enormous golden dragon thousands of feet long. Its body is covered in massive, thick, diamond-shaped golden scales, while two huge wings extend from its back. It has ruby-colored eyes filled with fierce and violent light, a pair of horns, rows of spikes extending from its head toward its tail, and a long, heavily spiked tail.
					
					
						Provided by: Community
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What does the ruby-like color of the Golden Dragon King's eyes signify?
						
				
				
					
						The ruby hue of the Golden Dragon King's eyes symbolizes the destructive intent inherent in his Golden Dragon King lineage. This color links to his transformation into the Blood Dragon, representing a potent destructive force.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom

Appearance[]
The Golden Dragon King is a giant dragon that is thousands of feet long. Its eyes are ruby-like colors, full of fierce and violent light. It possesses two massive wings and its entire body is like covered in large golden scales. Each scale is diamond shaped, thick, solid, full of sharpness, and more than one square meter in size. A pair of horns protrudes from its head, and the spikes on top of the head spread backwards along the back to the tail. Its tail is very long, but the tip is thick and full of spikes which is like an enlarged version of a super wolf tooth hammer.
characters.appearance: It was a golden crystal, about the size of a fist. The crystal was presented in a diamond shape, leading the intersection, just like the scales of the Golden Dragon King. But, it contained an extremely terrible huge power.
characters.personality: It was a golden crystal, about the size of a fist. The crystal was presented in a diamond shape, leading the intersection, just like the scales of the Golden Dragon King. But, it contained an extremely terrible huge power.
characters.history:
After escaping from the Forbidden Land in the Divine Realm, it wanted to destroy the Divine Realm and find the Silver Dragon King, but due to its underestimating Tang San, it got itself killed by the Sword of Three Trials which is a fusion of the Asura Sword along with the Swords of the God of Evil and the Goddess of Goodness and supported by the energies from the Goddess of Life and God of Destruction. This was a technique that they created especially for dealing with the Dragon God.

The Golden Dragon King's body suffered damage at an unrecoverable level due to the attack so it instead used its God Core to infiltrate into Tang Wulin, who was just a new born child, as a means of getting revenge on the Asura God who caused its death, also hoping a chance of reborn.
characters.trivia: It was revealed in SL4 that it also inherited the Time Element from the Dragon God while the Silver Dragon King inherited the Space Element.

characters.appearance:
The Golden Eyed Leopard was considered extremely strong among spirit beasts. Also, they were usually in a group; there may not be many of them, but it was still a considerable number, usually three to seven of them together.

They were fast and highly aggressive. Their main means of attacking were to use their sharp claws and bites that could tear your flesh up. But their strongest point was having an innate ability.

Its innate ability was the Gold-eyed Stare. It could cause its opponent’s body to freeze. The duration of the freeze was determined by the difference in both parties’ cultivation, but it was still a period of freezing. With the speed of the Gold-eyed Leopard, even a short moment was enough to kill its opponent.

Once it merged with Qian Lei as a Spirit Soul, it became fat with golden hair.

In Chapter 495, Golden Fatty was much bigger than before. It was half the height of Qian Lei. He was fat, covered with thick golden hair, and has strong arms. There were two fangs protruding from the mouth. It's a bit fierce to show off.

Fierce Golden Fatty

In Chapter 564, Golden Fatty exceeded the 2.5 meters. He had broad shoulders and a big body. He lost the feeling of being fat. His arms were extremely long and thick, and his golden hair was extremely thick, just like a golden steel needle.

Description[]
The Golden Tortoises are known for their longevity, as they are a symbol of auspiciousness. As long as one cultivates close to them, they can avoid any calamities. As a result, they hardly have any enemies in the world of spirirt beasts. Any spirit beast would be willing to get close to them. They have no problem living to at least ten-thousand years. Golden Tortoises are very auspicious, and they possess great auxiliary abilities. Golden Tortoises are the smartest ones among all tortoises.
characters.appearance:
Golden Tortoise is around two meters long. Not only is its golden turtle shell extremely eye-catching, it also seems to be very thick. The gold on its shell was extremely proportionate and deep, and every shell line was dark gold. There weren’t any flaws at all.

The Golden Tortoise’s head was different from the head of an ordinary turtle. There were three ridges on it, and it wasn’t oval like a turtle’s, instead being slightly triangular in shape. There were even a few barbs that resembled whiskers at the bottom of its head. Its entire head was dark gold. The further down its head, the brighter the gold was.
characters.history: He once tried to sneak into the Lake of Life and steal the Life Gold since he wanted to evolve just like Di Tian. Before he finished doing, Di Tian returned. So, he bit the Life Gold and ran away. Instead of evolving, the Life Gold absorbed his vitality and he was on the blink of the death. After the Spirit Souls were introduced, he voluntarily came to contract with someone, hoping to escape from the wrath of Di Tian. The Life Gold he ate was devoured by the Life Guardian Blade and he finally became the Spirit Soul of Xu Sanshi.

characters.history:
Gu Tianri and his brothers were chosen as the representatives of their class for the class promotion tournament. They arrived at the competition stage early with their teacher, Ye Yingrong. When class five arrived, the Teaching Director, Long Hengxu called the students on the stage for the match to begin.

As soon as the director started the match, they released their spirit and flew up into the sky. When Tang Wulin threw Xie Xie and then Gu Yue into the air, Gu Tianri calmly gave a hand signal and his brothers positioned themselves to the sides. Towards the oncoming Xie Xie, he avoided direct combat with him. He waited for the moment Xie Xie begins to fall back down.

Suddenly, as Xie Xie begins to fall down, an ice ball appeared beneath his feet, allowing him to use it as a spring to jump toward Gu Tianri. He was caught off guard. Xie Xie was then before Gu Tianri, who was at his wit’s end. He tried to kick at Xie Xie in the hopes of knocking him away, but his leg was caught by Xie Xie and he knocked his Light Dragon Dagger on Gu Tianri's head before stepping on his shoulder to jump toward Gu Tianyue. Gu Tianri was out of the match.

characters.introText:
Quick Answers
		
		
	
	
			
				
					What is the significance of Gu Yuena's transformation into the Goddess of Life?
						
				
				
					
						After becoming the Goddess of Life, Gu Yuena attains the level of a God King and becomes a member of the Divine Council of the Great God Circle. In this position, she governs the fundamental laws of Life and Creation, allowing her to wield powerful life and creation energies for healing, suppression, and other divine abilities. She can also perceive the fortune or misfortune of future events.
					
					
						Provided by: Community
					
					
				
			
			
				
					How does Gu Yuena's role as the Divine Beast Silver Dragon King impact the story?
						
				
				
					
						As the Silver Dragon King, Gu Yuena is one of the two halves of the original Dragon God and inherited its immense spiritual power and elemental abilities. She serves as the lord and ancestor of the Spirit Beasts and plays a central role in their struggle with humanity. Her relationship with Tang Wulin, the inheritor of the Golden Dragon King's power, eventually leads to the birth of Tang Xuanyu, who later becomes the new Dragon God.
					
					
						Provided by: Community
					
					
				
			
			
				
					How does Gu Yuena's appearance change when she poses as Gu Yue?
						
				
				
					
						In her guise as Gu Yue, Gu Yuena features long blackish-purple hair, usually in a ponytail, and violet eyes. Her appearance is described as delicate and pretty, with an average build and height. Upon merging with Na'er, her true appearance emerges, characterized by long silver hair and violet eyes, presenting a more mature look. She is depicted as extraordinarily beautiful with an enticing figure. She sometimes dons a dark mask when venturing outside the Academy.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom

Appearance[]
Human Form[]
While posing as Gu Yue, Gu Yuena has long blackish-purple hair that is often tied in a pony tail. She also possesses a great pair of violet eyes. Though not particularly beautiful, she was described as being "delicate" and "pretty" with an average build and height for her age.
characters.appearance:
While posing as Gu Yue, Gu Yuena has long blackish-purple hair that is often tied in a pony tail. She also possesses a great pair of violet eyes. Though not particularly beautiful, she was described as being "delicate" and "pretty" with an average build and height for her age.

After merging with her other self, Na'er, Gu Yuena regains her true appearance. She inherits her counterpart's long silver hair and violet eyes, but looks more mature. She is described as being extremely beautiful and had everything that a woman could dream of. She had exquisite beauty and an alluring figure. It's to the point that every man who looks at her, skips a heartbeat and even other woman are attracted to her.

In Soul land 4, Gu Yuena becomes much more mature. She is described as too beautiful; a beauty that is indescribable to the point that all the vocabulary in the dictionary is insufficient to describe her appearance. She has a fairly tall, voluptuous and perfect figure. The most striking thing about her is her entire head of silver hair that sweeps all the way down to her ankles. Not only is her silver hair gentle and agreeable, it gives off a sense of silver crystal texture. She is also occasionally seen wearing a dark-colored mask when going outside of the Academy to hide her appearance in front of others.
characters.personality:
The Silver Dragon King woke up from her long slumber from beneath the center of the Star Dou Forest, after she sensed the death of the Golden Dragon King. She roared in sorrow and anger. Before her was the sight of several spirit beasts kneeling to her. She led some of the spirit beasts to the outside world in order to learn about humans, so they can destroy them.

Gu Yue showed up on the sports field of Eastsea Academy. She asks Wu Zhangkong if she can still enroll even though the enrollment period was over. She watches Tang Wulin and Xie Xie while they are doing physical training. She approaches Wu Zhang Kong and expresses her desire to enroll although enrollment is already over.

She is given a test by fighting Xie Xie. During the battle she showed control over six different elements (fire, water, wind, earth, light and space) and defeated Xie Xie.

P.S.: The reason why she chose to commit suicide in SL3 was because the bloodline of the Golden and Silver Dragon King would definitely cause one of them to devour the other. Only when she commits suicide and voluntarily lets Wulin swallow her to become new Dragon God, could Wulin live and not be driven insane, and the world would not be destroyed by the madness of the new crazy Dragon God.

She didn't know that she was pregnant with Xuanyu. If she knew it, she would not choose to commit suicide. In fact, Xuanyu's birth solved the problem that they had to swallow each other.

characters.history:
There was a Land Dragon Golden Melon in the Ice and Fire Yin Yang Well. It came with Tang Wulin.He and the other plant Spirit Beasts left their seed with the Eternal Tree. It would later become the spirit soul for Yuanen Yehui.

Land Dragon Golden Melon was one of the six plant great beasts that was able to cultivate past 100,000 years and survive the heavenly tribulation. When the seven devils, Gu Yuena, and Zang Xin showed up at the Ice Fire Yin Yang Well, they were not happy to see them. When Zang Xin demand a herb or fruit for each of the devils including Yuena, they tried to chase them away using the remnant souls of the Water and Fire Dragon Kings, but was stopped by Gu Yuena. They tried again, only to be stopped and intimidated by Zang Xin and forced to agree.

The Great Beasts guided them around the well. Xu Xiaoyan, Xu Lizhi and Gu Yuena picked out their herbs, the Star Luo Spirit Bead, the Chaotic Element Immortal Herb, and the Singular Velvet Sky Chrysanthemum, and started absorbing them. Tang Wulin was absorbing part of the Chrysanthemum with Yuena. Tulip made an offer to the remaining four devils to become their spirit soul, but was refused. Wulin was the only one to accepted his offer. When Wulin revealed his status as a child of nature, the six spirit beasts begin arguing on who should become Wulin's spirit soul. Each of the great beasts presented their abilities to Wulin. Golden Melon was last in line. In the end, Tulip was chosen.

Wulin made an contract with the Great Beasts in exchange for them to become spirit souls for him and his friends. They resided themselves in Wulin's spirit sea next to the seed of nature until the devils are ready to break through. Chaotic Element Immortal Herb gave his seed to Wulin and became Xu Lizhi's spirit soul.

Land Dragon Golden Melon became the Spirit Soul of Yuanen Yehui after she reached rank 80.

He and the other plant Spirit Beasts' seeds were given by Wulin to the Eternal Tree be planted around the Eternal Tree.

characters.introText:
Quick Answers
		
		
	
	
			
				
					How did Guan Yue become Hall Master after Chen Xinjie?
						
				
				
					
						Guan Yue succeeded Chen Xinjie as Hall Master after Chen's retirement. Before this, Guan Yue was the Vice-Hall Master of the Battle God Hall and one of three Limit Douluos. His background includes studying at Shrek Academy and joining the War God Temple, fulfilling a debt to Chen Xinjie.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What role did Guan Yue play in the Battle God Hall?
						
				
				
					
						Guan Yue was the Vice-Hall Master and later Hall Master of the Battle God Hall. He was key in the War God Temple's success, defeating the Black Emperor and Devil Emperor. Guan Yue also guided Tang Wulin's group at the War Gods Hall, demonstrating his spear skills and leadership.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What is Guan Yue's connection to Shrek Academy?
						
				
				
					
						Guan Yue is connected to Shrek Academy through his sworn brother, Yun Ming, with whom he trained. He also mentors Tang Wulin at the academy, teaching him spear consciousness.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					Who taught Guan Yue spear intent at Shrek Academy?
						
				
				
					
						Guan Yue learned spear intent at Shrek Academy from Yun Ming, his sworn brother, with whom he trained in their early days.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					Why did Guan Yue join the War God Temple?
						
				
				
					
						Guan Yue joined the War God Temple to repay a favor to Chen Xinjie, his superior. His contributions were crucial in elevating the temple's status and ensuring human survival against Abyssal creatures. Guan Yue played a key role in defeating the Black Emperor and the Devil Emperor, securing victory for the temple.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom

characters.trivia:
His name and his Martial Soul are both the same as Gui Mei translates to Ghost Demon.

His real face was known only to a few people, as he usually wore mask to hide it.
Er Ming's Gravity Control Domain forced the mirage on his body to dispel, revealing his real face.

He wore his red ceremonial robes during the Finals of the Continental Elite Young Soul Master Tournament.

Gui Mei and Yue Guan have an unusually close relationship. Along with a rare fusion ability, the two spent nearly 60 years together, their feelings surpassing blood brothers, and they were shown to share a tent together during Martial Soul Hall's hunt for Xiao Wu.

He feared the Sea God's Light more than the light used by Qian Daoliu, Qian Xunji and Qian Renxue, as the former completely rendered him inert.

His face was visible from the beginning.

He never wore his red ceremonial robes in the Donghua.

He and Yue Guan battled Dugu Bo and Chen Xin for a while before Tang Hao showed up.

He did not offer Tang San help for an optimal Soul Ring in exchange for his stay with the group.

He stated that the 100,000+ years Level Soul Ring from Xiao Wu's Sacrifice would be wasted due to Tang San not being at Level 90.

He died due to the fact that the Sea God's Light ignited the Holy Fire left on his body by Qin Ming.

In manhua, he was killed by Dugu Bo and Tang San when he made an attempt to kill Tang San and the rest of the residents when Martial Soul Hall went to Sea God Island to steal a certain treasure.

characters.history:
The Ocean Soul Brothers had a 4-match winning streak in the Great Spirit Arena of the Vast Sea City before being matched against the Phoenix Fragrance. They ignored Ma Hongjun's provocation and dived into the pool to conceal themselves. They were shocked when Ma Hongjun began heating the water with Phoenix Flames, forcing them to attack. They were further shocked when Ma Hongjun forcefully overcame their attacks. They used their strongest ability against Ma Hongjun to prevent him from recovering.

They were baited into focusing on Bai Chenxiang due to her actions, unaware that her offense was much weaker. Ma Hongjun forced them to use their Martial Soul Fusion, the Forbidden Water Tornado. They were knocked out when the Phoenix Explosion caused heat energy to enter their bodies, losing the match. Ma Hongjun retrieved the heat energy from their bodies after the result was announced.

characters.introText: Haider is the Captain of the Sea Devil, allied with the Purple Pearl Pirates led by Zi Zhenzhu.
characters.appearance: Haider is a burly man with grey skin and a golden hook replacing his right hand. He has navy blue hair, and a short beard and mustache. He wears black robes lined in silver and adorned with golden emblems, a thick yellow belt, an eye patch, and a large pirate's hat. He smokes from a golden pipe shaped like a human skull.
characters.personality:
Haider is a proud, deceptive old pirate with a black heart and saltwater in his veins. Though he first acted as a kind and helpful host, his true colors emerged when he poisoned the Shrek Seven Devils, and danced and drank beer over their collapsed bodies. He's ruthless and manipulative, and only cares for his son.

Though he's a pirate for a living, Haider is not especially brave or fearless, only attacking when he's sure he'll have the upper hand. Just to be safe, he utilizes poison and trickery to make things go his way. When captured, he quickly cooperates, begging for his life.

Despite this, Haider had hidden strength when it came to his murdered son, and brought the entire ship to certain death just for the chance to avenge him. He remained seemingly calm and gracious right until the point his deception was uncovered, when his booming laughter betrayed his true feelings of hatred.

Haider appears to be religious, worshiping the Sea God and seeking his power.
characters.history:
Novel & Donghua

The Sea Devil was hired by Tang San and Oscar for the journey from Vast Sea City to Sea God Island.

His actions before the group's departure drew Tang San's attention, causing the latter to remain on guard. He and Tang San discussed the Sea Soul Beasts and their territories, and he informed the latter that most experienced sailors knew how to avoid them.

The Sea Devil Pirates poisoned the breakfast of the Shrek Seven Monsters and Bai Chenxiang on the 3rd day to kill and rob them. He was shocked when his son pointed out that Xiao Wu was fine. Tang San then restrained the pirates after the rest of the group revealed that they had pretended to be poisoned to lure them into revealing their true intentions. He was so terrified by the Soul Rings of Tang San's Blue Silver Emperor that he could not react when his son and four others were killed by Ma Hongjun. He revealed that he was a subordinate of the Purple Pearl Pirates. He diverted the Sea Devil into the territory of the Deep Sea Demonic Whale King to take revenge for his son's death. He and the remaining crew were torn to shreds along with the Sea Devil by the shockwave released by the Deep Sea Demonic Whale King.

Healed by Holy Light

After the Shrek Seven Devils admitted they'd only pretended to be poisoned, and knew they were pirates the entire time, they swiftly defeated and captured Haider and his crew. But before long, a terrible storm brewed out of nowhere, and Haider begged to be freed, recognizing the signs of a powerful Spirit Beast, the Deep Sea Demonic Whale King. But it was too late for warnings, and the monster destroyed the Sea Devil. Haider was critically injured and thrown into the sea, but was able to recover and even undergo a spirit transformation under the light of the Vast Sea Cosmic Shroud. He survived, stronger than before, and began hunting the Shrek Seven Devils to steal the mystic item for himself. After being healed, he had the ability to sense its general location.

Mutated Octopus Spirit

Haider destroyed the wall of Zi Zhenzhu's house, searching for the Shrek Seven Devils. He celebrates over finally finding them. Zhenzhu asks him if having a few extra tentacles on his spirit gave him the guts to challenge her, but he says he isn't there for her title as leader, but Oscar and his companions. This sparks a conversation which completely ignores Haider, and he smashes more of the house in anger, nearly killing Oscar and Xiao Wu. Zhenzhu protects them both.

Haider protests, saying Zhenzhu has no right to interfere in his grudge according to pirate law. She agrees that would be the case, if she hadn't claimed both Oscar and Xiao Wu as her 'brides' already. She battles Haider with the full force of her spirit, ordering the Purple Pearl Pirates to join the charge. The underlings are easily defeated by Haider's newly mutated spirit. He brags about his strength, but is ultimately killed by Oscar's Hell Spirit Cat copy technique.
characters.trivia:
He tried to scare the Shrek Seven Monsters by telling them that Zi Zhenzhu is a Level 73 Spirit Saint.

In the Donghua, his crew was eaten by a Sea Soul Beast while they were confronting the Shrek Seven Monsters.

Haider is Rank 67 in the Manhua, but between 50-60 in the Light Novel.

His spirit essence mutated in the Manhua, becoming the powerful Mutated Octopus

Haider survived the destruction of the Sea Devil in the Manhua, but was killed on his next appearance.

Appearance[]
Caitou is an extremely big person with a height exceeding 2m, wide shoulders and tanned skin. He is bald headed and has a dark complexion. He had a plain and simple appearance.
characters.appearance:
He Caitou is from the Sun Moon Empire; the only place where a dark person like him can be found. Furthermore, he's a member of the Sun Moon Empire’s imperial family, and also the nephew of the current Emperor. His father is also the previous emperor of the Sun Moon Empire. He has seven older sisters, and his mother only gave birth to him when his father turned forty-eight years old.

Back when his father was still the crown prince, his father's younger brother, who’s also his uncle, had always tried to snatch the throne away from him. However, his grandfather knew about his uncle’s vicious nature, and knew that giving him the throne would’ve only brought trouble to the country. Even though his uncle’s talent far surpassed that of his father’s in every field, his grandfather still decided to deny him the throne. Once his father inherited the throne, he earnestly ruled the empire. He gave his all to take care of national affairs, every day. As time went on, their empire became more and more prosperous beneath his father's rule. A large majority of the officials were moved by his earnestness, thus they pledged their loyalty to him.

Right before his grandfather's death, he told his father to completely strip away his uncle’s power to ensure that their country remain peaceful. However, his father was too kind-hearted; he couldn’t bear to take away his younger brother’s power. Therefore, he didn’t fulfill his grandfather’s last wish, and thus left behind the root of all of the troubles that followed.

Some years ago, when his father was in the prime of his life, he suddenly died in the middle of the night. His mother and his three unmarried elder sisters also died that same night. Later that same night, his uncle led the army and barged into the capital. It was later found out that his father, mother, and elder sisters’ food had all been poisoned. Everything changed from that night on. He still rememberedcthat terrifying figure entering the imperial palace and murdering everyone. He was only able to survive because his mother shoved him into a secret passage.

When his uncle didn’t find his body, he sent out some people to find and kill him. At the same time, he declared to the country that his entire family had died from food poisoning. characters.personality:
He Caitou is from the Sun Moon Empire; the only place where a dark person like him can be found. Furthermore, he's a member of the Sun Moon Empire’s imperial family, and also the nephew of the current Emperor. His father is also the previous emperor of the Sun Moon Empire. He has seven older sisters, and his mother only gave birth to him when his father turned forty-eight years old.

Back when his father was still the crown prince, his father's younger brother, who’s also his uncle, had always tried to snatch the throne away from him. However, his grandfather knew about his uncle’s vicious nature, and knew that giving him the throne would’ve only brought trouble to the country. Even though his uncle’s talent far surpassed that of his father’s in every field, his grandfather still decided to deny him the throne. Once his father inherited the throne, he earnestly ruled the empire. He gave his all to take care of national affairs, every day. As time went on, their empire became more and more prosperous beneath his father's rule. A large majority of the officials were moved by his earnestness, thus they pledged their loyalty to him.

Right before his grandfather's death, he told his father to completely strip away his uncle’s power to ensure that their country remain peaceful. However, his father was too kind-hearted; he couldn’t bear to take away his younger brother’s power. Therefore, he didn’t fulfill his grandfather’s last wish, and thus left behind the root of all of the troubles that followed.

Some years ago, when his father was in the prime of his life, he suddenly died in the middle of the night. His mother and his three unmarried elder sisters also died that same night. Later that same night, his uncle led the army and barged into the capital. It was later found out that his father, mother, and elder sisters’ food had all been poisoned. Everything changed from that night on. He still rememberedcthat terrifying figure entering the imperial palace and murdering everyone. He was only able to survive because his mother shoved him into a secret passage.

When his uncle didn’t find his body, he sent out some people to find and kill him. At the same time, he declared to the country that his entire family had died from food poisoning. He then took advantage of the situation and killed all of the subordinates and servants in the palace that were still loyal to He Caitou's father, and then buried them with him. After this great purge, and due to the fact that he was the sole remaining heir to the empire, he began to rule over the country with an iron fist.

Description[]
Even in the Great Star Dou Forest, the Heavenly Dragon Horses are considered very rare. The blood lineage of Light Holy Dragon runs in their bodies. Although they are shaped like horses, their draconic lineage is actually very pure. They are recognized as one of the most arrogant soul beasts. characters.appearance: The Heavenly Dragon Horse is more than four meters long and two and a half meters tall. It is like a white steed. Its body is like a horse, but its head is shaped like a dragon. White dragon scales extends from its forehead all the way to its neck and down its entire spine. Although it is already in the twilight of its life, it still continues to reflect the aura of light. The most eye-catching part about it is the diamond-shaped, dim golden gem on its forehead. Although the light that comes from this gem is dimming, it is still very bright.
characters.history: It was saved by Bi Ji when it was younger, and thus it shared a good relationship with her. It became the Spirit Soul of Bei Bei.

Quick Answers
		
		
	
	
			
				
					What makes the Heavenly Snow Woman's ice element 'Ultimate'?
						
				
				
					
						The Heavenly Snow Woman's ice element is 'Ultimate' because she controls the Ultimate Snow element, sensing everything in snow and ice. Her Three Ultimate Techniques were powerful enough to defeat dominant soul beasts in the Extreme North. She also used a hundred-thousand-year Snow Lotus to seal her origin, enhancing her abilities.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What is the significance of the Extreme North to Heavenly Snow Women?
						
				
				
					
						The Extreme North is crucial for the Heavenly Snow Women, as it is their home and the source of their Ultimate Ice power. Formed from pure ice-type origin energy in the region's core, they developed intelligence and mastery over the Ultimate Snow element. The Snow Empress, a key figure among them, is known for her dominance in this area.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					How does the Heavenly Snow Woman compare to the Manifold Mysterious Ice Essence?
						
				
				
					
						The Heavenly Snow Woman is a 700,000-year-old spirit beast with control over the Ultimate Snow element, revered by the Ice Clan. Quick Answers
		
		
	
	
			
				
					What is the relationship between Hu Liena and Tang San?
						
				
				
					
						Hu Liena's relationship with Tang San is marked by animosity, primarily stemming from her defeat at his hands in the Continental Advanced Spirit Master finals.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					How does Hu Liena's personality contribute to her character development?
						
				
				
					
						Hu Liena's character development is significantly influenced by her personality traits of intelligence, confidence, and determination. Her willingness to confront dangerous challenges to enhance her strength reflects her upbringing as an orphan in Spirit Hall, where she was trained as a Spirit Master. Her unique charm and distinctive voice further contribute to her character's allure.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What is the significance of Hu Liena's affiliation with Spirit Hall?
						
				
				
					
						Hu Liena's ties to Spirit Hall are marked by her commitment and service. Trained as a Spirit Master there, she had access to extensive resources to hone her abilities. She vowed lifelong service to Spirit Hall at her coming of age ceremony. In a match against the Heaven Dou Imperial Academy's Emperor Team, she demonstrated a Spirit Fusion with Xie Yue, dubbed Charm Demon. She holds Bibi Dong, her mentor at Spirit Hall, in high regard, attributing her accomplishments to her and the institution.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What obstacles does Hu Liena face in her quest to become stronger?
						
				
				
					
						In her pursuit of strength, Hu Liena confronts numerous challenges. She braves the severe environment of Hell Road, nearly succumbing to the overwhelming power inside her. To survive, she entrusts her life to Tang San, compelling him to render her unconscious. She also self-inflicts injury to maintain consciousness. Upon overcoming these trials, she acquires the Deathgod Domain. She also grapples with the emotional turmoil of belonging to rival clans with Tang San, for whom she harbors affection.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					How does Hu Liena's rough voice add to her peculiar charm?
						
				
				
					
						The rough voice of Hu Liena enhances her unique charm by creating an intriguing contrast with her beautiful looks. This blend of beauty and toughness adds to her appeal. Her voice, coupled with her intelligence, confidence, and determination to overcome challenges, contributes to her captivating character.

characters.appearance:
She, Xie Yue, and Yan skipped the 1st round of the Finals and did not participate in the 2nd round before facing the Heaven Dou Imperial Academy's Main Team in the 3rd round. She used her abilities to prevent Yu Tianheng from using his abilities. She activated her Chaos Fog before fusing with Xie Yue to form the Charm Demon. The Charm Demon defeated the opponents under the cover of the Charm Fog before defusing.

The team advanced to the 5th round after easily winning their 4th-round match. She, Xie Yue, and Yan had the additional mission of crippling or killing Tang San besides becoming champions.

The team advanced directly to the Grand Finale after the teams from Shrek Academy and God Wind Academy forfeited the three-way match. She watched the match between Shrek Academy's Team and God Wind Academy's Team.

The team was told by Bibi Dong how to counter the Shrek Seven Monsters' Seven-in-One Martial Fusion and was threatened by Gui Mei with three years in the Disorienting Grand Canyon if they lost. They tried to demoralize the Shrek Seven Monsters before the match and used their usual 3-4 formation. She opened with her Charm, but it was ineffective because the Shrek Seven Monsters covered their eyes and ears, and Xiao Wu countered it with her own Charm. She then used Chaos Fog before fusing with Xie Yue to form the Charm Demon under Xu Yu's amplification, which accelerated the fusion.

The Charm Demon was shocked when Tang San blocked its attack on Ning Rongrong. It expanded the area of the Chaos Fog after Tang San sent the rest of the Shrek Seven Monsters out of it. The Charm Demon was shocked to see six members of the Shrek Seven Monsters fly out of the Chaos Fog while Tang San activated his Eight Spider Lances, mistakenly believing it was a Torso Bone. The Charm Demon was forced to continue fighting Tang San before finding an opportunity to attack Dai Mubai.

The Charm Demon recalled the Moon Blade after Dai Mubai deflected it, then focused on Tang San after he was forced to consume a large amount of Soul Power to protect Dai Mubai. It was shocked when Tang San used the Clear Sky Hammer to deflect both Moon Blades. It initiated Xie Yue's Full Moon to attack Tang San, gradually cutting off the appendages of the Eight Spider Lances before the Clear Sky Hammer forced it to defuse. She and Xie Yue were assisted by Xu Yu to recover their Soul Power. She was then poisoned by the fragments of the Eight Spider Lances and was forced to suppress the poison.

Her Soul Power was amplified by Ning Fengzhi to help her temporarily suppress the poison. She was detoxified by Tang San, who also stole some of her Soul Power in the process. The team was taken away to rest and recover.

They managed to reappear on the scene once more, while Huang Chutian displayed his valiant strength again. They were able to win their last three matches consecutively by directly confronting their opponents, who’d already exhausted a lot of their energy from their previous matches. As a result of that, they won seven out of their ten matches in the end. As such, entering the top sixty-four teams was not that great of a problem for them.

The team went on to take 3rd place in the exam and were all very happy about it. They’d lost to Dai Huabin’s team during the semifinals, but they’d been able to obtain third place by beating Zhou Sichen’s team. During their match with Team Zhou Sichen, the Lan sisters had recovered the ability to use their fusion skill, allowing them to defeat their opponents. Otherwise, they wouldn’t have been able to win based on their individual strength alone. characters.personality: He has had to rely on himself for everything, since he lost all his family and friends at a very young age. Perhaps this explains why the Heavenfiend Douluo is a very capricious person with a fickle nature, becoming extremely cruel and brutal at times.
characters.history:
Huang Jinxu, the Heavenfiend Douluo's martial soul is extremely special; he uses the stars in the skies above as his own martial soul. Legend has it that there was a star that was especially bright on the day he was born. His martial soul was automatically awakened after his birth. On the same night, his mother died from losing too much blood, and his father passed away when he was eight years old. After this, his friends also died one by one. It was later discovered that his martial soul was the Heavenfiend Lonestar that targeted his family and friends. Because of this, he is destined to be alone for the rest of his life.

The Heavenfiend Lonestar martial soul caused him to lose his family, but at the same time, it gave him great power. It’s been claimed that he cultivated without a master, and that everything he knows is self-taught. He has continued his journey alone over the years, and eventually attained the title of Heavenfiend. He’s around sixty years old, and his cultivation level is also around Rank 91 or 92. characters.history:
Being one of the oldest God Kings in the Douluo Divine Realm, he wanted to be in charge of the Divine Realm and not satisfied with the junior God King like Tang San to be in charge. He wanted to expand the divine realm so that many gods would be allowed to enter the divine realm. But that idea was rejected by Tang San who had premonition that something bad would happen to the divine realm. Even though Tang San asked him to wait one more year, he didn’t wait at the end and started rebellion.

He threatened Tang San with pregnant Xiao Wu who was about to deliver. After Tang San surrendered, he sealed him and turned him into an ordinary god. He was afraid of not to be able to seal Tang San with his strength alone, he used the forbidden power of the Forbidden Land that imprisoned the Golden Dragon King. That seal was very powerful that no God King in the Divine Realm could be able to unseal. But, the seal was unsealed by Tang San using the cord blood of his newborn child, Tang Wulin.

The usage of the forbidden power led the escape of the Golden Dragon King. The divine realm was also almost destroyed by the Space-Time Turbulent. Realizing his fault, he sacrificed his life together with Sheng Ming, to stabilize the divine realm. Before he died, he entrusted the God of Destruction Seed to Tang San to choose for his successor.

characters.history:
He was just ordinary human beings who had neither  bloodline nor talent, but he was very smart. Since childhood, he had been a blacksmith, specializing in forging various weapons. Because of his ingenuity, he had made great progress, could always make all kinds of powerful weapons, and even invents a variety of alloys to make weapons stronger, thus gradually gaining a little fame.

In order to forge better weapons, he began to try to collect the blood of various powerful races and integrate them into his forging. Later, he found a special alloy. When this special alloy was inadvertently refined by him, with this alloy, he found that after it absorbed some blood, he could briefly absorb and release the racial talent of the race to which the blood belonged. Although it would be much weaker, it did have that characteristic. Fifty years later, he finally succeeded in his research. After success, he made a paper-like existence with this special metal, and then to print through the blood, so that he could use it for a short time and help himself complete the forging.

When he used such a paper to print hundreds of blood abilities and tried to fuse them together. His life was sublimated by this alloy. The alloy had the breath of life, just like the spirit of the spirit clan, and gave him strong feedback, which made him ascend to the sky in one step and become the ninth-order strong man in one fell swoop. He had no blood talent, but with the awakening of the alloy, which promoted a pure energy for him, which could support it to apply through this metal and show all kinds of blood power. He successfully survived the disaster and became a monster king. After that, he studied for another 50 years, formed a system that only belonged to himself, and finally became an emperor in one day.

When the Ancestral Court at that time found that that emperor was actually a human, they felt unbelievable. Therefore, it took three years for the ancestral emperors to finally catch him, take him back to the ancestral court and ask him how he became an emperor. He didn't hide it and told the ancestral court about it. His imperial pillar was formed at that time. He destroyed everything before he was caught and the alloy formula disappeared forever. Before he died, he told that all the secrets were in his imperial pillar. If one day, whoever could be recognized by his imperial pillar could get his inheritance.
