characters.introText: She is an extremely beautiful woman. She is very tall and has a well shaped body. She has deep red waves of long hair hanging down to her waist, a fair face with exquisite facial features, a pair of big eyes faintly flickering with silvery light.
characters.appearance:
She is an extremely beautiful woman. She is very tall and has a well shaped body. She has deep red waves of long hair hanging down to her waist, a fair face with exquisite facial features, a pair of big eyes faintly flickering with silvery light.

In the Manhua, Huo Wu is a tall young woman in an orange and black school uniform. Her dark brown hair is nearly to her knees, with long bangs framing her face and an orange streak on the left, with a tasseled hair clip matching her uniform. She has gold eyes.
characters.personality: She is an extremely prideful, arrogant, and haughty individual, due to her talent, appearance, strength and background. She tends to hold petty grudges. She has quite the temper, often throwing temper-tantrums from the littlest of insults, prodding, or, most often, remembering the fact that Shrek Academy decimated her in the tournament. Doesn't seem to learn or grow from her losses, as shown after the five year time skip where she hasn't matured at all from her loss at the hands of Tang San, if anything she got more temperamental due to the humiliation she suffered during the tournament, angrily declaring she's going to snatch away Shrek Academy when her own was seized by Spirit Hall, only to be on the receiving end of a one sided massacre courtesy of Ma Hongjun and (yet again) Tang San. She'll most likely never grow up mentally.
characters.history:
She waited patiently during the match against the Shrek Academy's Team, and used her Repelling Fire Ring to isolate Tang San when Dai Mubai, Tai Long and Huang Yuan tried to knock out Huo Wushuang. She was forced to use her Repelling Fire Ring again when Tang San pulled Dai Mubai, Tai Long and Huang Yuan back into position.

She started charging up her Brilliant Sun after signaling Huo Wushuang to protect her. She fired her Brilliant Sun at Tang San after the latter provoked her. She was shocked to hear that Tang San was immune to fire. She and her teammates were restrained inside individual Blue Silver Prisons to force them to surrender. The team realized that they could not defeat the Shrek Academy's Team even without Tang San's fire immunity. She confronted Feng Xiaotian about his feelings for her, and told him that she would date him if he defeated Tang San.

She noticed that Zhu Zhuqing had replaced Jiang Zhu for the match and was angered thinking that the Shrek Academy's Team thought of the Blazing Academy's Team to be weaker than the Blue Sunshine Academy's Team. She tried to strike Tang San but was countered causing her to stumble. She stopped Huo Wushuang from acting out. The team was furious about the introduction from the host. She was shocked when the Shrek Academy's Team broke the Seven Asura Dreamland, only to be consoled when Tang San declared that it was not a Martial Soul Fusion.

She watched the match between the Shrek Academy's Team and the Skywater Academy's Team, and became happy that Tang San was completely suppressed by Shui Bing'er. She tried to provoke Tang San into fighting her in close combat, attacked him when he refused, and was pushed back to Huo Wushuang as a result. She sobbed when Huo Wushuang told that she was not Tang San's match, she had to cultivate hard, and even use methods similar to Shui Bing'er to defeat him.

She was the second to participate in the match against the Fabia Academy's Team and won four bouts to win the match. She then proceeded to provoke Tang San.

She decided to win the bout against Tang San no matter the cost after he had won the previous six bouts, to preserve the reputation of the Blazing Academy. She tried to use her Repelling Fire Ring repeatedly to push Tang San out of the stage to win. She started using her Soul Ring Merging to power her Brilliant Sun when Tang San jumped high to evade the effects of her Repelling Fire Ring. She tried to kill Tang San along with herself when he used her as a shield against her own Brilliant Sun. She was protected by Tang San at the last moment, by taking the burnt of the Brilliant Sun, and admitted his defeat. She conceded the next bout due to depleting her Soul Power, losing the match. She accompanied Huo Wushuang to thank Tang San for saving her life, but was turned back by Xiao Wu.

She took Tang San away for a chat after the end of the sixth round, and asked why he saved her life. She was shocked when Tang San told her his reasoning to save her, which was completely different from her imagination that he liked her. She kissed Tang San stating that it was her payment for saving her life, and she won't owe him anymore.

She witnessed Feng Xiaotian challenging Tang San to a one-on-one duel, and was asked by Huo Wushuang if that was her intention.

She proposed to Feng Xiaotian to have the members of the team of Blazing Academy join with the team of God Wind Academy. She told Feng Xiaotian that as long as the members of both team verbally promise Sa Lasi about joining the Martial Soul Hall after graduation, the tournament committee would allow them to join teams. The convoy from the Heaven Dou Empire was ambushed along the way to the Martial Soul City 10 days into the journey. She arranged her team to block the enemies.

She realized Ning Rongrong's identity after the ambushers were forced to retreat, as her team was nearby, and was shocked that she was still hidden by the Shrek Academy.

She participated in the Finals as part of Godwind Academy's Team and led the team to easy victories in the first two rounds. The team skipped the 3rd round as the highest-placed team after Shrek Academy's Team from the Heaven Dou Qualifiers still active in the tournament. She was shocked to see the full Shrek Seven Monsters lineup facing the Main Team of the Star Luo Imperial Academy in the 3rd round. She was shocked to learn that Zhu Zhuqing was still under 15 and wondered about Tang San's age.

She witnessed the Shrek Seven Monsters defeat the Main Team of the Star Luo Imperial Academy and the Martial Soul Hall Academy's Team defeat the Heaven Dou Imperial Academy's Main Team. The team advanced to the 5th round after easily winning their 4th-round match. She tried to hide from Tang San after he realized that God Wind Academy's Team had colluded with the Martial Soul Hall Academy's Team to exhaust Shrek Academy's Team before the Grand Finale.

God Wind Academy's Team forfeited the three-way match after Shrek Academy's Team forfeited. Before their match against Shrek Academy's Team, she told Tang San they had given up their chance to become champions for a rematch. She used her Soul Ring Fusion to support Feng Xiaotian as he took flight under the amplifications of Huo Jun and Huo Chui, creating armor around him with its energy. After Feng Xiaotian was knocked out of the stage, she began storing energy again. She was blasted out of the stage along with Huo Jun and Huo Chui by a single swing of the Clear Sky Hammer Avatar.

She arrived at Shrek Academy as part of the Four Elements Academy, formed by combining the Blazing Academy, God Wind Academy, Sky Water Academy, and Thunderclap Academy. Choosing a time when Flender, Yu Xiaogang, Liu Erlong, and Zhao Wuji were away, they defeated Shao Xin, Lu Qibin, and Li Yusong. She did not recognize Tang San's new appearance and thought Xiao Wu had fallen for someone else. After consulting with the others, she, Feng Xiaotian, and Huo Wushuang stepped forward. She was shocked when Tang San revealed his identity. She was shocked to see the Soul Rings of Tang San's Blue Silver Emperor. From the start of the battle, she, Feng Xiaotian, and Huo Wushuang were suppressed by Tang San.

She and Huo Wushuang tried to give Feng Xiaotian time to use the Storm Wind Demon Wolf’s Fifty Four Successive Chops but failed. Tang San restrained and poisoned her. Bitter about the defeat, she realized that Tang San had gone easy on them. She asked Tang San about Xiao Wu but received no answer. She stayed for the meeting. She became irritated when Ma Hongjun suggested that Feng Xiaotian rent space from Heaven Dou Imperial Academy for the Four Elements Academy. She became furious when Tang San refused to let the Four Elements Academy rent space inside Shrek Academy. She and Feng Xiaotian left Shrek Academy with the intention of visiting again to meet with Flender.

She participated in the Continental War and led the fire element Spirit Masters of the Shrek Academy to attack the Spirit Masters of the Martial Soul Empire after Tang San destroyed Bibi Dong's physical body along with a portion of the walls of the Jialing Pass, lowering enemy morale.

characters.introText:
Quick Answers
		
		
	
	
			
				
					Who are the parents-in-law of Huo Yuhao in Soul Land 2?
						
				
				
					
						Huo Yuhao's parents-in-law are Tang San and Xiao Wu, the parents of his wife, Tang Wutong. Through his marriage to Tang Wutong, Huo Yuhao is also the brother-in-law of Tang Wulin.
					
					
						Provided by: Community
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What is the significance of the Spirit Pagoda founded by Huo Yuhao?
						
				
				
					
						Huo Yuhao's Spirit Pagoda is instrumental for Soul Masters, offering vital research into artificial spirit souls. As the strongest force across three continents, it mediates peace between humans and spirits. Each Spirit Pagoda in the eighteen major cities, known as the Eighteen Pillars of Heaven, features a mural of Huo Yuhao, his Spirit Souls, and his companions.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What is the physical appearance of Huo Yuhao?
						
				
				
					
						Huo Yuhao from Soul Land 2 is described as an average-built individual, slightly thin, and around forty years old. His hair is short and black. As a God, his appearance remains largely unchanged, except for his hair, which is longer.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					How does Huo Yuhao's personality reflect in the Soul Land 2 series?
						
				
				
					
						Huo Yuhao is kind, hardworking, and exceptionally determined, readily helping people in need and relentlessly pursuing his goals. His difficult childhood also makes him distrustful of others and leaves him with a deep hatred connected to the suffering of his mother, which can sometimes cloud his judgment.
					
					
						Provided by: Community

characters.appearance:
Huo Yuhao leaves the Duke's mansion taking up his mother's last name 'Huo', vowing to one day return as a powerful Spirit Master. He makes his way alone to the Star Dou Forest to get his first Spirit Ring. While he is camping and roasting fish, the good smell attracts Tang Ya and Beibei. He gives them some fish to eat and sets on his way to the Star Dou Forest.

Near the outskirts of the Star Dou Forest, he is attacked by a Wind Baboon. He manages to kill it using the White Tiger Dagger. Shortly afterward appears an Ice Worm Spirit Beast named Skydream Ice Worm , who condenses itself to become Huo Yuhao's 1st Spirit Ring and becomes a conscious Spirit Ring existence within Huo Yuhao. Daydream reveals that he is a 1,000,000-year-old Spirit Beast who had been searching for a mental attribute human being so that he can become a Spirit Ring and take revenge on all the Spirit Beasts that harassed him.

Huo Yuhao wakes up with Tang Ya and Beibei surrounding him, worried about him. He is ecstatic he has obtained his 1st Spirit Ring. He is then invited by Tang Ya to join Tang Sect and also to become a student in Shrek Academy which he joyfully accepts.

Along with Tang Ya and Beibei, he arrives at the Star Dou Forest looking for a Spirit Ring for Tang Ya. They come across a Datura Snake suitable for Tang Ya's 3rd Spirit Ring. Beibei battles the Datura Snake and with Huo Yuhao's support with his spirit ability manages to subdue the Datura Snake. While Tang Ya absorbs the Ring, he instructs Huo Yuhao and also helps to clear his meridians. He imparts a lot of knowledge to Huo Yuhao while making their way back to the Shrek City to enter the Shrek Academy.

characters.introText:
Quick Answers
		
		
	
	
			
				
					What is the relationship between Huo Yun'er and Dai Hao?
						
				
				
					
						Huo Yun'er and Dai Hao were childhood friends. After Dai Hao became the Duke of White Tiger, she served as his personal maid and later gave birth to their son, Huo Yuhao. After Dai Hao left for war, the Duchess persecuted Huo Yun'er and forced her and her son to live in poor conditions.
					
					
						Provided by: Community
					
					
				
			
			
				
					How would you describe Huo Yun'er's personality?
						
				
				
					
						Huo Yun'er is calm, kind, good-natured, determined, and hardworking. Despite suffering severe hardships and living in poor health, she devoted herself to raising and caring for her son, Huo Yuhao.
					
					
						Provided by: Community
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What was Huo Yun'er's role after Dai Hao's ascension to Duke?
						
				
				
					
						Huo Yun'er served as a personal maid to Dai Hao following his rise to Duke. She bore him a son, Huo Yuhao, and was subsequently raised to nobility. After Dai Hao left for war, the Duchess relegated her to a woodshed, falsely claiming she had a contagious disease. Despite her frailty, Yun'er raised her son until she passed away when Huo Yuhao was 10.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom

characters.history:
She and Dai Hao were childhood friends. Following his ascension to Duke, she became his personal maid attending to him. Then she became pregnant by him with her son Huo Yuhao. After his birth, she was made into a noble woman.

Following the Duke's departure to war, she was forced to live in a woodshed behind the servant's quarters by the Duchess who fabricated lies that she had an infectious disease. She worked hard with her weak body to raise her son but died after Huo Yuhao became 10.

characters.introText:
Quick Answers
		
		
	
	
			
				
					Who are Huo Zhanji's parents in the Legend of Douluo World?
						
				
				
					
						In the Legend of Douluo World, Huo Zhanji is the offspring of Huo Yuhao and Tang Wutong. He has a senior sibling, Dai Ying. On the Douluo planet, he led the Blue Silver Team and later moved to the Falan Planet.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What is the significance of Huo Zhanji's black and blue hair?
						
				
				
					
						The black and blue hair of Huo Zhanji, a character from the Soul Land wiki, is a manifestation of his Dragon God bloodline. This transformation, observed by Bai Xiuxiu, gives his hair the tranquil sea's hue, lighter than dark blue. His eyes also acquire a hint of blue and a subtle nine-color glow. His appearance grows more heroic after practicing the Heavenly Demon Art.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					Who is the captain of the Blue Silver Team in the Legend of Douluo World?
						
				
				
					
						Huo Zhanji is the leader of the Blue Silver Team, an elite group from Shrek Academy. He serves as the primary auxiliary-control system soul master and possesses power equivalent to a 5-ringed Soul King.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What happens to Huo Zhanji when he is transmitted to the Falan Planet?
						
				
				
					
						Huo Zhanji, part of the Blue Silver Team, is sent to the Falan Planet with his companions. This is the location where his grandparents have undergone reincarnation. His heroic demeanor is further accentuated after he practices the Heavenly Demon Art.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					Who are Huo Zhanji's grandparents and what is their connection to the Falan Planet?
						
				
				
					
						Huo Zhanji's maternal grandparents are Tang San and Xiao Wu, while his paternal grandparents are Dai Hao and Huo Yun'er. Tang San and Xiao Wu were reincarnated on the Falan Planet, where Tang San was reborn and later reunited with Xiao Wu's reincarnation. Huo Zhanji was later transported to the Falan Planet together with his companions.
					
					
						Provided by: Community

characters.trivia:
Regarding the surnames of the two children, Huo Yuhao verbally told Yi Zichen that Dai Ying followed his father Dai Hao's surname while the second child would follow the surname of his mother Huo Yun'er.

The meaning of his name, 斩疾, was killing the disease. His grandmother, Xiao Wu, was sick before, and everyone hoped that she would get better before she could name the second child.

He was born with full of luck because of the influence of his father, Huo Yuhao.

Besides the Magic skills, he also learned Battle Armor making skills from Tang San and weapons forging skills from Ge Lisi. Although he knew the methods of Alchemy, he didn’t practice.

He possessed 2 spirit souls, Xiao Xie and Tian Meng. They should be the 2 former spirit souls of Huo Yuhao.

After his team became the champion of the Advanced Academy Soul Master Elite Competition, their team was rewarded with 3 spirit bones. Although it wasn’t mentioned that what spirit bone he had fused with, his eyes were on Wisdom Skull Bone of Sacred Magical Devil Ape.

characters.title: Ice Bear
characters.introText: There aren’t many soul beasts in the Extreme North in the first place, and the Ice Bears are considered one of the rarer species. If these bears can grow until they reach ten thousand years of cultivation, they will become the main fighting force of the Extreme North’s soul beasts.
characters.appearance:
There were several Ice Bears in the Extreme North that were incredibly muscular. These bears were very large, at least seven to eight meters tall when they stood up, while their bodies were extremely thick and tough. These spirit beasts had thick fur, and their strength was terrifying. Furthermore, their explosiveness was so vigorous that they could spring over short distances as quickly as agility-type soul beasts. They were high up in the food chain within the Extreme North’s icy plains.

Full-grown Extreme Northern Bears had to have at least 1.000 years of cultivation, but one couldn’t underestimate their threat just because they were only thousand year spirit beasts. The Ice Bears in this place were like the Dark Gold Fear Claw Bear in the Great Star Dou Forest. Thousand year Ice Bears could rival normal 10.000 year spirit beasts, and even though their fighting strength still couldn’t match up to that of the Darkgolden Terrorclaw Bears, very few spirit beasts dared to provoke them.

Ice Bears had very sensitive senses of smell, because the Extreme North always had a scarcity of food. Therefore, their sense of smell became very strong through their consistent evolution. They could smell other living beings from kilometers away, and it was clear that they had discovered him, and were treating him like prey.

The Ice Bears’ paws were sold at extremely high prices in every empire on the continent.

characters.introText: Xiao Bai, one of the overlords of the Extreme North, is an Ice Bear King with a cultivation of 290,000+ years. He was adopted by  Snow Empress, so he respects her as his mom, and thus calls Huo Yuhao "grandpa".
characters.appearance:
The Ice Bear King was a white bear whose tremendous body was like a tiny hill as it was over forty meters tall. Thick fur covered its immense frame, and it radiated faint silver hues. Its head was over two meters in diameter. His eyes were dark blue and his large nose, which was different from its white fur, and was a little pinkish, poked forward.

He was just like a ball-shaped human with huge tummy. His flesh was all round, and even his head was ball-shaped. His look was extremely interesting, or rather funny.

It was a gigantic bear which was over a hundred meters tall. Its muscular body was even thicker and broader than some of the smaller mountains. It was covered in a layer of grey fur with a faint bluish-grey air current that rippled about its body. The most peculiar thing about it was its eyes. There was a powerful blue flame burning in its eye sockets.
characters.personality: He was very simple-minded and had a child like personality. He appeared very foolish, but was very determined.
characters.history:
Snow Empress found Little Bai as a tiny Ice Bear when she first called herself queen, and he had been living with the Snow Empress ever since. It had been at least two hundred thousand years. Little Bai used to rule over his own domain, but he always treated the Snow Empress like a mother.

He helped Huo Yuhao to scare away the Sun Moon Empire’s army who came to the Extreme North to mine the rare metals. He also followed him after that and was always ready whenever he was needed. While in the Electrolux‘s Demiplane, his 3rd Thunder Tribulation suddenly arrived that caused him on the blink of death. For the sake of Huo Yuhao, Di Tian resisted the last Thunder Tribulation that prevented him from death. Even so, there was no way to save him. Thus, he became another Spirit Soul of Huo Yuhao. His body underwent mutation because it was restricted by the rules of the Demiplane. A streak of his soul still remained in his body and became the Undead. It was named Er Bai and it later became the King of the Demiplane.

Together with other spirit souls, he accompanied throughout the journey of Huo Yuhao and finally crossed towards the Divine Realm with him.
characters.trivia:
When he first transformed into a human, he specially asked the Snow Empress. She said that she liked him in his chubby state. That’s why he chose this look.

Er Bai’s strength was far superior than the Ice Bear King at his peak when he was alive.

characters.title: Ice Devil Titan
characters.introText: The Ice Devil Titans live in very cold environments. Tian Meng says that the blood of the Ice God flows through their bodies. The Ice Devil Titan clan is a descendant of the Titan Giant clan. They are the most powerful race of the Extreme North. They possess incredibly terrifying strength. Their body is their strongest weapon and ability. Their strength and dominance are nightmares for their enemies. However, their bodies ate very large, which makes them easy targets for Soul Tools. Every step they took covered more than a hundred meters. When they leaped up, they could even cover more than five hundred meters. In just two leaps, they covered one kilometer!
characters.appearance:
Ice Devil Titans are over ten meters tall at birth, while adult Ice Devil Titans are over fifty meters tall. The Ice Devil Titan King was over a hundred meters tall, and he’s most likely the largest living creature on the Douluo Continent.

The Ice Devil Titans had a build that was very similar to that of humans. It had long and slender arms, and snowy white fur covered its entire body. Even its face had similar features to that of humans, except there were many wrinkles on its forehead, and its skin had a copper tint. It had two large fangs, and those two fangs showed its true colors as a spirit beast. It's hands can also turn into claws that can easily tear through metal alloys.

Ice Devil Titans has the strongest bodies of the Extreme North. They use their bodies in close combat and to roll down their enemies.

					What is the Ice Empress's rank among the top 10 Great Beasts of the continent?

Appearance[]
Spirit Beast Form[]
It was a scorpion whose beauty had reached the pinnacle. It was roughly 1.5 meters long and had two colors on its body. One was the color of ice, and the other was a jade green color.
characters.appearance:
It was a scorpion whose beauty had reached the pinnacle. It was roughly 1.5 meters long and had two colors on its body. One was the color of ice, and the other was a jade green color.

The front end of its body had four layers stacked above each other, and each layer was longer than the previous one by a third of a meter. Its head lay on the frontmost layer, and its silver-white mouth shone with an ominous, cold light. The front of its body was covered a type of special protruding outwards.

They were shaped like hexagons and shone with an incomparably bright luster, and were akin to a diamond in shape. They covered the front section of its body, and its six slender legs.

Its two pincers were both a meter long, and they were both covered with the strange diamond-like hexagonal protrusions. Only, the foremost parts of its pincers were covered in a mirror-like silverish-white color just like its mouth.

Its eyes were yellow, as if two yellow diamonds had been embedded within its sockets. They were also hexagonal, and the flickering of their crystal-like yellow light gave off a feeling similar to that of a gem glistening.

Unlike the finely segmented tail of an ordinary scorpion, the tail of the Ice Empress only had five segments. Each segment shone with an alluring jade-green light that was filled with luster. Its five segments were identically colored, and the segment nearest to its upper body was the widest of the five; the further away from its body, the narrower it got. The last segment was also inlaid with the diamond-like protrusions, and the very tip of its tail similarly flickered with a mirror-like, silver white luster.
characters.personality: She was cold and arrogant. She was full of a desire to kill back then but later changed after becoming spirit soul of Huo Yuhao.
characters.history:
When Huo Yuhao reached level 20, Skydream told him to go to the Extreme North to seek her for his second spirit. However, skydream left Yuhao out of the negotiation process completely.

Skydream went out by himself to confront her and lured her out into his trap, ultimately with the intention of convincing her to be a part of his grand plan. She was agitated at first but after hearing him out, she was eventually taken by his idea of making god together. Skydream recounted her about the birth of a (human) god 10,000 years prior. Skydream also assured her that when she became a spirit ring, she would be a spirit ring with intelligence. Skyydream gave her 2 options, to wait for a slow boring meaningless death or to live for eternity as the part of god. She thought it through, not having any other option that was better than that, she realized what an opportunity this was.

She finally agreed to help Yuhao achieve god status with Skydream together. Skydream introduced the 2 properly, shortly afterwards Yuhao was put to the test by the emperor to endure a very painful and long spirit bone fusion. After having gone through it, he successfully absorbed both her spirit bone and spirit ring. She also became his second martial soul, Ice Jade Scorpion Empress.

A scorpion marking on the back of its host

As the conscious spirit ring, she helped Huo Yuhao in many possible ways. After she found out that the embryo of 100,000 years spirit beast was the Snow Empress, she persuaded her to also follow Huo Yuhao who then later became the first ever spirit soul in the history. She also later became the spirit soul of Huo Yuhao.

Together with other spirit souls, he accompanied throughout the journey of Huo Yuhao and finally crossed towards the Divine Realm with him.
characters.trivia:
The author rounds up her age after she beaks her final bottle neck, turning her into a full fledge 400,000 year beast spirit (which explains the 4 golden markings on her red rings). Any spirit who has lived anywhere near 400,000 years would be able to change the colour of the sky to their theme colour, which for her case was a beautiful Jade Green.

She is the love of Daydream's life. (Since they first met 200,000 years ago.)

Daydream calls her "bing bing" (冰冰) which in the Chinese language means, ice ice, While Yuhao calls her "Bing Di" (冰帝) which translates to: Ice Empress in English.

Daydream always had the intention for the Ice Empress to be Yuhao’s second spirit.

Her full addressing title in Chinese is: "Bing Bi Huang Di Xie" (冰碧帝皇蝎), which is word for word equivalent to "Ice Jade Emperor Scorpion" in English, though this does not preserve the meaning. The appropriate translation should be "Ice Jade Scorpion Empress".

Quick Answers
		
		
	
	
			
				
					How does the speed of Ice Silk Worms affect their fighting strength?
						
				
				
					
						Ice Silk Worms are Spirit Beasts with very low speed, which weakens their fighting strength. This slow movement makes them less effective in combat, contributing to their status as ordinary Spirit Beasts. Natural predators also limit their survival, often preventing them from reaching higher cultivation levels.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					Why is the golden mark significant for Ice Silk Worms?
						
				
				
					
						The golden mark on an Ice Silk Worm signifies its advancement to 100,000 years of cultivation, evolving it into a Gold-patterned Ice Silk Worm. This mark is rare due to their slow speed and natural predators, which often prevent them from reaching this level.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What attributes do Ice Silk Worms possess?
						
				
				
					
						Ice Silk Worms, Spirit Beasts from the Extreme North, have Mental and Ice attributes. Their low speed limits their combat strength. They rarely exceed 10,000 years of cultivation due to predators. A golden mark signifies their evolution into Gold-patterned Ice Silk Worms at 100,000 years. Their shed skin provides ventilation, resists elements, and hides their aura.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What is the maximum cultivation age for most Ice Silk Worms?
						
				
				
					
						Most Ice Silk Worms reach a maximum cultivation age of 10,000 years due to natural predators. However, some, like the Skydream Ice Worm, can live up to 1,000,000 years.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What challenges do Ice Silk Worms face in the Extreme North?
						
				
				
					
						Ice Silk Worms in the Extreme North struggle due to their low speed, which weakens their defense against predators. This limitation often prevents them from reaching more than 10,000 years of cultivation. Despite having Mental and Ice attributes, these do not significantly aid their survival.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom

Description[]

They have dual attributes, Mental attribute and Ice attribute. Their speed is extremely low, which reflects poorly on their overall fighting strength. This makes them rather ordinary Spirit Beasts. Being the Immortal Fire Phoenix, she possesses Phoenix True Fire which is superior to Fiery Sun Flower’s True Fire. Medium- and long-distance attacks are the strength of the immortal fire phoenix.

It is the original skill of Immortal Fire Phoenix, also the reason why they are named Immortal. Phoenix Nirvana is in real fire. Although it is not immortal, as long as there is Phoenix Real Fire, they can complete Nirvana, and no matter how serious the injury is, it can be resolved. Of course, nirvana rebirth will touch the origin. Although it can also be used continuously, the more times it is used, the greater the cost.

When Phoenix Nirvana, the surrounding Phoenix True Fire is the strongest. It is not only defense, but also taking the opportunity to kill the enemy.

Thousands of golden red light spots flow in the direction of the enemy. It is a golden red flame in the shape of phoenix feathers, almost all over the sky. Every golden flame feather looks like substance, like a large open net. Phoenix fire rain is extremely dense, no matter how good the flight ability is, it can't be completely avoided.

This is the secret of the immortal fire phoenix clan. Only ethnic groups like it who are qualified to inherit have the opportunity to learn it. Phoenix Fire Rain is an all-round control, and once stuck, it is almost impossible to break free. Falling surrounded by the real fire of the phoenix, the ultimate result of the enemy will only be the extinction of ashes. Although Phoenix Fire Rain is immortal, once the energy is detached from the body, it will be consumed.

Ji Qing and Yuan Nong form the duo Swallowed Crab, where they fight in the Vast Sea City Arena against Dai Mubai and Zhu Zhuqing.
Before the match, Tang San informed Mubai that this spirit is a mutated version of the deep sea soul eater, hence Mubai and Zhuqing ate Oscar's detoxifying garlic. Mubai and Zhuqing are able to defeat Swallowed Crab but unfortunately for them, they revealed to the audience that they had taken the antidote before the match which was against the rules, resulting in Swallowed Crab taking the win.

characters.personality:
Jia Yu iternally holds great pride and firm will as a Shrek Academy student and Sea Spirit Master. Knowing his difficulties as a Sea Spirit Master to study at Shrek Academy, Jia Yu continuously fortifies his willpower to work hard and finds each bottleneck breakthrough gratifying.

He loves Shrek Academy with all his heart. Most of the time, Jia Yu acts with the flow and speaks less in his trio. He is shy when praised and calm during his normal speech. He is also bold, daring to harm his cultivation and life just to stay in Shrek Academy's Inner Court.
characters.history:
Jia Yu was first introduced alongside Li Bin and Li Han fighting against Tang Xuanyu, Qian Lei and Liu Feng. With Xuanyu's Sea God bloodline suppression, Jia Yu's trio failed to complete their battle. Afterwards, with Shrek Academy's interest in Tang Xuanyu's influence on sea martial souls, Jia Yu's trio learned of befriending hum and under his bloodline influence, created their trio's signature spirit fusion technique. With their spirit fusion, the trio secured chance enrollment into Shrek Academy.

During the trip to Elven Planet in his Shrek Outer Court first year second semester, Jia Yu was the only one in the whole class who did not ontain a true Spirit Soul because of the planet's lack of the sea spirit beast.

By his Outer Court graduation, Jia Yu had reached Rank 65 and a 2-word battle armor, with Tang Xuanyu’s forged metals. He had also earned enough resources to have his own Purple Sky Wing Mecha.

He had a very strong talent in fighter pilot. In the whole class, he simply competed with fighter pilot. He was the third person after Tang Xuanyu and Ding Zhuohan.

During the Shrek Inner Court Trial of Blood, he noted as one of the weakest members of the 33 Sky Wings. He lacked a true Spirit Soul, a Soul Core for his cultivation rank and his Sea Scepter required a great water source to summon his sea creatures, if none then more power was paid to summon.

Near the trial's second level of crowd combat, a drastic Jia Yu discovered a new medium and technique to empower his Sea Scepter's summoning and offensive capabilities, blood. With this discovery, Jia Yu had become more exploratory about his Sea Scepter.

For his military period, Jia Yu's trio was grouped with Bing Tianliang, Lin Donghui and Yu Tian to conduct their military services.
characters.trivia:
He was the first Sea Spirit Master to suffer under Sea God bloodline's suppression of Tang Xuanyu.

Jia Yu had earned a promise from Tang Xuanyu to assist him obtaining a true Sea Spirit Soul.

Quick Answers
		
		
	
	
			
				
					How does Jiang Nannan's beauty affect her surroundings?
						
				
				
					
						Jiang Nannan's unparalleled beauty, likened to lunar radiance and blossoming trees, significantly influences her environment. Her presence is so captivating that it seemingly dims the hues around her. Her attractiveness, coupled with her gracious and respectful demeanor, has earned her immense popularity, particularly at Shrek Academy, where she's acknowledged as the supreme beauty. Despite her allure, she favors modest attire and is recognized for her humility.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What is the nature of Jiang Nannan's personality and how does she treat others?
						
				
				
					
						Jiang Nannan is characterized by her kindness and grace, treating everyone with respect. Her interactions with Xu Sanshi, however, reveal a colder side due to their past disagreements. Nannan's past has also shaped her frugality, often avoiding costly items and haggling over small amounts. She declines gifts and financial assistance from Xu Sanshi, showcasing her independent nature.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What are the unique qualities of Jiang Nannan's voice and temperament?
						
				
				
					
						Jiang Nannan, often referred to as Nan Nan, is recognized for her calm voice and elegant demeanor. She is respectful towards everyone, and her presence often eclipses her surroundings. Her voice and temperament contribute to her unparalleled charm and beauty.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					How does Jiang Nannan's physical appearance contribute to her character?
						
				
				
					
						Jiang Nannan is characterized by her slender, well-proportioned physique, golden hair, and snow-like skin. Her golden eyes and jade-like face, likened to a moon and a blooming tree, enhance her graceful demeanor. Her exceptional beauty is said to outshine her surroundings, reflecting her kind and respectful nature.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom

Appearance[]
Jiang Nannan has a slender and well-proportioned body, with her long golden hair flowing behind her head. Her skin is like snow, her eyes are like gold that possess a graceful quality. Her face is like jade, like a newly filled moon, like snow around a flowering tree, with tender looks, a relaxed voice, a delicate temperament and beauty beyond comparison. Her presence seems to make the colors around her dull.
characters.appearance:
Jiang Nannan having smelled the roasted fish arrives at the fish stall conducted by Huo Yuhao tries to bargain with him. However seeing that he does not wish to bargain, she quickly apologizes and tries to buy a roasted fish. However she is not sold any since the last 2 fish were kept aside for Tang Ya. This causes the surrounding people to become angry for not selling it to Nannan and having seen this Xu Sanshi forcibly takes the fish and tries to give it to her, which she refuses.

The following day she is approached by Xu Sanshi who tries to give Jiang Nannan the fish he bought after queuing up properly. However Jiang Nannan refuses the offered fish and even rejects his confession saying they will never be together.  After his incessant whining, she told him she would drop out of Shrek Academy if he didn't leave her alone.

Jiang Nannan becomes one of Yuhao's regular customers, openly praising his skill to Tang Ya despite her shy nature.

When Yuhao and Wang Dong were attacked outside Shrek Academy, Jiang Nannan was one of the first students to jump to their rescue, arriving even before the teachers. She teamed up with Ma Xiaotao, Xu Sanshi, and Bei Bei to kill their enemies, without leaving a single survivor.

During the group battle to determine the reserve team for the Shrek Seven Devils, Nannan was one of the final seven contestants, earning a spot on the team for the tournament. She qualified despite showing mercy, and only throwing her opponents out of bounds. Instead of being happy, she immediately became depressed when she realized she'd be on a team with Xu Sanshi, who was openly gloating.

After she qualified, Nannan was given the option of becoming a Shrek Guardian: a dangerous and shadowy job, where she would assassinate rogue Spirit Masters while disguised under a mask, to protect civilians from the shadows. Despite the serious danger and being only 15, she accepted, becoming a Guardian.

characters.history:
Tian Long noticed Tang Xuanyu and the 33 Sky Wings who discovered his secret on the Dragon Source Planet. He sent his projection to kill them to silence them, but Nana and Wang Tianyu interfered. He almost killed Wang Tianyu with one punch.

He appreciated Nana very much and asked her to be his wife (first queen). Nana rejected him. To this he felt regret, then he tried to kill her. After Nana summoned the Dragon God's Core, he started to get scared because he thought he met a former God King.

In ending of book 15, he wanted to use his projection's explosion to kill the people who knows his secret, but Nana saved Tang Xuanyu and his classmates, expending most of her energy in the process, which caused her to fall into a lava planet.

He went to Douluo Planet together with Tianma to discuss the truce after Tang Xuanyu exploded the base of Space Source Crystal and stole the source, Sky Bug, of the Space Source Star.

Volume 1 - Awakening[]
Spirit Soul[]
It was originally a 10 year old Grass Snake, a defective Spirit Soul that Tang Wulin purchased from the Spirit Pagoda. If it was to be described in the simplest of words, only four were needed. Harmless human raised livestock!
characters.appearance: It evolved to 100,000 year old spirit soul during Tang Wulin's Sea God Examinations.
characters.history:
It was originally a 10 year old Grass Snake, a defective Spirit Soul that Tang Wulin purchased from the Spirit Pagoda. If it was to be described in the simplest of words, only four were needed. Harmless human raised livestock!

First it was too tiny, measuring only about ten centimeters in length and was about as thin as a child’s finger. Its body was an earthen yellow color, and if you looked at it closely, a tiny rhombus shaped scale could be seen. When Tang Wulin absorbed the grass snake, it grew 8 centimeters long with a blue tint on its earthen yellow body.

Under the influence of the Golden Dragon King's bloodline, its body turned golden, and its scales stuck out a bit now, and they contained a distinct radiance to them. Golden stripes traveled from its tail up its body and converging at a single point on its forehead. It grew one more centimeter. Its murky eyes were gone, replaced with clarity.

In the manhua, it remained green and had a golden scale on its forehead.

characters.introText: Jing Hongchen was the youngest Class 9 Soul Engineer, the Hall Master of the Illustrious Virtue Hall, the Grand Advisor of the Sun Moon Empire and also the Dean of the Sun Moon Imperial Soul Engineering Academy. He was the grandfather of Xiao Hongchen and Meng Hongchen.
characters.appearance: He looked not more than 40 years of age, and he wasn’t tall, yet he was robust. However, one couldn't tell his actual age simply just based on his looks as he was around the same age as Yan Shaozhe. A simpler way of explaining his appearance would be that he was short and plump. Long hair wasn’t suitable for a person with a short and plump build, but he had a flowing lock of long reddish-brown hair that draped behind his head, and this made his short and thick neck even more obscure. He wasn’t even one-and-a-half meters tall, but his girth was definitely over a meter-and-a-half. He placed his hands behind his back, and there was a flowing black robe embroidered with golden patterns covering his bulbous tummy.
characters.personality:
His haughtiness was even greater than Du Busi's. He was a ruthless, ambitious, and formidable character, and the only problem was the kinks in his personality. Honor was a little too important to him, and he was headstrong and irritable at the same time. How could one judge something calmly and fairly if one got angry, and that meant others would have a chance to take advantage of him. Even though he had a hot temper, he was a highly adaptable person.

Elder Mu said Jing Hongchen was a ruthless, ambitious, and formidable character, and the only problem was the kinks in his personality. Honor was a little too important to him, and he was headstrong and irritable at the same time .
characters.history:
He came to the Shrek Academy uninvited together with other evil soul masters to kidnap Ma Xiaotao. He was confronted by Mu En and to please him, he was forced to reluctantly give away his own creation, a unique class 9 soul tool, the Hongchen's Blessing to the Shrek Academy, unknowing that the other soul tools he brought were also being taken as well.

He was the head of Illustrious Virtue Hall that was later destroyed by Huo Yuhao who caused the massive explosion in the Mingdu City. Although he wanted to rebuild it, he was kicked out by Xu Tianran even though he supported him throughout his life.

After hatching, she called Tang San "Dad" and was named Jing Jing by him. She merged with Tang San and took up one of his Brand slots. Although she was sleeping most of the time, she helped Tang San at critical times.

It was revealed before Tang San revisited the Hell Garden that she was the true reincarnation of the Crystal Great Monster Emperor and planned to re-cultivate to become god through Tang San's tribulation and separate from him after he withstood the brunt of it, but reconsidered after witnessing just a glimpse of it, crushing her dreams of succeeding her plans and finally followed Tang San to the Divine Realm.
characters.trivia:
It should be noted that although Jing Jing cannot replicate luck, she can isolate luck. When the Great Crystal Monster Emperor went to re-engrave the power of the bloodline of Heavenly Fox Great Monster Emperor, it was impossible to re-engrave it, but she invalidated the ability of the Heavenly Fox Great Monster Emperor on herself.

Among all the emperors, she was the only one with the strength to kill the Heavenly Fox Great Monster Emperor.

She can re-engrave at least 3 bloodlines at the same time.

She can control space and time which is related to the true meaning of the universe to a certain extent, which is only a simple copy but she cannot comprehend the true meaning of it.

Although her final cultivation rank wasn't explicitly stated, she probably broke through Tier 12 after transcending the Emperor Tribulation with Tang San and Mei Gongzi. Just like she broke through Tier 10 after accompanying Tang San to transcend the Great Divine Tribulation of Destruction and Annihilation of the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths.

characters.introText:
Quick Answers
		
		
	
	
			
				
					What role does Ju Zi play in the Sun Moon Royal Spirit Guidance Master Academy?
						
				
				
					
						Ju Zi, a student at the Sun Moon Royal Spirit Guidance Master Academy, was among the four esteemed disciples of Xuan Ziwen. Her roles expanded beyond academia as she ascended to the position of Empress in the Sun Moon Empire. She held numerous titles including the Right Arm of Xu Tianran, 5 Star Soul Engineer, Phoenix Soul Engineer, Legion's Commander, and Goddess of War. Her affiliations included the Phoenix Soul Engineer Legion and Glory Hall.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What does Ju Zi look like?
						
				
				
					
						In the novel, Ju Zi is described as a pretty young woman with long, flowing black hair who initially appears to be around seventeen or eighteen years old. She has large, nimble eyes with a slightly nebulous and drowsy appearance, soft and delicate skin, and a naturally cute, somewhat lazy demeanor.
					
					
						Provided by: Community
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What led to Ju Zi becoming the Empress of the Sun Moon Empire?
						
				
				
					
						Ju Zi, originally a student at the Sun Moon Royal Spirit Guidance Master Academy, harbored a deep-seated hatred and sought the Sun Moon Empire's power for revenge. She left her first love, Yuhao, at the Illustrious Virtue Hall to marry Xu Tianran, the Sun Moon Empire's crown prince. After saving Xu Tianran from an assassination attempt by taking two stabs in her back, she became his confidante and later ascended as the Empress of the Sun Moon Empire.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What are some notable characteristics of Ju Zi's personality?
						
				
				
					
						Known as the War Empress or Queen Orange, Ju Zi is a resilient and determined character. She studied at the Sun Moon Royal Spirit Guidance Master Academy before becoming the Empress of the Sun Moon Empire. Despite her toughness, Ju Zi can be anxious in situations involving Huo Yuhao. As a Spirit Sage, she possesses an Orange Spirit, contributing to her alias, Queen Orange.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					How does Ju Zi's relationship with Xuan Ziwen evolve throughout the story?
						
				
				
					
						Ju Zi, initially in love with Yuhao, left the Illustrious Virtue Hall to marry Xu Tianran, the Sun Moon Empire's crown prince, for revenge. Her relationship with Yuhao changed when she revealed that he was the father of her child, leading her to abandon her quest for revenge. As Xu Tianran's confidante, Ju Zi demonstrated her loyalty by protecting him from an assassination attempt.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom

Appearance[]
She was a young pretty woman who seemed a little drowsy-eyed. She had long, flowing black hair and she looked to be between seventeen and eighteen years of age, with her large and nimble eyes appearing a little nebulous. Her complexion was just too impressive, as not a single pore could be seen on her soft and tender skin. Perhaps she wasn’t as pretty as Jiang Nannan, but her lazy and naturally cute demeanor was riveting. Her soft and silky voice gave people a strange and tickly sensation in their hearts.
characters.appearance: She was a young pretty woman who seemed a little drowsy-eyed. She had long, flowing black hair and she looked to be between seventeen and eighteen years of age, with her large and nimble eyes appearing a little nebulous. Her complexion was just too impressive, as not a single pore could be seen on her soft and tender skin. Perhaps she wasn’t as pretty as Jiang Nannan, but her lazy and naturally cute demeanor was riveting. Her soft and silky voice gave people a strange and tickly sensation in their hearts.
characters.personality: Even though Ju Zi was ignorant and obnoxious, she was also very ambitious. She wouldn’t hesitate to destroy everything in her way to achieve her dream. She was also twisted who would break her promises just for her ego. Her heart was filled with hatred. Her innate kindness was still there, but it was deeply concealed.
characters.history:
She met Xu Tianran, the future emperor of Sun Moon Empire, befriended and accompanied him for several years, joined the army, and eventually become his wife and the empress of the empire. She is renowned as the "God of War" or the "War Empress" by the common people and the army.

Because she ignored her agreement with Huo Yuhao and confronted with the Star Luo Empire while the latter was on retreat, Huo Yuhao had no choice but to take away Xu Yunhan through a space rift, which had angered Tang San causing him to descend to the lower realm, ending up with Yuhao finding out he is Xu Yunhan's father.
characters.trivia: Ju Zi's favorite colour is orange. This can be seen from the color of her soul tools like her storage-type soul tool, flying-type soul tool, carving knife, etc.

He thought he could win since one of that was Rank 11 Soul Tool, but with Absolute Zero of Huo Yuhao, he was easily defeated.
characters.trivia:
If not for the fact that he placed most of his energy on researching soul tools, he might not actually be inferior to Ye Xishui, Long Xiaoyao and any other Ultimate Douluo in terms of his cultivation.

Ye Xishui's Death God Pagoda was mainly constructed by Kong Deming.

His second martial soul could be Space Element or its related one, based on the spatial abilities of his Silver Moon Divine Light Barrier and Silver Moon Divine Light Ray that he invented.

The other masterpiece of his was the Humanoid Soul Tool which he designed and later it became the starting point of the mecha in SL3.

characters.history:
She became ill after forty years due to the curse of the Ice Clan. It broke out and became so serious that even Bi Ji or even the highest federal technology or replenishing with life energy couldn’t treat her. Tang Xuanyu gave her a drop of the divine life essence of the Eternal Tree to cure her disease and specially asked Old Shu for help in person. In addition with Bi Ji, a drop of this divine life essence was taken, which finally made up for the life loophole of her and saved her life.

Old Shu advised her to stay at the Mother Planet for a period of time. One was to stabilize her condition and not to repeat, and the other was to practice here. The divine life essence can really open the divine door, especially on the mother planet. Being able to take a drop is definitely an adventure for her, and she is already at the level of titled Douluo. If there is a period of accumulation, it may be possible to touch the God level.

characters.introText: Lei Jun, Bi Ran and Wu Yuhan participated in the Skysea Tournament. They encountered class zero, Tang Wulin, Xie Xie, and Gu Yue, of Eastsea Academy as their first opponents in the round-robin round of the spirit master team competition.
characters.appearance: He is short and stout.
characters.history:
Lei Jun, Bi Ran and Wu Yuhan participated in the Skysea Tournament. They encountered class zero, Tang Wulin, Xie Xie, and Gu Yue, of Eastsea Academy as their first opponents in the round-robin round of the spirit master team competition.

As soon as the match started, Bi Ran charged toward class zero with Wu Yuhan and Lei Jun behind him on his left and right respectively maintaining their triangle formation. As soon as they saw Tang Wulin with a purple spirit ring, they decided to launch a pincer attack on him.

Sparks curled around Lei Jun’s being made from pure electricity. Electric snakes slithered out of his body, converging into a ball in front of him. Lei Jun launched his rippling electric sphere straight at Tang Wulin. At the same time Wu Yuhan launched a lightning attack at him.

When the thunder ball reached Tang Wulin, he grabbed it with his right golden dragon claw and crushed it with his fist. When Lei Jun prepared to use his second soul skill, Gu Yue dropped a giant ball of water on top of him. The water soaking him conducted his electricity and completely dispersed it, draining him of soul power.

A portion of Tang Wulin's Bluesilver Grass encroached upon the wet Lei Jun. The water soon froze into ice, leaving him incapable of defending against Tang Wulin’s Bind. Row upon row of icicles floated in the air surrounding him, ready to impale him at a moment’s notice. Frozen and restricted by Bluesilver Grass, he was practically a lump of meat on the chopping block. Wu Yuhan had to be protected by the referee from Xie Xie's attack, while Bi Ran was struggling to defend himself against Tang Wulin's attacks. The referee ended the match with victory going to class zero.

After absorbing the seven-colored elemental calamity produced by the Divine Blacksmith Tang Wulin, the purple-blue color of the vine became darker than before. It was even more peculiar that a faint seven-colored radiance was seen on every vine. Even though one would only notice upon close examination, its aura was completely different compared to before.
characters.history:
It was the spirit soul of Zhang Geyang during the Battle of Five Gods against Tang Wulin. Under the pursuance of Damask Tulip, he chose to follow Tang Wulin afterwards. Through constant absorption of the power of thunder and lightning, it broke through 100,000 years cultivation base, giving Tang Wulin a Red spirit ring with Purple-Gold inside. Moreover, it sealed in a large amount of pure lightning power that had yet to be completely absorbed. The lightning power was sufficient to provide continuous supply to the Thunderclap Nether Vine’s digestion and absorption in the future which would allow it to continue its evolution faster than ordinary spirit souls by countless times.

After Tang Wulin killed the ~400,000 years Evil Spirit Orca King and passed the Sea God Trials' 6th Trial, all his four spirit souls received additional ~100,000 years increase, thus evolving it into a 200,000 years Orange-Gold spirit ring.

It accompanied throughout the journey of Tang Wulin together with Gold Song and other spirit souls.
characters.trivia: Although it didn't debut in the Soul Land 4, it should have already become God Level together with Gold Song being the spirit souls of Tang Wulin.

characters.trivia: In the Encyclopedia, Lei Xiang is listed as having become the Supreme God King of the Great God Circle at least once. However, there is no mention of this in the official novels. characters.personality: She was domineering yet charming, noble yet ruthless.
characters.history:
Leng Yaozhu welcomed Tang Wulin's group when they came to the Spirit Pagoda for the tower attack together with Gu Yue. After their outstanding performances, she persuaded them to join the spirit pagoda but her offer was declined.

In the intermediate spirit ascension platform, Tang Wulin absorbed Overlord Dragon, an unyielding spirit soul. She was the one examined him and informed the Shrek Academy. Ya Li whom she loathed came as the representative. Before Ya Li left, she told her that she needed to return in a hurry because her husband was waiting for her. Leng Yaozhu was extremely furious for this insult.

After Shrek Academy was destroyed by the 12 ranked God Killer Soul Ammunitions, she was very sad for Yun Ming who was killed during that accident. She even hold grudges against Qiangu Dongfeng who had been pursuing her for a long time.

During the war between the Douluo Continent and the Abyssal Plane, she fought for the humanity. She fought with her sister, Leng Yulai, and was killed by her. Before her death, she thought-concreted the reality which led the suicide of Leng Yulai. After the war, she was resurrected together with other fallen heros by the planar lord, Tang Hao.

characters.history:
She was one of the assassins that killed Yun Ming during the attack on Shrek Academy. After the academy was destroyed, she retained and imprisoned a trace of his soul.

While ambushing a military soul guidance shell transport convoy with another Heavenly King, Darkness Bell Na Nali, she was repelled by the combined efforts of Tang Wulin, Sima Jinchi, and Zang Xin, and was captured during her escape. She later traded Yun Ming's soul in exchange for her freedom and returned to the Holy Spirit Cult.

During the great battle in the Extreme North against the Abyssal Plane, she fought against her sister Leng Yaozhu. Taking advantage of her opponent's trace of kindness, she successfully ambushed with a divine tool, dealing a fatal blow to Leng Yaozhu. However, in her dying moments, Leng Yaozhu used thought concretization to reveal the truth: it was actually Leng Yaozhu who had been reminding Yun Ming that her younger sister had feelings for him, hoping he would pay more attention to her rather than stealing him away.

Upon learning the truth and realizing her tragic misunderstanding, she was overwhelmed with shame and indignation, and died by suicide. Both sisters perished in the battle.

After the Dragon Source Crystal incident, the Dragon Horse Federation prepared and amassed forces to launch an attack to the Douluo Federation's fleets. However, they suffered heavy casualties losing a third of it from the Seventh Fleet.

Tianma questioned Jiang Weiqiang why and the latter suddenly figured out that it was just a trap set by the Douluo Federation because Lan Xuanyu's team did not die previously.

While Tianma and Jiang Weiqiang was in Douluo Planet to negotiate with Douluo Federation to withdraw their fleets within the terrotory of the Dragon Horse Galaxy, however, Lan Xuanyu already concocted an internal strife between the Dragon Clan and the Yukong Clan, that the bombing of the latter's core resource was related to the former. Thus, Tian Long flew back immediately to pacify the matter.

Tianma, along with two other Heavenly Horse Knights, welcomed Dawn Dragon Knight Zhong Zhichang, Holy Light Dragon Knight Huang Liangwei, Qi Tianlong, Xu Yanmo, Blue, and Huang Xiuxiu in the Heavenly Horse Square then led them to the Heavenly Horse Manor.

He was part of the team from the Martial Soul Hall Academy and participated in the 2nd round of the Finals after skipping the 1st round as a seeded team, before facing the Heaven Dou Imperial Academy's Main Team in the 3rd round. He did not take any action during the match.

The team advanced to the 5th round after winning their match of the 4th round easily. The team advanced directly to the Grand Finale after the teams from Shrek Academy and God Wind Academy forfeited the three-way match. He watched the match between Shrek Academy's Team and God Wind Academy's Team.

The team was told by Bibi Dong how to counter the Shrek Seven Monsters' Seven-in-One Martial Fusion and was threatened by Gui Mei with three years in the Disorienting Grand Canyon if they lost. They tried to demoralize the Shrek Seven Monsters before the match and used their usual 3-4 formation.

He, Sun Chuantao and Zhang Ping were forced to block Ma Hongjun and Xiao Wu. He and Zhang Ping attacked Xiao Wu when she blasted Sun Chuantao towards Ma Hongjun.

He was glad to see Tang San's injuries after the Chaos Fog dissipated due to the Charm Demon's de-fusion. He and Zhang Ping were defeated by Ma Hongjun and Xiao Wu. He was poisoned by the fragments of the Eight Spider Lances and was forced to suppress the poison before being knocked out.

His Soul Power was amplified by Ning Fengzhi to help him temporarily suppress the poison. He was detoxified by Tang San, who also stole some of his Soul Power in the process. The team was taken away to rest and recover.

Appearance[]
He is a sixty-something old man who wears unadorned simple clothing.
characters.appearance:
He conducted the first test of Shrek Academy's enrollment and collected the Registration Fees. He checked the bone age of the students and their approximate Soul Power to decide whether they can proceed for further testing. He called out Dai Mubai when the parent of one of the students demanded the registration fees back and told him to take care of it.

He explicitly stated the conditions of the enrollment of the Shrek Academy after a parent tried to argue, and revealed his strength to be a Soul Emperor to everyone standing for registration. He sent some applicants to the second test after they pass his testing. He asked Ning Rongrong if the Seven Treasure Glazed Tile Clan knew that she was there, before instructing Dai Mubai to take her inside. He tested Xiao Wu and declared that her age was suitable. He asked Tang San whether he was cultivating some Technique using his hands before testing his bone age through his calf. He asked both of them to activate their Martial Souls, and was shocked to see Tang San's Blue Silver Grass. He told Dai Mubai to bring Tang San and Xiao Wu for further tests.

Fu Lande told the new students to hand over the annual fees of 100 Gold Soul Coins to him as was responsible for managing the Finances of the academy.

He was present when Fu Lande introduced everyone.

The remaining teachers stayed behind to look after the Academy when Fu Lande, Zhao Wuji and Yu Xiaogang brought the students to Suotuo City for extended stay for the second stage of their training.

The teachers were called for a meeting by Fu Lande about the future of the Shrek Academy.

characters.title: Lin Ximeng
characters.introText: She has long brown hair tied up on top of her head with a orange chicken accessory. Her eyes are green and she wears a white long shirt and pink coat over it.
characters.appearance: She has long brown hair tied up on top of her head with a orange chicken accessory. Her eyes are green and she wears a white long shirt and pink coat over it.
characters.history:
Lin Ximeng was the homeroom teacher of Tang Wulin at Red Mountain Academy. She teaches the basic knowledge required for Spirit Masters over the first three years.

When everyone was introducing themselves, she was startled when Tang Wulin showed his spirit to be Bluesilver Grass. They then begin class.

In the Manhua, she tried to contain her laughter when Tang Wulin showed his spirit.

As Lin Ximeng taught her students for the next three years, she was shocked by Tang Wulin's cultivation speed. Cultivating to rank 10 soul power from rank 3 innate soul power in three years couldn’t be considered fast among Soul Masters. At most, it was only considered an average speed.

However, his martial soul was Bluesilver Grass! Cultivating to rank 10 in three years with this kind of trash martial soul certainly couldn’t be considered slow. Although it couldn’t be compared with those geniuses, it was still within the upper levels within the class.

As Lin Ximeng guided Tang Wulin, she discovered that this child had a gift for meditation. It was very easy for him to sense the energy in the atmosphere. Moreover, his meditative state was exceedingly focused. Later, she discovered the cause of Tang Wulin’s fast cultivation speed. This child’s spiritual power was far higher than his peers, enabling him to cultivate with more focus and thus, speed.

If even one more student was able to reach rank 10 before graduation, the teacher would win glory as well as a bonus. Thus, in their last year of studies, Lin Ximeng had treated Tang Wulin with much more importance. She would frequently give him pointers and one on one instruction. Tang Wulin didn’t disappoint her either. With half a month to spare before graduation, Tang Wulin had reached rank 9 and was just a step away from rank 10.

When Tang Wulin reached rank 10, she had him take a spirit power test to make sure and advised him to get a spirit soul as quickly as he can.

During the past three years, Lin Ximeng had taught her class about spirit souls as well as what fusion felt like.

Lin Ximeng handed Tang Wulin and the rest of the students who had reached rank 10 a recommendation letter to a intermediate academy.

characters.history:
After Lin Ximo became a great monster emperor and had no city to rule, he wanted to take over the Kerry City since the lord of the Kerry City was Wang Qing, his love rival over Su Qin. Although he was a great monster emperor, Wang Qing burned the ancestral fortune so that both were severely injured.

He needed to recuperate for some time not only to heal his injuries but also to stabilize his monster emperor realm.

After the death of the Dark Dragon Great Monster Emperor, there was no emperor in charge of dark dragon city, so the Ancestral Court decided to appoint him as the new lord of dark dragon city since he was one of the few emperors who didn't have any city under their control. The name 'Dark Dragon City' was changed to Crystal Phoenix City under his leadership.
characters.trivia: He became an emperor very reluctantly, and if it wasn't for the help of the Immortal Great Monster Emperor, he would have failed.

Appearance[]
She was young and looked to be only fifteen or sixteen years old. She was extremely beautiful with a gentle and graceful body but her most attractive features were her palms. Her palms were as white as jade, and her fingers were especially slender. Although her palms were as large as a man’s palms, they were much slenderer.
characters.appearance: She was the youngest rank-5 blacksmith and had known for the longest time that she was the peerless blacksmith genius of the century. Because her martial soul was Lightning Element, she used the act of refining metals with lightning that was rarely seen. Not only did the act pose a high requirement on the martial soul, it also demanded exceptional control power. Her spiritual power was very strong so that she would be able to control the lightning this well.
characters.history:
She came to the headquarter of the Blacksmith Association together with her teacher, Chang Gongyan. She participated in the challenge against Tang Wulin, made by Chang Gongyan, and the divine blacksmith, Zhen Hua. She lost to Tang Wulin. She never thought it would be possible to find another person who loved forging as much as she did, but she never expected to meet a beast like him. She was interested in him after that.

When she went back to the Star Luo Empire, she met Tang Wulin again who was among the Shrek Academy's Exchange Students, going to the Star Luo Empire for the Exchange Program. She invited Tang Wulin to dance with her during the Gala Dinner. That made Gu Yue jealous.

characters.introText: Ling Luochen is an inner courtyard disciple of Shrek Academy and one of the previous Shrek Seven Monsters. She's also a member of Shrek Guardians.
characters.appearance:
She has a cool sort of beauty. Her skin is very white, with light blue hair that extends down towards her shoulders and she seems completely weightless as she steps forward. She wears a special looking crown on her head with heterochromatic eyes, the right being light-blue like her hair and the other a golden-like colour which is capable of changing expression depending on her emotions.

She wears a sleeveless frilly looking dress with detached sleeves holding frills at the end. She has a slightly short frilly skirt, white pantyhose with shoes that have heels. Around her body, she has various size ocean blue gems around her body.
characters.personality: Upon her introduction, Ling Luochen seemed to be bored of everything, which was apparently a result of her inability to find a lover. However, after meeting Huo Yuhao, her demeanor instantly changed to that of a lovestruck teenage girl. She didn't have an explosive temper like Ma Xiaotao, but the pride deep within her heart was no different from the other members of Shrek.
characters.history: At the start of her introduction, she is a level 55 control type spirit king, sitting lonely on her seat, drawing two hearts being pierced by an arrow. Sitting bored as she contemplates her inability to have a boyfriend. Upon opening a astrology magazine, she comes across a page that tells her that it is the best day for love. Making her believe that she will meet her prince today. However, she begins to sulk when most of her day has past and she has yet to meet anyone by then, putting her hopes on the male members of the Shrek's Seven Devils. But she regrets it as one member Dai Yaoheng is too cocky for her tastes, Gongyang Mo is eliminated due to being such a girl. Yao Haoxuan being such a kid was eliminated, and Chen Zifeng being too cold was crossed out too. Souring her mood up further until she placed her last hope on the boys of the next Shrek Seven Devils, wondering if one of them could be her prince.

characters.personality: She is very stubborn and quick to anger. She is also straightforward and direct.
characters.history:
Ling Wuyue first appeared in the first match of the Mecha round-robin tournament of the Star Dou Battle Network against Tang Wulin. At first, she overwhelmed Wulin with her excellent control skills and use of 3 boomerangs. Wulin had to resort to catching her boomerang martial soul with his golden dragon claw and use the Overlord Dragon to beat her. After losing the battle, she believed Jiang Wuyue was the one defeated her, so she told him to meet her. From her questioning, Jiang Wuyue told her it was a newcomer, Tang Wulin, who defeat her. She demanded him to call Tang Wulin.

She and Jiang Wuyue met with Tang Wulin outside the gravity training room. She challenged Wulin to a match and he happily agreed. They went to the Mecha combat arena. Ling Wuyue used her black Mecha and one-word Battle Armour, while Tang Wulin used his Two-word Battle Armour and the Golden Dragon Spear. She ended up defeated by Tang Wulin's Blood Soul Fusion Skill. After the battle, she agreed to Wulin's request of teaching him Mecha techniques in exchange for forging her a Two-word Battle Armour.

characters.introText: Ling Yumo is the especially recruited student of Changgong Wei for the Holy Light Department of the Shrek Academy. He was regarded as being very similar to Changgong Wei when he was younger, especially in his laziness.
characters.appearance: When Ling Yumo first came to Shrek Academy, he was of average appearance and medium build. After studying for one year, his height was significantly higher than before. His entire body would shine brightly becoming golden in an instant when he was conjuring the light elements, even his clothes were like this.
characters.personality: He was originally lazy and unmotivated, who just wanted to be a second-generation ancestor. He only wanted to grow up, inherit the hundreds of millions of family properties from his father, eat, and wait to die. However, he was quite observant, attentive, and finally careful to follow and make a good choice or decision. At a young age, he understood that teaching people how to fish is better than giving people fish. He was kind and intelligent by nature. He was later taught by Changgong Wei that, "All efforts today are for tomorrow's laziness" and deeply remembered "Safety first," hence his battle prowess was inclined to both defense and auxiliary; though he had learnt some light elements attacking skills.
characters.history:
He was apparently forced to attend the exam because of his parents. He belonged to the 3,640 successful entrants to Shrek Academy, and was the first to drop out as he was one of those unable to withstand the spiritual impact from Outer Courtyard's Dean Lan Mengqin's Jade Phoenix Zither's Mountains and Flowing Waters spirit ability, who eventually failed to pass the first assessment of the entrance examination.

Being included in about 200 students who failed their first assessment to study in the academy, also prior to the commencement of the entrance examination's third assessment, Ling Yumo was about to leave when all of a sudden he was teleported back to the academy by Changgong Wei through the light gate. He was reluctant at first and eventually agreed to become the special recruit student of the academy's Holy Light Department.

Upon arriving to his room, the first thing that he does is go to sleep. Changgong Wei believed they would be a proper pairing given their common lazy nature. While he slept, he supposedly had a dream.

This dream was the childhood of Death God, Ah Dai. Although it was set in Shrek City, from the very beginning, the story of his interactions as a beggar and an orphan, as well as his childhood friend being taken away. He questions why Ah Dai let her go, and then treats the young boy to a meal. He then offers to have his family pay for the young boy's education and support before Ah Dai ran off and disappeared. It was a test by Changgong Wei, and after observing the boy's kindness, he rewarded him with the gift of the Son of Light Bloodline.

The next day he woke up feeling refreshed. He is then fed some fruits by Changgong Wei, and then goes back to sleep. Upon waking up, he asks if there is anything he can learn besides sleep, and Zhang tells him about the Five Realms of Laziness. After learning about the nature of Laziness, he learns that the first step to attaining it is "Safety" as well as "No Worries." Soon after, Zhang takes him to a world where there is a fight against many Demons charging at them, protected from something called a Holy Light Array. He gives Ling Yumo 49 days in order to comprehend the Holy Light Array as his first assignment to protect himself.

He then meditated within the Holy Light Array and felt the individual elements that surrounded him. As the Array begins to crumble, he quickly searches his memory for the presence of the Array Formation, as well as the construction of the array, and the utilization of Light Elements- and the magic spells that accompany it. It ends up being a success.

Quick Answers
		
		
	
	
			
				
					What role did Ling Zichen play in the Tang Sect's Research Institute?
						
				
				
					
						As the head of the Tang Sect's Research Institute's science division, Ling Zichen spearheaded research in science and spirit technology, creating weapons, vehicles, and Spirit Devices for the Tang Sect's army and disciples. Her work surpassed the Federation's advancements in weaponry. She later ascended to the role of Pavilion Master of the Sea God Pavilion at Shrek Academy, and held positions as a True God level powerhouse, 9th Rank Doutian Fighter, and Vice President of the Doutian Department.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					How did Ling Zichen become the Pavilion Master of the Sea God Pavilion?
						
				
				
					
						Ling Zichen, the adopted daughter of Cao Dezhi and a scientist, served as the Tang Sect's Research Institute's chief scientist. She later became the Pavilion Master of the Shrek Academy's Sea God Pavilion. Additionally, she is a True God level powerhouse, a 9th Rank Doutian Fighter, and the Doutian Department's Vice President.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What rank was Ling Zichen as a Doutian Fighter?
						
				
				
					
						Ling Zichen held the rank of a ninth-level Sky Fighter, equivalent to the position of Deputy Minister in the Doutian Department. However, Ling Zichen was not particularly active in managing the department's affairs.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What was Ling Zichen's relationship with Cao Dezhi?
						
				
				
					
						Ling Zichen, often referred to as Ling Zi, had a nuanced relationship with Cao Dezhi. Ling Zi's parents perished during research, and she herself was part of a dangerous experiment that risked the lives of numerous researchers. She sacrificed herself to prevent a catastrophic explosion, leading to her permanent fusion with the experiment. Cao Dezhi was privy to Ling Zi's history and disclosed it to Wu Lin, which caused Ling Zi to feel annoyed.
