characters.appearance:
She was dressed in a very ordinary uniform, consisted of a tight, black, knee-length skirt and a black blazer that made her appear neat and tidy. One could see that she was wearing a formal white shirt under the blazer. Her long, black hair was tied into a bun and fastened with a wooden hair clip. The unusual thing about her was that the curvature of her figure was different from the vast majority of women.

She had a very slim waist, yet the most glaring part was that her buttocks was so pronounced that it seemed almost disproportionate. It was round, luscious, and it could even be described as fleshy. She had a long pair of legs that complemented her pronounced bottom. There was no doubt that she was the epitome of sexuality.

Furthermore, due to the exaggerated curvature of her buttocks, all eyes would very easily land on that part of her body at first glance.

Her facial features were not especially attractive. She was certainly not on the same level as Gu Yuena. However, she had large eyes, a healthy complexion with a wheat-like hue, and a few freckles that adorned her face. Her entire person exuded wildness. On the other hand, she was wearing a pair of black-framed glasses. Wild as she may have seemed, she had a dash of professional feminism in her as well. Judging from her appearance, she was about twenty-five or twenty-six years old. However, her actual age must have been slightly older, judging by her aura and eyes.
characters.personality:
In SL3, Tang Wulin used her knowledge to save a 12th-ranked Soul Guidance Fixed Bomb in base of Shrek Academy. The bomb was taken from the hands of Spirit Pagoda, and Shrek Academy used it to counter the pressure given by the Hawk Faction of the Federation Parliament and Spirit Pagoda. To strengthen the defense of Shrek Academy, Ling Zichen used mono-source array as the foundation to build Layers of Energy Defenses that enveloped the whole of Shrek Academy including the Eternal Tree. She claimed that even the 12-level Soul Fixed Bomb couldn't destroy Shrek Academy again.

On early Collision with the creatures of Abyssal Plane and evil spirit masters from Holy Spirit Cult in Northland of Douluo Continent, the Forces of Federation, Shrek Academy, Spirit Pagoda, Tang Sect, and hidden sects, got frustation because they couldn't bring damage to the Blood River Killing God Great Array, which was built from million souls of victims of explotion in Shrek City. To solve this problem, Ling Zichen proposed an idea to Tang Wulin, to bring the 12th-rank Soul Guidence Fixed Bomb from the Shrek Academy and launch it to the Blood Array.

In the Shrek Academy, Ling Zichen talked with Tang Wulin about the secret of the god killer bomb. The bomb could be used repeatly in some period if its source array, which used same principle with her mono-source array, was implanted within the body. If the host had enough endurance, like a Limit Douluo, it could be describe as the Ultimate Weapon. So, she wanted to implant its array to her body, so she could fight alongside Tang Wulin, and it would be the key for Human to solve stale state of war. Tang Wulin went silent after considering it for a moment, and Ling Zichen said that she wanted a drip of his blood for experiment. Tang Wulin gave her his blood although in fact she used it to make a clone of Wulin.

Ling Zichen succeeded in implanting source array of the 12th-rank Soul Guidence Bomb into her body, then she used it twice. First, to destroy the Blood River God Killer Array, second to damage Abyssal Lord. In first try, she nearly perished and saved by Tang Wulin, and put her down close to mini-Eternal Tree to replenish her vitality. Her condition was mentioned by Ya Li as Life Wither. In second try, she truly perished. But, in the end of war, she was ressurected by Tang Hao, and gained normal and healthy body. But, she depressed because her source array within her body had vanished.

Every time Ling Zichen came up with an idea, it would be beyond sanity of ordinary people, spirit master, even another researcher. Due to her idea to implant the mono-source array of 12th-rank Soul Guidence Fixed Bomb into her body, and she flew herself twice to use it which watched by human army, then people called her as Mad/Crazy Scientist Woman.

characters.title: Liu An

When they arrived, Liu An saw a unknown battle armour master. They landed a hundred meters away and Liu An asked the man to identify himself. characters.history:
Liu An deployed with twelve other mecha masters to the site of a terrorist attack on a train heading to Heaven Dou City from Shrek City. When they arrived, Liu An saw a unknown battle armour master. They landed a hundred meters away and Liu An asked the man to identify himself. After verifying the man was Zhen Hua, the Divine Blacksmith, Liu An relaxed and let out a deep breath. If Zhen Hua turned out to be hostile, this place would have been his grave. Liu An didn't stop him when he took Tang Wulin with him to Heaven Dou City.

Liu An gave the order to his regiment to search the surroundings of the terrorist attack, but in the end, they never found any trace of hostiles. Not even a single hair to go on. The only evidence of the tragedy, besides the blood and the corpses and destruction, was a small mound of ashes tinged green. The rest of the terrorist’s remains had already been blown away by the wind.

A few days later, Liu An was sent to receive Tang Wulin and Zhen Hua when they arrived at Heaven Dou City's administration offices to give Wulin's statement on the terrorist attack. Liu An esorted them to a private room and questioned Wulin on the events of that day. When Mo Wu came, he gave the statement he had written to him.

Later on, Liu An esorted Tang Wulin back to Shrek Academy. Along the way, he talked to Wulin about being a Mecha Master and exchanged contact information.

characters.introText:
Quick Answers
		
		
	
	
			
				
					What is the significance of Liu Erlong's impulsive nature in the story?
						
				
				
					
						Liu Erlong's impulsive nature stems from her traumatic past, leading her to find pleasure in slaughter. This impulsivity guided her life decisions, from adopting her mother's maiden name to forming the Golden Iron Triangle with Yu Xiaogang and Flender. Her impulsive streak is evident in her readiness to confront Spirit Hall, showcasing her bravery and resolve.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					How does Liu Erlong's appearance contribute to her character development?
						
				
				
					
						Liu Erlong, a character with a striking appearance, is depicted as a beautiful woman in her thirties, possessing a charming figure and delicate features. Her visage is often compared to a painting. Variations in her hair and eye color, red or black, exist across different adaptations. She carries the Blue Lightning Tyrant Dragon Bloodline and a Dragon Physique, enhancing her physical allure. This captivating exterior contrasts with her resilient personality and challenging history, contributing to her character depth.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What is the meaning behind Liu Erlong's statement about turning the sky and earth upside down?
						
				
				
					
						The phrase 'turning the sky and earth upside down' by Liu Erlong is a metaphorical expression. It represents her resolve to challenge existing norms and bring about substantial changes, irrespective of potential challenges.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					How does Liu Erlong's voice reflect her personality?
						
				
				
					
						The rough yet charming quality of Liu Erlong's voice mirrors her strong and confident personality. Her voice, like her character, is not conventionally delicate but holds a unique appeal, demonstrating her determination and readiness to confront challenging situations for personal growth.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What is the symbolism of Liu Erlong's red hair in the Manhua?
						
				
				
					
						Liu Erlong's red hair in the Manhua signifies her connection to the Blue Lightning Tyrant Dragon Bloodline and her Dragon Type Beast Spirit. This color choice mirrors her fiery spirit, underlining her position within the Golden Iron Triangle's Slaughtering Corner and her teaching role at Shrek Academy.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom

Appearance[]
She is a beautiful woman seemingly in her thirties with a charming figure. Her facial features are delicate, appearance like a painting. Although her big black eyes looked lifeless, they still had spirit. She has a well developed figure. She has a very gentle and melodious voice.
characters.appearance:
She was singing a song living alone in a beautiful cottage in the forest in the Blue Tyrant Academy. She cried on reuniting with Yu Xiaogang. She immediately hands over all control of the Blue Tyrant Academy to Fu Lande, renaming it Shrek Academy. She introduced the Academy in detail to the group.

She, intending to never let Yu Xiaogang slip from her hands again, kept a close watch over him. She was alerted by the Soul Power fluctuation after Tang San was kidnapped by Dugu Bo.

She went along with Fu Lande and Yu Xiaogang to search for Tang San and Dugu Bo. She, Yu Xiaogang and Fu Lande discussed about the goal of the kidnapping and speculated Tang San's eventual fate. They were attracted by a large Soul Power fluctuation and deduced it belonging to Dugu Bo, before they rushed over. They initiated their Martial Soul Fusion to generate the Light Holy Dragon, and expel the poison of Dugu Bo's poison formation as a result.

The Light Holy Dragon continued overpowering the Jade Phosphor Serpent Emperor Avatar due to Dugu Bo trying to keep the damage to a minimum. They depleted much of their Soul Power defending against the Medusa's Gaze. They triggered the Light Holy Dragon Avatar by spitting blood after the Light Holy Dragon was petrified. They were frozen in place when Dugu Bo used Time Freeze, defeating them, completely depleting their Soul Power. She revealed to Dugu Bo that both her and Yu Xiaogang were descendants of the Blue Lightning Tyrant Dragon Clan.

They were permitted to visit Tang San and given antidotes to protect against the poison formation. They remained within the poison formation to recover their Soul Power and discussed about Tang San and Dugu Bo. She commented that they could have killed Dugu Bo if she and Fu Lande were Soul Douluos.

She along with Yu Xiaogang, Fu Lande, Zhao Wuji, Shao Xin, Lu Qibin and Li Yusong welcomed Dugu Bo when the latter came with Tang San, and prevent accidents. They were shocked to hear that Dugu Bo would become the advisor of the Academy. She led the rest of the teachers away after Tang San and Yu Xiaogang started talking.

She and Fu Lande accompanied Dai Mubai and Yu Xiaogang to the Sunset Forest to hunt for Soul Rings.

She, Yu Xiaogang, Fu Lande and Dai Mubai returned five days after Tai Tan and Ning Fengzhi's visit. She, Yu Xiaogang and Fu Lande were given an account of the events by Zhao Wuji. She complained about Yu Xiaogang being distant to her.

The Shrek Seven Monsters were accompanied by Yu Xiaogang, Fu Lande, her and Zhao Wuji for the hunt.

She seduced Yu Xiaogang when he tried to sleep, only to be interrupted after Dai Mubai alerted everyone that a suitable Soul Beast had arrived. She was angered due to the interruption and started attacking the Giant Earth King violently.

She dismembered the Giant Earth King leaving only its torso intact, before throwing it to Ma Hongjun. She told Ma Hongjun to start the assimilation before returning to rest. She woke up the next day in a bad mood after waiting for Yu Xiaogang all night. The group was surrounded by a nest of Pink Maidens led by a Pink Queen, while searching for other suitable Soul Beasts. The encirclement of the Pink Maidens followed the group as they tried to break out.

The group broke out of the encirclement by consuming a Flying Mushroom Sausage and connected to each other using Blue Silver Grass. She started massacring the Pink Maidens due being furious at the wastage of time. Her actions attracted the attention of the Pink Queen, and she retreated after Yu Xiaogang's instruction. The group discussed about the effects of Ao Sika's Stimulating Pink Sausage. The group continued searching for suitable Soul Beasts for the next two days without finding any.

The group reached the vicinity of the Ice and Fire Yin Yang Well and prepared themselves. She, Fu Lande and Zhao Wuji remained on alert when the Shrek Seven Monsters engaged the 3,000 - 5,000 years Level Phantom Tiger in combat. They blocked the other Soul Beasts which had appeared due to the Aromatic Silk Beauty from interfering with the Shrek Seven Monsters. Their strength, speed and Soul Power was amplified by Ning Rongrong by 40% for a few moments, after which they retreated inside the Poison Formation.

He, Fu Lande and Zhao Wuji practiced using the Flying God Claw. She became excited to beat up the Unicorn Armoured Beast as it had very high defenses, and started beating it up. She called Ning Rongrong to follow her and agreed when Ao Sika volunteered to go along.

She returned to the group after Ning Rongrong started assimilating the Soul Ring from the Unicorn Armored Beast. She charged over when 6,000+ years Level Man Faced Demon Spider attacked Xiao Wu and Yu Xiaogang. She attacked the Man Faced Demon Spider seeing Xiao Wu getting injured to save Yu Xiaogang. She had to decrease her flames after seeing Tang San mindlessly attacking the Man Faced Demon Spider.

She took Xiao Wu as her direct disciple and adoptive daughter. She threatened Tang San that she would dismember him like the Giant Earth King if he lets Xiao Wu down in the future.

She cried from happiness when Yu Xiaogang hugged her and apologized to her. She agreed to Yu Xiaogang's plan happily due to having taken Xiao Wu as her daughter. The group waited inside the poison formation waiting for Tang San. The rest of the group apart from Xiao Wu was trapped inside individual Blue Silver Prisons by Tang San. The group discussed about the Blue Silver Prison and it applications. The group returned to the Shrek Academy to prepare for the Continental Elite Young Soul Master Tournament. She, Yu Xiaogang and Fu Lande recruited Tai Long, Huang Yuan, Jing Ling and Jiang Zhu into the Shrek Academy's Team for the Tournament.

They remained within the poison formation to recover their Soul Power and discussed about Tang San and Dugu Bo. She commented that they could have killed Dugu Bo if she and Fu Lande were Soul Douluos.

She along with Yu Xiaogang, Fu Lande, Zhao Wuji, Shao Xin, Lu Qibin and Li Yusong welcomed Dugu Bo when the latter came with Tang San, and prevent accidents. They were shocked to hear that Dugu Bo would become the advisor of the Academy. She led the rest of the teachers away after Tang San and Yu Xiaogang started talking.

She and Fu Lande accompanied Dai Mubai and Yu Xiaogang to the Sunset Forest to hunt for Soul Rings.

She, Yu Xiaogang, Fu Lande and Dai Mubai returned five days after Tai Tan and Ning Fengzhi's visit. She, Yu Xiaogang and Fu Lande were given an account of the events by Zhao Wuji. She complained about Yu Xiaogang being distant to her.

The Shrek Seven Monsters were accompanied by Yu Xiaogang, Fu Lande, her and Zhao Wuji for the hunt.

She seduced Yu Xiaogang when he tried to sleep, only to be interrupted after Dai Mubai alerted everyone that a suitable Soul Beast had arrived. She was angered due to the interruption and started attacking the Giant Earth King violently.

She dismembered the Giant Earth King leaving only its torso intact, before throwing it to Ma Hongjun. She told Ma Hongjun to start the assimilation before returning to rest. She woke up the next day in a bad mood after waiting for Yu Xiaogang all night. The group was surrounded by a nest of Pink Maidens led by a Pink Queen, while searching for other suitable Soul Beasts. The encirclement of the Pink Maidens followed the group as they tried to break out.

The group broke out of the encirclement by consuming a Flying Mushroom Sausage and connected to each other using Blue Silver Grass. She started massacring the Pink Maidens due being furious at the wastage of time. Her actions attracted the attention of the Pink Queen, and she retreated after Yu Xiaogang's instruction. The group discussed about the effects of Ao Sika's Stimulating Pink Sausage. The group continued searching for suitable Soul Beasts for the next two days without finding any.

The group reached the vicinity of the Ice and Fire Yin Yang Well and prepared themselves. She, Fu Lande and Zhao Wuji remained on alert when the Shrek Seven Monsters engaged the 3,000 - 5,000 years Level Phantom Tiger in combat. They blocked the other Soul Beasts which had appeared due to the Aromatic Silk Beauty from interfering with the Shrek Seven Monsters. Their strength, speed and Soul Power was amplified by Ning Rongrong by 40% for a few moments, after which they retreated inside the Poison Formation.

He, Fu Lande and Zhao Wuji practiced using the Flying God Claw. She became excited to beat up the Unicorn Armoured Beast as it had very high defenses, and started beating it up. She called Ning Rongrong to follow her and agreed when Ao Sika volunteered to go along.

She returned to the group after Ning Rongrong started assimilating the Soul Ring from the Unicorn Armored Beast. She charged over when 6,000+ years Level Man Faced Demon Spider attacked Xiao Wu and Yu Xiaogang. She attacked the Man Faced Demon Spider seeing Xiao Wu getting injured to save Yu Xiaogang. She had to decrease her flames after seeing Tang San mindlessly attacking the Man Faced Demon Spider.

She took Xiao Wu as her direct disciple and adoptive daughter. She threatened Tang San that she would dismember him like the Giant Earth King if he lets Xiao Wu down in the future.

She cried from happiness when Yu Xiaogang hugged her and apologized to her. She agreed to Yu Xiaogang's plan happily due to having taken Xiao Wu as her daughter. The group waited inside the poison formation waiting for Tang San. The rest of the group apart from Xiao Wu was trapped inside individual Blue Silver Prisons by Tang San. The group discussed about the Blue Silver Prison and it applications. The group returned to the Shrek Academy to prepare for the Continental Elite Young Soul Master Tournament. She, Yu Xiaogang and Fu Lande recruited Tai Long, Huang Yuan, Jing Ling and Jiang Zhu into the Shrek Academy's Team for the Tournament.

Quick Answers
		
		
	
	
			
				
					What is the significance of Liu Feng's White Dragon King bloodline?
						
				
				
					
						Liu Feng's White Dragon King bloodline gains importance from its enhancement via a special quenching method from Heavenly Dragon Planet, adapted by Tang Xuanyu. This process significantly boosts his dragon bloodline, awakening the White Dragon species' Brightness attribute after his seventh ring, with greater effects from the eighth ring onward.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					How did Liu Feng's training at Shrek Academy affect his physical appearance?
						
				
				
					
						Liu Feng's training at Shrek Academy led to a notable change in his physical appearance. His rigorous training resulted in numerous scars, and by age 15, he reached nearly 180 cm in height. This transformation reflects his dedication and hard work.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What role does Liu Feng play in the Shrek Seven Monsters?
						
				
				
					
						Liu Feng is a key member of the Shrek Seven Monsters, serving as the Sixth Sky Wing in the 33 Sky Wings. He carries the White Dragon King bloodline, which enhances his abilities. His commitment and rigorous training at Shrek Academy highlight his importance within the group.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What are the defining traits of Liu Feng's personality?
						
				
				
					
						Liu Feng is known for his compassionate and supportive nature as a teacher. He takes pride in his students' successes and offers guidance, particularly to Tang Xuanyu. Liu Feng values hard work and ordinary spirit masters, reflecting his own experiences. He is strict but supportive, focusing on improving his disciple's foundation.

					How does Liu Feng's relationship with Lan Xuanyu and Qian Lei influence his character?
						
				
				
					
						Liu Feng's relationships with Lan Xuanyu and Qian Lei play a crucial role in his character development. As childhood friends and roommates, their interactions influence his calm and blunt demeanor, which becomes expressive under emotion. His strong willpower is evident in his support for Xuanyu's breakthroughs and his role in Xuanyu's military team. These bonds enhance his growth as a spirit master, improving his abilities and determination.

characters.appearance:
Liu Feng's Determination (Shrek Entrance Examination)

He is a sharp youth with gray hair and eyes. Because of his maniac training since arriving at Shrek Academy, his body is covered with numerous scars. At age 15, his height has almost reached 180 cm.
characters.personality:
He is strong, tenacious, brave and selfless. He is also hardworking and cares for his brothers, Lan Xuanyu and Qian Lei. He also does not like to be left behind and would even desires to experience VR self-explosion through Xuanyu's bloodline increase abilities continuously until his spirit dried up in order to improve his White Dragon spirit and standby his friends.

He speaks calmly and bluntly. He acts solemn and collective, but when he becomes emotional, Liu Feng breaks this appearance, becoming very expressive. When striving for a goal, he can become a maniac of willpower.
characters.history:
At age 9 became roommates with Lan Xuanyu and Qian Lei of dorm 333 at Tian Luo Soul Academy - Elite Youth Class

By age 12, he became one of his school's top agility system spirit masters and later with his roommates attained acceptance to Shrek Academy. His Shrek Outer Court homeroom teacher became his Master who made Liu Feng become financially in-debt (immortal herb) to him for helping Liu Feng establish a solid foundation due to his White Dragon Spear's mediocre level.

At age 13, his White Dragon Spear awakened, with Xuanyu's help, to White Dragon King. Xuanyu bought him a 10,000 year Green Vine that increased his physical healing factor and help him attain a stable 4th Ring breakthrough. Because of Xuanyu's negotiations, Liu Feng later contracted on Elf Planet a Thorny Dragon Spirit Soul skilled in the Space element. His White Dragon King also possesses potential in the Space element. Liu Feng is also envied by his Master because the obtaining of a Spirit Soul. After the 1st Year final exam, Liu Feng's Purple class sky wing mecha is funded by Xuanyu, and for his fellow monsters.

At age 15, with two years of condensing his power at rank 49, Liu Feng breaks through to his 5th ring during his 4th year at Shrek Academy, solidifies his spirit soul connection and awakens teleportation abilities. Later from God Beast King Da Ming and Er Ming's Spiril Beast Lineage spirit bone reward cave, Liu Feng obtains a Thorny Dragon Left Leg Spirit Bone under his Spirit Soul's advice and his current abilities evaluation to enter the Inner Court. He also becomes a Shrek Seven Monsters candidate alongside his friends, entering Tang Sect.

By age 18, Liu Feng has become Rank 70+, obtained a Xuanyu forged 2-word Battle Armor and a Purple-class Sky Wing mecha. He has graduated from the Outer Court and then enters a 1 year evaluation period (military) alongside Xuanyu, Qian Lei, his fellow Monsters and graduated 26 classmates to enter the Inner Court. Liu Feng and his other 6 Monsters were morally tested by the Seven Saints with the lust test awakening his awareness to the person (unknown male/female) he liked. Liu Feng becomes part of Xuanyu's military team to scout Tian Ma galaxy.

For about half a year, Liu Feng cultivates in secret on Heavenly Dragon Planet while Bai Xiuxiu and Tang Xuanyu continue their infiltration as a pair of sisters Xiuxiu and Blue. During the period, Liu Feng once went back to Shrek Academy with his 7 member squad for Xuanyu's breakthrough to Rank 60+ and was assigned a physique compatible Hundred-Thousand immortal herb-plant life-partner (total 45 herbs + Old Shu) from the Land of Immortal Spirits by Treasure Hunter Beast Xiao Bao. Liu Feng's cultivation rank did not increase much, however, his spiritual realm achieved Spirit Abyss realm and his physique advanced to the level of a God rank's. Notably due to being one of the few Sky Wings with a true dragon bloodline, Liu Feng's White Dragon King bloodline increased under Heavenly Dragon Planet's unique quenching method acquired by Tang Xuanyu who adapted it for non-dragon bloodline holders.

characters.history:
Long Huantian and Zhang Zhenpeng were in Box One of the Skysea Stadium. He was called to the stadium by Zhang Zhenpeng to discuss getting three quotas for the Shrek Academy Entrance Exam. He assumed that Zhenpeng wanted three normal quotas, but it turns out he wanted three inner court quotas. Long Huantian was hesitate to agree since the alliance only gets five inner court quotas every three years for the entrance exam.

Zhang Zhenpeng convinced Long Huantian to watch his academy's match against Eastsea Academy first before deciding. Zhang Zhenpeng introduced his students to Long Huantian as they entered the arena. Since he made such a request, Long Huantian believes he must hold utmost confidence in his disciples. Plus he had a high evaluation for the Eastsea Academy tertiary team. Long Huantian was looking forward to the match.

Near the end of the match, the twin sisters, Zhou Hanyou and Zhou Tian'er used their martial soul fusion skill. Seeing that something was amiss when the referee called a stop to the match, Long Huantian and Zhang Zhenpeng broke through the glass of box one and rush toward the arena to stop the soul fusion skill, but were too late. The attack ended up severely injuring Tang Wulin, while he was protecting Gu Yue. Gu Yue transported them outside the arena and the soul fusion skill ended when they and Wu Zhangkong arrived at the arena. Gu Yue started to heal Tang Wulin by wrapping both of them in a cocoon of light and using her own lifeforce.

A furious Wu Zhangkong confronted Zhang Zhenpeng, for it is the fault of the teacher for not teaching their students properly, only for Zhenpeng to talk to him in a belittling manner. This caused Wu Zhangkong to attack him. Seeing that his friend was not able to stop Wu Zhangkong's attack, Long Huantian stepped in to help him block the attack. In the aftermath, they retreated ten steps, with him pale and Zhenpeng bleeding from the mouth.

They felt suppressed with Wu Zhangkong facing them. Their bodies stiffened; their soul power circulation became erratic. The disturbance in the stadium cause a squadron of twenty mechas to appear, lead by a purple mecha. Long Huantian sighed in relief when the mechas appeared, believing that the situation was under control. They surrounded  the levitating Wu Zhangkong when they arrived, aiming their guns at him. This caused Wu Zhangkong to unleash his battle armor. Realizing he's a battle armor master, the mecha pilots froze their attacks. Some of them lowered their cannons. All of the mechas took defensive maneuvers while Long Huantian and Zhang Zhenpeng were simply overwhelmed with shock seeing that Wu Zhangkong was about to attack.

Shen Yi rushed out to stop Wu Zhangkong from attacking. Everyone saw him break through to Soul Sage. Noticing that the cocoon of light was disappearing, Wu Zhangkong and Shen Yi went down to examine them before leaving the stadium with them in their arms. Everyone stood there as they left the stadium.

When Du Busi tried to assassinate Xu Tianran, he appeared and defended the emperor. Although he hoped Ye Xishui would come and stand side by side with him, Ye Xishui didn’t appear and only waited to reap the benefits from the deaths of thousands of people.

characters.history:
This old lady was the original legion commander of the Phoenix Soul Engineer Legion. Ever since Ju Zi came, she was demoted to the position of vice-legion commander. Her abilities were even greater than Wang Yiheng’s, and she was one of the oldest Class 9 soul engineers in the Sun Moon Empire.She was a Rank 94 Titled Douluo, known as the Fire Phoenix Douluo. It was a pity that her martial soul wasn’t a Fire Phoenix, but a Fire Phoenix Sword instead. The Fire Phoenix Douluo was once a very notable name in the Sun Moon Empire. She was as reputable as the Starsky Douluo, Ye Yulin.

Her signature soul tool was called Soaring Phoenix, and was a pure offensive soul tool. It could reach a temperature of over a thousand degrees Celsius, and possessed great explosive strength. It could only be used once before it became useless, but it was much more powerful than most ordinary Class 9 stationary soul cannon shells. However, its shortcoming was that it couldn’t reach as far as a stationary soul cannon shell. However, it was very suitable for usage within a fixed region.

characters.history:
She first met Tian Hen when she was exiting a train and needed help getting her luggage. She asked Tian Hen to grab it from the top shelf, unbeknownst to him was the fact it held the ancient darkness artifact called the Blood Red Star. Fusing with it allows her to transform into the Medusa Queen and unleash the full power of the Soul Sacrifice. She was killed by the Dark Speaker in order to save Tian Hen, but was later revived by him when he reached sufficient cultivation.

She took Tian Hen's virginity in order to awaken her Medusa Queen transformation. She had him restrained but didn't know what to do after. It was incredibly awkward at first, and she had to consult a reference video to finish the task. She would eventually become Tian Hen's fourth wife.
characters.trivia:

She is also the patriarch of one of the four major families in the Galactic Alliance, possessing great political influence.

characters.history:
She appeared together with other clan members when Lin Ximo ordered to detain all members of Peacock Clan. She defended her son, Wang Yan, who tried to expose Mei Gongzi.

After Wang Qing announced Mei Gongzi as the new patriarch, she opposed and asked the Elder Council to vote. When the votes on her side wasn’t favored for her, she demanded Wang Qing to proceed Hundred Birds Sunrise which was a competition eligible for any races who had the same rank as the new patriarch to challenge for 3 days and 3 nights.

Before Wang Qing died, he explained everything, explaining the reasons for his plots, and apologizing to her. To deceive everyone, he had to act as if he were in love with Su Qin. He also claimed that the reason his children were weak was because of him, because of his weak bloodline. He told her not to hate Mei Gongzi, as she had inherited his bloodline and, in a sense, was also his daughter. That through her, he would fulfill his promise to the princess to make the clan prosper.

Tang San said that he could probably resurrect him when he became God. She was in a very sorry state and waiting for the days that her husband would resurrect.

After her husband was resurrected, she accepted him, even though he was a human, which did not prevent her from giving her lineage to him again.
characters.trivia:
She deeply blames herself for the way she treated Wang Qing and for what he had to endure for the clan.

She accepts Mei Gongzi as her daughter, helping her with administration, giving her advice, and protecting her when needed.

After her husband's rebirth, she becomes more lively, joking and teasing Mei Gongzi several times.

She never had a daughter, so Mei Gongzi becomes a special existence to her, as her only daughter.

She considers Mei Gongzi to be as romantic as she is, for choosing love over convenience.

Quick Answers
		
		
	
	
			
				
					What causes Ma Hongjun's physical transformation in Soul Land?
						
				
				
					
						In Soul Land, Ma Hongjun undergoes a significant physical transformation after absorbing the 'Ten Headed Fierce Yang Serpent Neidan'. This results in a shift from a sturdy, plump appearance to a youthful, handsome figure akin to a man in his early 20s. His transformation is marked by long, scarlet hair and captivating crimson eyes. A spirit transformation triggers a purple light emanating from his body, and his hair morphs into a Mohawk style. This process also enhances his ability to morph into a leaner, stronger version of himself.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What is the 'Ten Headed Fierce Yang Serpent Neidan' that Ma Hongjun absorbs?
						
				
				
					
						The 'Ten Headed Fierce Yang Serpent Neidan' is an entity absorbed by Ma Hongjun, gifted by Tang San, contributing to his seventh spirit ring. This action evolves his martial soul, first into a Nine-Headed Fire Phoenix, and later a Ten-Headed Fire Phoenix upon reaching specific achievements. The Neidan originates from the Ten Headed Fierce Yang Serpent, a prehistoric beast known for its powerful fire poison, after a cultivation period of ten thousand years. Absorbing the Neidan triggers considerable transformations in Ma Hongjun.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					How does Ma Hongjun's appearance change after his transformation?
						
				
				
					
						Initially, Ma Hongjun is short and sturdy with reddish-brown hair and emerald eyes. After absorbing the 'Ten Headed Fierce Yang Serpent Neidan', he transforms into a young man in his early 20s with long, scarlet red hair and crimson eyes. His hair turns into a Mohawk style during spirit transformation, and he grows fiery red wings that emit intense heat.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What is the significance of Ma Hongjun's 7th Spirit Ring in Soul Land?
						
				
				
					
						The 7th Spirit Ring of Ma Hongjun in Soul Land, named Spirit True Body - Nine Headed Fire Phoenix, morphs him into a Seven Headed Fire Phoenix. With progression to 'Spirit Douluo', the Spirit quality enhances, turning into an Eight Headed Fire Phoenix, and further evolves into a Nine Headed Fire Phoenix at 'Titled Douluo'. This metamorphosis amalgamates all of Ma Hongjun's strengths, substantially boosting his combat prowess.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What are the unique characteristics of Ma Hongjun's appearance before his transformation?
						
				
				
					
						Ma Hongjun, prior to his transformation, was a short, sturdy individual with a plump, round face. His hair was short and reddish-brown, and his eyes were emerald. He had a small mustache. Despite his cute appearance, his personality was straightforward and at times, vulgar. He was known to indulge in sexual promiscuity, a trait attributed to his Spirit, but could also be serious when required.

characters.trivia:
All direct references of him needing sex to calm his Fire is skipped in the Donghua.

The instructions for consuming the Cockscomb Phoenix Sunflower is skipped in the Donghua.

The Donghua skips the order in which the Shrek Seven Monsters reach Level 40.

He was injured by the Cyan Wolftaken to protect Bai Chenxiang, whereas in the Novel, he was injured due to being caught off guard.

He reached the 31st Step of the stairs on the Sea God Mountain on his first try.

He completes digesting the energy of the Inner Core of the Ten Headed Fierce Yang Serpent and condensed his 7th Spirit Ring in a single night. His clothes were not burned when he becomes a Spirit Saint.

He is forced into an illusion by the poison of the Sea Ghost Douluo and made to experience a peaceful life, before he breaks out and defeats the latter.

He along with Dai Mubai, Oscar, Xiao Wu and Ning Rongrong, was captured by Bo Saixi to threaten Tang San out of hiding, before Bo Saixi traps them in an alternate dimension. The participants use a Six-in-One Martial Fusion to break out of the trap, passing the Trial.

characters.appearance:
Ma Xiaotao usually dresses in red clothes, with her face covered by a red veil, which does little to hide her extremely beautiful appearance. She has very long scarlet-red hair and a beautiful pair of crimson eyes representing a ruby. She is also a buxom girl with a busty body.

Mai Xiaotao has long, straight red hair that extends past her waist, with layered strands framing her face. Her eyes are red and almond-shaped, angled slightly downward, with a neutral to serious expression. Her skin tone is light. She is wearing a fitted black dress with lace trim at the neckline and hem, exposing her shoulders and upper chest. The dress is sleeveless and form-fitting, extending to mid-thigh. She wears black lace stockings on her legs. Accessories include a black choker, a necklace with a circular pendant, bracelets, and rings.

In the Donghua, Ma Xiaotao has a fair skin and red hair styled into two buns at the back of her head, with loose strands framing her face. Her eyebrows are thin, her eyes appear large and dark, and she has no visible facial hair.

She is wearing a short red outfit with gold decorative patterns and structured shoulder sections. The outfit has long sleeves that widen near the wrists and a fitted bodice. The lower part of the outfit is short, exposing her legs. She is wearing thigh-high red boots with gold patterns and fitted shapes around the knees and calves.
characters.personality:
She is has a domineering personality and tends to be rather detached, distant and cold. When alone she has been shown to be relaxed and almost childish, especially when interacting with her adoptive younger brother, Huo Yuhao.

Her temper is fiery and explosive, but her thoughts and reasoning are meticulous and thorough.

characters.title: Ma Xiunuo
characters.introText: He was angered when Su Yuntao barged into his Office before recognizing the latter. He chided Su Yuntao to maintain his disposition or else he would not advance past Soul Grandmaster like himself. He was informed about Tang San by Su Yuntao, and he asked to confirm if it was Advanced Appraisal and not Martial Soul Awakening. He was told by Su Yuntao that Tang San had already awakened his Martial Soul. He mocked Su Yuntao's relationship with Si Si and stated that he could not contain her. He took Tang San to the Advanced Appraisal Room for testing. He explained the hierarchy of the Martial Soul Hall to Tang San. He chided Tang San for being impatient before he told the latter to activate his Martial Soul. He was shocked to see the state of Tang San's Blue Silver Grass. He told Tang San to use the Soul Power Testing Sphere to record the latter's Soul Power level, commenting that it should be at Level 11 in theory. He was shocked to discover that Tang San's Soul Power was at level 13, before he asked him about the Soul Beast from which the Soul Ring was obtained. He asked Tang San how he could assimilate a Soul Ring from a Animal Type Soul Beast to his Plant Type Martial Soul, after hearing that the Soul Ring was obtained from a 400+ years Level Datura Snake. He asked Tang San about the latter's teacher hearing about the Martial Soul Mimicry Principle. He accidentally revealed that Yu Xiaogang was expelled from the Martial Soul Hall for his theory, before asking Tang San if he wanted to be formally registered as a Soul Master of the Martial Soul Hall. His offer was rejected by Tang San stating that he was already studying at the Nuoding Academy. He told Tang San about the stipend of the Soul Masters and the Soul Grandmasters.

characters.title: Man Faced Demon Spider
characters.introText:
Quick Answers
		
		
	
	
			
				
					How does the Man Faced Demon Spider compare to the Dark Devilgod Tiger?
						
				
				
					
						The Man Faced Demon Spider, a powerful spirit beast with venomous abilities, is known as the 'Predator of Predators.' Though its quality is less than the Dark Devilgod Tiger, it poses a significant threat to other spirit beasts. Its armored body and venom make it formidable. Despite being rare, Tang San has encountered several. The Dark Devilgod Tiger is of higher quality, but both are highly dangerous.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What makes the Man Faced Demon Spider a Predator of Predators?
						
				
				
					
						The Man Faced Demon Spider, a spider with a human face, is a Predator of Predators due to its formidable power and lethal abilities. This spirit beast's hard carapace and corrosive venom make it a nightmare for other creatures. Its venomous web traps and kills, allowing it to consume energy and grow stronger, making it a rare but significant threat.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					Why is the Man Faced Demon Spider considered a nightmare to spirit beasts?
						
				
				
					
						The Man Faced Demon Spider is feared by spirit beasts due to its vicious nature and lethal abilities. This spider with a human face has a stone-hard armor and venom that corrodes bones. Its sticky, venomous web and sharp legs increase its threat. The tyrannical spirit essence is hard to absorb, adding to its danger. These traits make it a nightmare beyond normal spirit beasts.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					How often does Tang San encounter the Man Faced Demon Spider?
						
				
				
					
						Tang San encounters the Man Faced Demon Spider several times. He first kills a 2,000-year-old spider to absorb its Spirit Ring. Later, he meets a 6,600-year-old spider in Sunset Forest but does not absorb it. During an escape from Spirit Hall, a 50,000-year-old spider attacks him. Tang San uses his Eight Spider Lances to poison it, causing it to flee. He later finds it again and drains its life, evolving his Eight Spider Lances.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What abilities make the Man Faced Demon Spider extremely powerful?
						
				
				
					
						The Man Faced Demon Spider is powerful due to its venom that corrodes bone and starts at the heart. Its web is venomous, sticky, and durable, and its legs are sharp. The spirit essence is difficult to absorb. At 5,000 years, it resists poison, and at 10,000 years, it gains stealth, hiding from spiritual probes. At 50,000 years, it becomes the Man Faced Demon Spider Emperor, with a golden carapace and a human-like face pattern.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom

characters.title: Man Faced Demon Spider Emperor
characters.introText: The Man Faced Demon Spider Emperor seemed much smaller than expected, not even the size of the 10,000 year Man Faced Demon Spider. But its body was peculiar, apparently only around three meters in diameter, crawling close to the ground, eight long legs retracted near its body. Its carapace was a strange dull golden color. Unless observed carefully, it would be taken as black. It didn’t have any pattern. Unlike its black back carapace, its belly was completely white. It might be described as a white human face, all features visible, just looking incredibly vicious. Especially its deathly pale eyes made people feel a chill from the depths of their hearts. Those white eyes weren’t the Man Faced Demon Spider’s true eyes, but rather one of its abilities. Its true eyes were below its head, six dark blue little eyes revealing an ice cold and frightening light.

characters.history:
Manager Ao breaks up a fight about to ensure between Dai Mubai and Mad Xi. Then he gives some advises to the Shrek Seven Monsters prior to the match against the Mad Battle Team. He is also the announcer of the battle between them.

Later on after the Shrek Seven Devils make a name for themselves with their successive victories, Manager Ao approaches them to hand out a challenge against the Emperor Team due to whom the Great Spirit Arena of the Suotuo City has suffered considerable losses in terms of money in only two days due to bets. Despite the Shrek Seven Devils being an Iron ranked team, he overlooks it and matches them up with the Silver ranked team. He told Yu Xiaogang not to let the Shrek Seven Monster fight in any other matches to prepare for the match against the Emperor Team. He had the staff of the Great Spirit Arena gather the Shrek Seven Monsters, and provided the basic information on the members of the Emepror Team to Yu Xiaogang.

He helped the members of the Shrek Seven Monsters calculate their points. He was shocked when Tang San's points reached the level of Gold Soul Badge within a month. He assured the Shrek Seven Monsters that they would not have to worry about fighting the Gold Soul Badge level teams of the Soul Elder stage as they were the only ones to have it, and that there were about 5 Silver Soul Badge level teams of the Soul Elder stage in the Heaven Dou Empire.

characters.introText: Mei Gongzi is the reincarnation of Xiao Wu and wife of Tang San. She is the daughter of Su Qin and Lin Ximo, Crystal Phoenix Great Monster Emperor, and the granddaughter of the White Tiger Great Monster Emperor and Immortal Great Monster Emperor.
characters.appearance:
She has a petite and well-proportioned figure. Her black hair is neatly scattered behind her head. Her face is pink, her facial features are exquisite, and she is a little lively and strange. She perfectly inherited all the advantages of her mother. When her big black eyes blink, her long eyelashes slightly vibrate. Due to being the messenger of space, she gives off a strange aura of nothingness, being one with space.

She looks more and more like Xiao Wu as she grows up. After becoming an emperor, her original appearance has changed. Her beautiful face is a little more dusty, and her facial lines have also been slightly adjusted, making her look more perfect and touching. There is still the outline of this life, but there is no woman in the world who can compare with her. After the fusion of the two generations has really returned, the faces of the two generations also merge with each other.
characters.personality: Mei Gongzi had always been proud since she was a child. All her efforts were to make herself stronger, to better protect herself and let the Peacock Clan see that although she was a mixed-blood, she was not inferior to them. But as she grew up and matured, her mother told her about the suffering of humanity, allowing her to always remember that she was human and therefore work hard for the continuation and survival of humankind. With the responsibility of saving the organization on her shoulders, she worked very hard to become a useful person. Later on, the reason for Mei Gongzi's efforts and persistence changed, and had more to do with keeping up with Tang San's pace, hoping to stand by him and help him when he needed it.
characters.history: Although she is the successor of the Peacock King's position as Kerry City's lord, her goal as a member of the Redemption Organization and a human being is to build a safe community for humans to thrive. She is first seen serving milk tea to a line of monsters alongside her mother, Su Qin.
characters.trivia:
After breaking through the emperor level, she recovered the memories of her past life.

She is afraid that her children will reject her for not having the personality she had in her original life, something Tang San assures her will never happen.

She has a very keen sense of smell, detecting the scent of another woman on Tang San, which he managed to escape at the time, but it left him on guard.

characters.introText: Meng Binbai was forcefully recruited by Zhou Weiqing for the Department of Mechanics. Zhou Weiqing originally was eyeing for Yi Chen to be his disciple because of Yi Chen's very strong explosive power and his bloodline that fit perfectly his Heavenly Jewel Change cultivation method. Unfortunately, he lost his bet with other God Kings on the sequence of recruiting students.
characters.appearance: SL4.5 Chapters 6 to
characters.personality: SL4.5 Chapters 6 to
characters.history:
He makes his first appearance during the second exam.  He was regarded as a four-ringed Spirit Ancestor. He was noticeably slower than the others at the start. He rode his Dark Green Snake through the water of Sea God's Lake, as it devoured the life energy. He was noted by Lan Mengqin as being the smartest and wisest within the batch of students. He was the only student to note and take advantage of the precious Sea God's Lake.

He was left uninterrupted as he slowly took a detour around the longer route. As he arrived at the shore, supposed to be fifth, he waited and did not step onto the land in order to maximize the benefits of the lake water.

Eventually, he was called up by Zhou Weiqing to join the department of mechanics. Before he could ask any more questions, he was silenced and effectively forced to join the Department.

As Zhou Weiqing begins to train him, he notes that it is not Martial Soul that matters, but Bloodline. He notes that Hanbai's bloodline needs to be strengthened. He then brings Hanbai to the Ice and Fire Yin Yang Well and tells him that his Martial Soul has limited growth and needs to be stripped. Without time to process, he finds his Martial Soul suddenly purged by Zhou Weiqing.

He awakens in a significant amount of pain and covered in the remnants of various herbs from the well. Zhou Weiqing notes his immense willpower and his potential as a Son-in-Law if he ever has a daughter. He notes his strong perseverance, and recognizes that although he is lacking in talent, his nature and personality make him ideal.

Zhou Weiqin takes a different approach with Meng Binbai. Although Zhou Weiqing cultivated both Elemental and Physical Jewels with his technique, given the flaws and paling comparison to the other God-Kings, he sought to reorganize his technique so that his students do not suffer the same fate.

The Heavenly Jewel Change technique he provides offers 12 condensed physical jewels. Each bead can give strength and condense armor or a weapon, and greatly increase the strength of the body. After abolishing the martial soul and making up for the innate deficiencies with Heavenly Treasures, his new physique can reach his previous level rather quickly. However, if he fails to condense a Physical Jewel within 49 days, he will recultivate his Martial Soul and leave the department.

He trains him in condensing Physical Jewels, without condensing any equipment inside of them, as a means to increase base strength. Hanbai initially is resistant to this process, and resentful at the removal of his cultivation, however he also understands rather quickly that he has made the right choice.

His jewels appear to be Icy-Jade, Strength Enhancement Jewels. Zhou Weiqing explains to him the process of the Heavenly Jewel Change. He explains the process of condensing the Consolidating Equipment and the importance of a good weapon. He explains his own Hate Ground No Handle Set. Zhou Weiqing then explains that he can become a God if he cultivates 12 changes and surpass him with 18 changes. He then advises that for the End-of-Year exam, he wants Hanbai to win and by then to have cultivated four Strength Jewels.

Meng Binbai then asks Zhou Weiqing about his set, and his experiences. After learning about his skill with a bow, he devises that a proper "Extreme" of strength, would be to cultivate a bow as his first equipment, and then add a bowstring successively. Each time, strengthening the bow and the overall power. Arrows would be not needed because it could be condensed from sheer power. The bow can always be strengthened, and in the case of absolutely powerful attack: force, with each additional bowstring, the power of the arrows that the bow can shoot increases by points, and it increases exponentially. Although the pulling of the bowstring may become more difficult over time, it will still be worth it- as then each string offers a different level of attack, and even then- momentary methods to increase strength can be strong enough. One bow and Seventeen strings could destroy a star, and even Douluo Planet.

He teamed up with Ling Yumo and finished first during the final examination.

characters.introText: Meng Hongchen is the sister and granddaughter of Xiao Hongchen and Jing Hongchen respectively. She is a student at the Sun Moon Imperial Academy.
characters.appearance:
Her looks couldn’t compare to Jiang Nannan’s, but she was still a charming and good-looking young girl, and was about Jiang Nannan’s age as well. Her flowing locks were a rare wine-red color. It was a deeper hue than Ma Xiaotao’s, and resembled mellow wine flecked with pale hues. Her pair of big blue eyes would turn red when her spirit was released. Her face was very similar to that of his brother.

Meng Hongchen has long, light silver hair styled with loose waves, with a large blue bow tied near the back of her head. Her eyes are blue and large, with a calm, neutral expression. Her skin tone is light.

She is wearing a blue, off-shoulder dress with floral patterns and gold-colored decorative elements at the collar, shoulders, waist, and sleeves. The dress exposes her shoulders and upper arms and fits closely around her torso. She has matching blue and gold accessories, including hair ornaments and arm details.

In the Donghua, she has shoulder-length dark red hair with straight bangs and slight outward curls at the ends. She has light skin, large eyes, and defined facial features. Her build is slim with a narrow waist and long legs.

She wears a fitted red and black outfit with gold ornamental armor elements. The top consists of a structured black corset with gold detailing, layered under a red long-sleeved jacket with gold trim. She wears a short black skirt and thigh-high boots with gold armor plates at the knees and shins. A wide decorated belt with a central ornament is worn at the waist. She wears a dark hat with a short brim and gold accents. Her arms and legs are partially covered by armored accessories,.
characters.personality: She was a very proud person. The pride in her heart had never been inferior to her brother's.
characters.history: Meng Hongchen and her brother, Xiao Hongchen, were reserve members of the Sun-Moon Imperial Soul Engineering Academy during Huo Yuhao's first Continental Advanced Academy Soul Dueling Tournament. She was the fourth-contestant in the single-elimination round of the finals against Bei Bei. She defeated Bei Bei practically without breaking a sweat. She subsequently defeated Ling Luochen, however she lost to Dai Yueheng in the following match.
characters.trivia: Meng Hongchen had a crush on Wang Dong who was disguised as a male during their first Continental Advanced Academy Soul Dueling Tournament.

characters.history:
He along with Chao Tianxiang and Meng Yiran reached Tang San's location after the latter killed a 2,000+ years Level Man Faced Demon Spider. Chao Tianxiang told him about the previous event, and he told Tang San that they had been targeting the Man Faced Demon Spider the whole day and they were only delayed due to the Spider Webs. He was shocked that Tang San alone could kill the Man Faced Demon Spider. He used his Soul Power to flip the corpse of the Man Faced Demon Spider to check and started admiring Tang San. He was asked by Meng Yiran to take her side on the matter. He gave Tang San the choice to join his Clan and he would allow him to assimilate the Soul Ring. characters.history:
She and Chao Tianxiang revealed themselves after the latter told the Shrek Academy's group to stop.

She formally introduced herself before the start of the battle against Tang San. She was restrained by Tang San before she freed herself. She tried to kill Tang San as her clothes were damaged by the thorns of his Blue Silver Grass. She was shocked that she could not free her Serpent Cane from Tang San's grab. She poured her Soul Power through her Serpent Cane to counter Tang San's Soul Power. Her Soul Power gradually lost its advantage.

She was knocked out as a result of Soul Power clash against Tang San after Chao Tianxiang separated her. She was stabilized by Chao Tianxiang and cultivated a little before leaving. She became upset seeing Tang San cultivating and Ao Sika assimilating the Soul Ring from the Phoenix Tail Crest Serpent after waking up. She was pulled away from the area after her injuries were suppressed, to be healed elsewhere.

She along with Meng Shu and Chao Tianxiang reached the location of Tang San after he had killed the 2,000+ years Level Man Faced Demon Spider. She was shocked to see the corpse of the Man Faced Demon Spider and asked who killed it. She was shocked to see Tang San's appearance and asked him why it was him again. She told Meng Shu to take her side on the matter. She asked Tang San whether Zhao Wuji was not able to defeat the Soul Beast. She protested when Meng Shu decided to let the matter slide, before asking Tang San to compete with her. She proposed a bet that if Tang San won, the Soul Ring could be assimilated by him, else, he had to leave it. She was told by Ao Sika that she had to kiss Tang San if she lost the bet. She proposed to Tang San that they both had to throw equal number of knives and they will determine the winner based on the total number of leaves pinned by the their knives.

She told Meng Shu to start and threw her knives at the falling leaves after he shook the tree. She asked Tang San if he won't throw the knives, only to get the answer that he already did it. She personally checked the results after Meng Shu told her that she lost the contest. She was gifted with a batch of Bone Piercing Needles by Tang San, before she kissed him as part of the bet. She was taken away by Meng Shu and Chao Tianxiang to find another Soul Beast for her 3rd Soul Ring. They discussed about the Shrek Seven Monsters after leaving the area.

She appeared in the second match of the first round of the Qualifiers as the Vice-Captain of the Cryptid Academy's Team. She won 3 bouts before imitating Huo Wu to provoke Tang San.

She was shocked when Yue Guan forced her grandparents to retreat.

characters.title: Mermaid
characters.introText: Mermaids are also known as genies in the sea. They are the best in terms of spiritual abilities among all the aquatic spirit beasts that we currently know. Their upper bodies are like humans, while their lower bodies resemble that of fish. When they leave the sea, they can temporarily take on a complete human form for a short amount of time, otherwise they die. Most of them are female, and the females rule their species. Whether it’s a male or a female, the upper half of a Mermaid is always very nice. The reason why they’re called Mermaids is because of their leader, who is known as the Princess of the Sea. The Princess of the Sea is the ruler of this aquatic region and a one hundred thousand years spirit beast. Because of how strong they are and their spiritual abilities, many other species of aquatic soul beasts ally with them. Their overall abilities are rather strong.

The Princess of the Sea is the ruler of this aquatic region and a one hundred thousand years spirit beast. Because of how strong they are and their spiritual abilities, many other species of aquatic soul beasts ally with them. Their overall abilities are rather strong.

Across history, Mermaids have lived deep in the Ice Sea.

Mermaids feel that they are above others. They don’t really respect any other species of spirit beasts. The strength of her lineage is visible because the heir and queen mermaid will have a golden crown and a golden tail. The rest of the royal family will have a silver crown and tail.

However, whenever they cry, their tears become magical pearls of pure spiritual power. They are the most valuable pearls in the world. If normal people were to obtain even a single tear, their intelligance would be enhanced, and they would even find longevity from the nourishing spirit.
characters.history:
By teaming up, several merfolk can pool their spiritual powers together to form a net. This empowerment sums up their spiritual power to enhance everybody else included in the skill. With enough merfolk, they can even achieve the Limit Douluo level of spiritual power.

The Ocean Heart was a fabled super spirit skill that only Merfolk with the golden bloodline could control and use. It could grant its user immunity from any energy-based attack once. Following this, it would transfer the energy within the attack it had absorbed to the user, allowing them to combine that power with their own power for their next attack.

Each of the mermaids has the opportunity to offer a blessing once in their lives. The person that’s blessed by them will be fortunate, and he’ll forever be seen as a friend to Merfolk. If it’s someone from their species, it’s a show of love.

characters.history:
Mo Lan was the conductor of the soul train that Tang Wulin was hitchhiking to Heaven Dou City. One of the train attendents brought him to her when he discovered Wulin did not have a ticket. She was surprised to learn that Tang Wulin was a Soul Elder and from Shrek Academy and a little annoyed about the harshness of their exam. She offered to help him about his exam. After that, the terrorists hijacked the train. She thought she would die. But, Tang Wulin saved her and many other people despite she was injured.

The second time she met Tang Wulin, the terrorists hijacked the soul train again. She went into coma due to the Phosphor Fire Soul Refinement. Luckily, Ya Li saved her.

Later, she became the sworn elder sister to Tang Wulin after that accidents. She represented the Dove Faction that wanted peace and didn't initiate a war against Star Luo Empire and Dou Ling Empire, stood together with Shrek Academy and Tang Sect.

During the war between human and the soul beasts, she was the representative from the human side. She negotiated with Gu Yuena. Later, she made sure to get peace between two communities.

In the setup manual, it was shown that her son did not actually die, and finally reunited with her.

characters.history:
There was a Black Jade Divine Bamboo in the Ice and Fire Yin Yang Well. It had been cultivating for a hundred and sixty thousand years. It's perfectly compatible with plant type Spirits. The Spirit would be vastly strengthened and enhanced upon absorbing it. It will increase the firmness of the soft side.

It came with Tang Wulin. He and the other plant Spirit Beasts left their seed with the Eternal Tree.

Black Jade Divine Bamboo was one of the six plant great beasts that was able to cultivate past 100,000 years and survive the heavenly tribulation. When the seven devils, Gu Yuena, and Zang Xin showed up at the Ice Fire Yin Yang Well, they were not happy to see them. When Zang Xin demand a herb or fruit for each of the devils including Yuena, they tried to chase them away using the remnant souls of the Water and Fire Dragon Kings, but was stopped by Gu Yuena. They tried again, only to be stopped and intimidated by Zang Xin and forced to agree.

The Great Beasts guided them around the well. Xu Xiaoyan, Xu Lizhi and Gu Yuena picked out their herbs, the Star Luo Spirit Bead, the Chaotic Element Immortal Herb, and the Singular Velvet Sky Chrysanthemum, and started absorbing them. Tang Wulin was absorbing part of the Chrysanthemum with Yuena. Tulip made an offer to the remaining four devils to become their spirit soul, but was refused. Wulin was the only one to accepted his offer. When Wulin revealed his status as a child of nature, the six spirit beasts begin arguing on who should become Wulin's spirit soul. Each of the great beasts presented their abilities to Wulin. Divine Bamboo was 4th in line. In the end, Tulip was chosen.

Wulin made an contract with the Great Beasts in exchange for them to become spirit souls for him and his friends. They resided themselves in Wulin's spirit sea next to the seed of nature until the devils are ready to break through. Chaotic Element Immortal Herb gave his seed to Wulin and became Xu Lizhi's spirit soul.

Black Jade Divine Bamboo became the Spirit Soul of Ye Xinglan after she reached rank 80.

He and the other plant Spirit Beasts' seeds were given by Wulin to the Eternal Tree be planted around the Eternal Tree.

Mo Mo was one of the God level plant spirit beasts that resided in the Land of Immortal Spirits within the Eternal Sky City.

His title also refers to his unique abilities, including a domain type ability and the Dragon Emperor Demonic Rupture, where his hand turns into a dragon-scaled golden crystal. Old[]
He was a man who looked quite old. He had a set of grey clothes on, and the number of flies that his wrinkles could crush to death had reached the double digits. He had a very ordinary appearance, and he wasn’t very tall either. He even gave off the feeling that he already had one foot in the grave. characters.personality: He was very composed.
characters.history:
He held the highest authority in Shrek Academy. He made all the important decision and not even the headmaster of the academy or elders could change his decision. But he usually sat outside of the dormitories like a security guard and stayed there every day, as he enjoyed watching the students from the outer courtyard, and the dynamism that they emanated. Only this would help dilute the loneliness he felt in his heart.

He deeply cared for his students and never once had he doubted them. Once he discovered about Huo Yuhao having a 400,000 year old spirit ring. He asked no further and stopped questioning him. He taught Huo Yuhao, Xiao Xiao, and Wang Dong, helping them in their cultivation. Though he sustained an injury in his youth, he was still able to wield the mysterious Sea God's Light from within the Golden Tree and with his strength had also killed the brother of the current Body Clan Head, Du Busi.

When Di Tian marched the Beast Tide, he together with Xuan Zi used the power of the Golden Tree and trapped Di Tian so that the academy could survive the Beast Tide.

Before he died, he went and met with Long Xiaoyao and asked him to pass on the Dragon Pill to Huo Yuhao and protect him. When Huo Yuhao tried to form his 2nd soul core by using the Yin Yang Complementary Method and was about to fail, he used the last trace of his consciousness residing inside the Golden Tree to help him and died completely.

Quick Answers
		
		
	
	
			
				
					What motivates Mu Jin to care deeply for her students?
						
				
				
					
						Mu Jin's deep care for her students stems from her past losses and rivalry with Zhou Yi. She treats her students as her own children, motivated by the pain of losing previous students. Her commitment is further fueled by her rivalry with Zhou Yi, who expelled her students. This drives her to support and protect her students, believing in their potential and making significant bets on their success.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What is the nature of Mu Jin's rivalry with her fellow teacher?
						
				
				
					
						Mu Jin's rivalry with Zhou Yi began when Zhou Yi expelled Mu Jin's students, despite her protests. This led to a competitive dynamic where they bet on their students' abilities. In the freshman class finals, Mu Jin wagered on her students, Team Tian, against Zhou Yi's Team Yuhao. Zhou Yi suggested a high-stakes bet involving a spirit bone, which Mu Jin accepted. The rivalry is driven by Mu Jin's desire to demonstrate her students' strength and her resentment over past events.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					Why does Mu Jin beg not to expel her students?
						
				
				
					
						Mu Jin pleads against expelling her students because she deeply cares for them and has previously suffered the loss of her students. Her rivalry with Zhou Yi, who expels them despite her pleas, intensifies as a result. This rivalry leads to competitive bets on their students' strengths.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					How does Mu Jin handle her team's loss to Team Yuhao?
						
				
				
					
						Mu Jin reacts emotionally to her team's loss to Team Yuhao. She turns away in tears, accepting the defeat but maintaining that her students would not have lost. There is no further confrontation with Zhou Yi, who later retrieves her Spirit Bone from Mu Jin.

characters.personality:
Mu Jin is a passionate individual who cares for her students like her own children. Despite her pride, she begs her fellow teacher not to expel her students, and develops a deep rivalry and grudge against Zhou Yi after she expels them anyways. She is shown to be a highly capable teacher, with powerful and very loyal students.

Despite being weaker than Zhou Yi, she competes with her using their students, and is quick to make bets. She never lets herself forget the pain of losing her previous students, and never lets Zhou Yi forget her feelings either.
characters.history:
Zhou Yi previously expelled her disciples despite Mu Jin bitterly begging her not to. This crated a deep rivalry between the two, and they would make bets on who had the stronger students.

During the freshman class finals, she bet on her students, Team Tian, to beat Zhou Yi's Team Yuhao. Zhou Yi accepted, on the condition they bet a spirit bone. Mu Jin was taken aback by her willingness to bet such a rare item, but believing in her students power, agreed. For her prize, she requested a Spirit Weapon made by Fan Yu.

Fan Yu overhears their bet, and agrees on Zhou Yi's behalf. He says he'll never belong to Mu Jin, and that she is in the wrong, despite her past pain. She agrees angrily, saying she may have lost to Zhou Yi, but her students would never lose to hers. She turns away to hide her tears.

In the end, her team lost. She was forced to give the prize over, but still comforted her distraught students, telling them she cared more about their well being than a Spirit Bone.

Later, she hears one of Zhou Yi's students has broken school rules, to the point of needing expulsion, but Zhou Yi has not punished the student at all. Furious, she confronts the teacher about her hypocrisy in front of her class, and demands the student be expelled. Zhou Yi, and her husband Fan Yu, come up with a fake cover story for their student, who had actually broken the rules, which is accepted by school staff. Mu Jin is publicly disgraced for her display of (apparently unfounded) temper, and leaves while the other teachers think to themselves how annoying she is.
characters.trivia:
Mu Jin is in love with Zhou Yi's husband, Fan Yu, which adds a deeper element to their bitter rivalry.

Despite her bitter feelings, she had never taken out her anger on her students, treating them with kindness and patience no matter what.

She was a female who couldn’t be considered very pretty, but she had a healthy complexion. She had a slender figure, and was around a hundred eighty centimeters tall. She also had a long dark red hair which is sometimes tied into a ponytail and a sharp look in her eyes. She looked much neater this way and her yellow uniform also made her look more valiant and formidable. However, her figure still seemed very proportionate and flawless. All women craved a body like hers. There was no fat on her body, and her skin was extremely smooth and tender. Her slender waist was springy, and her flawless curves extended all the way down. Later on, her pale skin was tinged with rosy hues, and her body was brimming with youthful vitality, while her mental state was also drastically different from before.

characters.trivia:
Na Na wasn’t part of the back up team in the first edition of the tournament, but she had managed to excel based on her own capabilities in the academy. After she managed to become a Soul King at the age of seventeen, she was finally confirmed as a member in the next tournament.

Before she became a Soul Emperor, she was one of the best among all the Soul Kings in the Sun Moon Imperial Soul Engineering Academy. She was far stronger than both Xia Xuanchen and Wan Yijun.

Na Na's status amongst the Holy Servants was relatively high because her cultivation level was almost at Rank 60 during this period of time, and she was also considered preemptively as a Holy Ghost Disciple.

characters.title: Na Na's Father
characters.introText: He was a Baron of the Sun Moon Empire. He was also the father and husband of Na Na and Na Na's mother respectively.
characters.appearance: His eyes are blue just like Na Na's eyes.
characters.personality: He was meticulously caring and stubborn. While he was of nobility, he was a kind person; he was very nice to all the tenants. He wasn’t a superstitious person.
characters.history:
He coincidentally met Na Na's mother, who was critically injured after hunting soul beasts when he was out on a leisurely trip. Na Na's mother fainted just as she saw him. He saved her and helped her to escape danger. However, he had no choice but to bring her home because her injuries were too serious. He saved her and helped her to escape danger. However, he had no choice but to bring her home because her injuries were too serious. Na Na's mother recuperated for a month before she was fully recovered. He asked Na Na's mother to stay and confessed his love for her on the day she was supposed to leave. However, Na Na's mother told him that she was an inauspicious character, and that letting her stay would only bring him harm. But he told her that he wasn’t afraid. Na Na's mother was moved after interacting with him for a month and experiencing his meticulous care. After hesitating, she decided to stay. Their relationship blossomed, and they got married three months later.

After a year, Na Na was born. After Na Na's mother married him, she stayed at home. Before Na Na was six, they lived a happy life. But when she  was six years old, her mother told her father that she was going somewhere. She was going hunting for soul beasts again. Her soul power had reached a bottleneck, and she needed a soul ring to achieve a breakthrough. He encouraged the cultivation of Na Na's mother, but for half a year, they never heard from her. After six months, she returned with a dismal look on her face. He was too delighted at her return back then, and didn’t realize anything was amiss. Na Na's mother managed to obtain her soul ring.

His innate martial soul had no soul power, so he couldn’t become a soul master.

Not long after she returned, a bunch of strangers came to their house one day and Na Na's mother had to leave with them. He tried to stop them, but he couldn’t. From that day on, it became a nightmare for his family. His wife kept on leaving the house, and she left for long intervals of time. She always looked very depressed when she returned, but her abilities kept getting stronger and stronger. Eventually, Na Na was sent to a soul master academy to study. Later on, he seemed feeble and older and Na Na's mother still rarely came home.

He passed away when Na Na was twelve years old. He died with his eyes open. Even though he had passed away, his eyes were still filled with disbelief. It was like he saw something he couldn’t understand and there was also an obviously fatal wound on his chest. When he died, Na Na's mother took out a small knife and viciously stabbed herself in the chest. Her blood splattered all over him. She seemed to lose all her strength, and Na Na's mother collapsed on him just like that. He was killed by Na Na's mother who was under the control of the Holy Ghost Church.

Her soul power had reached a bottleneck, and she needed a soul ring to achieve a breakthrough.

She was born a commoner, and her cultivation was self-achieved. When she was small, she had attended an elementary soul master academy and learned some simple knowledge, but couldn’t continue her education afterwards, because she was broke. However, she managed to reach Rank 40 based on her own abilities when Na Na was six years old, and became a Soul Ancestor. For an ordinary person, that was a very rare thing.

Na Na's father encouraged her mother’s cultivation, but for half a year, they never heard from her. After six months, she returned with a dismal look on her face. Her father was too delighted at her return back then, and didn’t realize anything was amiss. She managed to obtain her soul ring. Na Na's martial soul was also awakened by then. Like her mother, her martial soul was also Spectre. Not long after she returned, a bunch of strangers came to their house one day and she had to leave with them. Her father tried to stop them, but he couldn’t. From that day on, it became a nightmare for her family. She kept on leaving the house, and she left for a long intervals of time. She always looked very depressed when she returned, but her abilities kept getting stronger and stronger. Later on, her husband seemed feeble and older, and she still rarely came home.

She met the people from the Holy Spirit Cult when she was hunting soul beasts at a place where soul beasts gathered. They wanted her to join them because her martial soul was unique, but she decisively rejected the offer. Her family’s nightmare began from that day onwards, and Na Na's mother herself didn’t know how she ended up under their control. She was forced to join the Holy Spirit Cult, and they would compel her to complete various tasks for them involuntarily.

Na Na's mother broke her shackles from time to time because of her love for Na Na's father, so they ordered her to murder her father. Her mother was extremely distraught after she killed him, to the point where she finally broke free from their grasp, and eventually committed suicide over her husband’s corpse by viciously stabbing herself in the chest.

characters.appearance:
It was a giant vine not with the huge buds on the tips of the vines. The outer layers of the buds were dark green, but their tips were bright red. They looked like they were ready to bloom. The vine was more than fifteen meters tall. Its huge buds swayed gently which made it look enticing. When such huge buds blossom, the flowers would be more than five meters in diameter.

It attacked the prey suddenly as the colossal vine like a giant hammer and the huge bud came straight. The giant bud opened up during its action and an extremely powerful suction force came from the blooming flower. When the flower opened up its petals, there were rings upon rings of tightly-packed sharp teeth on the inside. It seemed like a meat grinder and was filled with fierceness. The vine was growing rapidly as the bud pounced towards the prey with blinding speed. It was clear that being bitten by this giant bud would not be a comfortable affair.
characters.history: It was extinct long ago. But it appeared with other extinct soul beasts in the ten thousand beast platform. It attacked Lan Fozi and poisoned her which was detoxify later by Tang Wulin.
