Although he couldn’t fuse his two 1st Class bloodlines into one to advance into a super bloodline like Tang San, he could still use these two similar bloodlines at the same time, making them complement each other, almost on par with super bloodline.

Marriage between Ning Chenen and Lan Moqian might produce children with super bloodline, that could be the arrangement of both clans.

A soft black hair was scattered over his shoulders and back, all looked subconscious, without any artifice.
characters.appearance:
His face was like fair jade, nose straight and mouth square, appearance refined and gentle, wearing a pure white robe without a speck of dust. Appearing approximately forty years old, with a gentle gaze, he looked like an ordinary person. A soft black hair was scattered over his shoulders and back, all looked subconscious, without any artifice.

Ning Fengzhi is a tall and slender man, with a refined build and an upright, confident posture. He has fair skin and narrow, sharp facial features, most notably thin eyebrows and almond-shaped, light purple eyes that give him a calculating, composed look. His hair is dark violet-black, straight, and neatly styled, parted to the side with medium length that reaches the nape of his neck.

He wears thin, rectangular glasses. His usual attire consists of a white suit layered with a long, white coat trimmed with thick fur around the collar and shoulders. Underneath, he wears a light gray shirt paired with a purple tie, matching the purple accents and geometric patterns on his clothing. His outfit is completed with white trousers and gloves, maintaining a clean, elegant color palette dominated by white and purple.
characters.personality: Ning Fengzhi is an extremely kind person with a big heart. He does not care for nobility much and values talent above all else, especially those talented in the attack oriented systems since he is an Auxiliary System Soul Master. Despite his gentle nature he can be imposing when need be. He dotes on his only daughter. He is also calculating but generous.
characters.history: Ning Fengzhi is the the Patriarch of the Seven Treasure Glazed Tile Clan which is one of the three upper clans and the richest. His Martial Soul is considered to be the best support system on the continent. His status is almost on par with that of Emperor Xue Ye and even the other royal princes do not dare stand up to him, as he is also the nominal teacher of Xue Qinghe.
characters.trivia:
Ning Fengzhi is unable to breakthrough to Spirit Douluo level as he does not have the evolved form of Seven Treasure Glazed Tile Pagoda, the Nine Treasure Glazed Tile Pagoda.

He was briefly taken hostage by the Bishops of the Martial Soul Hall when Chen Xin and Dugu Bo battle Yue Guan and Gui Mei.

He inwardly praised Tang Hao being worthy of the title of the Clear Sky Douluo.

He wears glassess in the manhua

characters.history:
She challenged Chang Gongyan when the representative team of the Star Luo Empire came to Douluo Continent for the research purpose. After she lost by a margin, she told him that the divine blacksmith, Zhen Hua, was outstanding but had no heir so that Chang Gongyan would go to challenge him.

She tried to assassinate Zhen Hua because he was an obstacle as the only divine blacksmith from the Federation but failed due to the timely space transfer of Gu Yue. Later, she tried to kidnap Tang Wulin and Gu Yue so that Zhen Hua had no choice but to come. After she found out the blood essence of Tang Wulin, she gave up the idea of killing Zhen Hua and wanted to devour Tang Wulin’s blood essence instead. Involving Gu Yue, the Bear Lord personally intervened and severely injured her. She wasn’t chased and escaped in the end.

Appearance[]
Ning Rongrong has extremely fair delicate skin, her figure unusually harmonious, her entire being looking to give people a kind of earthy feeling. Rong Rong has long flowing, pink hair and also has a pair of beautifully delicate light amethyst colored eyes. She gave off the impression of a highly educated noble young lady. Her gentle and beautiful smiling expression can affect everyone in her surroundings.
characters.appearance:
She reached Suotuo City to enroll in the Shrek Academy. When she is tested at the first site, Li Yusong asks her if her Clan knows about her being there. She indirectly asks Li Yusong if he is discriminating against her for belonging to a prestigious Clan, before he allows her to the next test. After Tang San and Xiao Wu reveal that they are at Level 29, thus exempted to the Fourth Test, she claims that she should also be directly sent to the Fourth Test, revealing that she is at Level 26. Zhu Zhuqing snatches the Testing Sphere from he to reveal that she is at Level 27. Lu Qibin tells Dai Mubai to take the four of them directly to the Fourth Test.

She was shocked to learn that there are only 3 students in the Academy, and asks Dai Mubai why the Academy doesn't relax its requirements as there are many people who want to study there. When Zhao Wuji learns that four people were directly excused from the Second and the Third Test, he proposes to personally conduct the examination. She states Zhao Wuji's history to the rest of the group when she learns that his nickname is the Motionless Bright King. She tells the group that her Martial Soul is the Seven Treasure Glazed Tile Pagoda, making them realize that she is a descendant of the Seven Treasure Glazed Tile Clan. She tells that group that the effects of her Spirit Rings are Strength and Speed amplifications at 30% for one incense stick before she exhausts herself. Tang San tells her to support him, Xiao Wu and Zhu Zhuqing as they attack Zhao Wuji. When the group activates their Martial Souls, Zhao Wuji targets her, but Tang San moves her away. She amplifies Tang San, Xiao Wu and Zhu Zhuqing as they attack.

She felt useless after Zhao Wuji uses his Motionless Bright King Body to counter, injuring Xiao Wu, and telling the group that they are too weak. Tang San asks her to take care of Xiao Wu before he challenges Zhao Wuji to a duel. She is shocked when Tang San starts using the Techniques of the Tang Sect to fight Zhao Wuji, as even the Seven Treasure Glazed Tile Clan had no record of them.

She asks Zhao Wuji if they passed the exam, after Tang San's duel with him, which he agrees. She is arranged to share a room with Xiao Wu.

She welcomes Tang San and Xiao Wu, when they arrive for breakfast the next day in the Canteen. She is shocked to learn the nature of Ma Hongjun's Evil Fire Phoenix. She tells the rest to call her Rongrong as is it already her nickname in home. She points out that there are restrictions involved for Spirit Masters affiliating with the Empires and Kingdoms. When Flender gathers everyone and gives some general instructions, he tells Oscar and her to follow him, after dispersing the rest. Flender tells Oscar and her to run 20 laps around the Shrek Academy Village, while they can use the effects of their Martial Souls to help themselves. As they run out of the Academy, Oscar tells her to follow him, as the total distance is more than 60km. When they are nearing the completion of the 1st Lap, she asks Oscar about the total distance. When Oscar tries to give her a Large Recovery Sausage, she curses him, before using the Speed amplification on herself to run away.

That evening, Flender confronts her for failing the task and reveals she went to Suotuo City to eat and wander instead. He warns that such behavior would get her killed in real combat and gives her two choices: leave or obey the Academy’s rules. She arrogantly dismisses him as “just a Spirit Saint,” but Flender counters that despite being a talented descendant of the Seven Treasure Glazed Tile Clan, she is only a Spirit Grandmaster and expels her. When she threatens consequences, he orders Dai Mubai to throw her out. Flender adds that the other students are stronger and she would only disgrace her clan, even noting that Ning Fengzhi himself needs protection. Learning that Oscar has Innate Full Spirit Power and could rival her clan’s support dominance, her pride shatters, and she runs away in tears.

She mocks Dai Mubai for not being able to handle Zhu Zhuqing, to which he threatens to kill her, reminding her that they are not in the Seven Treasure Glazed Tile Castle. As she continues to mock Dai Mubai, he blasts her back, before being stopped by Tang San. She tells Tang San to kill Dai Mubai for her, and she will give him 10,000 Gold Soul Coins, and the unconditional backing of the Seven Treasure Glazed Tile Clan, to which he tells that he should leave the Academy if she continues to have that attitude. As she tries to ask Oscar to help her, he refuses, telling that he liked her, but she treated him like her servant, so she should leave the Academy. She cried the whole night after that. She arrived in the plaza the next day before everyone else, and is shocked to learn that Oscar has reached Level 30. Flender proposes that every student must consume the sausages created by Oscar as the task.

She volunteers to be the first to consume the Large Recovery Sausage and the Small Detoxifying Sausage, scaring Oscar to retreat. She is surprised that the flavor of the Sausages are exceptionally good, and their effects faster than any of the Food System Martial Souls she had contact with in the Seven Treasure Glazed Tile Clan. Flender tells the group that in the future Oscar will be their food supply, and they will depart the Academy under Zhao Wuji's lead to head to the Star Dou Forest to help Oscar hunt for his 3rd Spirit Ring.

She is told by Dai Mubai to follow behind Tang San along with Oscar, as he arranges the rough formation for the trip. She could barely keep up with the rest during the journey, as she did not use her Seven Treasure Glazed Tile Pagoda, isolating herself within the group.

Tang San tells her to act according to the situation when the group faces off against Ye Zhiqiu, making her feel that she was already excluded.

Zhao Wuji asks her why she didn't amplify the rest, to which she answers that wanted to keep the element of surprise. She is supported by Tang San when the rest remained unconvinced. Next morning, he tells Oscar and her to remain close to him, as they may very easily face 1,000 years or even 10,000+ years Spirit Beasts in the Star Dou Forest. She activates her Seven Treasure Glazed Tile Pagoda after Tang San and Zhao Wuji alert the group about the approaching entity. She amplifies Dai Mubai's strength and speed by 30% when the 1,500+ years Phoenix Tail Crest Serpent approaches the group, as he blocks it.

When Zhao Wuji tells the group to show Chao Tianxiang their Spirit Power Levels, she along with Tang San and Oscar only reveal their Spirit Rings, concealing the Martial Souls.

She joins the rest to protect Tang San, while he recovers his Spirit Power. She is shocked to learn the effects of the Flying Mushroom Sausage, and thinks to draw Oscar into the Seven Treasure Glazed Tile Clan, as among most Support Type Spirit Masters that she knew, the ability to make others fly only appeared as the ability of their 6th Spirit Ring, and even those had very low speed. She is shocked again when Tang San declares that he needs a Spirit Ring due to reaching Level 30.

She amplifies the strength and speed of  Zhao Wuji and Dai Mubai by 30% when Er Ming arrives near the group to take Xiao Wu away, before amplifying Tang San too. She is pushed to the ground by Oscar to protect her after Er Ming casually blasts Zhao Wuji away. She is supported by Oscar after Er Ming takes Xiao Wu away.

She is startled when Oscar creates a Flying Mushroom Sausage for Tang San to chase Er Ming, drawing the attention of the rest. She amplifies Tang San's speed by 30%, as he leaves.

She rushes over along with the rest after noticing the Spirit Power Fluctuations of Tang San battling the 2,000+ years Man Faced Demon Spider. She laughed out loud when Meng Yiran takes out her knives and proposes a contest to use them.

She joins the rest to guard Tang San as he starts assimilating the 3rd Spirit Ring of his Blue Silver Grass.

She and Zhu Zhuqing turn away after Tang San wakes up after assimilating the Spirit Ring and the External Spirit Bone, casing his clothes to be destroyed. She gains the approval from the rest of the group by the time they left the Star Dou Forest.

She asks Tang San if he can sell her the Godly Zhuge Crossbow after witnessing its effectiveness. Tang San agrees to sell a batch of the Godly Zhuge Crossbow to the group after returning. She asks Tang San if he can make a deal with her to sell a batch of Hidden Weapons to the Seven Treasure Glazed Tile Clan. When Tang San asks her about the subordinate Clans protecting the Seven Treasure Glazed Tile Clan, she tells him that in the past, one of her uncles was abducted by a protector. She manages to make Tang San find a way to mass manufacture Hidden Weapons, telling him that she will ask her father for his opinion about it.

She meets the full roster of the Academy after the journey, along with the Grandmaster: Yu Xiaogang. Flender tells her along with Ma Hongjun and Zhu Zhuqing to quickly reach Level 30. Yu Xiaogang formally names the Shrek Seven Monsters, ranking her sixth by age. As Ma Hongjun tells the girls to call him as Fourth Brother, she tells him that as long as he is stronger than Tang San, she will address him like that. She mocks Ma Hongjun as Tang San refuses his offer to accompany him. She asks Xiao Wu if she is not afraid of Tang San being led astray by Ma Hongjun, tells her that she will pray for her and Tang San.

She accompanies Xiao Wu to breakfast, which is prepared by Yu Xiaogang, only properly waking up after smelling meat.

She asks Yu Xiaogang if they also have to run, after he punishes Dai Mubai, Oscar, Tang San, Ma Hongjun and Xiao Wu, before following Zhu Zhuqing to accompany the rest. She is assigned the basket with the smallest stones. As the group discusses the actual goal of the punishment, she tells Oscar that he is quite clever. She is drenched in sweat after one lap around the Shrek Academy village just by carrying 5 kg. She faints after 3 km on the final lap and Tang San had to carry her. In the 4th km, she was given to Xiao Wu as Tang San carries Oscar who faints. She wakes up by the final km and tells Xiao Wu to put her down, before fainting again completing he lap.

She accompanies the rest to train hard for the next three months, before they are given a week's break to adjust themselves.

She asks Tang San to team up with her, and he tells her that he has already teamed up with Xiao Wu. Ma Hongjun asks her to team up with him, which is supported by Yu Xiaogang, who explains the reasoning. She teams up with Zhu Zhuqing for the matches. Yu Xioagang gives her the codename, Seven Treasure Glazed Tile for the matches.

She and Zhu Zhuqing won their first 2-v-2 match, due to the opponents not wanting the offend the Seven Treasure Glazed Tile Clan. The Shrek Seven Monsters face the Mad Battle Team. She witnesses Kuang Xi trying the gauge Dai Mubai's strength before the match. During the match Oscar stayed close to her.

She amplified the strength and speed of the rest of the Shrek Seven Monsters by 30% at the start of the match, forcing Kuang Xi to give up the plan to severely injure the Shrek Seven Monsters. After the Mad Battle Team are forced into berserk state, Spider Woman tells the Shrek Seven Monsters to give up, as she doesn't want to severely injure her, making the enemy of the Seven Treasure Glazed Tile Clan. She follows the rest of the Shrek Seven Monsters except Tang San to leave the Stage after 1 min of the Flying Mushroom Sausage.

She joins the celebration of the Shrek Seven Monsters after winning the first team match. She was able to out drink the rest during the celebration. In that month, the Shrek Seven Monsters fight in 27 matches and win them all, her team with Zhu Zhuqing wins 22 matches of the 27 they participate in, with eight successive victories. Her Spirit Power increases to Level 27 during the month.

When the Shrek Seven Monsters are drawn against the Emperor Team, she asks if the Captain is a descendant of the Blue Lightning Tyrant Dragon Clan. She then suggests that the Shrek Seven Monsters should target Ye Lingling and force her to withdraw first, revealing the uniqueness of the Nine Heart Flowering Apple.

During the match, Tang San uses his Blue Silver Bind to connect the Shrek Seven Monsters together. She amplifies Dai Mubai's strength and speed by 30% when he clashes with Yu Tianheng. The rest of the Shrek Seven Monsters understand the reason she told them to get rid of Ye Lingling as the latter heals Yu Tianheng's injuries. She helps Xiao Wu as they leave the stage winning the match.

She is shocked to learn that Yu Xiaogang is also a descendant of the Blue Lightning Tyrant Dragon Clan, and Yu Tianheng's uncle. She is surprised to hear that Qin Ming is the first graduate of the Shrek Academy.

She tells the rest of the Shrek Seven Monster about the Heaven Dou Imperial Academy, before they collect their badges from the Great Spirit Arena and celebrate.

She tells Tang San that they should hold off the negotiations about the Hidden Weapons till they reach the Heaven Dou Imperial Academy.

Tang San gives everyone a batch of Hidden Weapons before they leave the Suotuo City, and teaches them how to use them.

She is surprised that the flavor of the Sausages are exceptionally good, and their effects faster than any of the Food System Martial Souls she had contact with in the Seven Treasure Glazed Tile Clan. Flender tells the group that in the future Oscar will be their food supply, and they will depart the Academy under Zhao Wuji's lead to head to the Star Dou Forest to help Oscar hunt for his 3rd Spirit Ring.

She is told by Dai Mubai to follow behind Tang San along with Oscar, as he arranges the rough formation for the trip. She could barely keep up with the rest during the journey, as she did not use her Seven Treasure Glazed Tile Pagoda, isolating herself within the group.

Tang San tells her to act according to the situation when the group faces off against Ye Zhiqiu, making her feel that she was already excluded.

Zhao Wuji asks her why she didn't amplify the rest, to which she answers that wanted to keep the element of surprise. She is supported by Tang San when the rest remained unconvinced. Next morning, he tells Oscar and her to remain close to him, as they may very easily face 1,000 years or even 10,000+ years Spirit Beasts in the Star Dou Forest. She activates her Seven Treasure Glazed Tile Pagoda after Tang San and Zhao Wuji alert the group about the approaching entity. She amplifies Dai Mubai's strength and speed by 30% when the 1,500+ years Phoenix Tail Crest Serpent approaches the group, as he blocks it.

When Zhao Wuji tells the group to show Chao Tianxiang their Spirit Power Levels, she along with Tang San and Oscar only reveal their Spirit Rings, concealing the Martial Souls.

She joins the rest to protect Tang San, while he recovers his Spirit Power. She is shocked to learn the effects of the Flying Mushroom Sausage, and thinks to draw Oscar into the Seven Treasure Glazed Tile Clan, as among most Support Type Spirit Masters that she knew, the ability to make others fly only appeared as the ability of their 6th Spirit Ring, and even those had very low speed. She is shocked again when Tang San declares that he needs a Spirit Ring due to reaching Level 30.

She amplifies the strength and speed of  Zhao Wuji and Dai Mubai by 30% when Er Ming arrives near the group to take Xiao Wu away, before amplifying Tang San too. She is pushed to the ground by Oscar to protect her after Er Ming casually blasts Zhao Wuji away. She is supported by Oscar after Er Ming takes Xiao Wu away.

She is startled when Oscar creates a Flying Mushroom Sausage for Tang San to chase Er Ming, drawing the attention of the rest. She amplifies Tang San's speed by 30%, as he leaves.

She rushes over along with the rest after noticing the Spirit Power Fluctuations of Tang San battling the 2,000+ years Man Faced Demon Spider. She laughed out loud when Meng Yiran takes out her knives and proposes a contest to use them.

She joins the rest to guard Tang San as he starts assimilating the 3rd Spirit Ring of his Blue Silver Grass.

She and Zhu Zhuqing turn away after Tang San wakes up after assimilating the Spirit Ring and the External Spirit Bone, casing his clothes to be destroyed. She gains the approval from the rest of the group by the time they left the Star Dou Forest.

She asks Tang San if he can sell her the Godly Zhuge Crossbow after witnessing its effectiveness. Tang San agrees to sell a batch of the Godly Zhuge Crossbow to the group after returning. She asks Tang San if he can make a deal with her to sell a batch of Hidden Weapons to the Seven Treasure Glazed Tile Clan. When Tang San asks her about the subordinate Clans protecting the Seven Treasure Glazed Tile Clan, she tells him that in the past, one of her uncles was abducted by a protector. She manages to make Tang San find a way to mass manufacture Hidden Weapons, telling him that she will ask her father for his opinion about it.

She meets the full roster of the Academy after the journey, along with the Grandmaster: Yu Xiaogang. Flender tells her along with Ma Hongjun and Zhu Zhuqing to quickly reach Level 30. Yu Xiaogang formally names the Shrek Seven Monsters, ranking her sixth by age. As Ma Hongjun tells the girls to call him as Fourth Brother, she tells him that as long as he is stronger than Tang San, she will address him like that. She mocks Ma Hongjun as Tang San refuses his offer to accompany him. She asks Xiao Wu if she is not afraid of Tang San being led astray by Ma Hongjun, tells her that she will pray for her and Tang San.

She accompanies Xiao Wu to breakfast, which is prepared by Yu Xiaogang, only properly waking up after smelling meat.

She asks Yu Xiaogang if they also have to run, after he punishes Dai Mubai, Oscar, Tang San, Ma Hongjun and Xiao Wu, before following Zhu Zhuqing to accompany the rest. She is assigned the basket with the smallest stones. As the group discusses the actual goal of the punishment, she tells Oscar that he is quite clever. She is drenched in sweat after one lap around the Shrek Academy village just by carrying 5 kg. She faints after 3 km on the final lap and Tang San had to carry her. In the 4th km, she was given to Xiao Wu as Tang San carries Oscar who faints. She wakes up by the final km and tells Xiao Wu to put her down, before fainting again completing he lap.

She accompanies the rest to train hard for the next three months, before they are given a week's break to adjust themselves.

She asks Tang San to team up with her, and he tells her that he has already teamed up with Xiao Wu. Ma Hongjun asks her to team up with him, which is supported by Yu Xiaogang, who explains the reasoning. She teams up with Zhu Zhuqing for the matches. Yu Xioagang gives her the codename, Seven Treasure Glazed Tile for the matches.

She and Zhu Zhuqing won their first 2-v-2 match, due to the opponents not wanting the offend the Seven Treasure Glazed Tile Clan. The Shrek Seven Monsters face the Mad Battle Team. She witnesses Kuang Xi trying the gauge Dai Mubai's strength before the match. During the match Oscar stayed close to her.

She amplified the strength and speed of the rest of the Shrek Seven Monsters by 30% at the start of the match, forcing Kuang Xi to give up the plan to severely injure the Shrek Seven Monsters. After the Mad Battle Team are forced into berserk state, Spider Woman tells the Shrek Seven Monsters to give up, as she doesn't want to severely injure her, making the enemy of the Seven Treasure Glazed Tile Clan. She follows the rest of the Shrek Seven Monsters except Tang San to leave the Stage after 1 min of the Flying Mushroom Sausage.

She joins the celebration of the Shrek Seven Monsters after winning the first team match. She was able to out drink the rest during the celebration. In that month, the Shrek Seven Monsters fight in 27 matches and win them all, her team with Zhu Zhuqing wins 22 matches of the 27 they participate in, with eight successive victories. Her Spirit Power increases to Level 27 during the month.

When the Shrek Seven Monsters are drawn against the Emperor Team, she asks if the Captain is a descendant of the Blue Lightning Tyrant Dragon Clan. She then suggests that the Shrek Seven Monsters should target Ye Lingling and force her to withdraw first, revealing the uniqueness of the Nine Heart Flowering Apple.

During the match, Tang San uses his Blue Silver Bind to connect the Shrek Seven Monsters together. She amplifies Dai Mubai's strength and speed by 30% when he clashes with Yu Tianheng. The rest of the Shrek Seven Monsters understand the reason she told them to get rid of Ye Lingling as the latter heals Yu Tianheng's injuries. She helps Xiao Wu as they leave the stage winning the match.

She is shocked to learn that Yu Xiaogang is also a descendant of the Blue Lightning Tyrant Dragon Clan, and Yu Tianheng's uncle. She is surprised to hear that Qin Ming is the first graduate of the Shrek Academy.

She tells the rest of the Shrek Seven Monster about the Heaven Dou Imperial Academy, before they collect their badges from the Great Spirit Arena and celebrate.

She tells Tang San that they should hold off the negotiations about the Hidden Weapons till they reach the Heaven Dou Imperial Academy.

Tang San gives everyone a batch of Hidden Weapons before they leave the Suotuo City, and teaches them how to use them.
characters.history:
During their visit to the Star Dou Forest she assists everyone with her spirit by increasing their Strength and Speed. Thus she manages to gain the approval of the other six and become friends. After seeing Tang San's use of Hidden Weapons she immediately asks if he would be willing to make a business deal with her clan.

In the Great Spirit Arena she forms a team with Zhu Zhuqing. Her presence as a member of the Seven Treasure Glazed Tile Clan causes people to be reluctant to attack or hurt her.
characters.trivia:
The instructions for consuming the Beautiful Silk Tulip was skipped in the Donghua.

The Donghua drastically reduced the time required by her to assimilate her 4th Spirit Ring.

She is forced into an illusion by the poison of the Sea Ghost Douluo and made to experience a peaceful life, before she breaks out and helps Ma Hongjun defeat him.

She uses her Fantasy Space to disrupt the mind reading of the Sea Woman Douluo, before telling Zhu Zhuqing to use Abilities opposite that are opposite to their thoughts to counter the mind reading.

She along with Dai Mubai, Oscar, Ma Hongjun and Xiao Wu, was captured by Bo Saixi to threaten Tang San out of hiding, before Bo Saixi traps them in an alternate dimension. The participants use a Six-in-One Martial Fusion to break out of the trap, passing the Trial.

characters.appearance:
Ning Tian was rather tall; she was even slightly taller than Huo Yuhao and Wang Dong. She had short golden hair, and was extremely nimble. Her large golden eyes had long eyelashes, and she had a few cute freckles on her cheeks.

Later on, she appeared to be a lady who looked like she was seventeen or eighteen years old. Not only was she very pretty, but her figure was also very proportionate. After so many years, her figure and looks had developed so drastically making her unrecognizable. Compared to before, she felt much simpler now and there was also a refined aura about her within the simplicity, which made others feel good about her. She was even more attractive than Zhu Lu.
characters.personality:
She is a determined and level headed young woman, capable of analyzing each situation calmly to use her abilities to maximum effect. She has powerful emotions, and an even stronger willpower to keep them in check. Her sense of responsibility is more important to her than anything, to the point she makes many important life decisions based on how they'll impact her clan, rather than for herself.

She is a born leader, but has difficulty accepting the orders of others, like her  senior, Ling Luochen.
characters.history:
A student of Mu Jin, member of Class 9 and Team Ning Tian in the Freshmen exam. She is one of only 3 freshmen to be over rank 30 but her and her team were defeated by team Yuhao in the round of 32.

After being defeated by Yuhao's mental shock abilities, she woke up to Wu Feng visiting her in the hospital. She angrily asked Ning Tian to use her clan's influence to destroy Yuhao in revenge, but Ning Tian turned her down. She says they lost because of their own weakness, and needed to take responsibility.

During the Sea God's Blind Date Event, she chose Huo Yuhao as her partner in the fourth segment. Huo Yuhao was her choice, not because she liked him, but because he was strong enough, and judging from his abilities, he'd be of the greatest benefit to her clan. She was turned down, and her teammate Wu Feng confessed her love to Ning Tian. While she cares for Wu Feng deeply, Ning Tian still turned down her feelings, as they were both women.

Later on, she was granted a gender change in the Yin-Yang Love Querying Valley. After becoming a man, Ning Tian accepts Wu Feng as his lover.

characters.history:
About two thousand years ago, the life force and destructive energies suddenly descended from the sky. The destructive energy made those fragments and formed the Demon Island, while the life force acted as a restraint on the destructive energy. Being the Shrek Seven Devils, they were duty bound to explore the mysteries of life and destruction. Thereupon, they were sent there.

They had triggered the Destruction Fragment. All seven of them were torn to shreds by its horrific power and utterly obliterated. They had lost their physical bodies, but the life energy preserved their souls. Thus, they became the Old Demons, taking on these ghastly forms. It was this same life energy that extended their longevity to such an extent that they could live for thousands of years. But, they couldn’t leave and could only remain there, because as soon as they left the location of the life force, their souls would dissipate.

characters.introText:
Quick Answers
		
		
	
	
			
				
					What gives Oscar a distinguished and elegant noble son look?
						
				
				
					
						Oscar's noble appearance is due to his deep set peach blossom eyes, pale jade-like face, and moderately thick eyebrows. His frivolous smile adds to his distinguished look. His fast-growing beard can give an elderly impression. His personality traits, including determination, hard work, kindness, and loyalty, particularly during battles, contribute to his elegant demeanor.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					How does Oscar's beard growth affect his overall appearance?
						
				
				
					
						Oscar's rapid beard growth imparts an older appearance when unshaven. He's known for his determination and hard work, particularly when focused on a goal. His loyalty to friends is strong, and he aims to avoid being a burden in battles. Despite his fondness for jokes and vulgar spirit incantations, Oscar maintains a sense of pride.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What are some characteristics that describe Oscar's personality?
						
				
				
					
						Oscar is a good-natured, kind, and loyal friend, known for his unique role as an Auxiliary Food System Spirit Master with Innate Full Spirit Power. Despite his occasional laziness, he is determined and hardworking when focused on an objective. He often jokes and uses vulgar spirit incantations, yet maintains a sense of pride that he seldom reveals. His unique abilities led to his recruitment into Shrek Academy in the Soul Land universe.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					How does Oscar's work ethic contrast with his tendency to be lazy?
						
				
				
					
						Oscar, known for his good-natured personality and loyalty, strives to avoid burdening others during battles. Although he can be lazy, he exhibits strong determination and hard work when he has a clear objective, demonstrating a stark contrast between his work ethic and his usual demeanor. His pride in his tasks is evident, despite the vulgarity of his spirit incantations.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom

Appearance[]
 	 	 	 		 			 		 		 		 	 
He is a handsome person. His deep set peach blossom eyes, gives people a kind of abstruse feeling, face like pale jade, handsome and harmonious, moderately thick eyebrows, on his face a frivolous smile. He looks somewhat like he is a distinguished and elegant noble son. However his beard grows exceptionally fast giving him an elderly impression when its not shaved.
characters.appearance:
He advertised his Sausages to the applicants promising them that they would easily pass the tests after consuming it. He was addressed as uncle by Tang San and asked about the rate of the Sausages. He refuted Tang San calling him uncle and told him that he was only 14, and a student of the Shrek Academy. He was asked by Dai Mubai to create fresh Sausages, which he reluctantly agreed. He was told by Dai Mubai to sell the Sausages outside the Academy.

He was called by Dai Mubai to the location of the fourth test. He was asked by Dai Mubai to produce Sausages for the injured people. He produced the Sausages and reminded Dai Mubai to pay him 5 Copper Soul Coins later for each Sausage. He was asked by Zhao Wuji for the Sausages after Tang San declined them. He asked Zhao Wuji how the latter was inside the Shrek Academy and even knew his name. He was threatened by Zhao Wuji with punishment, and he looked at Dai Mubai for confirmation. He was signaled by Dai Mubai not to ask questions, before he gave Zhao Wuji each of his Large Recovery Sausage and his Small Detoxifying Sausage. He supported Tang San after the latter fainted, before asking Dai Mubai about Zhao Wuji, before bickering. He asked Dai Mubai why the latter supported Zhu Zhuqing while he had to support Tang San. He was asked by Tang San where they were after the latter woke up. He told Tang San that they would be sharing the Room together. He was asked by Tang San about Xiao Wu, which he answered that she was sharing a room with Ning Rongrong. He told Tang San that Dai Mubai was interested in Zhu Zhuqing. He told Tang San that he would be pursuing Ning Rongrong after teasing the latter about Xiao Wu.

He refused to wake up when Tang San tried it. He told Tang San the location of Xiao Wu and Ning Rongrong's room to Tang San to make him leave.

He was munching on a Sausage when the rest of the students gather at the Plaza. He was asked by Tang San if he had shaved his beard, to which he replied that his target was Ning Rongrong, and told the latter not to fight him over her. He commented on Dai Mubai's appearance after the latter arrived with Zhu Zhuqing. He introduced Fu Lande to the new students after Xiao Wu asked Tang San. He told Xiao Wu that there were less than 100 Soul Douluos on the entire continent. He told Tang San that Fu Lande is famous for holding grudges, but he also protects his own, causing the latter to glare at him. He was instructed by Fu Lande to follow him along with Ning Rongrong. He was instructed by Fu Lande to lead Ning Rongrong and run 20 laps around the village. When Ning Rongrong asked him how long would the lap take, he created a Large Recovery Sausage and told her about its effects. He was cursed at by Ning Rongrong before she used her Seven Treasure Glazed Tile Pagoda to leave.

He was asked by Fu Lande whether he and Ning Rongrong had completed the given task, and he replied that he finished it. He lied for Ning Rongrong when Fu Lande asked specifically about both of them. His Soul Power was sealed by Fu Lande and he was punished to run another 20 laps. His punishment was cancelled and he was instructed to comfort Nin Rongrong.

He was waiting by the entrance of the Academy when Dai Mubai, Tang San, Xiao Wu and Zhu Zhuqing return. He was asked by Ning Rongrong to help her after she was refused by Tang San, which he refused as she treated him like her servant. He told Ning Rongrong to leave the Academy if she continued her attitude, when she asked if he liked her. He was cultivating the next day, when Tang San woke up. He reached the Plaza when Fu Lande was about to send Tang San to fetch him. He told Fu Lande that he had reached Level 30, after the latter threatened him with running laps as punishment.

He was excited at the prospect of having Ning Rongrong consuming the Sausages, and produced both his Large Recovery Sausage and his Small Detoxifying Sausage, and asked the rest of the students who wants them first. He was scared at the expression Ning Rongrong used while consuming the Sausages, and asked her if she was hungry. The students went back to their rooms to cultivate after Fu Lande told them to prepare for going to the Star Dou Forest the next day. He asked Tang San about what the Soul Ring he would get that would be best for his Sausage. He told Tang San about the Star Dou Forest. The students gathered in the Plaza the next day after they had their breakfast to find Zhao Wuji already present, they were shocked to see the latter with injuries. He and Ning Rongrong were told by Dai Mubai to follow behind Tang San and remain in the middle. The students and Zhao Wuji left the Academy for the Star Dou Forest. The students consumed 1 Large Recovery Sausage per hour during the journey to move at their maximum speed to cover a distance of 400 km. He was supported by Tang San and Dai Mubai during the journey to help him recover his Soul Power faster. They were told to rest at the border town. He stated that the Soul Beasts of the Star Dou Forest occasionally leave the area to rampage, thus 100 km was a safe distance for the border town. The students were told by Zhao Wuji to pay for their own rooms in the hotel. He agreed when Ma Hongjun proposed that they should have a meal before resting. They were waiting for their meal when they group from the Blue Sunshine Academy led by Ye Zhiqiu entered the hotel. He told Tang San that according to Fu Lande, Soul Masters who did not cause troubles were not good Soul Masters.

He asked Tang San if he won't help Xiao Wu. He thanked his luck that he did not provoke Xiao Wu previously. He was tasked by Tang San to continuously produce Sausages to assist the rest during the fight against Ye Zhiqiu. He told Ning Rongrong to use her actions to prove herself to be a part of the Shrek Academy. They were told by Zhao Wuji to go back to sleep.

They were told by Zhao Wuji to act like a team.

They were told by Zhao Wuji to stop and prepare themselves to their peak condition when they reached the edge of the Star Dou Forest. He provided everyone a Large Recovery Sausage to refresh themselves, before providing everyone with a Large Recovery Sausage and a Small Detoxifying Sausage as emergency reserve. They rested after searching for suitable Soul Beasts till noon. He and Ning Rongrong remained in the middle of the formation. He was told by Tang San that the Phoenix Tail Crest Serpent was perfect for him, after calculating its cultivation, and that the effect of the Soul Ring would be related to speed. He praised Tang San's knowledge about Soul Beasts. They engaged in battle against the Phoenix Tail Crest Serpent when it reached them. He was told by Zhao Wuji to quickly kill the Phoenix Tail Crest Serpent and start the assimilation after it was knocked out. They were interrupted by Chao Tianxiang and Meng Yiran before they relaxed, as Chao Tianxiang was a Soul Emperor.

He asked Chao Tianxiang how she could prove that they had been hunting the Phoenix Tail Crest Serpent, stating that they had not seen them when they fought it. They were told by Zhao Wuji to reveal their Soul Rings for Chao Tianxiang to see. He told Chao Tianxiang that he was not a descendant from any Clan, and the dean told him that his Martial Soul was a Variant.

He gave Tang San a Large Recovery Sausage to help him recover, and told him that he would remember the favor. He killed the Phoenix Tail Crest Serpent after he was reminded by Zhao Wuji and started to assimilate the Soul Ring. He finished the process of assimilation after an hour to become a Soul Elder. He stated that they would discuss about the ability of his 3rd Soul Ring after returning. He told everyone not to laugh at the incantation of his 3rd Soul Ring, before producing the Flying Mushroom Sausage. He announced that the effect of the Flying Mushroom Sausage was flight. He stated that the consumer could only fly for a minute. He revealed that the consumer could fly at the speed of the Phoenix Tail Crest Serpent. He stated that he could only create a batch of 10 Flying Mushroom Sausage at his current level before exhausting his Soul Power. They were told by Zhao Wuji to prepare to leave the Star Dou Forest once Tang San woke up. He was shocked to hear that Tang San had reached Level 30. They were led 5 km in another direction by Zhao Wuji. They continued searching for 2 days without finding any suitable Soul Beast.

They were alerted by Zhao Wuji when they were resting in their tents. They were confused about Zhao Wuji's reaction before they saw Er Ming appear before them. They were told by Zhao Wuji to consume Flying Mushroom Sausages and escape. The rest of the students were told by Ning Rongrong to leave. He started creating Flying Mushroom Sausages for the rest to escape when needed. He was blasted back when Er Ming roared. He pushed Ning Rongrong to the ground hugging her; their position saved them as Er Ming landed on all four limbs. He gave Tang San a Large Recovery Sausage after Er Ming left. They were told by Zhao Wuji to stabilize themselves before deciding on future actions. He was asked by Tang San for a Flying Mushroom Sausage, which he complied.

He was asked by Ning Rongrong what he was doing, attracting the attention of the rest. He told Zhao Wuji that if he had not given Tang San the Flying Mushroom Sausage, the latter would had chased on foot. He was told by Zhao Wuji to create Flying Mushroom Sausages for the rest to chase after Tang San.

They reached Tang San's location along with Zhao Wuji. He gave Tang San two Large Recovery Sausages to consume. He interrupted Meng Yiran and stated that she needed to kiss Tang San once if she lost the bet. They tried their best not to laugh when Meng Yiran proposed the contest.

He asked Tang San whether Meng Yiran's kiss was pleasurable. They were asked by Tang San to protect him while he started assimilating the Soul Ring. They were prevented from interrupting the assimilation after Tang San spat out a mouthful of blood. They were shocked when Xiao Wu returned to the group. They were shocked by the ease at which Xiao Wu obtained her 3rd Soul Ring.

He discovered the assimilation process of the Eight Spider Lances when Dai Mubai pointed it out. He created a Small Detoxifying Sausage for Ma Hongjun to consume after the latter was poisoned, before commenting that it was not enough to detoxify and asked about the source of the poison. They were careful during their retreat due to Zhao Wuji being weakened by 50% after using his Vigorous Vajra Bear Avatar. He was shocked to see the effect of the volley fired from the Godly Zhuge Crossbow.

He asked Tang San for a Godly Zhuge Crossbow after Ning Rongrong. The group are treated to a meal after leaving the Star Dou Forest by Dai Mubai. The group rested for two days at the border town with Dai Mubai paying the expenses.

The students were told to return to their rooms to rest by Zhao Wuji after returning to the Academy. He asked Tang San about the latter's conversation with Ning Rongrong, and reminded him that he would be pursuing her.

He was present when Fu Lande introduced everyone. He was congratulated by Fu Lande for becoming a Soul Elder. He told Tang San that Yu Xiaogang seemed more difficult than Fu Lande. He refused to accompany Ma Hongjun to Suotuo City to sleep.

He was taken to the canteen the next day for breakfast by Tang San.

They retreated for the battle between Dai Mubai and Tang San. He was ordered by Yu Xiaogang to team up with Ma Hongjun to challenge Dai Mubai, after the latter was defeated by Tang San. He continuously provided Ma Hongjun with Sausages as the latter attacked Dai Mubai, eventually winning the match.

He was chided by Yu Xiaogang for his mistakes and punished with 10 round trips from the Academy to the Suotuo City carrying weights, without using Soul Power. He agreed with Tang San's conjecture about the punishment. He chided Ma Hongjun for his idea and stated that the teachers of the Academy must be watching over them. They carried the total weight by sharing the load amongst themselves, before fainting after completing the 10th trip.

They reached the plaza after having their breakfast on time as stipulated by Yu Xiaogang and were praised for it. They volunteered to accompany Tang San with the latter's remaining punishment. Their training was supervised by Yu Xiaogang for next three months, which included weight laps, restricted battles, etc. Their bodies were strengthened by the high intensity training. They were given a vacation of seven days after the first stage of training, to rest and stabilize themselves. He and Tang San found Ma Hongjun beaten up. He along with Dai Mubai and Tang San decided to avenge Ma Hongjun.

They finished their dinner early to go to Suotuo City to avenge Ma Hongjun, before they are stopped by Xiao Wu. He prepared his Sausages after they reached Suotuo City. They saw Bu Le exiting from an establishment. They witnessed Xiao Wu luring Bu Le to a remote alley and using her Eight Stage Drop on him. He asked Xiao Wu about her continuous usage of her Soul Ring Abilities.

They rested for the remaining days of vacation after returning from the Suotuo City.

They were told by Yu Xiaogang that the Stage 2 of their training would be conducted in the Great Spirit Arena of Suotuo City, and it would continue till they had achieved the Silver Soul Fighter Badge. They were told that they would have to pay for living in the hotel closest to the Great Spirit Arena, as the income from the battles would be significant. They were told that they had to attain Silver Soul Fighter Badge in both individual and group matches. They were forbidden to use Hidden Weapons, and instructed to fight in at least 2 matches each day no matter the result. He asked Yu Xiaogang if he and Ning Rongrong had to obtain the same even though they are support type Soul Masters. He praised Yu Xiaogang's decision for combat training after he was told that he could continue the previous training as an option. He asked Dai Mubai to team up with him for doubles matches as he would not be able to win in any singles matches. They cultivated till the evening to reach their peak state for the matches. He prepared a set of his Sausages to help the rest recover after their individual matches. He registered for the fights using his nickname.

He his doubles match of the day, with the team being called the Dual Winged White Tiger Combination. He consumed two Large Recovery Sausages to recover to his peak state before the team match. He started preparing a set of his Sausages for every person on the team. He witnessed Kuang Xi provoking them and Dai Mubai being slightly weaker in direct confrontation. The Shrek Seven Monsters were told about the history of the Mad Battle Team and warned about potential injuries by Manager Ao. He reminded Dai Mubai that Kuang Xi was possibly trying to gauge their strength before the match. The Shrek Seven Monsters positioned themselves in a 3-1-1-2 formation with Dai Mubai, Xiao Wu and Zhu Zhuqing in front, followed by Tang San, then Ma Hongjun, and finally Ao Sika and Ning Rongrong in the back.

The strength and speed of the members of the Shrek Seven Monsters were amplified by Ning Rongrong by 30% at the start of the match. He consumed a Flying Mushroom Sausage to fly. He stated that he could only create another Flying Mushroom Sausage at most. He produced the last Flying Mushroom Sausage and left the stage after depleting his Soul Power.

The Shrek Seven Monsters registered their victory and left the Great Spirit Arena along with Fu Lande, Yu Xiaogang and Zhao Wuji. He blamed himself for being the burden of the team. The Shrek Seven Monsters were warned by Yu Xiaogang and Fu Lande about provoking other Soul Masters, but they had to defend the reputation of the Academy if they were provoked instead. The Shrek Seven Monsters had a small party to celebrate their victory, with him being the second to collapse from drinking. The Shrek Seven Monsters participated in matches for 27 days within the month. The Shrek Seven Monsters won all 27 team matches they participated in. The Dual Winged White Tiger Combination won 16 matches and lost 11 matches.

The Shrek Seven Monsters were gathered by the staff of the Great Spirit Arena after Yu Xiaogang made a deal with Manager Ao, and they were informed about the upcoming match against the Emperor Team. He agreed with Yu Xiaogang's arrangements regarding the reward money. The group discussed about the members of the Emperor Team based on the information provided by the Great Spirit Arena. The Shrek Seven Monsters were told to pay more attention to Yu Tianheng and Dugu Yan by Yu Xiaogang.

The Shrek Seven Monsters entered the main stage from the opposite side of the Emperor Team and they were given a minute to activate their Martial Souls.

The Shrek Seven Monsters consumed a Small Detoxifying Sausage each, and he started creating more Small Detoxifying Sausages for future need. The Shrek Seven Monsters understood the reason Ning Rongrong told them to take care of Ye Lingling first.

He felt slightly dizzy but the rest of the effects of the Jade Phosphor Green Poison was restrained by the Small Detoxifying Sausage he consumed. He continued supplying Sausages to Ma Hongjun to support him against Yu Feng. He gradually lost the ability to create more Sausages due to exhausting his Soul Power.

He produced a few Large Recovery Sausages and fed them to Dai Mubai, Xiao Wu and Zhu Zhuqing with Ma Hongjun's help. He asked Yu Xiaogang for a vacation. He was shocked hearing about the Stage 3 Training from Yu Xiaogang. The Shrek Seven Monsters were shocked by Qin Ming's statement that he would remain a student of the Shrek Academy, as they had earlier noticed him by the side of the Emperor Team. The Shrek Seven Monsters were shocked that Yu Xiaogang was a descendant of the Blue Lightning Tyrant Dragon Clan. The Shrek Seven Monsters were told by Yu Xiaogang to collect the points and the rewards from the Great Spirit Arena.

The Shrek Seven Monster talked about the match, before discussing about the Heaven Dou Imperial Academy, and Qin Ming's cultivation. His points in the Great Spirit Arena reached 1879, earning him the Silver Soul Badge, along with the monetary reward for consecutive victories. The Shrek Seven Monsters were surprised to hear that they were without opponents in the Great Spirit Arenas of the Heaven Dou Empire.  The Shrek Seven Monsters returned to their hotel to find Fu Lande, Zhao Wuji and Qin Ming talking in the restaurant.

The Shrek Seven Monsters remained silent while the teachers were having argument about their future. The teachers and the Shrek Seven Monsters returned to the Shrek Academy the next day. The Shrek Seven Monsters were told by Yu Xiaogang to completely digest the combat experience gained in the Great Spirit Arena. He directly went to sleep after returning to his room and told Tang San not to wake him.

The remaining Shrek Seven Monsters cultivated through the nights in place of sleeping during the time Tang San was forging. The Shrek Seven Monsters paid the food expenses after earning money from the Great Spirit Arena. The remaining Shrek Seven Monsters practiced with the Hidden Weapons to familiarize with them.

He told everyone not to laugh at the incantation of his 3rd Soul Ring, before producing the Flying Mushroom Sausage. He announced that the effect of the Flying Mushroom Sausage was flight. He stated that the consumer could only fly for a minute. He revealed that the consumer could fly at the speed of the Phoenix Tail Crest Serpent. He stated that he could only create a batch of 10 Flying Mushroom Sausage at his current level before exhausting his Soul Power. They were told by Zhao Wuji to prepare to leave the Star Dou Forest once Tang San woke up. He was shocked to hear that Tang San had reached Level 30. They were led 5 km in another direction by Zhao Wuji. They continued searching for 2 days without finding any suitable Soul Beast.

They were alerted by Zhao Wuji when they were resting in their tents. They were confused about Zhao Wuji's reaction before they saw Er Ming appear before them. They were told by Zhao Wuji to consume Flying Mushroom Sausages and escape. The rest of the students were told by Ning Rongrong to leave. He started creating Flying Mushroom Sausages for the rest to escape when needed. He was blasted back when Er Ming roared. He pushed Ning Rongrong to the ground hugging her; their position saved them as Er Ming landed on all four limbs. He gave Tang San a Large Recovery Sausage after Er Ming left. They were told by Zhao Wuji to stabilize themselves before deciding on future actions. He was asked by Tang San for a Flying Mushroom Sausage, which he complied.

He was asked by Ning Rongrong what he was doing, attracting the attention of the rest. He told Zhao Wuji that if he had not given Tang San the Flying Mushroom Sausage, the latter would had chased on foot. He was told by Zhao Wuji to create Flying Mushroom Sausages for the rest to chase after Tang San.

They reached Tang San's location along with Zhao Wuji. He gave Tang San two Large Recovery Sausages to consume. He interrupted Meng Yiran and stated that she needed to kiss Tang San once if she lost the bet. They tried their best not to laugh when Meng Yiran proposed the contest.

He asked Tang San whether Meng Yiran's kiss was pleasurable. They were asked by Tang San to protect him while he started assimilating the Soul Ring. They were prevented from interrupting the assimilation after Tang San spat out a mouthful of blood. They were shocked when Xiao Wu returned to the group. They were shocked by the ease at which Xiao Wu obtained her 3rd Soul Ring.

He discovered the assimilation process of the Eight Spider Lances when Dai Mubai pointed it out. He created a Small Detoxifying Sausage for Ma Hongjun to consume after the latter was poisoned, before commenting that it was not enough to detoxify and asked about the source of the poison. They were careful during their retreat due to Zhao Wuji being weakened by 50% after using his Vigorous Vajra Bear Avatar. He was shocked to see the effect of the volley fired from the Godly Zhuge Crossbow.

He asked Tang San for a Godly Zhuge Crossbow after Ning Rongrong. The group are treated to a meal after leaving the Star Dou Forest by Dai Mubai. The group rested for two days at the border town with Dai Mubai paying the expenses.

The students were told to return to their rooms to rest by Zhao Wuji after returning to the Academy. He asked Tang San about the latter's conversation with Ning Rongrong, and reminded him that he would be pursuing her.

He was present when Fu Lande introduced everyone. He was congratulated by Fu Lande for becoming a Soul Elder. He told Tang San that Yu Xiaogang seemed more difficult than Fu Lande. He refused to accompany Ma Hongjun to Suotuo City to sleep.

He was taken to the canteen the next day for breakfast by Tang San.

They retreated for the battle between Dai Mubai and Tang San. He was ordered by Yu Xiaogang to team up with Ma Hongjun to challenge Dai Mubai, after the latter was defeated by Tang San. He continuously provided Ma Hongjun with Sausages as the latter attacked Dai Mubai, eventually winning the match.

He was chided by Yu Xiaogang for his mistakes and punished with 10 round trips from the Academy to the Suotuo City carrying weights, without using Soul Power. He agreed with Tang San's conjecture about the punishment. He chided Ma Hongjun for his idea and stated that the teachers of the Academy must be watching over them. They carried the total weight by sharing the load amongst themselves, before fainting after completing the 10th trip.

They reached the plaza after having their breakfast on time as stipulated by Yu Xiaogang and were praised for it. They volunteered to accompany Tang San with the latter's remaining punishment. Their training was supervised by Yu Xiaogang for next three months, which included weight laps, restricted battles, etc. Their bodies were strengthened by the high intensity training. They were given a vacation of seven days after the first stage of training, to rest and stabilize themselves. He and Tang San found Ma Hongjun beaten up. He along with Dai Mubai and Tang San decided to avenge Ma Hongjun.

They finished their dinner early to go to Suotuo City to avenge Ma Hongjun, before they are stopped by Xiao Wu. He prepared his Sausages after they reached Suotuo City. They saw Bu Le exiting from an establishment. They witnessed Xiao Wu luring Bu Le to a remote alley and using her Eight Stage Drop on him. He asked Xiao Wu about her continuous usage of her Soul Ring Abilities.

They rested for the remaining days of vacation after returning from the Suotuo City.

They were told by Yu Xiaogang that the Stage 2 of their training would be conducted in the Great Spirit Arena of Suotuo City, and it would continue till they had achieved the Silver Soul Fighter Badge. They were told that they would have to pay for living in the hotel closest to the Great Spirit Arena, as the income from the battles would be significant. They were told that they had to attain Silver Soul Fighter Badge in both individual and group matches. They were forbidden to use Hidden Weapons, and instructed to fight in at least 2 matches each day no matter the result. He asked Yu Xiaogang if he and Ning Rongrong had to obtain the same even though they are support type Soul Masters. He praised Yu Xiaogang's decision for combat training after he was told that he could continue the previous training as an option. He asked Dai Mubai to team up with him for doubles matches as he would not be able to win in any singles matches. They cultivated till the evening to reach their peak state for the matches. He prepared a set of his Sausages to help the rest recover after their individual matches. He registered for the fights using his nickname.

He his doubles match of the day, with the team being called the Dual Winged White Tiger Combination. He consumed two Large Recovery Sausages to recover to his peak state before the team match. He started preparing a set of his Sausages for every person on the team. He witnessed Kuang Xi provoking them and Dai Mubai being slightly weaker in direct confrontation. The Shrek Seven Monsters were told about the history of the Mad Battle Team and warned about potential injuries by Manager Ao. He reminded Dai Mubai that Kuang Xi was possibly trying to gauge their strength before the match. The Shrek Seven Monsters positioned themselves in a 3-1-1-2 formation with Dai Mubai, Xiao Wu and Zhu Zhuqing in front, followed by Tang San, then Ma Hongjun, and finally Ao Sika and Ning Rongrong in the back.

The strength and speed of the members of the Shrek Seven Monsters were amplified by Ning Rongrong by 30% at the start of the match. He consumed a Flying Mushroom Sausage to fly. He stated that he could only create another Flying Mushroom Sausage at most. He produced the last Flying Mushroom Sausage and left the stage after depleting his Soul Power.

The Shrek Seven Monsters registered their victory and left the Great Spirit Arena along with Fu Lande, Yu Xiaogang and Zhao Wuji. He blamed himself for being the burden of the team. The Shrek Seven Monsters were warned by Yu Xiaogang and Fu Lande about provoking other Soul Masters, but they had to defend the reputation of the Academy if they were provoked instead. The Shrek Seven Monsters had a small party to celebrate their victory, with him being the second to collapse from drinking. The Shrek Seven Monsters participated in matches for 27 days within the month. The Shrek Seven Monsters won all 27 team matches they participated in. The Dual Winged White Tiger Combination won 16 matches and lost 11 matches.

The Shrek Seven Monsters were gathered by the staff of the Great Spirit Arena after Yu Xiaogang made a deal with Manager Ao, and they were informed about the upcoming match against the Emperor Team. He agreed with Yu Xiaogang's arrangements regarding the reward money. The group discussed about the members of the Emperor Team based on the information provided by the Great Spirit Arena. The Shrek Seven Monsters were told to pay more attention to Yu Tianheng and Dugu Yan by Yu Xiaogang.

The Shrek Seven Monsters entered the main stage from the opposite side of the Emperor Team and they were given a minute to activate their Martial Souls.

The Shrek Seven Monsters consumed a Small Detoxifying Sausage each, and he started creating more Small Detoxifying Sausages for future need. The Shrek Seven Monsters understood the reason Ning Rongrong told them to take care of Ye Lingling first.

He felt slightly dizzy but the rest of the effects of the Jade Phosphor Green Poison was restrained by the Small Detoxifying Sausage he consumed. He continued supplying Sausages to Ma Hongjun to support him against Yu Feng. He gradually lost the ability to create more Sausages due to exhausting his Soul Power.

He produced a few Large Recovery Sausages and fed them to Dai Mubai, Xiao Wu and Zhu Zhuqing with Ma Hongjun's help. He asked Yu Xiaogang for a vacation. He was shocked hearing about the Stage 3 Training from Yu Xiaogang. The Shrek Seven Monsters were shocked by Qin Ming's statement that he would remain a student of the Shrek Academy, as they had earlier noticed him by the side of the Emperor Team. The Shrek Seven Monsters were shocked that Yu Xiaogang was a descendant of the Blue Lightning Tyrant Dragon Clan. The Shrek Seven Monsters were told by Yu Xiaogang to collect the points and the rewards from the Great Spirit Arena.

The Shrek Seven Monster talked about the match, before discussing about the Heaven Dou Imperial Academy, and Qin Ming's cultivation. His points in the Great Spirit Arena reached 1879, earning him the Silver Soul Badge, along with the monetary reward for consecutive victories. The Shrek Seven Monsters were surprised to hear that they were without opponents in the Great Spirit Arenas of the Heaven Dou Empire.  The Shrek Seven Monsters returned to their hotel to find Fu Lande, Zhao Wuji and Qin Ming talking in the restaurant.

The Shrek Seven Monsters remained silent while the teachers were having argument about their future. The teachers and the Shrek Seven Monsters returned to the Shrek Academy the next day. The Shrek Seven Monsters were told by Yu Xiaogang to completely digest the combat experience gained in the Great Spirit Arena. He directly went to sleep after returning to his room and told Tang San not to wake him.

The remaining Shrek Seven Monsters cultivated through the nights in place of sleeping during the time Tang San was forging. The Shrek Seven Monsters paid the food expenses after earning money from the Great Spirit Arena. The remaining Shrek Seven Monsters practiced with the Hidden Weapons to familiarize with them.

characters.introText: Ou Ya is a tall, well built man with long silver hair. He wears simple black robes, with black hair pieces.
characters.appearance:
Ou Ya is a tall, well built man with long silver hair. He wears simple black robes, with black hair pieces.

His physique appears to permanently exhibit traits of Seahorses in the Donghua.

Upon the activation of his Martial Soul, his whole body gets covered in a bizarre ash grey armor, with the projection of a Seahorse behind him.

He transforms into a 3 meter long Seahorse under his Martial Soul Avatar.
characters.personality: He is a solemn and dignified person. He is very patient, especially when answering questions and delivering long explanations. Ou Ya is highly respectful, even bowing to Ning Rongrong after recognizing her Seventh Level Red Trial.
characters.history:
Novel & Donghua

He was meditating when he was informed that the Shrek Seven Monsters and Bai Chenxiang had arrived to accept the Sea God Trials. He invoked the Sea Horse Holy Pillar and created a barrier 10 meters above the surface of the Sea within the Sea around it, telling the group to reach the platform of the Sea Horse Holy Pillar to qualify for the Trials.

Sea Horse Holy Pillar and Sea within the Sea

He praised Dai Mubai as one of the strongest Soul Emperors and for not harming any of the 1,000+ years Level Sea Horses in the Sea within the Sea around the Sea Horse Holy Pillar. He praised Zhu Zhuqing for outperforming Dai Mubai despite being younger. He praised Ning Rongrong for possessing the Seven Treasure Glazed Tile Pagoda but was confused by Oscar's Martial Soul before being shocked to learn that he was a Food System Soul Master. His mind relaxed upon noticing that Ma Hongjun was a Soul King and Bai Chenxiang was a Soul Ancestor, but he was shocked by their methods of passing the test. He was shocked by Tang San's method and suspected that the group belonged to the Martial Soul Hall before Dai Mubai clarified their origins. He triggered the Sea Horse Holy Pillar for Dai Mubai to obtain a Trial and was shocked when the latter obtained the Black Level Six Trials. He explained the difficulty levels of the Trials and their associated dangers to the group.

He also told the group about the differences in the time limits for Land Soul Masters and Sea Soul Masters during the Trials. He was shocked when Zhu Zhuqing obtained the Black Level Five Trials and Oscar obtained the Black Level Six Trials in succession. He was shocked when Ning Rongrong received the Red Level Seven Trials. He politely asked for Ning Rongrong's name, shocking the rest of the group, before revealing that although the Red Level Trials were harder than the Black Level Trials, they had a 100% success rate. He struggled to hold back his smile at the contents of Bai Chenxiang's Yellow Level One Trial and informed her of the consequences of failing it. He looked down on Ma Hongjun's actions after Bai Chenxiang completed her Trial, before being shocked when he obtained the Black Level Six Trials. He prevented the rest of the group from interfering while Tang San and Xiao Wu received their Trials. He was shocked when Xiao Wu received the Red Level One Trial, as it had no precedent. He was shocked by the phenomenon before Tang San received his Trials.

He was stunned by the Golden Trident Mark on Tang San's forehead and was unable to answer the latter's question regarding the Sea God Nine Trials before stating that the content of Xiao Wu's Red Level One Trial was to accompany Tang San as he completed his Trials. He asked Bo Saixi to punish him for not understanding the situation. Bo Saixi told him to relay her orders to treat the group as VIPs on Sea God Island and fulfill their requests apart from helping them with their Trials. He led the group to Sea Horse City and hosted them in his mansion.

The Guardians of the Sea God Holy Pillars were instructed by Bo Saixi not to go easy on the Shrek Seven Monsters during their 5th Trial.

He welcomed the Shrek Seven Monsters when they reached the Seahorse Holy Pillar for their first attempt at the 5th Trial. He started the timer for Tang San's 5th Trial task, by triggering the Seahorse Holy Pillar. He was shocked by the Soul Rings on Tang San's Blue Silver Emperor.

He was forced to use his Blue Sea Sky Shield under the amplification of his Seahorse Avatar to minimize the effects of Asura Hell. Shocked that Tang San could devour his Soul Power through his Soul Ring Abilities, he used Tornado Giant Wave Nirvana Fist, but Tang San forcibly interrupted it with Orca Evil Spirit Axe and Blue Silver Emperor Orca Devil's Absorption, causing internal backlash. After accepting defeat, he advised Tang San to use the Sea God's Light in future challenges. Oscar challenged him immediately afterward, and he allowed it, stating that it did not violate the rules. He was easily defeated with Ning Rongrong's support and received 10 Large Recovery Sausages afterward.

The guardians waited outside the Sea God Temple during the 6th Trial and discussed the possibility of Tang San completing the Sea God Nine Trials. They were shocked when he fired the Blue Silver Emperor Tyrant Spear at the temple and were forced to intervene when he controlled the plants on Sea God Mountain to attack it from all directions.

They were informed that their intervention had changed the Trial’s objective, which the participants completed easily. They asked Bo Saixi to punish them for interfering with the Trial, but she remarked that Tang San was too clever. They listened to Bo Saixi and Tang San’s conversation and were shocked by Tang San’s analysis.

The Guardians waited outside the Sea God Temple on the day of the 7th Trial.

They witnessed a transparent projection of Tang San in golden armor appear above the Sea God Temple upon completion of the 7th Trial. The Guardians prayed to the Sea God in response to the phenomenon.

The Guardians knelt before the Sea God Trident when Tang San exited the Sea God Temple. They saw Tang San’s group off as they departed from Sea God Mountain.

The Seahorse Douluo was first introduced on Sea God island, as the Guardian of the Seahorse Holy Pillar. In order to earn the right to a trial from the Sea God, each member of the Shrek Seven Devils, along with Bai Chenxiang and Xiao Bai, fights their way through his domain. By doing so, Ou Ya gets a good general idea of their skill level and abilities, and allows all of them to undertake a trial.

He expressed a mixture of shock and horror as each member of the Shrek Seven Devils achieves Black or Red level trials, believing they're all doomed to death. He's actually relieved to see Xiangxiang and Xiao Bai receive normal level trials.

Ou Ya's Seahorse Domain

He serves as a guardian and guide for the Seven Devils throughout their trials. Bo Saixi tasks him with being their teacher during their trials, since they arrived at his pillar first.

His chosen successor for the Seahorse Holy Pillar, and main student on the island, is Xiao Wu.
characters.trivia:
Ou Ya was only Rank 40 when he was 18, but thanks to being a denizen of Sea God Island, his time limit for each stage of his Black Trial was 10 years instead of 1. It took him 40 years to pass.

Ou Ya doesn't get along with Tang San, due to their personalities just not mixing well. They seem to be on different wavelengths, making one on one conversation awkward.

He had 10 Purple Ranked Sea Soul Masters as his direct subordinates, whose were either Soul Saints or Soul Douluos.

He personally administers the Yellow Level One Trial of Bai Chenxiang for 27 days, before telling her to go to the Shrek Seven Monsters after she completes it.

Tang San allows him to completely initiate the Tornado Giant Wave Nirvana Fist, instead of interrupting it in between.

characters.appearance: He is a good looking person who is rather tall for his age.
characters.history: During the Freshman Examination, their group appears first against Team Yuhao. Right after the start of the battle, he and Chen Junfeng eat the chicken leg from Zhao Haochen, thus boosting their agility and goes after Wang Dong to divide and conquer the opponents one by one. However they are soon defeated easily by Wang Dong.

characters.title: Ouyang Zixin
characters.introText: She was a tall and slender girl. She was very pretty with delicate facial features and large, limpid eyes. She looked to be about fourteen or fifteen years old and was already beginning to turn into a woman. She wore a pink tracksuit which offset her milky white skin and her long blue hair that was collected into a bundle with a comb. Under the rays of the morning sun, it seemed as if a layer of golden light was drawn to her. She was simply too stunning

characters.history:
Zixin encountered Tang Wulin running on the Academy's track field. She was surprised that his eyes were larger than beautiful than hers.

characters.title: Overlord Dragon

characters.introText: It is known as the unyielding spirit soul of the Spirit Pagoda. Moreover, it is an elite soul amongst all of them. It is one of the most uncontrollable creatures. There are only a few that are on par with it. The Overlord Dragon is wild and overbearing in temperament. There was once a human soul master who had achieved Rank 90 that wanted to absorb it as his final spirit soul, but he died tragically as a result of being forcibly breached by it. None have ever conquered its unyielding will. Amongst the Spirit Pagoda’s preserved souls, there is only one spirit soul from a soul beast that has been extinct since ancient times. It is also a creature at the pinnacle and exceedingly disobedient. It’ll often devour the other soul beasts in the spirit ascension platform. The spirit pagoda had thought about killing it, but due to its long history, as well as its rarity, they chose to leave it be.
characters.appearance:
When it first appeared, it was a titanic, sixty-meter tall monster with a body as vast as a hill. There were thick greyish-black scales covering its entire body, each one an irregular shape. Most of which were oval and semicircular, but in the middle of the forehead was a brilliant golden colored diamond shaped scale, exactly like the scale of the Golden Dragon King’s. Its monstrous head was almost a quarter of its body length, and with colossal pair of eyes. It was dragging a thick and strong tail behind its back, and its slightly gaping mouth was big enough to swallow even the Diamond Boar King. Its ghastly white teeth were as sharp as knives inside its cavernous mouth.

After it devoured the skeleton of the Overlord Dragon in the Dragon Valley, it started to grow tiny wings on its back. But the amusing part was that the pair of wings was disproportionate to its body. The wings were only about ten meters in width when spread out so it was apparently impossible to lift its enormous body, over seventy meters in height and fifty thousand kilograms in weight. The dusk gold radiance that covered its entire body seemed to glow brighter than before while the thick, heavy scales appeared to be exerting even more terrifying pressure.

As Tang Wulin's cultivation base grew, it was undergoing a tremendous transformation as well. It was around hundred meters tall. Its incomparably monstrous figure was even more fearsome. Its entire body was covered in duskgold scales. The scales were each about the size of a table, thick and heavy with obvious cuticles at the surface. There was even an enormous horn that grew out of the top of its head.

Its biggest change was the wings. When they first emerged, its pair of wings could only produce a minor effect when it was performing actions such as jumping due to its massive size. By this point, its wings were at least five times larger than their original size. They were attached to its back like an enormous cape, making the Overlord Dragon appear even more overbearing and ferocious.

It had had a kind of awakening due to the Golden Dragon King Bloodline, causing it to undergo a continuous transformation process. Judging by its appearance, it wouldn't be recognized what kind of creature it was.
characters.history: It first met Tang Wulin in the Intermediate Spirit Ascension Platform of the Spirit Pagoda. It sensed the Golden Dragon King bloodline in him and willingly offered to become the spirit soul of Tang Wulin. After it devoured the ten thousand years spirit ring of the Demon Spirit Great White Shark, it officially became Tang Wulin's spirit soul. It accompanied throughout the journey of Tang Wulin together with Gold Song and other spirit souls.
characters.trivia: Although it didn't debut in the Soul Land 4, it should have already become God Level together with Gold Song being the spirit souls of Tang Wulin.

She was the only emperor of the Peacock Clan who once led the Peacock Clan not only for the glory but also for the decline. She brought the peacock clan, which was originally at the second class bloodline, to the peak. She could definitely be described as one of the best emperors in the history of the monster clan.

characters.history:
When she was young and self-sustaining, she chose to peep the future with the Heaven’s Secret Plume. She did have glory, but she ran out of the life force. With the cultivation of the Great Monster Emperor, she only lived for less than 200 years, and she was also cursed and harmed to future generations of the Peacock Clan.

She had the best talent ever in the peacock clan. When she was young, she got countless opportunities under the attachment of God. However, in her later years, there were serious physical problems. She watched her relatives leave one by one, and even the continuation of her blood became a big problem. Originally, she didn't understand what was going on. It was not until her life was coming to an end that she finally realized why she, as a Great Monster Emperor, had such an unfortunate fate. This was all the backlashes caused by the leakage of the heaven’s secrets.
