He has a pair of calm and slightly stern eyes with a faint light flowing inside. His skin is tanned, and he has a strong brow and jawline. He wears a white gold robe and a golden crown.
characters.history:
Before he attained god rank, he travelled the world with the Angel Goddess, who was also mortal rank at the time, and helped civilians from spirit beasts and natural disasters. They were said to be the strongest soul masters on Douluo Continent, possibly Limit Douluos. While he may have been willing to search for a path to becoming a god to change the world for the better, it should be noted he wasn't as ambitious as the Angel Goddess who wanted to control the continent, eventually leading to their clash over the Angel Sword.

Tang San was given the Vast Sea Cosmic Shroud, which had been kept as a treasure by the Heaven Dou Imperial Clan, by Xue Ye for protecting the Empire from being usurped by the Martial Soul Hall via Qian Renxue. Xue Ye informed Tang San to use Soul Power to activate the abilities of the Vast Sea Cosmic Shroud.

Tang San tried to use the Spiritual Power to inspect the Vast Sea Cosmic Shroud, but it instead knocked Tang San out and drew out a large quantity of blood, which it absorbed. His Divine Sense within the Vast Sea Cosmic Shroud awakened, commenting that Tang San's physique could endure the power of the Sea. The Vast Sea Cosmic Shroud calmed down afterward.

His Divine Sense awakened after Tang San was knocked out by the Deep Sea Demonic Whale King. His Divine Sense threatened to blind the Deep Sea Demonic Whale King's remaining intact eye, forcing the latter to flee. His Divine Sense expressed hope for Tang San before sending the latter towards the Purple Pearl Island. His Divine Sense then withdrew into the Vast Sea Cosmic Shroud.

His Divine Sense in the Sea God Island granted the Sea God Trials to the Shrek Seven Monsters and Bai Chenxiang.

His Divine Sense elevated Bai Chenxiang's authority to the Purple Level after she climbed to the 61st Step of the stairs on the Sea God Mountain.

He was cursed by Oscar due to the actions and incantations required for the latter's Martial Soul Avatar, causing lightning to appear in the sky above the Sea God Mountain.

His projection appeared to prevent Xiao Bai from killing Tang San.

His Divine Sense within the Sea God Trident awakened while Tang San was covering Xiao Wu, Da Ming, and Er Ming’s escape from Bibi Dong, Yue Guan, Ci Xue, She Long, and another Titled Douluo. His Divine Sense taught Tang San the first three Techniques of the Golden Thirteen Halberds, restraining and injuring the Martial Soul Empire's group and destroying Bibi Dong’s body. It reminded Tang San that Bibi Dong would not die so easily and told him that he would learn the complete set during the actual Inheritance.
characters.trivia:
He was surprised that the Deep Sea Demonic Whale King has exceeded the cultivation limit of 100,000+ years Level within 20,000 years, and succeeded in Dragon Transformation.
This was later revealed to be the lightning tribulation Soul Beasts have to face at certain intervals after their cultivation exceeds 100,000+ years.

It was implied that there were others who were chosen by his Divine Sense in the past 20,000 years as potential successors, but they failed eventually.

He communicated with Tang San directly when the latter passed the 7th Trial.

Zang Xin told them about the destruction of Shrek Academy and Tang Sect headquarters. When Zang Xin asked for a hundred-thousand years heaven and earth treasure for each of the devils and Gu Yuena, they refused. They tried to expel them from the well using the remnant souls of the Water and Fire Dragon Kings, but was stopped by Gu Yuena and became submissive to her. Nevertheless, they still tried to expel them, but they were intimated by Zang Xin and were forced to agree to his demands. They showed them around the well introducing each herb.

Beautiful Silk Tulip interest was piqued when he saw how talented the devils were and offered to become one of the Shrek Seven Devils spirit soul, since there is little chance for him to overcome the next heavenly tribulation. Four of the devils, who have not yet started absorbing or eating a herb, shot him down, making him very angry and pissed off. Wulin was the only one who accepted his offer. When Wulin revealed his status as a child of nature, the six spirit beasts begin arguing on who should become Wulin's spirit soul. They decided to express their abilities to Wulin and let him decide.

In the end, Tulip got picked to became Tang Wulin's third spirit soul. He and the others, including the Chaotic Element Immortal Herb, left their seeds to Wulin to later be planted with the eternal tree after making a contract with him.

When Wulin broke through rank 60, he officially became his spirit soul. He also took part in the battle against Blood Nine. As a spirit soul, he was able to talk to Wulin and gave him advise on spirit beasts and plants. He accompanied throughout his journey together with his other spirit souls.

He appeared during Tang Wulin’s Spirit Souls Battle. He helped him to win by persuading Thunderclap Nether Vine to defect Zhang Geyang and follow Tang Wulin.

He appeared during Tang Wulin’s proposal to Gu Yuena.

characters.introText: Qian Daoliu is the ruling elder of the Martial Soul Temple as well as the High Priest of the Angel God.
characters.appearance:
Qian Daoliu is a handsome person seemingly about thirty or forty years old, appearing wearing a grey robe.

Qian Daoliu looked only 30 or 40 years old, very handsome, with a faint smile on his face. The calm and serene breath gives people a very comfortable feeling. He is tall, but not sturdy. He is dressed in a plain gray robe, with long black hair scattered behind his head, neatly combed. Although his clothes are so simple, he just stood there, giving people a feeling of worshipping.
characters.personality:
Qian Daoliu has a very calm personality and is rational. He keeps his powers in check, not even letting a single drop of spirit fluctuation to leak from his body. He gives off a peaceful and tranquil aura which gives off a very comfortable feeling.

Qian Daoliu is clear about right and wrong, he knows that his son Qian Xunji was killed by Bibi Dong, but he also knows that Qian Xunji's method of preventing Bibi Dong from leaving was too dark/shady, so he does not have much hatred for Bibi Dong. The future of the Martial Spirit Hall is more important to him than his personal hatred, and Bibidong has the talent to reach another level and lead the Spirit Hall further, so he is willing to support Bibi Dong and support her to become the Pope of the Hall.

Qian Daoliu keeps his promises. He once fought with Tang Chen and made a promise that the Spirit Hall will never set foot on the mountain where the Clear Sky Sect is located, unless he himself could defeat Tang Chen. Even though Tang Chen had been missing for many years, Qian Daoliu still kept his promise. Even when his son was indirectly killed by Tang Hao, Qian Daoliu did not attack the Clear Sky Sect. However, the Clear Sky Clan was still forced to banish Tang Hao. He also tried to hunt Tang Hao down, but failed to kill him.
characters.history:
Qian Daoliu is the ruling elder of the Martial Soul Temple as well as the High Priest of the Angel God.

He is known as the 'Invincible of the Sky', and is known as one of the two mountains of the land spirit master world, symbolising an insurmountable mountain, along with Tang Chen, the patriarch of the Haotian Sect.

After the tour of the Sea God Island, Qian Daoliu stayed in Spirit Hall as the Grand Elder of the Hall of Elders and Lord of the Hall of Douluo, responsible for the consecration of the Hall of Douluo and presiding over the ceremony of all the newly promoted title Douluo.

Now no longer involved in the affairs of the Hall of Wushu.
characters.trivia:
He was more than 70 when Qian Xunji was born.
It makes him more than 120 years older than Qian Renxue.

In the Manhua Qian Daoliu is portrayed as an old man with white hair wearing a mask.

characters.appearance:
At age 12, Qian Lei passed the Entrance exam and entered Shrek Academy with his two brothers, Xuanyu and Feng. During the actual combat exam, Qian Lei broke through to Spirit Sea Realm and realized more of his Summon Gold Coin's basic abilities, such as selective race summoning and beast fusion.

As a first year Outer Court student, Qian Lei chose mecha designer as his secondary profession. He is chosen by Ying Luohong as a direct disciple because of his spiritual realm, unique Spirit and control system combatant potential. She had him undergo spiritual pressure training for over 24 hours to increase his spiritual realm by +100 in one ssession, resulting in Qian Lei missing the chance to participate in the first rich-gamble game by Xuanyu in Douluo World.

During the first semester, he bought an antique storage coin that contained Little Golden Fatty, an ancient divine beast called "Golden Behemoth" that rivaled the Dragon Clan in the past and formed his third soul ring, with the help of the head of the Life Sect. Due to Life Brand, it clings to Qian Lei as if he was its father. He later learns of Xuanyu's former bloodline promotion-spirit awakening ability from Liu Feng and requests Xuanyu's power, however, Qian Lei was too late and full of regrets. After the first semester's final exam, Qian Lei returns to Heaven Luo Planet to show his parents Golden Fatty and his breakthrough since attending Shrek Academy.

In the 1st year 2nd semester as an Outer Court disciple:

He ate 100,000-year Magma Fruit provided by Xuanyu to help Golden Fatty, before the skipping-grade matches to go the Elf Planet.

He forcefully awakened Little Golden Fatty's bloodline during their fusion under Teacher Nana's instruction, resulting in rank increase and a life-sucked fit body. This forced him to exclude from visiting Elf Planet, instead cultivating life at the Sea God Lake.

He is fed by Xuanyu an Elf Planet native bloodline purification fruit that caused Golden Fatty's completed bloodline awakening and Qian Lei to grow vain, taller and muscular. His rank reached 37~38 and became indebt with 30 Purple Shreks to Xuanyu for cultivating in Sea God Lake.

He joins the Life Sect due to the necessity of life energy to cultivate alongside Xuanyu.

By the end of this semester, Qian Lei became a Spirit Ancestor (Rank 40+) and increased his combat abilities to give half his fellow Monsters a descent fight.

After the 1st Year final exam, Qian Lei's Purple class sky wing mecha is funded by Xuanyu, and for his fellow monsters.

By the 2nd year, Qian Lei obtains his Xuanyu quality forged Mithril based 1-word Battle Armor.

Quick Answers
		
		
	
	
			
				
					What is the significance of Qian Renxue masquerading as Xue Qinghe?
						
				
				
					
						Qian Renxue, disguised as Xue Qinghe, used Soul Bones from the Seraphim Soul family to manipulate political situations within the Heaven Dou Empire. She planned to attribute the king's death to Xue Beng. However, her scheme was thwarted, resulting in her severe injury and unconsciousness.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What transformation does Qian Renxue undergo during the Angel God Trials?
						
				
				
					
						Qian Renxue's transformation during the Angel God Nine Trials culminates in her becoming the Angel God. Her father, Qian Daoliu, sacrifices his life in the final stage to facilitate her ascendance. She also acquires a Gold card and a forehead mark during the trials. However, her ascendance signifies the end of the Angel God position in the Divine Realm, following a confrontation with Tang San.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What is the meaning behind Qian Renxue's name?
						
				
				
					
						In the context of Qian Renxue's character, 'Qian' signifies 'thousand, kilo, swing, music of bell', indicating abundance and harmony. Although 'Renxue' is not explicitly translated in the provided content, it may be inferred to represent her meticulousness and nobility.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					How does Qian Renxue's appearance contribute to her character in the story?
						
				
				
					
						Qian Renxue's physical attributes, such as her slender phoenix eyes and stately face, contribute to her dignified and indifferent persona. Her transformation during the Angel God Trials, where she appears younger and more ample, mirrors her character's meticulousness and intelligence. Her slender waist, towering chest, and perfectly curved hips further emphasize her strength and confidence.

characters.appearance:
Extra Chapter 14 (Manhua)

A year before the events of the main chapter, the true Prince Xue Qinghe encountered Qian Renxue in a carefully orchestrated scenario. Unbeknownst to him, she had staged an attack by a Spirit Beast, positioning herself as a damsel in distress. The prince, displaying his valor, saved her and, believing her to be in need, took her in as his servant. During the year she spent in his service, Qian Renxue meticulously studied his behaviors, mannerisms, and even the most minute details about his life. By the end of that year, Prince Xue Qinghe remarked that she knew him better than he knew himself.

The turning point came during a hunting competition organized by the Emperor to celebrate the prince's birthday. High-ranking nobles and other dignitaries were in attendance, adding to the grandeur of the event. In the midst of the festivities, Renxue orchestrated another crisis. This time, she staged an attack by what seemed to be a Spirit Beast, but was actually a Spirit Master and assassin aiming for the Emperor.

As expected, the prince and his guards pursued the supposed assassin, leaving Renxue the opportunity she needed. Isolated from the others, she finally unveiled her true intentions: to usurp Prince Xue Qinghe’s identity and seize control of the empire. She revealed her true form, displaying her Seraphim Martial Spirit, and disclosed her affiliation with the Spirit Hall. With her domain power, she mercilessly eliminated the prince and his guards, securing her position and paving the way for her grand plan to take over the empire.

Ning Fengzhi takes Tang San to meet up with Xue Qinghe, who states that he idolized Tang Hao, reveals what he knows about the circumstances leading to Tang Hao's seclusion. He is impressed by Tang San's maturity and wishes to keep him on his side, even giving the latter his personal token.

He accompanied Ning Fengzhi to visit the group from the Shrek Academy in the Heaven Dou Imperial Hunting Grounds.

He accompanied Ning Fengzhi to visit Tang San after the latter was injured in the second round of the Qualifiers.

He stood up following Xue Ye to respect Dai Mubai and Yu Tianxin for their performance.

He was appointed by Xue Ye to be part of the judges and represent the Heaven Dou Imperial Clan in the Finals. The convoy from the Heaven Dou Empire was ambushed along the way to the Martial Soul City 10 days into the journey.

He led the escorting army to clear the area and asked Ning Fengzhi for his opinion regarding the journey, before the convoy continued its journey. He refrained from overly interacting with Tang San during the journey, and earned the latter's goodwill before reaching the Martial Soul City.

He was present at the Moon Pavilion for the graduation ceremony of Xue Ke's batch and became curious about Tang Yin, who was chosen as the batch representative over Xue Ke. He observed Tang Yin playing the harp and was shocked that he could not find any flaws in his performance. He was surprised to learn that Tang Yin was Tang Yuehua's nephew. He offered Tang Yin a position as his subordinate, but was surprised when he refused. He attempted to probe Tang Yin's cultivation using his Soul Power but was shocked when he could not determine anything. He gave Tang Yin his personal token, allowing him unrestricted future visits to the Heaven Dou Imperial Palace.

characters.personality: He had been an eccentric and solitary boy. He was very reluctant to make contact with others.
characters.history:
In the earlier years, his cultivation was nothing special. When Qiangu Dongfeng was nine years old, his cultivation base had already surpassed the twelve-year-old Qiangu Qingfeng. This had made his clan disregard him even more, and he was treated like an outcast. He did not share the same mother as Qiangu Dongfeng. Due to his half-blooded status in addition to his mother dying after giving birth to him, it had made his life in the clan quite difficult. When he was fourteen years old, he took a grant from the clan ostensibly to study abroad. After that, he did not return to the clan for twenty years.

Qiangu Dongfeng lived out a smooth life over those years. His elevation was extremely fast thanks to the financial support he received from the whole clan. He had already made a name for himself by the age of thirty and broke through to Title Douluo-rank. He was in high spirits at the time. Around that time, Qiangu Qingfeng suddenly came back. The first thing he did upon his return was challenge Qiangu Dongfeng.

Qingfeng became the next Qiangu Clan head before Qiangu Dieting's final battle with the Abyssal Plane.

Feeling that there were no more enemies and having a longer lifespan than before, Qiangu Qingfeng felt the need to do something. Ultimately, Qiangu Qingfeng chose to return to the Spirit Pagoda. The Qiangu Clan had been operating in the tower for many years and still had some connections. After returning, Qiangu Qingfeng disguised himself as a newcomer and gradually revealed his cultivation within the tower, with the help and cover of friends. It took him thirty years to climb the ranks and become a high-ranking member, hoping that the Qiangu Clan could return once he became the Pagoda Master.

Due to accidentally revealing his identity, Qiangu Qingfeng had tried for many years but failed to become the Pagoda Master of the Spirit Pagoda. The Tower was worried about being targeted by Shrek Academy and couldn't allow him to reach the highest position. However, they couldn't bear to let go of this God-level powerhouse either. The establishment of the Doutian Ministry in the Douluo Federation became a special opportunity for Qiangu Qingfeng. The Tower allowed Qiangu Qingfeng to represent them and join the Doutian Ministry. At that time, Qiangu Qingfeng believed that he had no more opportunities in the Tower, and the Doutian Ministry offered a new and broader stage without constraints. So, he worked diligently in the department, which lasted for thousands of years. With his long lifespan, Qiangu Qingfeng accumulated more power and eventually became the Minister of the Doutian Ministry, becoming a significant figure in the Douluo Federation.

Qiangu Qingfeng was attached to power and cherished his life even more. The longer he lived, the more he feared death. When he felt his lifespan coming to an end for the first time, fear filled his heart, and he tried various methods to prolong his life. As the Minister of the Doutian Ministry, Qiangu Qingfeng obtained assistance from the Life School of Shrek Academy. Leveraging his influence, he started searching for ways to extend life and eventually discovered the revived Holy Spirit Cult. Although the revived Holy Spirit Cult didn't possess great power, Qiangu Qingfeng completely annihilated them and confiscated all their records.

After truly encountering the Holy Spirit Cult and reading many of their documents, Qiangu Qingfeng realized that the members of the Holy Spirit Cult were also a group of pitiful people. Nobody is born evil; they become evil mainly due to unfair treatment since birth. Thus, Qiangu Qingfeng decided to help those with evil martial souls. With the power of the Doutian Ministry, Qiangu Qingfeng searched for children with evil martial souls throughout the Federation, gathered them, and provided education, particularly focusing on their moral qualities. He tailored his teachings to each individual, enabling them to live as normal people despite possessing evil martial souls. When they grew up, he let them join the Doutian Ministry as members of the Law Enforcement Division. These individuals didn't even know they were evil soul masters; they only knew that their powers were slightly different from others. They lived in the shadows according to the requirements of the Doutian Ministry and silently contributed to humanity. They became the Dark Division within the Doutian Ministry.

Through studying the records of the Holy Spirit Cult and his own cultivation, Qiangu Qingfeng began conducting experiments on himself, searching for possibilities of immortality. Eventually, he found some methods to prolong life. Thus, Qiangu Qingfeng enhanced his physical body in various ways, constantly changing himself and driving his evolution. Although he became less human and more like a ghost, he successfully extended his life by a thousand years.

Later on, Qiangu Qingfeng realized that he had taken the wrong path and had failed to pursue higher levels of Spiritual Power. He had focused solely on his physical body and neglected his consciousness. Therefore, Qiangu Qingfeng began exploring more about himself. In terms of developing his spiritual domain, he finally found the correct path. Through continuous research, Qiangu Qingfeng discovered a more suitable method of developing his spiritual domain, reaching a level of over 90% development. He entered the realm of True God.

As his research continued, Qiangu Qingfeng's physical body couldn't keep up with his spiritual level. This time, his decline was irreversible. So, Qiangu Qingfeng utilized some secret techniques from the Holy Spirit Cult, transforming himself into a state similar to an undead. Only his brain remained within the deteriorating body, while the rest of his body remained in a fixed state. In this way, he barely clung to life for another ten thousand years.

Qiangu Qingfeng was well aware that his physical body could no longer help him restrain his divine consciousness. At most, he had only ten more years to live. Thus, he decided to entrust the Doutian Ministry and the Dark Division to Shrek Academy and Tang Wulin. He also recorded his lifelong research in written form and donated it to Shrek Academy. However, Qiangu Qingfeng's achievements over the years gained recognition from Ling Zichen, and an agreement was reached. Ling Zichen helped Qiangu Qingfeng prolong his life. In return for the extra ten years, Qiangu Qingfeng would work for the Tang Sect and Shrek Academy. Moreover, a special brain science research institute was established for Qiangu Qingfeng in the Tang Sect.

He passed the information of the Shrek Seven Monsters to the members of the Emperor Team. He informed the members of the Emperor Team that the Shrek Seven Monsters had won 27 consecutive matches and that their total points had reached the requirements of the Silver Soul Badge, making them the fastest to do so, before reminding the Emperor Team that the time taken by them to reach the Silver Soul Badge was a whole year instead of a month. He informed the Emperor Team that the Shrek Seven Monsters faced the Mad Battle Team in their first match. He reprimanded Dugu Yan for her attitude of looking down on Tang San. He told the members of the Emperor Team not to kill any member of the Shrek Seven Monsters, and especially told Dugu Yan that she had to detoxify them immediately after the match if she used her poison on them. He told the Emperor Team that he would tell them the reason later.

He was shocked when Dugu Yan used the Jade Phosphor Violet Poison, before witnessing it being countered easily.

He waited for the members of the Emperor Team while they left the stage. He encouraged the Emperor Team to learn from their failure, before telling them to rest. He came to the waiting room of the Shrek Seven Monsters to visit Fu Lande and Zhao Wuji, before kneeling to them. He stated that he would forever remain a student of the Shrek Academy. He greeted Yu Xiaogang politely but his greeting was refused. He was shocked to hear that Yu Xiaogang was Yu Tianheng's uncle. He greeted the Shrek Seven Monsters before commenting that the Shrek Academy had grown. He was shocked to hear the financial situation of the Academy was still bad. He revealed that he was a teacher of the Heaven Dou Imperial Academy, and the Emperor Team were their best students.

He pondered about the Shrek Seven Monsters along with the financial situation of the Shrek Academy. He, Fu Lande and Zhao Wuji were talking when the Shrek Seven Monsters returned to the hotel. He didn't recognize the Shrek Seven Monsters at first before realizing their identity.

He commented that if the members of the Emperor Team were of the same age as the members of the Shrek Seven Monsters, they wouldn't have any chance of victory at all. He stated that he was at Level 62 after Dai Mubai asked about it. He offered to pay for the meal as respects to Fu Lande and Zhao Wuji for teaching him. He told the Shrek Seven Monsters that he would have used every means to bring them to the Heaven Dou Imperial Academy were they not students of the Shrek Academy. He commented that the leadership of the Heaven Dou Imperial Academy would use any means to keep the Shrek Seven Monsters there if they went for an exchange. He told Yu Xiaogang that the Heaven Dou Imperial Academy would declare that the Shrek Seven Monsters were part of them according to his plans. He commented that Yu Xiaogang's conditions were acceptable from the side of the Heaven Dou Imperial Academy.

Her projection kept flashing behind Bibi Dong when Qian Renxue obtained the Angel Level Nine Trials.

As she corrupted the Slaughter City, she could monitor the possessors of the Deathgod Domain. Her Divine Sense interfered with Tang Chen's Asura God Trials gradually to make his body the host of the Dark Golden Three-Headed Bat King and mutate him to become the Slaughter King. Her influence over Tang Chen was erased by the Sea God's Light from the Sea God Trident enabling him to pass his 8th Trial of Asura Inheritance.

She chose Bibi Dong to be her successor after the latter was raped by Qian Xunji and filled with vengeful thoughts. Bibi Dong killing Qian Xunji and absorbing his power marked the completion of the 2nd trial to inherit Rakshasa's position, shielding her from probing by Qian Daoliu. characters.title: Rakshasa God
characters.introText: The Rakshasa God is the former 1st Class God of the Douluo Divine Realm, not to be confused with the God King, God of Evil. The Rakshasa God is one of the two great Gods of Slaughter, controlling the malevolent, resentment and devilish auras while the other being the Asura God, controlling the murderous auras. They are all Gods of Slaughter, but they didn’t get along well. The Asura God is the nemesis to the Rakshasa God, with an even more restraining effect than the Light God.
characters.appearance:
The Rakshasa God is the former 1st Class God of the Douluo Divine Realm, not to be confused with the God King, God of Evil. The Rakshasa God is one of the two great Gods of Slaughter, controlling the malevolent, resentment and devilish auras while the other being the Asura God, controlling the murderous auras. They are all Gods of Slaughter, but they didn’t get along well. The Asura God is the nemesis to the Rakshasa God, with an even more restraining effect than the Light God.

In other words, the Asura God is the ‘Light God of Slaughter’, while the Rakshasa God is the ‘Dark God of Slaughter’. The Light of Asura is the pure light, and the Dark of the Rakshasa is the most sinister darkness.

Just Like the Sea God can take the power of the Sea; the Angel God can receive power from the Sun, the Rakshasa God can take every single bad thoughts, and intentions in the hearts of all dead or living creatures. Those grudges would become the Rakshasa God’s god power. The power of resentment is more powerful than the power of faith, but it cannot last long. However, in a battle, the resentment will be more intimidating.

The divine power of Rakshasa has a strong oppressive power on most deities. As long as they are contaminated a little, they need to rely on huge divine will to get rid of it or slowly get corroded and die.

Bibi Dong, Rakshasa God was killed by Tang San, Sea God during the war between Spirit Empire and Heaven Dou Empire.

characters.history:
Because both Da Ming and Er Ming have noticed that the Yearning Heartbroken Red provided huge vitality to Xiao Wu's physical body after performing Immolation, they have given Tang San two conditions to completely resurrect her. First is to gather three items - an at least 10,000-years-old Sacred Soul Grass, a 10,000 Year Ninth Grade Ginseng King (90,000 years), and an essence core of ancient beast. Second is for him to reach Titled Douluo cultivation in order to return Xiao Wu's spirit ring and spirit bone back.

They said, although very rare, it is not difficult to find a Sacred Soul Grass in the vast Great Star Dou Forest.

A 1,000+ years Sacred Soul Grass was devoured by the Monster Eyed Tree. The later became the strongest plant spirit beast, the Myriad Monster King and was rank fifth among the Top Ten Fierce Beasts.

characters.title: Sand Demon Beetle
characters.introText: The Sand Demon Beetle is a species of extremely evil soul beasts. They can burrow underground and fly. They rely on draining the bodily fluids of living creatures to survive and cultivate. Animals and plants are all their targets. A large herd of these beasts would need only a single day to destroy one square kilometer of forest.
characters.appearance: It is a very large crustacean-like creature over two meters in diameter. At the bottom of their heads, there's a very sharp mouthpart.

characters.introText: It was a Sand Demon Beetle over five meters in diameter. Its hard outer shell was black-brown in color while its entire body was emitting a highly condensed aura. The shell on its back cracked open and revealed a pair of wings. Its eight legs underneath its abdomen appeared razor-sharp, especially the two at the front. Its blade-like forelegs could be seen immediately when its upper body was raised a little.

characters.introText: The Sapphire Phoenix was obviously the legendary Phoenix Clan spirit beast that was said to be able to rival the Giant Dragon. Although is a subspecies of phoenix, its bloodline was very similar to a real phoenix.
characters.appearance: It was a large blue bird, only about seven meters in length. Its entire body was burning with piercing sapphire flames. It had three tail feathers that were raised high in the air. It was dazzling and radiant in its phoenix form.

characters.title: Sapphire Vine
characters.introText: The Green Jade Vine, also known as Sapphire Vine, is three-meter long that is blue-white all throughout with a faintly clear feeling. Its jade texture is very special, soft to touch, and exudes a touch of warmth, constantly twisting and turning like a snake. It can become a spirit once its spiritual wisdom is turned on.

characters.title: Scarlet Fire Monkey
characters.introText: The Scarlet Fire Monkey was considered a low-ranked spirit beast. Most of them had cultivation bases of ten to one hundred years. It was considered rare to see a hundred-year Scarlet Fire Monkey, and it was a solitary hunter. There was nothing impressive about it other than its speed and agility in the forest.
characters.appearance: The Scarletfire Monkeys all looked similar, except there were differences in their sizes. The biggest one was about two meters tall, taller than most fully grown humans, while the smallest one was no more than two feet tall. Their fiery-red fur was conspicuous inside the forest, and the two lengthy fangs protruding from their lips showed their carnivorous nature.

characters.title: Scarlet Fire Monkey King
characters.introText: The Scarlet Fire Monkey King was a massive, bulky creature with brown-red fur covering its entire body. Its body size was more than ten times larger than an ordinary Scarlet Fire Monkey. Its length exceeded seven meters while its brown-red fur was exuding a faint golden shimmer as it moved. What was even more astounding was the third eye on its forehead. The eye had a golden iris and a slit pupil glowing with an otherworldly light. The radiance emitted from its third eye was so brilliant.

characters.introText: An unnamed Sea Spirit Master entitled "Sea Dragon Douluo" who is ranked first among the Sea God Sacred Pillar Guardians of his era. After the new Sea God's apotheosis, the Sea Dragon Douluo becomes the next High Priest of Sea God Island during Tang San's era.
characters.appearance:
Sea Dragon Sacred Pillar Mark (Donghua)

He is more than two meters tall with a simple face, seemingly only thirty something years old, having an inverted triangle physique with solid pectoral and abdominal muscles, glinting with a healthy bronze light like armor, and the equally deep blue eyes. A head of deep blue semi long hair just reaches his shoulders, curling naturally. And on his solid back is a blue pattern of a giant dragon.

The sea dragon tattoo on the Sea Dragon Douluo's back brightened, intense blue light instantly enveloping his body, berserk energy waves rushing out. This energy affected the nearby sea water to produce giant waves with him as the epicenter.

On his bare upper body, the skin and face were swiftly covered with blue scales. The scales were round, each one with a bulging protrusion. Very soon, the Sea Dragon Douluo’s bare skin was all covered with scales. His originally imposing body also expanded a bit, a deep blue crystal appearing like an eye on his chest. Vaguely, an immense blue dragon image appeared behind him.

The Sea Dragon Douluo’s arms were especially thick and solid, sharp dragon claws condensing like five short spears. When he released his domain, a bizarre blue ripple spread out from that eye-like crystal on his chest. His Spirit Power was (dark) deep blue colored.

He is a powerfully muscled man with light skin. He wears his mid length blue hair tied away from his face, but loose around his shoulders. A large blue gem is embedded in his chest, his scars are blue, and patches of blue scales cover his wrists and other small areas of skin. He has a large dragon tattoo curling across his entire back.

He never wears a shirt, but has blue pants edged in wrought gold.
characters.personality:
He is brash and assertive and is often seen with a wide grin. He seems straightforward and bellicose, but not impulsive, and is mature and proud enough to accept his combat losses while analyzing his opponent. His inner strength and powerful nature have earned him great respect from all those around him. He appears in the Manhua to be a bit of a womanizer, using metaphors about bathing mermaids and beautiful women on occasion.

His Donghua version appears to be taciturn and expressionless, unless he was fighting. Even if he knows he cannot become a God, he desires to witness the level beyond Rank 99.
characters.history:
He noticed the Red Level Seven Trials descending on Ning Rongrong, the Red Level One Trial descending on Xiao Wu, and Tang San receiving the Sea God Nine Trials.

The Guardians of the Sea God Holy Pillars were instructed by Bo Saixi not to go easy on the Shrek Seven Monsters during their 5th Trial.

The Sea Dragon Holy Pillar responded to the Seahorse Holy Pillar signaling the start of Tang San's timer for the 5th Trial.

He welcomed Tang San's group upon their arrival near the Sea Dragon Holy Pillar 18 hours after the challenges began. He informed Tang San that, despite his victories over the remaining guardians, the Sea Spear Douluo and Sea Ghost Douluo had not fully accepted their defeats. He used his Devilbreaker Domain to disable Tang San's Blue Silver Domain, prompting Tang San to propose a battle using only their Martial Souls, without Soul Ring or Soul Bone abilities, which he accepted. He was shocked when Tang San activated the Clear Sky Hammer and was gradually overwhelmed by its power. Tang San defeated him with a combination of techniques, forcing him to use his Soul Ring abilities and violate their agreed conditions. He consoled Tang San after learning about the group's 6th Trial.

The guardians waited outside the Sea God Temple during the 6th Trial and discussed the possibility of Tang San completing the Sea God Nine Trials. They were shocked when he fired the Blue Silver Emperor Tyrant Spear at the temple and were forced to intervene when he controlled the plants on Sea God Mountain to attack it from all directions.

They were informed that their intervention had changed the Trial’s objective, which the participants completed easily. They asked Bo Saixi to punish them for interfering with the Trial, but she remarked that Tang San was too clever. They listened to Bo Saixi and Tang San’s conversation and were shocked by Tang San’s analysis.

The Guardians waited outside the Sea God Temple on the day of the 7th Trial. He led Tang San, Xiao Wu, and Ning Rongrong inside before leaving after informing Bo Saixi.

They witnessed a transparent projection of Tang San in golden armor appear above the Sea God Temple upon completion of the 7th Trial. The Guardians prayed to the Sea God in response to the phenomenon.

The Guardians knelt before the Sea God Trident when Tang San exited the Sea God Temple. They saw Tang San’s group off as they departed from Sea God Mountain.

The Sea Dragon Douluo first appeared clothed when Ning Rongrong attained the highest Red Level Trial. He Iater showed up in person at the Seahorse Pillar, along with the other guardians. After the first day of the Trial, he chose Dai Mubai as his successor and student. He continued to watch over the trial takers throughout their challenges.

He fought against Tang San during the latter's fifth Trial, but was tricked to fight with Tang San's "fighting method" proposal: only "Martial Souls" and without Rings or other Abilities, after he a TItled Douluo released his first ring and sole domain against Tang San. The result was his loss at the "non-prohibited" mortal hidden weapons of Tang Sect which led him to use his fifth Spirit Ring's barrier. His fight in the Donghua was more artistic and long.

After the fifth Trial "Fight the Seven Sacred Pillar Guardians", the Sea Dragon Douluo and his compatriots accompanied the Sea God Trials' audience.

After Tang San became the next Sea God, the Sea Dragon Douluo was appointed by Tang San as the High Priest of Sea God Island.
characters.trivia: He knew about the Clear Sky Hammer and some of its properties.

characters.introText: The Sea Ghost Douluo is a litte young man with short light brown hair grown over his eyes. His eyes, though rarely seen, match his hair color. He has two black crescent tattoos, one on each arm below the shoulder. He wears gloved black sleeves which end just before his tattoos.
characters.appearance: The Sea Ghost Douluo is a litte young man with short light brown hair grown over his eyes. His eyes, though rarely seen, match his hair color. He has two black crescent tattoos, one on each arm below the shoulder. He wears gloved black sleeves which end just before his tattoos.
characters.personality: The Sea Ghost Douluo is shown to be a quieter personality than his coworkers, but with a hidden intensity and drive he shows in little flashes throughout the Trials. He values the growth of his student, Bai Chenxiang, enough that he is willing to lie to her face without any sign of deception.
characters.history:
He noticed the Red Level Seven Trials descending on Ning Rongrong, the Red Level One Trial descending on Xiao Wu, and Tang San receiving the Sea God Nine Trials.

The Guardians of the Sea God Holy Pillars were instructed by Bo Saixi not to go easy on the Shrek Seven Monsters during their 5th Trial.

He was the target of Ma Hongjun's task for the 5th Trial. The Sea Ghost Holy Pillar responded to the Seahorse Holy Pillar signaling the start of Tang San's timer for the 5th Trial.

He was defeated by Ma Hongjun with Ning Rongrong's amplifications and Oscar's Sausages in a short time, then easily defeated by Tang San.

He did not approve of Tang San's method of defeating him.

The guardians waited outside the Sea God Temple during the 6th Trial and discussed the possibility of Tang San completing the Sea God Nine Trials. They were shocked when he fired the Blue Silver Emperor Tyrant Spear at the temple and were forced to intervene when he controlled the plants on Sea God Mountain to attack it from all directions.

They were informed that their intervention had changed the Trial’s objective, which the participants completed easily. They asked Bo Saixi to punish them for interfering with the Trial, but she remarked that Tang San was too clever. They listened to Bo Saixi and Tang San’s conversation and were shocked by Tang San’s analysis.

The guardians waited outside the Sea God Temple on the day of the 7th Trial.

They witnessed a transparent projection of Tang San in golden armor appear above the Sea God Temple upon completion of the 7th Trial. The Guardians prayed to the Sea God in response to the phenomenon.

The Guardians knelt before the Sea God Trident when Tang San exited the Sea God Temple. They saw Tang San’s group off as they departed from Sea God Mountain.

The Sea Ghost Douluo first appeared when Ning Rongrong attained the highest Red Level Trial. He later shows up in person at the Seahorse Pillar, along with the other Douluo guardians.

After the first day of the Trial, he chooses Bai Chenxiang as his successor and student. Before doing so, he remembers the meeting they held to decide on students, and everyone telling him he had to choose last thanks to being the youngest. He lies to Xiangxiang, telling her he chose first, and chose her without hesitation because of her hidden potential. He does admit there was some argument over choosing her as a successor, due to her weakness compared to the Shrek Seven Devils.

He, along with the other pillar guardians, assisted Tang San's absorption of the 100 thousand year Spirit Ring using the seven man fusion technique, Saint Pillar's Light.

He continues to watch over the trial takers throughout their challenges.

He was finally defeated by Ma Hongjun, with the help of Oscar and Ning Rongrong's support, in the Fifth Trial of Sea God.
characters.trivia:
He forced Ma Hongjun and Ning Rongrong to experience their hopes in an illusion induced by poison, before they break out and defeat him.

Tang San uses an Aromatic Silk Beauty to suppress his Poison and force him to admit defeat.

He was gratified to learn that Tang San was well versed in using and countering Poisons.
This contradicts with the fact that he disapproved of Tang San's method to secure victory.

characters.title: Sea God
characters.introText:
Quick Answers
		
		
	
	
			
				
					Who was the Sea God before Tang San inherited the Godhood?
						
				
				
					
						Poseidon, a 1st Class God and God King, was the Sea God before Tang San. He controlled the seas and all water types, earning worship from sea-type spirit beasts and spirit masters. Through the Vast Sea Cosmic Shroud, Poseidon met Tang San and chose him as his successor. Tang San ascended to Sea God after passing the Sea God Trials.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What powers does the Sea God possess in the Divine Realm?
						
				
				
					
						In the Divine Realm, the Sea God can draw faith energy from the sea and its inhabitants, using it to suppress enemies, enhance his strength, and create divine punishment. This deity can also summon his God-king powers, replicate his past life's martial soul powers, and his god position's authority. He can gather faith energy from diverse sea races to rejuvenate others and his divine consciousness. The Sea God's Light, a pure divine power, can nullify resistance, heal injuries, and revive life. It can cleanse the body and spirit from any evil intent.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What is the significance of the Vast Sea Cosmic Shroud in the Sea God's story?
						
				
				
					
						The Vast Sea Cosmic Shroud, alias Sea God's Heart, is a sentient national treasure given to Tang San by Emperor Xue Ye. It possesses multiple abilities, including a protective barrier and a potent purple light emission. After Tang San completed the Sea God's fifth trial, Love, the Shroud transformed into a blue-gold skull. Poseidon, the Sea God, entrusted the Shroud to Tang San with high expectations.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What are the Sea God Trials that Poseidon bestowed upon Tang San?
						
				
				
					
						Poseidon, the prior Sea God, met Tang San via the Vast Sea Cosmic Shroud and chose him as the next Sea God. He presented Tang San with the Sea God Trials on Sea God Island. These trials required extracting Poseidon's super artifact, the Seagod Trident, and aiding Tang San in his trial. The last trial involved acquiring all Spirit Rings, Spirit Bones, and revival. Tang San ascended as the new Sea God after passing these trials.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					Who are the Shrek Seven Devils in relation to the Sea God?
						
				
				
					
						The Shrek Seven Devils, a group of prodigies from Shrek Academy, are selected as successors by the Seven Children of the Sea God following their attempt to ascend the Sea God Temple steps. They receive training and supervision from the Seven Children throughout their initial trial, although the latter do not intervene in the tests. The Shrek Seven Devils also delve into the enigmas of life and destruction, and have faced turmoil on Sea God Island.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom

Description[]
The Sea God is a God King in the Divine Realm and a former 1st class God before Tang San inherited the Godhood. He has the ability to control the seas including all types of water and is worshiped by the sea-type spirit beasts and spirit masters.
characters.appearance: The Sea God is a God King in the Divine Realm and a former 1st class God before Tang San inherited the Godhood. He has the ability to control the seas including all types of water and is worshiped by the sea-type spirit beasts and spirit masters.
characters.history: Poseidon was the former Sea God. He encountered Tang San through the Vast Sea Cosmic Shroud. At that moment, he designated Tang San as his successor. When the Shrek Seven Devils arrived on Sea God Island, Poseidon bestowed Tang San the Sea God Trials. Tang San became the Sea God after completing the Sea God Trials. After becoming the Sea God, Tang San battled with the Angel Goddess, Qian Renxue, ending in her defeat.
characters.trivia:
Xiao Wu can temporarily become the Sea Goddess when Tang San uses the power of the Asura God.

Although Tang Wulin completed the Sea God Trials, he didn’t become the Sea God because the God Position couldn’t be passed down due to the God Realm was swept away by the Space-Time Turbulence and very far away at that time. He was only able to wield the Sea God Trident.

characters.introText:
Quick Answers
		
		
	
	
			
				
					What makes the Sea Princess a powerful Spirit Beast?
						
				
				
					
						The Sea Princess, a Spirit Beast over 600,000 years old, is the most powerful Mermaid and Royal Queen of the Aquatic Spirit Beast. She rules the Extreme North with the Snow Empress. Her spiritual power is second only to the Evileye Tyrant Emperor. She ranks among the top four of the Ten Great Savage Beasts. Her strength and spiritual abilities command respect and alliances from other aquatic soul beasts.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					How does the Sea Princess compare to the Snow Empress?
						
				
				
					
						Sea Princess, a Spirit Beast over 600,000 years old, is the most powerful Mermaid and Royal Queen of the Aquatic Spirit Beasts. She rules the Extreme North alongside the Snow Empress. While her spiritual power is formidable, only the Evileye Tyrant Emperor surpasses her. In terms of power, she would rank in the top four among the Ten Great Savage Beasts. The Snow Empress, on the other hand, possesses a fusion skill with the Ice Empress that creates devastating blizzards and snowstorms, turning water elements into lethal snowflakes and ice blades. Both figures are powerful in their domains, with the Sea Princess commanding aquatic realms and the Snow Empress wielding control over ice and snow.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					Why is the Sea Princess ranked among the Ten Great Savage Beasts?
						
				
				
					
						The Sea Princess ranks among the Ten Great Savage Beasts due to her status as the Royal Queen of the Aquatic Spirit Beast and her immense power. Over 600,000 years old, she is the most powerful mermaid, ruling the Extreme North with the Snow Empress. Her spiritual power is second only to the Evileye Tyrant Emperor. Her golden crown and scales signify her authority. Her abilities, Ocean Heart, Merfolk’s Blessing, and Mermaid’s Tears, enhance her ranking.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					Who can surpass the Sea Princess in spiritual power?
						
				
				
					
						The Sea Princess, a Spirit Beast over 600,000 years old, is the most powerful mermaid and the Royal Queen of the Aquatic Spirit Beast. She rules the Extreme North with the Snow Empress. Her spiritual power is formidable, but only the Evileye Tyrant Emperor can surpass her in this regard.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What is unique about the Sea Princess's spiritual power?
						
				
				
					
						The Sea Princess has a unique spiritual power called the Ocean Heart, a super spirit skill for Merfolk with the golden bloodline. It grants immunity from one energy-based attack, absorbing the energy to combine with the user's power. As a 600,000-year-old Spirit Beast, she is the most powerful Mermaid, ruling the Extreme North with the Snow Empress. Her spiritual power is second only to the Evileye Tyrant Emperor, placing her among the top four of the Ten Great Savage Beasts.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom

Appearance[]
She looked like a beautiful middle-aged woman and also very peculiar. Her size and figure was pretty similar to that of Li Jing. However, her crown was golden. In fact, even the scales on her fishtail were golden.
characters.appearance: She looked like a beautiful middle-aged woman and also very peculiar. Her size and figure was pretty similar to that of Li Jing. However, her crown was golden. In fact, even the scales on her fishtail were golden.
characters.personality: She used to be very kind and gentle to humans but after the incident of her daughter with the Evil Spirit Masters, she became very hateful and aggressive to humans.
characters.history:
She trapped Huo Yuhao and Tang Wutong who came to the Northern Ice Sea to discuss with her. She was very surprised to find out that the Snow Empress, who was also the lord of Extreme North like her, became the Spirit Soul of Huo Yuhao. She also tried to kill them because her daughter, Li Ya, was about to die. Only when Tang Wutong released her 9th Soul Skill, the Sea God Summon, that calmed her heart, making her hatred had disappeared.

To save her daughter, she used forty-nine golden pearls to fuse with Huo Yuhao that made her would need tens of thousands of years of nourishment to recover after consuming so much of her spiritual origin. Her daughter became the spirit soul of Huo Yuhao since it was the only way.

characters.appearance:
The Sea Serpent is a snake with gray-black scales all over its body. It is highly poisonous, and has a special kind of cold poison.

To detoxify the poison, you must be kept in the sun for three days before the toxicity can be released by itself. And during these three days, you can't eat, you can only drink a small amount of water. Then stand up straight. Cold poison will pour into the ground under the pressure of the sun. The crystal of Ten Headed Fierce Yang Serpent can also detoxify that poison.

His transformation upon activation of his Martial Soul is especially ugly, to the point of being called especially disgusting. His limbs become tentacles, along with his hair, which joins together to form the fifth tentacle.

characters.personality: He's a blunt, level headed person who takes his responsibilities very seriously. Though he can appear lazy and uncaring, he's actually a very serious and hardworking person. He has a bad temper, and constantly pushes and bullies Ma Hongjun to overcome his laziness and become a worthy successor to the Seven Children of the Sea God.

After the first day of the Trial, he chooses Ma Hongjun as his successor and student. (After insisting none of the other guardians could have him.) He procured a God Stone for Hongjun, and explained how to break it down to become a new Spirit Ring. When Hongjun began the breakdown, he noted that powerful willpower was required. Oscar replied Fatty had zero willpower, and would give up immediately if they threw a hamburger at him. Tang San scolded Oscar...and said half a hamburger would be enough instead. Dai Mubai told both of them not to actually throw the burger, as they were all brothers. The Sea Star Douluo wondered if he'd chosen the wrong disciple. (Manhua only)

The Ability of his 3rd Soul Ring is Devouring.

The effect of the Ability of his 9th Soul Ring is also devouring.

She can freely switch her tail with a pair of legs and vice-versa.

The Sea Woman Douluo appears to be a young girl with pink pigtails. She wears a ruffled white top with long, billowy sleeves, underneath a short black dress with suspender straps over her shoulders. She wears long thigh high leggings, cute shoes, and silver hair clips above each pigtail. Her large eyes are light blue.
characters.personality: The Sea Woman Douluo is a bubbly girl with a wicked smile. She likes cute things, and by her own admission has a bad temper. She enjoys toying with others, and playing with mind control.
characters.history:
She noticed the Red Level Seven Trials descending on Ning Rongrong, the Red Level One Trial descending on Xiao Wu, and Tang San receiving the Sea God Nine Trials.

The Guardians of the Sea God Holy Pillars were instructed by Bo Saixi not to go easy on the Shrek Seven Monsters during their 5th Trial.

She was the target of Zhu Zhuqing's task for the 5th Trial. The Sea Woman Holy Pillar responded to the Seahorse Holy Pillar signaling the start of Tang San's timer for the 5th Trial.

The Shrek Seven Monsters reached the vicinity of the Sea Woman Holy Pillar 16 hours after the challenges began. She engaged them in small talk to lower their guard and chided Tang San when he warned Ning Rongrong and Zhu Zhuqing. She repeatedly parried or blocked Zhu Zhuqing's attacks while temporarily severing Ning Rongrong's amplifications.

She tried to attack Ning Rongrong but was countered and burned by the Phoenix Flames used by the latter at point-blank range. Zhu Zhuqing then defeated her with a series of attacks. She explained Zhu Zhuqing's rewards, noting that she herself had not obtained another God-given Soul Ring after completing her Black Level Trials. Angry at Tang San for disrupting her plans, she used her Sea Calming Divine Song under her Martial Soul Avatar's amplification to launch a spiritual attack. She exhausted her Soul Power and Spiritual Power, when Tang San completely endured the effects of her ability, resulting in her defeat. She was shocked when Tang San's Blue Silver Emperor's 5th Soul Ring reached 100,000+ years. She promised to look after Zhu Zhuqing during her 8th Soul Ring assimilation as the rest of the group left for the Sea Dragon Holy Pillar.

The guardians waited outside the Sea God Temple during the 6th Trial and discussed the possibility of Tang San completing the Sea God Nine Trials. They were shocked when he fired the Blue Silver Emperor Tyrant Spear at the temple and were forced to intervene when he controlled the plants on Sea God Mountain to attack it from all directions.

They were informed that their intervention had changed the Trial’s objective, which the participants completed easily. They asked Bo Saixi to punish them for interfering with the Trial, but she remarked that Tang San was too clever. They listened to Bo Saixi and Tang San’s conversation and were shocked by Tang San’s analysis.

The guardians waited outside the Sea God Temple on the day of the 7th Trial.

They witnessed a transparent projection of Tang San in golden armor appear above the Sea God Temple upon completion of the 7th Trial. The Guardians prayed to the Sea God in response to the phenomenon.

The Guardians knelt before the Sea God Trident when Tang San exited the Sea God Temple. They saw Tang San’s group off as they departed from Sea God Mountain.

The Sea Woman Douluo was first seen reacting to the light from Ning Rongrong's Seventh Level Red Trial. She later appeared along with the other pillars to meet the new trial takers. After seeing their first day of trial, she selects Xiao Bai as her chosen disciple. She takes him away, saying she'll play with him for a few years. Xiao Bai is seen screeching 'Save me!' as she drags him away. (Manhua only)

She continues to watch over and support the trial takers throughout their challenges.
characters.trivia:
She only received the mandatory God-given Soul Ring the first time her Soul Power reached a bottleneck during her Black Level Trials. She did not receive a God-given Soul Ring after completing her Black Level Trials as her Soul Power was not at any bottleneck, instead her Martial Soul Avatar was strengthened by the reward.

Her Martial Soul in the Donghua was Mermaid instead of the Black Flute, which is changed into a Spirit Tool to amplify her abilities.

characters.introText: Shan Liang was one of the three human god kings that resided in the divine dragon domain along with the Xie E and the asura god. Five other races and ten dragons are also god kings with the dragon god as the only supreme god king.
characters.history:
Shan Liang was one of the three human god kings that resided in the divine dragon domain along with the Xie E and the asura god. Five other races and ten dragons are also god kings with the dragon god as the only supreme god king.

When the dragon god was at the final step in transforming the divine realm into a divine planet, during the process, his son scarified himself to help his father stabilize himself. When the dragon god noticed that his son died, he halted the ceremony and reversed time to investigate what happened. Finding the killers, the dragon god went mad and caused an eruption of immortal spirit energy from ceremony, badly damaging the divine realm and receiving backlash from the ceremony himself. The god kings fought the mad dragon god, losing nine of the god kings, but they managed to heavily injure the dragon god, causing him to be unable to move. Knowing they need to kill the dragon god to save the divine realm, of the remaining three dragon god kings, the light dragon king killed the water dragon king before committing suicide with the dark dragon king because they can't bring themselves to kill the dragon god. Regaining a trace of clarity and seeing the death of the last three dragon kings caused him to cry out in anguish and enter a stupor.

Just when the asura god was about to end it, the dragon slaying saber intervened and misunderstood the situation, which triggered the divine war between the divine beasts and other gods. In the aftermath, the human god kings were the only god kings left. The divine realm arrived at the brink of collapse due to the war. The dragon god woke up at the end and managed to repair the broken divine realm, reducing its size. He also absorbed all the negative intent and emotions within his raising dragon pillar and sealed it inside himself before asking the asura god to cut out his positive thoughts and negative thoughts. He also placed a seal on soul beasts from becoming gods. Afterwards, the dragon god left the divine realm for the dragon realm with the corpses of all the dead dragons.

Following the last instructions of the dragon god, the negative thoughts were sealed within the divine realm to be wearied down over time, while the positive thoughts was allowed to leave the divine realm. The three god kings now took charge of the new divine realm forming a divine council.

Shan Liang and Xie E reincarnated themselves after passing down their god positions. They are currently experiencing many different worlds, reincarnating over and over again, and whenever they reached the peak of their cultivation and regained some of their past memories as god kings, they refuse to come back to the divine realm.

infobox.Title: Sheng Ming
infobox.name: Sheng Ming
infobox.Aliases: Life Aunt Green (绿阿姨) Xiǎo Lǜ / Little Green (小绿)
infobox.physique: Ancient Tree of Life (True Body; SL2.5)

characters.introText: Sheng Ming, better known as the Goddess of Life, was one of the five God Kings of the Douluo Divine Realm and one of its three God Enforcers alongside the Asura God and Hui Mie, the God of Destruction. She was Hui Mie's wife, controlled the evolution of Life within the Divine Realm, and possessed the Ancient Tree of Life as her true body. Her overall cultivation was stated to be no weaker than Hui Mie's, while her significance to the Divine Realm was considered even greater.
characters.appearance: Sheng Ming appeared as an exceptionally beautiful woman with a gentle and elegant bearing. She normally wore a long water-green dress and radiated an extraordinarily dense aura of vitality, giving her an approachable and peaceful presence that contrasted strongly with the oppressive Destruction Intent naturally emitted by Hui Mie. Her residence, the Forest of Life, similarly reflected her authority over Life, as its concentration of life energy continuously increased toward its center, where the Ancient Tree of Life stood. In visual adaptations, Sheng Ming is depicted with long brown hair, brilliant green eyes, and a green flower decorating the side of her hair.
characters.personality:
Sheng Ming was gentle, benevolent, compassionate, and naturally peaceful. Despite being one of the most powerful and senior gods of the Divine Realm, she was approachable toward others and rarely displayed arrogance. Her temperament contrasted strongly with Hui Mie's more forceful and severe personality, mirroring the difference between their respective authorities over Life and Destruction. During Hui Mie's conflict with Tang San, Sheng Ming initially isolated herself within the Forest of Life and deliberately cut herself off from outside information. As a God Enforcer, she could not approve of Hui Mie's actions against Tang San, yet as Hui Mie's wife she was equally unwilling to oppose him, leaving her caught between her responsibilities and her personal loyalty.

After Tang Wutong and the God of Emotions came to seek her assistance and explained the full extent of Hui Mie's actions, Sheng Ming decided that she could no longer remain uninvolved and agreed to help rescue Tang San. Even after taking a position against Hui Mie's actions, she remained unwilling to truly fight her husband and ultimately attempted to stop him by placing her own life at stake, declaring that she would destroy her own godhead if he continued his course of action. Sheng Ming was also exceptionally close to Tang Wutong, whom she had known since childhood. Tang Wutong frequently visited the Forest of Life and affectionately called her Aunt Green, while referring to Hui Mie as Uncle Purple.
characters.history:
A major conflict developed between Tang San and Hui Mie over the future expansion of the Douluo Divine Realm. Hui Mie believed that the Divine Realm had accumulated enough power to expand and accommodate additional gods, while Tang San opposed immediate expansion because he had foreseen a potentially catastrophic crisis approaching the realm. Hui Mie eventually seized control of the Divine Realm Center, confined Tang San and several of his supporters, and began implementing his expansion plan. Sheng Ming, caught between her responsibilities as a God Enforcer and her loyalty toward Hui Mie, withdrew into the Forest of Life and deliberately remained outside the conflict.

Tang Wutong and the God of Emotions later traveled to the Forest of Life to seek Sheng Ming's assistance. Because Tang Wutong had maintained an exceptionally close relationship with her since childhood, Sheng Ming listened to their explanation of the situation. After learning the full extent of Hui Mie's actions and considering Tang San's judgment, she concluded that Hui Mie had made a serious mistake and agreed to accompany them in the effort to rescue Tang San.

After making her decision, Sheng Ming performed the Life Prayer Ceremony through the Ancient Tree of Life, using it to inquire about future fortune and calamity. The Ancient Tree became completely blood-red, an omen far more severe than the one associated with the Dragon God rebellion. It was later revealed that Sheng Ming had been divining the future of herself and Hui Mie because she did not know what consequences her decision to oppose his actions would have for the two of them. The blood-red result foreshadowed the calamity that would eventually befall them.

Sheng Ming then accompanied Tang Wutong and the God of Emotions toward the God Forbidden Land, where they encountered Rong Nianbing and the seven Elemental Gods, who were already participating in the effort to rescue Tang San. Sheng Ming's intervention fundamentally altered the balance of the conflict, as her overall cultivation was explicitly stated to be no weaker than Hui Mie's and her significance to the Divine Realm was considered even greater because of the immense life energy under her control. When she confronted Hui Mie, she released the Life Seed, whose pure Life power suppressed his Destruction Intent while she simultaneously protected the imprisoned gods with her own life energy.

Despite opposing Hui Mie's actions, Sheng Ming remained unwilling to truly fight him. She eventually told him directly that she would not attack him, but if he left her side to continue his plan, she would destroy her own godhead and completely perish as compensation to Tang San's family. Unable to accept the possibility of Sheng Ming's death, Hui Mie remained with her.

Following Tang San's escape and the subsequent developments in the Divine Realm, Sheng Ming was present after the birth of Tang Wulin. She kissed the newborn Tang Wulin on the forehead and bestowed upon him the Blessing of the Goddess of Life. The blessing consumed approximately one-tenth of her divine power at a fundamental level and required at least several decades of cultivation to fully recover. Even Tang Wutong had never previously received the same blessing. Tang Wulin consequently gained extraordinarily strong vitality and self-healing ability compared with an ordinary human. Sheng Ming bestowed the blessing as compensation to Tang San and Xiao Wu's child because of the guilt she felt over the conflict.

The forced expansion of the Divine Realm eventually left it dangerously vulnerable when the space-time turbulence predicted by Tang San arrived. Recognizing the consequences of his decisions, Hui Mie chose to take responsibility for them. He returned to his primordial Destruction Condensate, while Sheng Ming returned to the Ancient Tree of Life, their respective true bodies. Rather than allowing Hui Mie to bear the consequences alone, Sheng Ming chose to remain beside him and declared that his mistake was something they would make up for together.

Their powers of Life and Destruction spread throughout the Divine Realm and began to intertwine. Although normally opposing forces, Life and Destruction became mutually complementary when brought into complete harmony and generated a pale-pink energy identified by Tang San as the primordial power of Creation. Creation was one of the greatest powers associated with the original Creator God and had participated in the formation of the Divine Realm itself. Sheng Ming and Hui Mie used this power to reverse much of the previous expansion and compress the Divine Realm toward its former state, strengthening it so that it could better withstand the approaching space-time turbulence.

Producing Creation at this level required both gods to return completely to their origins. Sheng Ming and Hui Mie's divine forms disappeared, leaving behind only the Life Seed and Destruction Seed, which fell into Tang San's possession. Their consciousness nevertheless continued to exist within the seeds, and Hui Mie stated that they would return after approximately ten thousand years.

Much later, during the crisis surrounding Lan Xuanyu's inheritance of the Dragon God's power, Tang San revealed the Life and Destruction God King Seeds that had remained in his possession. Sheng Ming's Life God position was inherited by Gu Yuena, while Hui Mie's Destruction God position was inherited by Tang Wulin.
characters.trivia:
The SL2.5 and SL4 accounts give different explanations for the origins of the original God Kings. SL2.5 describes them as beings formed from pure primordial energy, while SL4 states that the divine positions of Goodness, Evil, Life, and Destruction were subsequently inherited by humans.

The Blessing of the Goddess of Life bestowed upon Tang Wulin consumed approximately one-tenth of Sheng Ming's fundamental divine power and required at least several decades to fully recover; even Tang Wutong had never received the same blessing.

Sheng Ming and Hui Mie's consciousness continued to exist within the Life and Destruction Seeds after their sacrifice, and Hui Mie stated that they would return after approximately ten thousand years.

characters.history:
He took back the members of the Blue Sunshine Academy's Team away from the Shrek Academy's group following their taunts.

He witnessed the Shrek Academy's Team winning against the Elephant Armored Academy's Team, which had defeated the Blue Sunshine Academy's Team in the first round. He commented that he would take care of the Shrek Academy. His group encountered the Shrek Academy's group during the seventh round, where he tried to provoke them to take actions.

He lured Tang San out of the Heaven Dou City to a forest after the latter left the Great Spirit Arena alone for the Shrek Academy. He trapped Tang San in a nightmare to torture him to death, after stating that if killing him was not enough, he would target the rest of the Shrek Seven Monsters next. He lamented that fact that he was not a Soul Douluo yet otherwise he would be able to see the nightmares for himself and enjoy them. He was struck by the Yama's Invitation after Tang San broke out of the illusion, causing him to die. His corpse was turned to dust by the poison and dropped a Soul Bone.

characters.personality:
She warned the rest of her team to go all out against the Shrek Academy's Team in the final match of the Preliminaries. She was angered to see the Shrek Academy's Team fielding their regular lineup, but maintained decorum and introduced herself. The team was expert at hiding the full manifestation of their Martial Souls. She restrained Tang San, Dai Mubai, Tai Long and Huang Yuan using Ice Bind. She provided ice armors to Yu Hairou, Shui Yue'er, Gu Qingbo, Qiu Ruoshui and Shen Liuyu. She prevented Xue Wu from being immobilized, and they initiated Drifting Snow. She warned the Shrek Academy's Team to concede if they can't handle it.

She was forced to pour all the power of the Drifting Snow into her Ice Phoenix for a final attack, after realizing that Tang San's defenses would outlast her and Xue Wu's consumption. She was shocked that Tang San managed to overcome her final attack and asked him the reason. She was shocked to hear that Tang San was immune to ice, before asking why he was restrained by her earlier. She agreed when Tang San proposed to the referee to consider the match as a tie.

She was defeated by Ma Hongjun in the match against the Shrek Academy's Team before the 12th round.

The convoy from the Heaven Dou Empire was ambushed along the way to the Martial Soul City 10 days into the journey. She led her team to block the enemies.

The convoy reached the Martial Soul City five days before the start of the Finals.

Appearance[]
Human Form[]
During her disguise as a man, he looks like a man covered in crystal armor. His age cannot be seen, as if he was twenty or thirty years old. A pair of eyes are strangely light blue, and crystal armor is on the body, emitting a faint chill.
characters.appearance:
During her disguise as a man, he looks like a man covered in crystal armor. His age cannot be seen, as if he was twenty or thirty years old. A pair of eyes are strangely light blue, and crystal armor is on the body, emitting a faint chill.

During Tang San's Thunder Tribulation, she was a woman entirely shrouded in crystalline armor, her age indiscernible and her features somewhat blurred, yet her aura was profound and abyssal—like the vast cosmos, defying any grasp of its boundaries.

Her real form is a woman in a long white dress, very much like a human and very beautiful.
characters.history:
When she was born, she underwent the dragon clan's unusual experiment that injected several dragon bloodlines into her body, resulting in the most successful mutation in the history of the Puppet Dragon.

She appeared as a man when Tang San climbed the Crystal Holy Mountain. She was very interested in Tang San for his multiple bloodlines and gave him two choices. The first choice was to let Tang San go and fail the test but his companion, Gu Li will die and the second choice was that his companion will live whiles Tang San will succesfully pass the test if he's able to hold on to her next attack for a minute. Tang San chose to withstand her Tier 9 attacks for one minute and successfully passed her test. She gave him two tokens and Crystal Egg was among them. She told Tang San to take care of the Crystal Egg with his life and to come back when breaking through to God Rank. She also warned Tang San that if he were to fail his task, he would die.

It was revealed later before Tang San revisited the Hell Garden that Jingjing was the true reincarnation of the Crystal Dragon Great Demon Emperor, while the one residing in the palace was just another replica, who planned to cultivate to god tier through Tang San's tribulation and separate from him after he withstands the brunt of it, but reconsidered after witnessing just a glimpse of it, crushing her dreams of succeeding in her plans. She collaborates with Tang San afterwords so both reap the most benefits from his next tribulation.
characters.trivia:
It should be noted that although she cannot replicate luck, she can isolate luck. When she went to replicate the power of the bloodline of Heavenly Fox Great Monster Emperor, it was impossible to replicate it, but she invalidated the ability of the Heavenly Fox Great Monster Emperor on herself, therefore she cannot control luck but she can avoid luck.

Among all the emperors, she was the only one who had the strength to kill the Heavenly Fox Great Monster Emperor.

She can replicate at least 3 bloodlines at the same time.

She can control space and time which is related to the true meaning of the universe to a certain extent, which is only a simple replication but she cannot comprehend the true meaning of it.

In the history of the Fairy Continent, there were only three emperors who could reach her level. Even so, she was considered the strongest emperor in history.

characters.introText: Si Long is a humble and good natured person who is very passionate about his work and cares for those who are close to him and respectful to others.
characters.personality: Si Long is a humble and good natured person who is very passionate about his work and cares for those who are close to him and respectful to others.
characters.history:
He and Si Yu were guarding the 4th floor when they met Tai Tan's group. He was shocked by Tai Tan's form of address for Tang San before escorting Tai Tan, Tang San, Xiao Wu, Oscar, Ma Hongjun, and Ning Rongrong to Lou Gao's personal smithy. He remained outside after the group entered. He was stunned when Lou Gao appointed him President of the Blacksmith Association before joining the Tang Sect.

Lou Gao told him to arrange preferential treatment for Tai Tan's group. Tai Tan gave him a procurement list, shocking him with the quantity of each item. He led the group to a restaurant for lunch, where they encountered the Martial Soul Hall's group led by Meyers. Meyers mocked and threatened him with having Lou Gao lead the Blacksmith Association to join the Martial Soul Hall before pushing him back. He recognized the Rank 1 Martial Soul Hall Token taken out by Tang San and asked if they belonged to the Martial Soul Hall. Tai Tan assured him that they had a hostile relationship with the Martial Soul Hall. He learned Ning Rongrong's identity and wondered about Tang San's real identity. Noticing Tang San's killing intent, he revealed the location of the Martial Soul Main Hall and the average strength of its Soul Masters.

He reported to Tai Tan and Tang San that most of the items on the list had been arranged and that the rest would take another day at most. He asked Tai Tan about the blueprints that had made Lou Gao forget food and sleep. He informed Tai Tan that Lou Gao's disciples had mutually decided for Si Yu and Si Kai to accompany Lou Gao to the Tang Sect, while he and Si Di would remain in the Gengxin City. He, Tai Tan, and Tang San inspected the ores bought by Ning Rongrong before the auction. He was shocked that Ning Rongrong had bought the ores at such low prices despite their quality and quantity warranting a much higher price. He realized that Tang San was a descendant of the Clear Sky Clan after seeing him activate the Clear Sky Hammer to test the Deep Sea Sunken Silver. He tested the Deep Sea Sunken Silver himself, having never encountered it before. He suppressed his greed after seeing the precious ores. He led the group to the auction in the evening.

He was officially made President of the Blacksmith Association by Lou Gao after the auction. He was left with the materials plundered from the Martial Soul Main Hall by the group before they departed.
