characters.introText:
Quick Answers
		
		
	
	
			
				
					How did the Silver Dragon King come into existence?
						
				
				
					
						The Silver Dragon King was created when the Dragon God was split in half by the Asura God after being defeated in the God Realm. This division resulted in the formation of the Golden Dragon King and the Silver Dragon King, with the latter inheriting control over elements like fire, water, earth, wind, light, darkness, space, creation, and destruction.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What powers does the Silver Dragon King inherit from the Dragon God?
						
				
				
					
						The Silver Dragon King inherits elemental control over fire, water, earth, wind, light, darkness, space, creation, and destruction from the Dragon God. It also wields the Silver Dragon Spear. As one half of the Dragon God, the Silver Dragon King embodies these powers following the Dragon God's division.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					Why was the Dragon God split into two entities?
						
				
				
					
						The Dragon God was divided into two entities by the Asura God during a conflict over creating a realm for spirit beasts. The split resulted in the Silver Dragon King, inheriting spiritual strength and elemental control, and the Golden Dragon King, inheriting physical power.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What is the significance of the Silver Dragon Spear?
						
				
				
					
						The Silver Dragon Spear, a divine weapon of the Silver Dragon King, ranks sixth in the Douluo Federation. It amplifies elements and has devouring traits like the Golden Dragon Spear. The spear is crucial to the dragon clan, surpassing some higher-ranked weapons in importance. Na'er temporarily wielded it after Gu Yuena's split, but it returned to Gu Yuena upon their reunion.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What elements can the Silver Dragon King control?
						
				
				
					
						The Silver Dragon King controls nine elements: fire, water, earth, wind, light, darkness, space, creation, and destruction. These powers originate from the Dragon God, from whom the Silver Dragon King is derived.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom

Description[]
The Silver Dragon King is the second half of the Dragon God that inherits the elemental control of the Dragon God including fire, water, earth, wind, light, darkness, space, creation and destruction, and the kindness in the Dragon God's heart. It possesses the Silver Dragon Spear.
characters.appearance:
The Silver Dragon King is the second half of the Dragon God that inherits the elemental control of the Dragon God including fire, water, earth, wind, light, darkness, space, creation and destruction, and the kindness in the Dragon God's heart. It possesses the Silver Dragon Spear.

When the Dragon God was defeated in the God realm due to causing too much chaos and conflict, the Dragon God split itself into the Golden Dragon King and Silver Dragon King after the Asura God cut him in half. The Silver Dragon King managed to escape the Divine Realm and remained in hibernation on Douluo Planet. She awakened when the Golden Dragon King was killed.
characters.history:
The author said on social platform that she didn't reincarnate as human just like Xiao Wu (spoiler from dd4).

Gu Yue had all the power of the Elements while Na'er had the power of the Silver Dragon Spear. Later in the Soul land 3, they combined to the Silver Dragon King's true human form, Gu Yuena, who is basically the appearance of Gu Yue and Na'er combined. Gu Yue's hair colour was black, while Na er's hair colour was white. When they combined, Gu Yuena's hair colour was silver.

The Silver Dragon King originally planned to kill Tang Wulin from the start to regain the power of the Golden Dragon King, but in a plot twist, she fell in love with him instead. At the end of the light novel, she chooses to die with him through his Golden Dragon Spear.

When she was revived in Soul Land 4, she was renamed as 'Nana' and became a Teacher. Whenever she meets her son Lan Xuanyu, she feels a maternal instinct but having all her memories lost, she still doesn't realize that he is her son.

↑ https://www.tangsanbooks.com/book/33831.html

characters.title: Silver Moon Wolf King
characters.introText: The Silver Moon Wolf King was a spirit beast with with extremely great amount of spiritual power and possessed power of seven elements: water, fire, earth, wind, light, darkness and lightning. Not only its fighting strength was immense, but also its defense was very strong. More frighteningly, it could enslave other wolf-type soul beasts.
characters.appearance: This Silver Wolf was three meters long, and wasn’t as developed as the golden wolves. However, it was more slender and still well-built, and a crescent shaped patch of silverish-white fur lay on its forehead.

characters.title: Silverbrave Beast
characters.introText: The Silverbrave Beast resembled a dog, but its limbs were extremely thick, and its shape was a little weird. There wasn’t any hair on its body, and it was covered with scales. While it was small, it looked very fierce. Its face was long and ugly, while its fangs poked out past its lips.

characters.history:
Silverbrave Beasts are very rare. They are classified as third-grade soul beast, but because they possess an extremely strong innate soul skill they are bumped up to second-grade.​

They are presumed to be extinct because they have poor reproductive capabilities, but according to Wang Qiu'er there should be more than one living in the Core Region of the Great Star Dou Forest.

characters.introText: Sima Jinchi was a brawny coarse face man with a tall and muscular figure comparable to Long Yue. His cool-looking figure was exceedingly huge and tall with more than 210 centimeters in height. He also had a facial hair-beard. His shoulders were extremely broad, and he resembled a mountain as he stood there. He had two bars and four stars on each of his epaulets, indicating that he was a senior colonel. His entire body was unleashing a wild and unruly aura while the long saber in his hand was his martial soul.
characters.appearance:
Sima Jinchi was a brawny coarse face man with a tall and muscular figure comparable to Long Yue. His cool-looking figure was exceedingly huge and tall with more than 210 centimeters in height. He also had a facial hair-beard. His shoulders were extremely broad, and he resembled a mountain as he stood there. He had two bars and four stars on each of his epaulets, indicating that he was a senior colonel. His entire body was unleashing a wild and unruly aura while the long saber in his hand was his martial soul.

In terms of age, Sima Jinchi was older than Tang Wulin and Ah Ruheng. He also looked old and had appeared to be in his forties.

He seemed to be a dozen years younger compared to the old Sima Jinchi. His outer appearance suggested that he was in his thirties. His copper-tan skin flickered with a faint golden light. His long golden mane fell loosely by the sides of his head. His looked resembled that of an impetuous child who had just arrived at school. His pupils were vertical and nobody had noticed when this change had occurred. The muscles on his body screamed strength and beauty. His aura was now contained and not sharp like a saber as it was before. Especially there seemed to be some remnants of the Dragon God’s aura on him.

Sima Jinchi shaved his facial hair and trimmed his brows to appear as a gentle, burly pretty boy.
characters.personality:
Sima Jinchi is tempermental, simple-minded, and talks unruly to those he does not respect or get along with, such as his sparring partner Body Douluo Ah Ruheng. He is rough as a man from the view of others.

Sima Jinchi is a highly competitive, wild and intractable man.

Sima Jinchi habitually carries his enormous Dragon Slaying Saber on his shoulder when non-offensive.

With Sima Jinchi’s abilities before being a Titled Douluo, he was supposed to be a general long ago. However, this person was not made out to be an officer. He had undergone the most transfers in the Southern Army Corps. From his initial post as the commander of the Imperial Guard to the posts of instructing officer, division commander, and others, he seemed to shirk every given responsibility. The reasons were simple. This person was a martial fanatic who knew not how to restrain himself. It was common for him to injure someone in the Corps. Sima Jinchi was also a cultivation madman at Rank 89.

Although Sima Jinchi was wild and intractable, his strength in combat was extremely powerful. In the Southern Army, he was always a beacon of morale.

He is very dutiful to his Dragon Slaying Saber. If anything were to happen to Tang Wulin, he would certainly end up in grave trouble as the Law Saber of the Dragon Clan. Even though he had not figured out the ending, but he would feel intense fear in his heart every time the idea appeared in his mind.

Because of his origins after becoming a Titled Douluo, Sima Jinchi became depressed from knowing he was never human, until Tang Wulin's sincere counsel made him see pass outer appearances. However, as the Dragon Slayer Saber, Sima Jinchi is highly respectful and subservient towards the Dragon God and those who wear his Aura or closest kin, refering them as 'Your Majesty' or 'Young Master'. He treats Wulin as a family member too.
characters.history:
Saber Demon Sima Jinchi was the divisional commander of the Southern Army Corps’ Gale Division. He had the nickname ‘Gale Saber Demon’ in the Southern Army Corps. He was without peer in the entire army corps when it came to winning in the trials of strength. He triumphed over everyone except for a few regimental commanders and powerhouses in the army. None of the Spirit Douluo 3-word battle armor masters in the army were his worthy opponents.

This guy was crazy about sabers. He was currently 42 years old and his favorite pastime was to challenge others. Back in the beginning, he was recruited into the army by the Southern Army Corps’ regimental commander, Yue Zheng'en. He spent most of his free time challenging the powerhouses in the army. Moreover, his fighting technique was wild and ruthless. He would frequently injure his sparring partners, so he was feared by the people in the army.

There was only one person bold enough to challenge the regimental commander in the entire Southern Army Corps. However, he suffered repeated defeats, hopelessly subdued in every battle. Sima Jinchi truly had heartfelt admiration for Yue Zhengyu’s grandfather. Otherwise, who else would allow a man with such a temperament to remain in the army?

In truth, Sima Jinchi had contributed many merits to the army corps. However, his faults were more than his contributions. Under heavy opposition, he did not become a general. He ended up being a senior colonel, but he did not wield any influence at all.

Sima Jinchi, currently 39 42 years old, was already a Rank 89 Spirit Douluo for almost ten years now. He already possessed the strength to become a Title Douluo when he was twenty-nine thirty-two. With his natural talents, there was no reason why he was not already a Title Douluo. After his soul power was raised to Rank 89, he made no further improvements. It was the reason Sima Jinchi cultivated and fought with a frenzy. He had hoped to find an opportunity to achieve a breakthrough in battle! .At present, Sima Jinchi was a rank 89 Soul Douluo, and he had been stuck at rank 89 for 10 years. He was currently 42 years of age, and even back at 32, he was ready to attempt a breakthrough to the Titled Douluo stage. With his brilliant aptitude, there was no way that he wouldn't have been able to become a Titled Douluo. However, he was unable to progress his soul past the 89th rank, and that was why he was constantly searching for fights and battles; he was hoping to find a catalyst for a breakthrough during battle!

Unfortunately, things did not proceed as he had wished. Throughout the past decade, he was unable to find a breakthrough no matter how hard he worked. It was only after his Sabersoul was awakened that he experienced intriguing events in his spiritual world. These events seemed to be guiding him onward.

Yue Zheng'en knew very well that Sima Jinchi’s Dragon Slaying Saber martial soul was definitely not inferior to the Holy Angel martial soul in terms of its quality. Moreover, under the diligent cultivation of this martial fanatic, he even awakened his Sabersoul. Once he attained the rank of a Title Douluo, his strength would definitely improve by leaps and bounds. 

The Gale Division was the trump card of the Southern Army Corps which was supposed to be a mecha division. It was quite odd since Sima Jinchi, as the divisional commander, was incapable of operating a mecha. He relied solely on his Dragon Slayer Saber and 2-word battle armor to rule over the entire division.

When Yue Zhengyu and Xu Xiaoyan first arrived at the Southern Army Corps, Sima Jinchi did not fancy Yue Zhengyu much. As the saying went ‘friends are often made after a fight’, Yue Zhengyu managed to last for ten minutes without being defeated during one of the battles he had with Sima Jinchi. Sima Jinchi treated Yue Zhengyu with increasing respect ever since and even exclaimed how Yue Zhengyu was a chip off his grandfather. Sima Jinchi's cultivation base was still at Spirit Douluo rank but his fighting capacity exceeded the majority of the Title Douluo-ranked powerhouses in reality.

Sima Jinchi had an awe-inspiring reputation. This person was once considered the number one valiant soldier of the Southern Army Corps. Regardless of the type of battlefield, Sima Jinchi only braced himself with his saber for he despised modern technology. Even so, very few people were capable of defeating him.

Even the generals would take a detour when they saw this person. He had no friends nor family, only his Dragon Slaying Saber. He spent every day doing nothing but cultivating. He had the military rank of a senior colonel pinned on his shoulders. Yet, in reality, he did not even have a single subordinate. Thus, his military ranks were purely for display. However, he would be the Southern Army Corps’ trump card whenever the grand army warrior competition was held. With the Gale Saber Demon, the army was always triumphant. Below the rank of a Title Douluo, he was a man without peer!

Sima Jinchi had only achieved his Sabersoul, bound to his Dragon Slayer Avatar Ring, at the seven-ring cultivation base. His cultivation base advanced by leaps and bounds after his successful attempt at forging the Sabersoul which finally resulted in him becoming the Southern Army Corps’ most powerful person under the rank of Hyper Douluo.

He once easily defeated a mecha battalion using his own power alone without donning his battle armor. A mecha battalion’s organizational system was comprised of 100 reinforced mechas with the battalion commander being a Black-rank mecha. Sima Jinchi was but a seven-ringed Spirit Sage at the time.

As contestant Number Nine, age 42 years old Sima Jinchi participated in the Federal Star Dou Battle Network Challenge under Yue Zheng'en's inticement. Yue Zhengyu’s grandfather had promised him that if he could become the champion of this year’s competition, he would then forge Sima Jinchi a three-word battle armor with the reward won from the competition.

During the the Federal Star Dou Battle Network Challenge Spirit Masters Battle Finals 1st Round, Sima Jinchi fought against Spirit Emperor Ye Xinglan and overwhelmingly won with several sword sratches on his Saber, entering the final eight contestants. He became respectful of her high talent to comphrehend a Swordsoul at her stage. In the Final 1st Round Semi-finals, he fought against Tang Wulin.

In Sima Jinchi’s view, Tang Wulin was just like a giant dragon that lay dormant, but could possibly burst out at any time. On the other hand, Sima Jinchi was an executioner whose savage energy was plain to see in Tang Wulin’s eyes. This was still the first time he had ever met a soul master whose martial soul was not affected by his Golden Dragon King bloodline.

Sima Jinchi especially had a very clear feeling after the Dragon Slaying Saber and the Golden Dragon Spear made contact. The force of the impact aside, his soul power began to surge violently and elevated by a huge amount due to stimulation of the Golden Dragon Spear. His spirit sea also moved further from half-step Spirit Domain realm. The Dragon Slaying Saber produced a feeling of One with the Saber that he had never felt before. He seemed to have already turned into the saber as jubilant emotions spread in his heart.

His final clash with Wulin lead him to be exhilarated and with enough energy to beat the exhausted Wulin, but Sima Jinchi rushed to logout to meet Wulin, resulting in Wulin's depressing win.

Obtaining information of Wulin's Blood God Army whereabouts from Yue Zheng'en, Sima Jinchi immediately bared him farewell with a military salute and set off from the Southern Army to meet his destined one.

Upon arriving at the Blood God Army with Ah Ruheng in their 2-word battle armors, both witnessed the Dragon God Transformation - Dragon God Possession used by Wulin and Gu Yuena. Afterwards, both hotblooded men were easily captured by Zhang Huanyun as "spies" and lead into a Zhang Huanyun-Cao Dezhi made farce, where Sima Jinchi and Ah Ruheng "owe my savior" Tang Wulin. This resulted with both peak Spirit Douluos commanded to become Wulin's guards for three years and have a remote-controlled explosive collar attached as a guarantee.

From the Blood God Army camp, he, Wulin and Ah Ruheng with 20+ other Blood God Army members formed the Blood Dragon Unit. Upon leaving the camp, Sima Jinchi, Wulin and Ah Ruheng flew in their 2-word battle armors alongside the Blood Dragon Unit members. Along the way, they encountered the Duskgold Dreadclaw Bear Lord who sought Wulin's death and no witnesses. During the fight, Sima Jinchi subconsciously turned into his divine tool form to assist the Golden Dragon King Avatar Tang Wulin against the Bear Lord. After the Bear Lord's escape, Sima Jinchi witnessed the Blood Dragon Unit's 20 Black mechas. Their mecha’s state-of-the-art technologies aside even their weapons made Sima Jinchi, who never used a mecha before, long for them.

For several months at the Blacksmith's Association of Heaven Dou City for closed-door cultivation, Wulin had Soul-fuse forging metals for Sima Jinchi (Mecha Manufacturer) and Ah Ruheng (Mecha Mechanic) to make 3-word battle armors. Sima Jinchi's 3-word battle armor using five types of fuse-forged (Harmonizing Refinement) rare metals as the limit. Jinchi also spars with the Tang Wulin and Ah Ruheng every night in the Blacksmith Association's gymnasium, while other member of the Blood Dragon Unit scout out Shrek Academy. Through sparring, Wulin's extraordinary progress depresses Sima Jinchi and Ah Ruheng,

During the journey of cultivation, Sima Jinchi was unable breakthrough to Titled Douluo because the ninth soul ring can only be activated by the Dragon God Aura. Due to the Aura within Tang Wulin, every time Sima Jinchi sparred with him, Sima's spiritual power and saber quality increased. Thus he was able to gain the ninth Spirit Ring, break the seal on his Saber and reawaken his slumbering memories. From that moment, Sima Jinchi refers to Tang Wulin as 'Young Master' or 'Your Majesty'. He also physically changed, becoming a decade younger and handsome.

From the ninth ring breakthrough, Sima Jinchi also learned there is a Saber God among Sabersouls, along the path of the saber (saber's consciousness, sabersoul, saber god/spirit). The Saber God is a power which is at the doorstep of godliness. Once he successfully cultivate the Saber God, he will have the power to become a god.

Later, Sima Jinchi, Tang Wulin and Ah Ruheng visited Tang Sect's secret underground city wide headquarters in Heaven Dou City. There, they continued to train while the uninformed Blood Dragon Unit stayed on the surface. By now, Sima Jinchi even grasped at the Saber God’s powers.

Without their new 3-word battle armors, Sima Jinchi and Ah Ruheng, alongside Tang Wulin, twice mock fight against Wulin's 6 fellow Shrek Monsters, the second fight ending with Sima Jinchi and Tang Wulin exhibiting their fusion skill. The six Shrek Monsters' battle armors had managed to reduce the disparity between themselves and the high-ranking soul masters. Ah Ruheng and Sima Jinchi could not imagine the extent of the outbursts of these seven people when they achieved the rank of a Title Douluo.

Alongside the Shrek Monsters learning of mechas and Ah Ruheng's introduction to piloting, Sima Jinchi learns to pilot mechas with clumsy difficulty. He receives a meticulously made unit of an advanced Tang Sect-produced black mecha of the highest grade.

Three months later, Sima Jinchi accompanies Wulin and group on the trip to the Star Luo and Dou Spirit Empires for 6 months. Sima Jinchi, alongside the group members, disguise as Skysea Academy students. There, Wulin encountered Holy Spirit Cult's Darkness Bell Na Nali and used Sima Jinchi's true saber form to thwart her.

Sima Jinchi spent 2 months in a submarine with the group to Dou Spirit Empire.

Sima Jinchi followed Wulin, Ah Ruheng and the Shrek Monsters to infiltrate Spirit Pagoda's Dou Spirit Branch and witnessed Wulin's almost descent to Blood Dragon, Golden Dragon King's negative side, mania. He then spent about 20 days in a submarine with the group to Star Luo Empire.

During Tang Wulin's Battle of the Five Gods with Holy Dragon Douluo En Ci, Sima Jinchi indirectly appeared as his Saber form to assist Wulin. Later, he accompanied the rest of Tang Wulin's group to immediately leave the Star Luo Empire in the Tang Sect submarine the morning after Wulin gave his purity to a passing Gu Yuena, to flee from being involved in the Star Luo Empire's honeytrap politics.

With Tang Wulin becoming a Titled Douluo upon thwarting the Federal Sea Fleet with his Sea God's influence over the sea, Sima Jinchi can fully use his God bestowed ninth ring.

He returns to the Tang Sect Headquarters in Skysea City by submarine with Wulin and the Shrek Monsters, alongside his finally awaken 3-word battle armor. He later returned to Shrek City's location with the others, and a month later aid Shrek Academy's manual reconstruction.

During Shrek Academy's reconstruction, Sima Jinchi accompanies Wulin and the Shrek Monsters to obtain a Life Crystal in the Star Dou Forest, ambushed by the Great Beasts. He uses his Saber to scare away Zi Ji and temporarily restrains Di Tian. He then witnesses Wulin's usage of the Sea God Trident and his sudden fly away. Afterwards, he returns to Heaven Dou City with the other Shrek Monsters and stays for half a month, training, until Wulin's return from the Sea God's First Trial. Sima Jinchi also learns of the Joust For a Spouse Festival announced by the Spirit Pagoda.

Sima Jinchi acts as Wulin's 'Young Master's' bodyguard while simultaneously as his true self as a contestant in the Joust For a Spouse Festival. Sima Jinchi participates through a letter of recommendation from the Southern Army as a Titled Douluo under 50 years old. He passes the selection process, elimination round and then enters the eighth group of the final stage. There was utterly no worthy opponent from his group at all. He was a Titled Douluo who rose among the ranks with his unparalleled might. He made a clean sweep in his group. Near the end of the Festival of the last ten contestants, he the eighth finalist withdraws under the reason of being Tang Sect's Sect Master's chief bodyguard.

During the Festival's selection process's eighth round, Sima Jinchi participated in the Festival's trial of the Ten Thousand Beasts Platform in the Spirit Pagoda and was affected by its planar laws.

Sima Jinchi and Ah Ruheng had followed Tang Wulin and chose to remain at Shrek. Sima Jinchi would never leave Tang Wulin, while Ah Ruheng found that he had nowhere else to go. Tang Wulin requested that both of them become the academy’s teachers so they could replenish the teaching strength of Shrek. Being teachers was new for them. They had no idea how far they could go, but they were very interested in the offer. They agreed to stay at once.

Tang Wulin had already discussed with them prior to this that they would be participating in the first round of the two-on-two matches.

In Spirit Pagoda's database, Gale Saber Demon Sima Jinchi was a high-ranking officer in the Southern Army Corps in the past. His information was naturally protected by the military’s security. As a result, there was very little available on him. He stayed at Tang Wulin’s side like a weapon. He had never done anything shocking, so not much attention had been placed on him. Even when he appeared in the Joust For a Spouse Festival, he did it in make up (cosmetics).

Although Sima Jinchi and Ah Ruheng were always seen quarrelling with one another, they had actually been cultivating together for a very long time. They worked very well together in a battle, so their cooperation was quite good regardless of how they spoke of one another. They were capable of distracting the opponents and also synchronized perfectly at the most crucial moments. Moreover, both Titled Douluos possessed a Hyper Douluo’s abilities, and they were even slightly more powerful than the rest of the Shrek Seven Monsters judging by their current cultivation bases.

He and Ah Ruheng participate as a pair in the spirit masters battle recruitment competition between Spirit Pagoda and Shrek Academy. They fought a pair of twins (externally ugly and manly, internally charming female) one possessing a Light elemental Unicorn (vs Sima Jinchi) and the other possessing a Space elemental Unicorn (vs Ah Ruheng). With Sima Jinchi's and Ah Ruheng's abilities, both twins (thought as male) are physically restrained and almost defeated. Sima Jinchi's battle armor's domain applied an element imprisonment on the Light and Ah Ruheng's powerful body decimated Space. Both Sima Jinchi and Ah Ruheng immediately released and ran away from the twins upon hearing their true gender's charming female voices, resulting in a stomach churning and bewildering loss for the two men. Afterwards, Sima Jinchi and Ah Ruheng argue again as usual.

Alongside Ling Zichen, Ah Ruheng, Tang Wulin and the Shrek Monsters, Sima Jinchi challenged the War God Temple to enter its inner sanctum and earn the right to steal the sealed 2 God-rank ammunitions left, previously used to destroy Shrek Academy.

Sima Jinchi witnesses Ye Xinglan's cocooning to reach Sword God/Swordspirit realm. Sima Jinchi is annoyed by Ah Ruheng's bragging of his new wife, the Seventh War God Shi Mengshan, and being called his good brother 'Little Si'.

With Tang Wulin, Ling Zichen, Xu Xiaoyan and Yuanen Yehui, Sima Jinchi entered the War God Battlefield, a small world created by the War God Temple and funded by the Federation. The challenge's objective is to destroy the opposing team’s starting point and to protect their own starting point. Their five member group is opposed by the five War Gods (2-Emperor Sword Douluo Long Tianwu, 5-Demon Guqin Douluo Mo Zihong, 8-Haughty Dragon Douluo Nan Gongyi, 13-God Sword Douluo Su Mengjun) lead by War God Deputy Master Skycrosser Douluo Guan Yue.

During his pair combat with Tang Wulin against the simulated Darkness Demon Dragon, Sima Jinchi's rings are gradually evolving under Wulin's nourishment. All nine of Sima Jinchi rings were black. However, it was even more ghastly that his black soul rings were quite different from ordinary ten-thousand-year soul rings. There was an additional layer of faint golden striations on the surface of his rings.

Sima Jinchi’s body was the Dragon Clan’s Law Saber while Tang Wulin possessed the Dragon God’s bloodline. Even though the Golden Dragon King was only a portion of the Dragon God, it was also the purest form. As a result, Sima Jinchi was naturally nourished by Tang Wulin as the Dragon Clan’s Law Saber. Under such circumstances, his cultivation base was elevating continuously. At the same time, the quality of Dragon Clan’s Law Saber was also in a gradual recovery process. Moreover, the Law Saber was sharpened by the grindstone, the Golden Dragon Spear. This resulted in the continuous enhancement of these two great divine weapons.

With both Sima Jinchi and Tang Wulin together, the foolish Darkness Demon Dragon was easily slayed, resulting with the War God Battlefield's rule amplification effect elevate their 5-member team's abilities by 1 rank (Ex: Hyper Douluo to Limit Douluo, Titled Douluo to Hyper Douluo).

Next, Sima Jinchi and his party was notified of Ling Zichen's loss. Then Sima Jinchi equipped his 3-word battle armor and hastened across the War God Battlefield to assist Xu Xiaoyan Yuanen Yehui, becoming Xu Xiaoyan's offensive meat shield against the opposing War Gods. With Tang Wulin's and Guan Yue declaration of the War Battlefield challenge a draw, Sima Jinchi and his party reunited with their group and entered the sixteenth level of Hell.

The sixteenth level of Hell housed a deep and Titled Douluo beyond water (river) environment, with the goal to traverse it to reach the seventeenth floor of Hell of the War God Temple. Sima Jinchi and the group easily completed the task with Tang Wulin's Sea God's Child status and Sea God Trident. This was the first time Sima Jinchi and the group (excluding Xie Xie) saw Tang Wulin's Sea God authority, making them shocked by his easy control of the water.

The seventeenth level of Hell housed the Fire Host Clan from the Magic Blue World main plane. Sima Jinchi and group learned hints from the Fire Host Clan Patriarch's talk with Tang Wulin and saw the exchange of the true god-rank fire, 7-colored Lotus Flower Flame.

The final, eighteenth level had Qiangu Dongfeng and Qiangu Dieting alongside several Spirit Pagoda top level masters. On this level, it is revealed without fighting the conspiracy trap for the Qiangu clan, the successful acquirement of the God-rank ammunition by Tang Sect and the retirement of Chen Xinjie. Returning to the original levels, Sima Jinchi and group witness Ye Xinglan's awakening from acquiring the Sword God/Swordspirit realm cocoon and her sudden humanizing change to accept Fatty Xu Lizhi's love, a personality change that shocked everyone of her companions.

For the next 2 months, Sima Jinchi stays at Shrek Academy to continue his teaching duties while Tang Wulin spends the first month consolidating his Spear God/Spearspirit foundation and the next month, improving his Divine Craftsman ability to reach the level of refining fusing metals that had gone through seven levels of the Heavenly Refinement.

Although the 4-word battle armors of Tang Wulin's comrades had already taken form, Tang Wulin had yet to complete even one piece of his four-word battle armor that required fusing metals that had gone through seven levels of the Heavenly Refinement. The fused forging of four types of metals was the highest level achieved by Tang Wulin. However, he was reluctant to accept using just four types of metals to make his 4-word battle armor. Tang Wulin only spent a few days during the second month experimenting with Ling Zichen's suggested method before he successfully completed the forging of five metals in a single attempt. Hence, Director Ling Zichen officially joined his forging work.

The combination of the 7-Colored Lotus Flower and Ling Zichen’s soul technology showed Tang Wulin the possibility of fuse-forging seven metals. He had been working hard to achieve it for the past two months. If he succeeded, he could begin to forge and make his battle armor. At the same time, he could also use the 7-Colored Lotus Flower to refine his comrades’ battle armors such that their 4-word battle armors would be even more powerful.

It has been two months since the group's return from the War God Temple. By Tang Wulin's decree, Shrek would not be taking any further steps in the next six months after Wulin refined his first 4-word battle armor piece (right arm gauntlet). He wanted to give the continent a chance to rest and recover. During these six months, Sima Jinchi familiarized his 4-word battle armor, sparred different Shrek-Tang Sect powerhouses and taught at Shrek Academy.

Tang Wulin had yet to complete his four-word battle armor set. This was because making true divine-ranked metals took a lot of his energy and left him physically fatigued. He could only completely recover after a week. During this period of time, he would help the rest of his allies to forge the metals needed for their four-word battle armor.

Meanwhile, Tang Wulin’s understanding of Heavenly Refinement had reached a new level after entering that particular realm. He could perform Heavenly Refinement as easily as his hand could move its fingers. His speed had not increased, but the quality of his finished results was obviously improved. He had even taken back the four-word battle armor made for his companions earlier for further processing in order to enhance their strength.

During these eight months, Sima Jinchi's battle armor evolved to four-word with Tang Wulin's heavenly-refined seven color fuse-forging metals purified by the 7-Colored Lotus Flower Flame. The battle armor's name is never mentioned.

Three days later, Sima Jinchi participates in a total of 20 Titled Douluos, with 7 being Limit Douluos, to fight the Qiangu family of the nearby Spirit Pagoda headquarters. Sima Jinchi walks alongside the Shrek Seven Monsters, the Strength God Ah Ruheng, the Skyfrost Douluo Wu Zhangkong, and the younger generation of outstanding soul masters including Lan Muzi and Tang Yinmeng. The Limit Douluo are Light Dark Douluo Long Yeyue, the Holy Spirit Douluo Ya Li, the Heartless Douluo Cao Dezhi, the Amorous Douluo Zang Xin, the Titan Douluo Yuanen Zhentian, the Heavenly Wild Douluo Yuanen Tiandang and the Qilin Douluo Tong Yu.

 After Tang Wulin's overwhelming clash against Qiangu Dongfeng, injuring Dongfeng's Life foundation and physique to be unable to breakthrough to the next rank, Sima Jinchi and all other Shrek-Tang Sect associates display to the opposing Spirit Pagoda powerhouses (Di Tian hidden among them) their unique Tang Wulin forged 4-word battle armors. This shows the Spirit Pagoda the disparity of God-rank Divine Craftsman Tang Wulin to predecessor Mortal-rank Divine Craftsman Zhen Hua and acknowledges the Spirit Pagoda's foolishness.

 The revenge conflict is interrupted by Chen Xinjie and Zhang Huanyun, mediating a resolution and alerting all Titled Douluos of both sides the apocalyptic actions of the Holy Spirit Cult colluding with the Abyssal Plane. Sima Jinchi returns with the others to Shrek Academy to prepare as part of a world Holy War against the Holy Spirit Cult and the Abyssal Planar creatures' invasion of the Douluo Plane.

After learning of the surprise invasion, Wulin commands Sima Jinchi and many Titled Douluos, such as the six of the Shrek Monsters, to stay back at Shrek Academy and Tang Sect as teaching staff and guard headquarters against Spirit Pagoda's possible retaliation, while Wulin and Limit Douluos head to the Extreme North. For about half a month, Sima Jinchi stays at Shrek Academy as a staff member and trains. He later joins on the frontlines of Shrek's Tang Sect's camp as part of Shrek Academy's powerhouses to fight the second invasion's Abyssal creatures. Around this time, Wulin conducts the Sea God's Trials for several days during the second invasion.

4-word Battle Armor Master Sima Jinchi participates with Shrek Academy's group temporarily joining Tang Sect's army to battle. Under Zang Xin's command, Sima Jinchi is assigned to Wu Zhangkong, Lan Muzi, Tang Yingmeng, and the Shrek Seven Monsters to form a 10 person squadron. This Battle Armor squadron will be in charge of rescuing the others from the skies. When one squadron is having difficulty, this squadron will provide assistance. He assists the Shrek Seven Monsters to fight the Holy Spirit Cult members and the Abyssal Plane creatures.

Sima Jinchi's squad leads with a Tang Sect mecha army battalion and fights against the abyssal Spirit Monarch's clan's abyssal Spirit Dragons that naturally possess Spirit Domain spiritual power, on the first mountain slope. These abyssal Spirit Dragons have 3 abyssal Spirit Dragon Kings each Limit Douluos and peak Spirit Domain realm while over a 100 meters long. The formation was:

Front: Sima Jinchi, Yuanen Yehui, and Yue Zhengyu

Middle: Wu Zhangkong and Lan Muzi

Back: The rest surrounding Xu Xiaoyan.

Other than Xu Xiaoyan, the second brightest star would be Sima Jinchi. the divine weapon Dragon Slaying Saber in his hand was the most potent weapon. anything crossing its past would be slain. almost no abyssal creature could withstand it. Sima jinchi and Yuanen Yehui fended off the powerful abyssal creatures which were like the tides lashing against them. had it not been the protection of the three Spirit Dragon Kings’ mist, the abyssal creatures on the mountain would have been killed by them.

During the abyssal Spirit Monarch's Divine Origin realm reveal, the abyssal Spirit Dragon Kings temporarily evolved and gained dark green scales and eyes while attaining pseudo-rank 3 Divine Origin realm. Sima Jinchi's squad's battle is interrupted by Gu Yuena slaying the abyssal Spirit Monarch resulting in all abyssal Spirit Dragons exploding.

The rescue squad manages to force the abyssal creatures (after lossing the abyss Spirit Dragon Kings) back. The squad members work together with their aerial forces to stabilize and strengthen the defensive line of the first mountain slope. Sima Jinchi's squad captain Wu Zhangkong then left to fight Darkness Hummingbird while Sima Jinchi and the rest of the squad fought the abyssal legion.

Once the fight stops, Sima Jinchi learns of Tang Wulin's personally publicized existence as Sea God Tang San's son.

Sima Jinchi follows the Shrek group back to the Life Subtree and learns of th Bet Bout offered by the Demon Emperor.

Sima Jinchi's group fights the Demon Emperor and eight abyssal powerhouses. One is an abyssal warrior with the strongest aura standing next to the Demon Emperor, emitting blue-purple radiance from its body. Moreover, it is clad in a suit of rare blue-purple armor and it was even holding a weapon in its hand. The weapon was an enormous halberd One could not see its face under the helmet. It was completely pitch black with only a pair of eyes glistening with purple glint.. It ranked third and it was known as the Intense Monarch! Other than the abyssal Sage King and the Spirit Monarch, there was the Intense Monarch. After the Spirit Monarch perished in battle, it could be said that the Intense Monarch was the most powerful monarch left on the abyssal plane. The other powerhouses are seven abyssal kings. 

Gu Yuena, the Shrek Monsters and Sima Jinchi behind Tang Wulin swiftly adjusted their battle formation, forming a single file. 

The Intense Monarch was killed by Wulin. Sima Jinchi and the others witness alongside the opposing abyssal kings the Dragon God Transformation. 

Upon Wulin's partial awareness of the Abyssal Plane's abyssal Sage Lord summoning conspiracy, Sima Jinchi works with the Shrek Seven Monsters and Gu Yuena to kill the Holy Spirit Cult's Demon Emperor and her entourage to thwart it. However, the Sage King uses the dead Demon Emperor's God rank corpse to become its manifest anchoring vessel to the Douluo Plane.

Sima Jinchi witnesses Cao Dezhi's and Zang Xin's sacrificial fusion technique to temporarily seal the Sage King for 3 days. He then waits at the Shrek Academy camp and later witnesses alongside all beings around Douluo Planet, in frozen space, Tang San's 10,000 year old conspiracy come to fruition. He also learns of the revival of many meritable powerhouses who contributed to opposing the Holy Spirit Cult and Abyssal Plane invasions.

For one month after Douluo Planet successfully evolved by devouring the Abyss Plane, Sima Jinchi continues training through sparring and his work as Wulin's Chief Bodyguard and as a Shrek Academy teacher. With his position, Sima Jinchi also cultivates within the revived Eternal Tree to improve his rank to peak Hyper Douluo. He also witnesses the construction of Eternal City.

Because Sima Jinchi participated in the Ten Thousand Beasts Platform during the Joust For a Spouse Festival, he became one of many in front of Tang Wulin to be divine controlled by Gu Yuena through the assistance of the Dragon God's Divine Core as a puppet. During Tang Wulin's final marriage fight with Gu Yuena and her divine-controlled Spirit Masters, Sima Jinchi, Ah Ruheng and the 6 Shrek Monsters were commanded to fight Wulin for the first round.

Through his spiritual connection to Wulin, Sima Jinchi was released from the divine control by his fusion skill. He then waited at the side with Long Yeyue and Chen Xinjie.

Sima Jinchi directly witnessed Tang Wulin's double suicide with Gu Yuena and then their flight towards the Extreme North.
characters.trivia:
Sima Jinchi's novel cover design for Soul Land 3 Book 20 in his 3-word battle armor is noted by many fans to conflict with what is written in the novels post-awakening.

Based on the fact Sima Jinchi's initial military deployment was under the Southern Army, the Saber could have fallen in the Douluo Continent's southern area.

In Soul Land III, Sima Jinchi's battle armor name from 2-word to 4-word is never revealed, with himself referred as Saber God Douluo or Crazed Wind Saber Demon/Wild Gale Saber Demon Sima Jinchi by those outside his companions' circle.

Several noted Ring skills:
Seventh Ring Dragon Slayer Avatar: Dragon Slay 斩龙真身: 斩龙

? Ring Black Dragon Slays 黑龙斩

Sixth Ring...
Related to slaying a Hell Evil Dragon/Hell Evil Dragon Emperor 地狱邪龙/地狱邪龙皇

Sima Jinchi's existence marks evidence of the predecessor Dragon God's great foresight: the choice to throw his Saber to the Douluo Continent knowing it would awaken, meet and dutifully protect Tang Wulin, a key component to his future successor. This is further supported in Soul Land IV Book 19 with the predecessor Dragon God's other divine tools and super divine tool.

Sima Jinchi did not have much opportunity to engage in a battle on normal days since he was always with Tang Wulin. the Strength God Ah Ruheng on the other hand, was shining bright especially when they faced against the Spirit Pagoda and engaged in a collision with the War God Temple.

In SL4, he should have already become a god given the time interval of 10,000 years. After all possessions of the Dragon God including the divine tools were fused with the new Dragon God Tang Xuanyu, he appeared somewhere in the Mingdu City, passed through the Galaxy and fused with Tang Xuanyu.

characters.introText: Situ Yu is a class 4 soul engineer and the captain of Cloud Luo Advanced Soul Engineering Academy. He's not only the captain but also the core of their group.

characters.personality: He is a stern leader who is not prone to rage. This can be seen from how he was not angry and didn't lash out at Xu Sanshi due to his previous actions in the tournament.
characters.history: He was the third and last student from Cloud Luo Academy to fight against Shrek Academy in the first match of the round-robin phase. In order to win his respect, he asked Xu Sanshi to use his actual strength because he wanted to see the real difference between the two of them. He told Xu Sanshi that if he managed to beat him, then there won’t be a need to fight the remaining matches to which Xu Sanshi also agreed after pondering for a moment. During the battle, Xu Sanshi blocked, doged and reflected all of his attacks with his incredible defensive power. After that, he pounced forward like a lion and ruthlessly smashed into Situ Yu’s soul tool fortress from the side which sent him flying from the stage without the slightest resistance. He was slammed against the light screen of the protective barrier and collapsed to the ground. After he lost, he admitted defeat on behalf of the Cloud Luo Academy.

characters.introText:
Quick Answers
		
		
	
	
			
				
					What powers does the Snow Empress possess?
						
				
				
					
						The Snow Empress, revered as the Icesky Snow Lady, wields the power of the Absolute Snow element and the profundity of the wind. Her three ultimate techniques are Snowy Dance of Ultimate Ice, Empress' Palm, and Empress' Sword. She has the unique ability to sense all occurrences in areas of snow and ice. Additionally, she can seal her origin with the pure essence of a hundred-thousand-year Snow Lotus.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					Who are the other two Arctic Kings alongside the Snow Empress?
						
				
				
					
						The Snow Empress, the initial ruler of the Extreme North, was one of the Three Arctic Kings. The Ice Devil Titan King, Ah Tai, was another Arctic King who assumed the rulership of the Extreme North after the Snow Empress transformed into the Spirit Soul of Huo Yuhao. The third Arctic King is not identified in the provided context.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					How does the Snow Empress maintain her youthful appearance?
						
				
				
					
						The Snow Empress, a Heavenly Snow Woman, retains her youth by controlling the Ultimate Snow element. She can transform into a child, losing her memories temporarily, but regrows as her strength increases. Her unique abilities include Empress' Chill, Unparalleled Chill, Empress' Sword, and Snowless Glacier.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What role does the Snow Empress play in the 'Seal of the Empress Remnant 2'?
						
				
				
					
						In 'Seal of the Empress Remnant 2', the Snow Empress is a key figure, recognized as the First of the Three Arctic Kings and the Third of Ten Great Beasts. She becomes a Spirit Soul of Huo Yuhao. As the Heavenly Snow Woman, she is a unique spirit of the Ice Clan. Alongside the Sea Princess, she governs the Extreme North. She shares a fusion skill with the Ice Empress, capable of creating a blizzard and snowstorm.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What is the significance of the Snow Empress in the 'Sun and Moon Ice and Snow' book?

Appearance[]
She looked like a seventeen or eighteen-year-old teenage girl. She had unrivaled beauty that matched even Tang Wutong. Her long, white hair flowed freely to her legs, and her sky-blue eyes were very clear. It was as if she could see through everything in the world. Her slender and exceedingly beautiful body was flawless, and her long white dress wasn’t adorned with any accessories but with ribbons. However, she still looked very elegant and ravishing.
characters.appearance: It was a young girl that seemed to be only two or three years old. Her chubby body was covered in a snow-white, cotton skirt. With time, she regained her strength and grew older until she reached around 20 years old.
characters.personality: She was proud and arrogant as well.
characters.history:
She was sold at the auction and bought by Jing Hongchen. Later, she was stolen by Huo Yuhao. Although she wanted to self-destruct and kill everyone in the Sun Moon Empire’s Illustrious Virtue Hall, she didn’t in the end and followed Huo Yuhao due to the persuasion of Ice Empress.

After that, she became the spirit soul of Huo Yuhao created by Electrolux but that led to the dissipation of the remnant divine consciousness of Electrolux in the Huo Yuhao’s spiritual sea. She became the first ever spirit soul in the history.

She returned to the Extreme North and made Ah Tai as her successor. She asked Ice Bear King to follow her who also became another spirit soul of Huo Yuhao.

Together with other spirit souls, she accompanied throughout the journey of Huo Yuhao and finally crossed towards the Divine Realm with him. She was the leader among Huo Yuhao’s spirit souls.
characters.trivia:
Even though Ice Empress loved her, she only considered her as a sister.

There was a spoiler saying that she successfully inherited the Ice Goddess, a 2nd Class God position in the Divine Realm. But in SL4.5, it was mentioned that all the spirit souls of Huo Yuhao were suppressed and only allowed to cultivate as 3rd Class Gods. In SL2.5, it was also mentioned that there wasn’t any Ice God, only Water Goddess and Sea God that shared the elements of the same origin.

characters.introText: He was a soul douluo-ranked expert from the Body Sect.
characters.appearance: He was clothed in an attire which revealed his identity as a warrior of the Body Sect.
characters.history:
He was among the body sect disciples that attacked the Illustrious Virtue Hall. He was tricked by Huo Yuhao who was disguised as Du Busi and presented him with the God Sealing Altar, which contained the embryo of the Snow Empress and a white tray with a wooden laddle, which also contained hundreds of gemstones of all colors.

He realized afterwards that Huo Yuhao was imitating the appearance of Du Busi. He subsequently attacked Huo Yuhao who retaliated by smashing the God Sealing Altar towards his fist. The God Sealing Altar cracked and a streak of white gas drilled its way out of the crack on the God Sealing Altar. He opened his arms and grabbed towards that streak of white gas.

In the next moment, he had been turned into an ice sculpture and was motionless as he stood in front of Huo Yuhao. Huo Yuhao stretched out his right index finger, and his Dark Golden Terrorclaw pierced through the ice, puncturing the Soul Douluo’s forehead and leading to his death.

characters.introText: She is the only female member of the Mad Battle Team. She is the only one in her team to have an optimum configuration of Soul Rings.
characters.appearance:
Through the heavy makeup her age couldn’t be made out, but by her figure she should be over twenty. Her clothes were also extremely revealing, on her upper body she only wore cloth wrapped around her chest, and although she wore a skirt it was thin as gauze, and her skin could be faintly seen through it.

As her Martial Soul was activated, her whole body was covered by a layer of pink light, wavy long hair rising into eight locks, unexpectedly taking the shape of eight spider legs to the sides of her head. On her forehead was a spider web mark, her two eyes also became pink.
characters.history:
She tried to distract Dai Mubai by trying to seduce him. She along with the rest of her team were shocked to see Ning Rongrong's Seven Treasure Glazed Tile Pagoda.

She used her Spider Silk to weave a spider web to try and restrain Ning Rongrong along with Tang San. Her spider web was burned by Ma Hongjun's Phoenix Fire Line. She warned Kuang Xi when Tang San used the Blue Silver Spider Web to target him. She ordered both the Soul Masters having Monkey as their Martial Soul to retreat and protect the Wishful Disk Spirit Master, and the Soul Masters having Sheep as their Martial Soul to hold their positions. She was trapped by the Blue Silver Bind when she tried to free Kuang Xi. She used the ability of her 2nd Soul Ring to create spider silk from all over her body to make a protective barrier against the Blue Silver Grass, even though her poison was overpowered. Her defense was broken by Ma Hongjun's Phoenix Fire Line. She used the ability of her 3rd Soul Ring to protect herself from being restrained by the Blue Silver Spider Web. She retained her consciousness after the Wishful Disk Spirit Master forced the rest of the members of the Mad Battle Team into berserk state. She helped Kuang Xi free himself before telling the Shrek Seven Monsters to surrender peacefully as respect to the Seven Treasure Glazed Tile Clan. She was shocked to see the Shrek Seven Monsters fly up making their berserk state useless. She inwardly bet that the berserk state would last longer than the flight of the Shrek Seven Monsters, and was shocked when the side-effects of the berserk state became apparant before Tang San's flight ended.

She tried to bluff Tang San into surrendering, but was refused. She used her Spider Silk to restrain Tang San after he knocked out Kuang Xi. She ordered the rest of her teammates to throw Tang San out of the stage, but found them already restrained by Blue Silver Bind. Her Soul Power was pulled along her Spider Silk when it triggered the Eight Spider Lances, resulting in the Spider Silk melting away. She was pulled along with her Spider Silk towards Tang San, and he caught her by the neck. She asked Tang San how he could overpower her. She was thrown out of the stage by Tang San.
characters.trivia:
In the novel, she had no official name, but was addressed as Spider Woman.

The names of the Abilities of her Soul Rings are not stated in the Light Novel, only the effects are mentioned.

It is the Spirit Master Academy under the direct management of the Martial Soul Hall. Talented Spirit Masters from all over the Douluo Continent are selected by the Branch Martial Soul Hall to study here. They teach via a philosophy of balanced teams of extreme individuals merging the cultivation directions of both the Empires.

It generally sends out the strongest Teams of the Continental Elite Young Soul Master Tournament that is held every five years, which become the champion of the majority of the editions.
characters.history:
During the Continental Advanced Academy Soul Dueling Tournament of 2645, they send out a very formidable team of elite individuals who are favorites to win the tournament.

As the Seeded Team, it directly fights in the 2nd Round of the Finals, defeating its opponent easily. The members of the Golden Generation participate from the 3rd Round onwards, winning their match against the Heaven Dou Imperial Academy's Main Team, before winning the 4th Round easily.

The Team encounters the Shrek Academy's Team in the Penultimate Round along with the God Wind Academy's Team as part of the Top Three. The Team battles the Shrek Academy's Team in the Grand Finale and loses.

Qian Renxue (Live Action only)
characters.trivia: The Team had at least three other members, as Xie Yue, Hu Liena and Yan didn't participate in the match in Round 2.

characters.history:
She was involved in the Spirit Hunting Operation by Spirit Hall and aids in attack of the Seven Treasure Glazed Tile Clan along with the Spirit Hall Army ,Huyan Zhen, She Long, Ci Xue and Devil Bear Douluo of Spirit Hall. She and the other 3 Spirit Hall Title Douluos fight Chen Xin, causing him to breakthrough, raising his soul power from level 96 to level 97, though Chen Xin lost an arm in the process.. Subsequently, the 4 Spirit Hall Title Douluos were defeated and they retreated.

She later joins Bibi Dong, Gui Mei, Yue Guan, She Long, Ci Xue and Tuoba Xi in hunting Da Ming and Er Ming for their spirit rings to become Bibi Dong's second Spirit, Soul Devouring Spider Emperor’s 8th and 9th spirit rings. After a battle of attrition, just as the 2 Spirit Beasts were about to fall, she goes in for an attack, eager to prove her strength and speed. However before she can release her 9th spirit ability, the 2 spirit beasts launched a desperate last minute attack, with Spirit Kite Douluo being caught in Da Ming's Slow Domain and Er Ming using Titan Firmament Breaker to crush her to death.

characters.introText:
Quick Answers
		
		
	
	
			
				
					What is the significance of the Spirit Ranks in Soul Land Clash of Spirit Masters?
						
				
				
					
						In Soul Land Clash of Spirit Masters, Spirit Ranks represent a person's strength, enhanced through Spirit Cultivation. They range from Spirit Scholar to Titled God, the highest rank unseen for 10,000 years. Each rank, including Spirit Master, Spirit Grandmaster, Spirit Ancestor, Spirit King, Spirit Emperor, Spirit Saint, and Spirit Douluo, signifies a higher spiritual realm relative to the cultivation rank.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					How are the spirit rankings determined in Soul Land Clash of Spirit Masters?
						
				
				
					
						Spirit rankings in Soul Land Clash of Spirit Masters are determined by Spirit Cultivation, reflecting a person's strength. These rankings range from 1 to 100, with each rank representing a different level of mastery. The highest rank, Titled God, has not been seen for 10,000 years in Soul Land III.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					Who is the highest ranked spirit saint in Soul Land Clash of Spirit Masters?
						
				
				
					
						Ning Fengzhi, with a rank of 79, is the top-ranked spirit saint in Soul Land Clash of Spirit Masters. The spirit rankings extend beyond the Spirit Saint level, with Titled God as the ultimate rank, unseen for 10,000 years in Soul Land 3.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What are some of the top tier characters in the Soul Land Clash of Spirit Masters tier list?
						
				
				
					
						In the Soul Land Clash of Spirit Masters tier list, top-tier characters include those in the Spirit Douluo/Great Soul Land Master and Soul Douluo ranks. Notable characters in the Spirit Douluo/Great Soul Land Master rank include Ge Long, Salas, Yu Luomian, Meng Shu, and Zhao Wuji, all with ranks exceeding 80. In the Soul Douluo rank, Meng Hongchen, Du Weilun, Fan Yu, Mo Yunfei, and Yu Tao stand out, also with ranks above 80.

characters.introText: He is the incumbent Emperor of the Star Luo Empire and father of Dai Weisi and Dai Mubai.
characters.history:
He was informed by Dai Mubai about the decision to train on Sea God Island and that Dai Weisi could inherit the throne if Dai Mubai did not return. Dai Mubai also told him that the Star Luo Empire could officially declare war on the Martial Soul Hall when the Shrek Seven Monsters returned. He hoped that Dai Mubai would succeed in his training and return safely.

He formally declared war on the Martial Soul Empire in coordination with Xue Beng’s declaration, aiming to pincer the Martial Soul Empire.

He orders the initiation of War Emergency throughout the Star Luo Empire following the aggression from the Martial Soul Empire. He agrees to let Dai Weisi become the frontline Commander of the Star Luo Empire's Army.

He takes Dai Weisi and Zhu Zhuyun to the Xilu City for a meeting with Xue Beng, but entourages of both Empires are ambushed by the forces of the Martial Soul Empire led by the Seventh Priest, the Falling Devil Douluo, Xie Yue, Yan, Feng Bailong and Hu Qianxing. He fights his way through the ambush along with Dai Weisi and Zhu Zhuyun, before they are overpowered by the Black Tiger Clan, and saved by the Hell White Tiger of Dai Mubai and Zhu Zhuqing. He orders the forces of the Star Luo Empire to start their counterattack on the Spirit Masters of the Martial Soul Empire, as the leaders are restrained from taking action by the Shrek Seven Monsters.

In the aftermath of the ambush, he participated in a meeting with the delegation from the Heaven Dou Empire, with the Shrek Seven Monsters in attendance. Xue Beng gives him command of the Xilu City to start the counterattack on the Martial Soul Empire, as he is more experienced.
characters.trivia:
He is only mentioned and doesn't appear in the Novel at any point.

He tried to rope Ma Hongjun in as a subordinate Spirit Master of the Star Luo Imperial Clan, when the latter visits Dai Mubai and Zhu Zhuqing.

She studied in the assassin department at the academy.

Her teacher Sloan, the tower master of the Dark Tower and Phil Jackson's student, took part of her soul as payment for helping her get revenge on her family. characters.introText:
Quick Answers
		
		
	
	
			
				
					What leadership qualities does Tai Tan exhibit?
						
				
				
					
						Tai Tan shows leadership through loyalty, respect for strength, and talent. As leader of the One Strength Clan, he values loyalty and treats others with respect. His leadership is marked by a strong presence and commitment to clan independence, especially after leaving the Clear Sky Clan. Despite being impulsive and short-tempered, he is dedicated to his followers and skilled at recognizing talent, evident in his interest in Tang San.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					How does Tai Tan's appearance reflect his personality?
						
				
				
					
						Tai Tan's appearance, with a stature like Vigorous King Tai Nuo and a commanding expression, mirrors his personality. He exudes authority without anger, reflecting his loyalty and respect for strength. Despite his leadership, he remains humble, not looking down on others. His impulsive nature and short temper are also evident.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What role does loyalty play in Tai Tan's life?
						
				
				
					
						Tai Tan's life is deeply influenced by loyalty. As the leader of the One Strength Clan, he showed loyalty by distancing his clan from the Clear Sky Clan after Tang Hao left. Tai Tan respects strength and loyalty, valuing these traits in others. His loyalty extends to Tang San, whom he respects for his strength and his ties to Tang Hao.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					How does Tai Tan compare to the Vigorous King Tai Nuo?
						
				
				
					
						Tai Tan and Vigorous King Tai Nuo have similar builds, but Tai Tan's expression is more profound, giving a forceful impression. Tai Tan is loyal, values strength, and has a short temper. Appearance[]
He is an old man with grizzled hair and beard. He has short hair standing out like steel needles at the top of his head. He looks similar to the Vigorous King Tai Nuo, only his eyes are much deeper and his expression is even more abstruse. He gives people a kind of not angry but forceful impression.
characters.appearance:
He slapped Tai Nuo after he was informed that the latter lost against a Soul Elder trying to avenge Tai Long. He dragged Tai Nuo and Tai Long to the Shrek Academy the next day. He pushed Tai Nuo and Tai Long back by erupting his Soul Power after Tang San admitted to defeating Tai Nuo and Tai Long. He proposed a bet with Tang San that if the latter can't withstand the pressure of his Soul Power for an incense stick of time, Tang San would have to join the Strength Clan. He agreed to the changed condition of the bet by Ao Sika and started exerting his Soul Power on Tang San at 60% from the beginning. He gradually increased the pressure to 70% of his Soul Power, as he was surprised by Tang San's endurance. He increased the pressure from 70% to 90% after seeing the Eight Spider Lances to force Tang San into the Strength Clan. He was stuck by a Spiritual attack from Tang San.

He warned Tang San that if the latter continues, it may cause permanent harm. He decided to destroy Tang San when the latter refused to concede. He was shocked when Tang San activated the Clear Sky Hammer, causing him to decrease the pressure. He greeted Ning Fengzhi and Gu Rong after they arrived to stop the bet. He was informed by Gu Rong that the Seven Treasure Glazed Tile Clan was interested in Tang San. He laughed and pointed Gu Rong to the Clear Sky Hammer on Tang San. He asked Tang San if Tang Hao was the latter's father. He led Tai Nuo and Tai Long to kneel to Tang San after the latter accepted that Tang Hao was his father. He asked Tang San about Tang Hao's news. He asked about the in charge of the Shrek Academy and was surprised that it was Zhao Wuji, and told the latter to find him a quiet place to talk to Tang San. He lamented hearing about Tang San's past and revealed the name of the Clear Sky Hammer to the latter.

He confirmed Tang Hao's handwriting seeing the letter left for Tang San. He refused to reveal the events of the past to Tang San telling him that only Tang Hao can reveal them to the latter. He then handed over the command of the Strength Clan to Tang San. He told Tang San not to join the Seven Treasure Glazed Tile Clan as a descendant of the Clear Sky Clan, and Tang Hao's opinion about Ning Fengzhi. He later asked ordered Tai Long to be Tang San's bodyguard.

By Book 16, Xiaodao has reached 6 rings, 2-word battle armor master.

In Book 21, Xiaodao is forced to participate in the Sea God Fate Blind-Date event by Piao Xiaoxu as a step to marry her in the future.

Quick Answers
		
		
	
	
			
				
					What is the significance of Tang Hao's title, the Clear Sky Douluo?
						
				
				
					
						The Clear Sky Douluo title held by Tang Hao denotes his position as a Titled Douluo from the Clear Sky Clan. His attainment of this title at a young age underscores his exceptional strength. The title also signifies his leadership within the Clear Sky Clan, renowned as the most powerful clan with numerous Titled Douluos.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					Who does Tang Hao ascend to the Douluo Divine Realm with?
						
				
				
					
						Tang Hao, a key character in the Soul Land wiki, ascends to the Douluo Divine Realm in the company of his wife Ah Yin, his son, his daughter-in-law, and his friends. This significant event takes place within a century of Tang Hao reuniting with his son and their comrades, and upon discovering Tang San's rise to the status of a God Enforcer.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What role does Tang Hao play in the Douluo Planet?
						
				
				
					
						In the Douluo Planet, Tang Hao serves as the Douluo Planar Lord. This role is bestowed upon him by his son, Tang San, as part of a 10,000-year plan for the planet's future. Alongside him, his wife, Ah Yin, is appointed as the Douluo Life Core. Their duties encompass the supervision of the Douluo Divine Realm and the safeguarding of their son and the planet's future.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					How is Tang Hao's physical appearance described in Soul Land?
						
				
				
					
						In Soul Land, Tang Hao is depicted as a tall, middle-aged man exceeding two meters in height. He sports short, prickly hair akin to steel needles and has robust, chiseled features. His eyes, a unique brownish-yellow, subtly glimmer with golden light. Despite his long grey robe, his muscular physique is evident. His skin bears a bronze hue, and his hair is unkempt, much like a bird's nest. An untrimmed beard complements his rugged appearance. A distinctive feature is a massive black hammer that floats unsupported behind him.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					How is Tang Hao related to Tang San in the Douluo Continent?
						
				
				
					
						In the Douluo Continent, Tang Hao is Tang San's father. He entrusts Tang San with the responsibility of revitalizing the Clear Sky Clan, and watches over him to prevent any issues related to his past. Tang Hao takes immense pride in Tang San's achievements.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom

characters.appearance:
He was the only Blacksmith of the Holy Spirit Village. He slept till late afternoon, before making a few farm tools to earn money, most of which he spent on alcohol. He was asked by Tang San to teach him forging so that he could take care of the income in the future. He told Tang San about his classification on the difference between a synthesizer and a blacksmith. He gave Tang San an Iron ingot to hammer 10,000 times, and was shocked when Tang San could lift the Forging Hammer. He remained uncaring about Tang San's Martial Soul Awakening Ceremony even after Jack reminded him.

He decided against sending Tang San to the Soul Master Academy to study after hearing that his Martial Soul was the Blue Silver Grass, which he recognized being similar to Ah Yin's. He was informed by Tang San that he had another Martial Soul and was shocked to see the Clear Sky Hammer. He became emotional and hugged Tang San for the first time in the latter's memory. He told Tang San to deactivate his Clear Sky Hammer after he reminded him that he could not bear it. He told Tang San to always use his Clear Sky Hammer to protect his Blue Silver Grass, before asking him if he really wanted to become a Soul Master. He accepted Tang San's decision to become a Soul Master after stating that even the strong Soul Master with the strongest Martial Soul was trash, and taught him the Disorder Splitting Wind Hammer for three months before the latter went to the Nuoding City to study at the Nuoding Academy.

He told Tang San not to reveal his Clear Sky Hammer to others under any circumstance, or assimilate Soul Rings to it; told him that he could assimilate Soul Rings to his Blue Silver Grass as per his wish as it would not prevent his Soul Power from advancing. He told Tang San to follow Jack to the Nuoding City and watched him leave.

He left Tang San a letter stating that he was leaving to reclaim something. He visited Yu Xiaogang after Tang San returned to the Holy Spirit Village. He praised Yu Xiaogang for his theoretical knowledge, and entrusted Tang San to his care. He gave Yu Xiaogang the Rank 1 Martial Soul Hall Token passed down among the Clear Sky Douluos, before he left.

characters.personality: Little Lazy Bug is lazy, does not want to cultivate, spends every day sleeping on the former Dragon God absorbing his space element aura, hence, given the name Little Lazy Bug and unable to transform a human appearance.
characters.history:
Little Lazy Bug was found in a pool of silvery liquid at the end of the cave on Resource Star No. 76 by Tang Xuanyu, Bai Xiuxiu, Tang Yuge and Yuanen Huihui; due to dense and almost viscous space elements and rich spatial element fluctuations inside, and it was recognized by Treasure Hunter because of familiar breath. She used Magic Silver as food and her tears and saliva could be transformed into Space Source Crystals and Space Original Liquid.

Back in the Divine Realm, the Sky Worm was a female compatriot of two siblings who were Guardians of Divine Realm's Space Element. Her diligent younger brother became a First Class God equivalent to the current Super God level; the God of Space Element and one of the Seven Elemental Gods. On the other hand, Little Lazy Bug all did was to sleep on the Dragon God absorbing his space element aura. Before the Dragon God was split into two entities Golden Dragon King and Silver Dragon King, he threw Little Lazy Bug into the void. She floated in space absorbing the space element for an unknown number of years then encounter the people of the Yukong Clan of the Dragon Horse Galaxy.

She was brought by Xuanyu to Douluo Planet and given to Tang Wulin for safekeeping so that she would not be found by super god level existences of the Dragon Horse Galaxy. She was then kept in the Seven Saints Abyss Realm of Shrek Academy.

Later, she transformed into human form after signing a contract with Tang Xuanyu. She was named Tang Kongkong by Tang Wulin, becoming a part of the Tang family.

characters.introText:
Quick Answers
		
		
	
	
			
				
					Who are Tang Wulin's parents in Soul Land III: Legend of the Dragon King?
						
				
				
					
						In Soul Land III: Legend of the Dragon King, Tang Wulin is the offspring of Tang San, the Sea God & Asura God, and Xiao Wu, a Soft Boned Rabbit of 100,000 years. He has a sibling, Tang Wutong, the Butterfly Goddess, and his brother-in-law is Huo Yuhao, the God of Emotion. Tang Wulin's spouse is Gu Yuena, the Silver Dragon King, and their son is Tang Xuanyu.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What is the significance of Tang Wulin's Golden Dragon King bloodline?
						
				
				
					
						The Golden Dragon King Bloodline of Tang Wulin significantly enhances his combat abilities, doubling his strength, attack, and defense. It also boosts his allies' attack and defense by a third within his domain. This bloodline has an affinity for destruction and time attributes, aiding skill comprehension. The energy of this bloodline is sealed within Tang Wulin's body and requires the removal of eighteen seals for assimilation. Additionally, it provides protective countermeasures in dangerous situations.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					Who is Tang Wulin's wife in the Soul Land series?
						
				
				
					
						In the Soul Land series, Tang Wulin is married to Gu Yuena. They are both gods, and Gu Yuena is the mother of Tang Wulin's child. Tang Wulin is the offspring of the Sea God & Asura God, Tang San, and his wife, Xiao Wu, a 100,000-year-old Soft Boned Rabbit.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What is the relationship between Tang Wulin and the God of Emotion, Huo Yuhao?

characters.personality:
Tang Wulin is an honest and kindhearted individual, which is apparent when he saved Na'Er from a group of teenagers, who were trying to kidnap her and sell her off. He is incredibly hardworking, not letting the words of others affect him negatively. Also having been raised in an impoverished family, he is significantly more sensible and mature than others of his age.

In Soul Land 4, due to his amnesia, Wulin acts rather stoic. He talks very little and regularly has an emotionless expression. Still, he retains his kind heart, being grateful to Le Qingling for taking him in.

But in Soul Land 4 volume 14, when he met with Gu Yuena, his heart was open for her again, and he turned back to the outgoing man.

In Soul Land 4 volume 16, after he and Xuanyu both knew each other's father-son relationship, he became quite stable and mature.

Tang (唐) means "Tang Dynasty".

characters.trivia:
Tang Wulin is the only known people to be a Rank 10 Divine Blacksmith.

When Tang Wulin heavenly refines metals alone, he works naked to not deal with the problem of thunder tribulation continuously destroying his clothes. If there are people observing his heavenly refinement, he dresses normally.

With the Seven-Colored Lotus Flame, he evolves his heavenly refinement level, resulting in a God rank heavenly refined metal that can alone become a piece of his 4-word Battle Armor without the need to apply circuits to the 3-word Battle Armor on the level of a Divine Tool. Tang Wulin is the only currently known Divine Blacksmith who can create a divine tool tier 4-word Battle Armor and its only possessor.

He is the first Super God in the history of the Douluo Federation.

In SL4 Book 27, Tang Wulin refined and forged all 33 Sky Wings' 4-word battle armors.

The Golden Dragon King bloodline was stripped from his body but he still retained the same body he had trained before. Although he loses Golden Dragon King’s abilities and powers, Gold Song still had that. His Blue Silver Emperor mutated due to GDK bloodline also remained the same.

characters.introText:
Quick Answers
		
		
	
	
			
				
					Who are Tang Wutong's parents in Soul Land 2?
						
				
				
					
						In Soul Land 2, Tang Wutong is the daughter of Tang San and Xiao Wu. She is also recognized as Wang Dong or Wang Dong'er. Her brother is Tang Wulin, making her the paternal aunt of Tang Xuanyu, Tang Wulin's son with Gu Yuena. Tang Wutong is a member of the Clear Sky Clan.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					Why did Tang Wutong disguise her true gender in Soul Land 2?
						
				
				
					
						In Soul Land 2, Tang Wutong, known as Wang Dong, concealed her gender to experience her father Tang San's upbringing. She used male attire and illusions to mask her femininity, as part of her father's plan for her to mentor his chosen successor, Huo Yuhao. Upon returning from a foreign exchange trip post the first Soul Master Tournament, Yuhao discovered her true identity, leading to their romantic relationship.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What is the significance of Tang Wutong's name in the context of Soul Land 2?
						
				
				
					
						Tang Wutong, originally Wang Dong/Wang Dong'er in Soul Land II, is a pivotal character in the Soul Land series. As a Clear Sky Clan member and God of Emotions Huo Yuhao's wife, she plays a crucial role. She is Tang San and Xiao Wu's eldest child, Tang Wulin's elder sister, and Tang Xuanyu's paternal aunt. Her name signifies the Tang Sect's legacy, a prominent group in the series, and is deeply connected to the sect's heritage and customs.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					How is Tang Wutong related to Tang Wulin and Tang Xuanyu?
						
				
				
					
						Tang Wutong, known as the Butterfly Goddess in Soul Land, is the older sister of Tang Wulin. They share similar eye features, which led to the revelation of their sibling relationship. While her direct connection to Tang Xuanyu isn't explicitly stated, they belong to the Tang family lineage.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom

Disguise as Wang Dong[]
Tang Wutong initially disguised her true gender by wearing male clothes and using illusions to hide her hair's length along with her other 'feminine' features. When Wang Dong had first entered the academy, he caught the eyes of almost the entire batch of young girls, including those from his class. He had charming, big pinkish-blue eyes, and pinkish-blue short hair that covered his forehead. His skin was tender and white, while his delicate face had a pink complexion. To every girl, he was like a lady-killer.
