characters.personality:
Tang Wutong was born as the first child and only daughter of Tang San and Xiao Wu. Growing up in the God Realm, she was known for being a troublemaker who always caused mischief for the other gods. She eventually grew tired of the God Realm and descended onto the human plane, which her father allowed since he wanted her to see the land he grew up in. However, he also sealed away her memories and true power, to prevent her from causing too much damage to the relatively weak humans.

Afterward, Tang Wutong was taken in by the current incarnation of the Clear Sky Clan, led by Niu Tian and Tai Tan; both of whom were actually the human reincarnations of her mother's childhood friends, Da Ming and Er Ming. She continued to live and train with them until she was accepted into Shrek Academy. To hide her true identity as a member of the Clear Sky Clan, she changed her name to "Wang Dong" and pretended to be a man.

Wang Dong arrives at the dormitory and meets with his new roommate Huo Yuhao. She immediately makes a set of rules while looking down on Yuhao and being rather rude. This causes the two of them to go outside to have a fight. Seeing Yuhao's 1st Spirit Ring Wang Dong states he will defeat him without even using his Spirit. However, the match ends up with Yuhao gaining victory. For the next few days, neither of them acknowledges the other despite being in the same room.

Wang Dong reminds Yuhao who is immersed in cultivation and sets off to their first class. When asked by teacher Zhou Yi who had fought in the previous days, he stands up after Yuhao does. Afterward, despite having arrived late to run the 100 laps around the Shrek Plaza, he finishes first. Then he helps Yuhao to finish his 12 laps in the final 5 minutes by carrying him which sprouts a friendship between them. They talk about each other, including the kind of spirit that they have.

In the afternoon class, Zhou Yi announced that he is the class president due to him having the strongest ability in his class. After that, he and his classmates are instructed to wear 30jin armor (1 jin = 0.5 kg) and run until the period ends, which is 2 hours later. He runs the most number of laps but loses the ability to keep going after falling down during the final minutes. However Yuhao's unwavering determination pushes the rest of the class, Wang Dong included, to stand up and continue again. Zhou Yi then takes the class president title from Wang and gives it to Yuhao, citing that he only cared for himself and didn't act as a good role model. As per Zhou Yi's instruction, if anybody wishes to take the class president position from Yuhao, they must battle Wang Dong instead, effectively making him Yuhao's bodyguard.

After returning to the room, he washes within the room, and Yuhao barges in seeing him almost naked. This causes Wang Dong to be embarrassed and enraged but before he could act Yuhao grabs his clothes and quickly leaves to meet up with Tang Ya. Wang Dong tracks Yuhao down at the Battle Spirit Arena and meets with Tang Ya who jokingly asks him to join Tang Sect to which he eagerly agrees, much to the amazement of Tang Ya. She puts it off stating that she will consider letting Wang Dong join Tang Sect. After the battle against Beibei and Xu Sanshi, Wang Dong takes Yuhao back to their room who had fainted from the power overdraft.

In their room, Wang Dong becomes curious about why Beibei casually gave Mystic Water Pill to Yuhao and wonders if Beibei got a wrong pill for Yuhao. The next morning he was asked by Yuhao about the sudden changes that happened to his body. To confirm, he uses a Spirit Guide Device which has the capability to measure the Spirit Power from level 10 to 30. It indicates that Yuhao's spirit power has increased and is just a hair away from the next level. He then further explains about the benefits and effects of the Mystic Water Pill.

Afterwords Yuhao treats Wang Dong to breakfast and Wang Dong suggests they go to the Sea God Lake to relax. Suddenly a person from the inner sect wearing a red mask approaches them in a state of madness and attacks. Wang Dong loses consciousness and comes to after being treated by Teacher Li who gives him and Yuhao each a Spirit Ascension Pill and asks them to forget about the matters that just occurred. When Yuhao asked Wang about that pill, he gives some details and when Yuhao demands a clarification, he refuses him and runs. He is chased by Yuhao and yelling that if Wang Dong explains it, he will treat him to lunch which slows him down. When he finds out that Yuhao is an orphan he apologizes and says that he will treat Yuhao to lunch. He then explains the effects of the pill. After school, he meets Tang Ya and asks if his request to join Tang Sect was approved. After some discussion, the two form a deal that if Wang Dong obtains rank one in the freshman examination, Tang Ya will approve his request for joining the sect. When he and Yuhao return to the dormitory after selling roasted fish, he is asked about which should be taken first between Mystic Water Pill and Spirit Ascension Pill. He responds that Yuhao should cultivate first for 10 days to maximize the effect of the first Mystic Water Pill which he took earlier and then take the 2nd Mystic Water Pill. Wang Dong then proceeds to take his Spirit Ascension Pill which gives a boost in his cultivation.

Wang Dong and his classmates are gathered by Zhou Yi to listen about the upcoming Freshman Examination. To make sure that he wasn't separated from Yuhao, he chooses the Control System after seeing Yuhao picking it which causes him to be berated by Zhou Yi as it does not suit him because his spirit is pure  Power Attack System. He thus changes it to Power Attack System after Zhou Yi states that although different cultivation, both will be in the same class. He then rejects Xiao Xiao who asks to speak to him alone.

At Yuhao's fish stand, he confronts Ma Xiaotao when she disperses the people standing in line to buy roasted fish. He only stops when Ma Xiaotao gives him a gold coin. He is shocked seeing Ma Xiaotao eating the fish making nothing remaining, not even a single drop of oil. As she leaves, he remembers the girl in red clothes who had attacked them earlier. Their discussion stops when a senior warns them that the girl is an inner school student whose strength ranks among the top 10.

On the morning of the day of examination he, Yuhao, and Xiao Xiao discuss their strategies in the upcoming examination. Conceited and arrogant about his prowess, he proposes to blast through their opponents without a set strategy earning the dissatisfaction of the other two. Thus he accepts Xiao Xiao and Yuhao's challenge, but is unable to attack them no matter what and is forced to concede his defeat.

When the examination starts their group is chosen to fight first against the group of Ouyang Junyi, Chen Junfeng, and Zhao Haochen as their opponent. With Yuhao's help, he easily manages to defeat them. The next four matches also end up in the same way with Team Yuhao dominating the battles.
characters.history:
In the Divine Realm, Tang Wutong became the Goddess of Butterfly. She lived together as a family with the God of Emotions, the God of War, the Goddess of Speed, Dai Hao and Huo Yun'er in a small courtyard that accommodated three wooden houses. In this small courtyard, she lived together with the God of Emotions in the one on the right among the three wooden houses, Dai Hao and Huo Yun'er lived on the left wooden house and the God of War and the Speed Goddess lived in the central wooden house.

On weekdays, the God of Emotions is responsible for cooking and the Goddess of Butterfly is responsible for hygiene. The family is very happy and among other families in the God Realm, it is also a relatively rare family.

They were once attacked by four of the seven 1st Class Original Sin Gods namely; the God of Greed, the Goddess of Envy, the God of Sloth and the God of Pride under the edict of the God of Destruction. The Butterfly Goddess and the God of Emotions successfully escaped from these four 1st Class Gods even though they were simply inferior to them in terms of cultivation.
characters.trivia:
Tang San sealed the true power of her Martial Soul and her memories, even though she was born in the divine realm, and she was still a human and cultivated like ordinary people, only she was faster supposedly due to the influence Immortal qi.

Wang Qiu'er was a part of Tang Wutong, after uniting with Wang Dong'er, she completed her true martial soul and restored her memories.

Although her 1st and 7th Soul Rings of Clear Sky Hammer were only mentioned, given the characteristics of Spirit Souls, she should have at least 6 Black and 3 Red Soul Rings. More Red Soul Rings weren’t impossible though.

During her early travels in the Douluo Continent, she used the aliases Wang Dong and Wang Dong'er, names inspired by the web novelist Hu Die Lan/Butterfly Blue (Wang Dong) on Qidian (The King's Avatar webnovel author). Another inspiration comes from Zhang Motong, the real-life daughter of Tang Jia San Shao (Zhang Wei).

Her birthday is on 14th June and her constellation is Gemini

characters.introText:
Quick Answers
		
		
	
	
			
				
					Who are Tang Xuanyu's parents and what is their significance in Soul Land?
						
				
				
					
						In Soul Land 4, Tang Xuanyu, the child of Tang Wulin and Gu Yuena, carries the bloodlines of the Golden Dragon King and the Silver Dragon Kings. His lineage caused a mutation in his two Blue Silver Emperor martial souls, granting him the powers of the Golden and Silver Dragon Kings. This earned him the moniker 'Little Dragon God.' His cultivation journey was marked by constant peril due to the internal conflict of his two bloodlines.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What is the significance of Tang Xuanyu's physical appearance in the Soul Land universe?
						
				
				
					
						In the Soul Land universe, Tang Xuanyu's appearance is linked to his identity and spiritual strength. His form is tied to the Golden Dragon King, signifying his vast spiritual prowess. As the reincarnation of Tang San, his appearance also denotes his heritage. Furthermore, he founded the Divine Dragon Realm, underlining his authority and influence.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What role does Tang Xuanyu play as the new Dragon God in Soul Land?
						
				
				
					
						In Soul Land, Tang Xuanyu, offspring of Tang Wulin and Gu Yuena, assumes the Dragon God's mantle. He holds the Golden and Silver Dragon Kings' bloodlines, leading to mutations in his Blue Silver Emperor martial souls. As the Dragon God, he establishes the Divine Dragon Realm on the Heavenly Dragon and Heavenly Horse twin planets, extending its sway over the Dragon-Horse Galaxy. He also identifies discrimination as a cause for war in the Divine Realm, with the Dragon God and dragon clan viewing other races as lesser.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What is the Divine Dragon Realm that Tang Xuanyu creates?
						
				
				
					
						Tang Xuanyu founded the Divine Dragon Realm following Soul Land IV's events, using the Heavenly Dragon and Heavenly Horse twin planets as its base. As the realm's sole ruler, Xuanyu holds a unique God Position. All Dragon Horse Galaxy species with a God Rank or higher had their rank lowered by one stage before they could reside in the realm. Those of around rank 100 or weak Gods had to retrain to regain their God Rank.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					How does Tang Xuanyu's lineage influence his character and abilities in Soul Land?
						
				
				
					
						In Soul Land, Tang Xuanyu's lineage deeply impacts his character and abilities. As the offspring of Tang Wulin and Gu Yuena, he carries the bloodlines of the Golden and Silver Dragon Kings. These bloodlines cause his Blue Silver Emperor martial souls to mutate, granting him the powers of the Golden and Silver Dragon Kings and earning him the moniker 'Little Dragon God.' However, his cultivation journey is perilous, as the two bloodlines clash within him, creating danger at every 10th rank breakthrough.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom

Appearance[]
Human Form[]
Defined
He is without a doubt a beautiful child. He has a face that looks like it is carved out of jade. He has beautiful skin and adorable dimples that people couldn’t help but admire. He has black hair with traces of silver hair to the sides. He also has blackish-blue eyes in his irises. However, unlike his parents, who are each quite tall, he is unusually short in comparison to others his age.
characters.appearance:
He is without a doubt a beautiful child. He has a face that looks like it is carved out of jade. He has beautiful skin and adorable dimples that people couldn’t help but admire. He has black hair with traces of silver hair to the sides. He also has blackish-blue eyes in his irises. However, unlike his parents, who are each quite tall, he is unusually short in comparison to others his age.

By his teenage period as a Shrek Academy’s Outer Court disciple, he matures into a notable handsome man taller than most of his classmates, excluding Qian Lei.

After reaching God level, his appearance changes. The first thing that changes the most is the hair color, a long blue hair spreads behind his head, which is lighter than Bai Xiuxiu’s dark blue hair, which is the color of a tranquil sea. There is also a hint of blue in the eyes, and there is a faint glow of nine colors.

Later, he appears as a handsome man with a deep black long hair, hanging over the shoulders. His eyes are also black which are as bright as stars and dazzling.
characters.personality:
Spoiler: Tang Xuanyu, Dong Qianqiu, Liu Feng, Qian Lei, Lan Mengqin, Yuanen Huihui, and Tang Yuge are new Shrek Seven Devils in Soul Land 4.

As the Class Leader, he becomes the main blacksmith and resources sponsor of his class and 33 Sky Wings for the entire Outer Court class period. The class teacher is Xiao Qi. He gifts each of the other Seven Monsters a Heavenly Treasure: Bai Xiuxiu a 10,000 years Mysterious Ice Essence, Liu Feng a 10,000 years Heavenly Green Vine, Qian Lei a 10,000 years Magma Fruit, Lan Menqin a 10,000 years Golden Yang Flower, and Yuanen Huihui a 10,000 years Fullmoon-Piercing Autumn Dew, taking a 100,000 years Purple Immortal Spirit Mushroom for himself. He also gifts his other classmates Heaven and Earth Treasures to promote their strength as a whole class.

He later becomes the Life School's Heir and joins Tang Sect, during which on his initiation day, he manages to momentarily be contacted by Tang San.

During his breakthough for Rank 50+, he condensed a Dragon God Core from his Dragon God bloodline essence at his chest area with Xiao Bao's support.

With his breakthrough to Rank 60+, he condenses a Spiritual Dragon Core in his spiritual sea similar to Huo Yuhao's that also symbolizes his Spirit Domain realm. Once this and his spiritual sea condense and evolve, Xuanyu will awaken the Divine Origin realm.

With his breakthrough to Rank 70+, he condenses 3 seven-colored cores: Chest, Spiritual, Dantian.

characters.introText:
Quick Answers
		
		
	
	
			
				
					How does Tang Ya's cheerful nature influence her interactions with other characters in the story?
						
				
				
					
						Tang Ya's cheerful disposition manifests in her kind and friendly interactions. Despite her bossy streak, she's known for her warmth. This cheerfulness shifts when she joins the Holy Ghost Church, turning cold and distant. Yet, her cheerfulness resurfaces in her concern for friends, especially when feeling left behind. Her personality undergoes a significant shift, becoming aggressive and ruthless, indicative of her personal struggles and losses.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What is the role of Tang Ya in the 'Saintess has a showdown' plot?
						
				
				
					
						Tang Ya is a key character in the 'Saintess has a showdown' plot. Following a showdown with Xu Sanshi and Beibei, she assists Wang Dong in returning Yuhao to their dormitory. She provides Yuhao with a Mystic Water Pill and joins him and Wang Dong at Yuhao's fish stall. She also stipulates that Wang Dong can only join the Tang Sect if he achieves the top rank in the freshman examination.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					How does Tang Ya's appearance reflect her character traits in Soul Land 2?
						
				
				
					
						In Soul Land 2, Tang Ya's appearance mirrors her personality changes. Initially bossy yet vulnerable when alone, she becomes cold and ruthless after joining the Holy Ghost Church. Her transformation into the Rakshasa God is marked by a green face, purple armor, and four giant sickle blades, reflecting her intense evil aura and aggression.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom

Appearance[]
She is a young lady, appearing to be around 15 to 16 years old, her very long black hair is tied into a ponytail behind her back, her whole body is covered in a light blue outfit that outlines her budding, and her delicate figure is filled with youthfulness. She has red phoenix eyes, her eyes are big but quick-witted, she has a slightly raised nose, and an almost perfect oval face which is beautifully delicate.
characters.appearance:
Tang Ya and Beibei come across Huo Yuhao near a stream while he is roasting fish. Tang Ya immediately taken by the smell, asks if he is willing to share and plops down alongside him eating the fish.

Following Huo Yuhao's departure, taken by him, decides to recruit him to Tang Sect and therefore sets after him after cleaning up to make sure he doesn't come to any harm. She is a bit distraught when she finds him unconscious following the battle with a spirit beast, but is relieved when he comes to. After Huo Yuhao regains consciousness, she invites him to join her clan and also offers him a position in the Shrek Academy which Huo Yuhao gladly accepts.

Along with Beibei and Huo Yuhao, she arrives at the Star Dou Forest looking for a Spirit Beast for her 3rd Spirit Ring. They encounter a Datura Snake and Beibei with Huo Yuhao's support subdues it, allowing her to get the last strike. She absorbs its Spirit Ring.

Following its absorption they set off to Shrek City, back to the Shrek Academy. On the way Tang Ya advises Yuhao to get into the Spirit Guidance Department. After giving him the necessary information they set off.

characters.introText:
Quick Answers
		
		
	
	
			
				
					What is the significance of Tang Yuehua's noble aura?
						
				
				
					
						The noble aura of Tang Yuehua, part of her innate domain called the Noble Circle, is a powerful force that eliminates all killing intent. It also bestows a noble aura upon those within its reach. This aura is a testament to her unparalleled proficiency in etiquette, art, culture, and other areas. It exudes a transcendent feel, akin to being in the presence of potent light and dragon power.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What is Tang Yuehua's passion and how does it influence her character?
						
				
				
					
						Tang Yuehua's passion lies in teaching, which shapes her character significantly. She is a protective figure, intervening to stop conflicts, as seen when she halted a fight between Tang San and Manager Aude. Her belief in her students' potential, such as Huo Yuhao, reflects her hope for the restoration of Tang Sect's former glory. Her passion extends to her leadership within the Tang Sect.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					How does Tang Yuehua respond to the murderous aura filling the Moon Pavilion?
						
				
				
					
						Tang Yuehua, upon detecting the murderous aura at the Moon Pavilion, intervenes in a conflict between Tang San and Manager Aude. She uses her innate domain to neutralize Tang San's murderous aura. After learning of Tang Hao's previous statements from an assistant, she becomes visibly shaken and approaches him in a trembling state.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What makes Tang Yuehua a unique character in her universe?
						
				
				
					
						Tang Yuehua is a character marked by a complex personality and intricate family relationships. She presents a cold exterior but harbors a warm heart, especially when it comes to family. Her family history is marked by her parents' divorce before her birth and a difficult relationship with her step-sibling, Yuanen Huihui. This lack of familial bonds from an early age and feelings of misplaced jealousy make her crave acknowledgment.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom

Appearance[]
Tang Yuehua is a very beautiful and elegant woman in her late twenties. But, her eyes seemed to see through everything in the world. Only Bibi Dong of the Martial Soul Hall can compare with her temperament alone.
characters.appearance:
She sensed the Deathgod Domain filling the Moon Pavilion and went to investigate the disturbance. She stopped the impending fight between Tang San and Manager Aude. She was shocked by the Soul Rings of Tang San's Blue Silver Emperor and overpowered his Deathgod Domain with her Noble Circle Domain. After learning from the receptionist about Tang Hao and Tang San, as well as the words Tang Hao had used, she rushed over and hugged Tang Hao, shocking everyone present. After crying for some time, she asked about Tang San and revealed that she was his aunt when he instinctively dodged her touch. She took Tang Hao and Tang San to the top floor of the Moon Pavilion and ordered everyone to keep the incident confidential. She and Tang Hao discussed Tang Xiao and the Clear Sky Clan. Tang Hao asked her to help Tang San, who had just returned from the Slaughter City, and to take him back to the Clear Sky Clan so he could acknowledge his ancestors. She then told Tang San that she would spend the next year teaching him etiquette to help him better control his abilities.

She told Tang San that her Soul Power was only at Level 9, but if Tang Hao had learned everything she knew, the outcome of the incident would have been different. She stated that Tang San needed to stabilize all of his abilities. A year later, during the Graduation Ceremony, she introduced Tang San as Tang Yin to Xue Qinghe as her nephew. She revealed that Xue Ke was interested in him and deduced that he already had someone else when he rejected her. She warned Tang San not to repeat Tang Hao's actions before letting him leave. She planned to return to the Clear Sky Castle to prepare for Tang San's arrival there.

Tang Hao asked her to help Tang San, who had just returned from the Slaughter City, and to take him back to the Clear Sky Clan so he could acknowledge his ancestors. She then told Tang San that she would spend the next year teaching him etiquette to help him better control his abilities.

She told Tang San that her Soul Power was only at Level 9, but if Tang Hao had learned everything she knew, the outcome of the incident would have been different. She stated that Tang San needed to stabilize all of his abilities. A year later, during the Graduation Ceremony, she introduced Tang San as Tang Yin to Xue Qinghe as her nephew. She revealed that Xue Ke was interested in him and deduced that he already had someone else when he rejected her. She warned Tang San not to repeat Tang Hao's actions before letting him leave. She planned to return to the Clear Sky Castle to prepare for Tang San's arrival there.

characters.personality: He cares a lot for his son. He wants nothing more than to see Tang Wulin live a happy life.
characters.history:
Tang Ziran went with Tang Wulin to the Awakening ceremony, the annual day when all six year old kids awaken their martial spirits, at Red Mountain Academy in Glorybound City. They waited outside until a teacher called Wulin's name. They followed the teacher inside the academy until they reached a circular building, the Awakening Chamber. Tang Ziran waited outside for Wulin to finish his ceremony. After that, they went home. He tried to cheer Tang Wulin up after he found that his spirit is Bluesilver Grass, but it backfired. During dinner, Tang Ziran and Lang Yue were surprised with Wulin's increased appetite.

The next day, Tang Ziran accompanied Tang Wulin to Red Mountain Academy and left for work. He returned home after work and went to see Wulin. He was surprised that Wulin was able to already grasp the art of mediation in one day when it usually takes awhile for spirit masters to do so. He talked to Wulin about the fight he got into to save Na'er, calling it reckless to charge in without thought when he knows he didn't have enough power to save others. They then discussed the matter of Na'er not having any record of family members. Tang Ziran asks Wulin what he wants to do regarding this matter. Wulin asks if Na'er can stay with them and Tang Ziran and Lang Yue agreed when Na'er accepted Wulin's offer to stay with them. After that, they ate dinner.

Tang Ziran told Wulin about the difficulties about being a spirit master, mainly getting a spirit soul since spirit souls cost a lot and with Ziran's wages, it'll be hard for him to buy a spirit soul for Tang Wulin, while having to feed a family of four with two kids that eat alot, so he created an opportunity for Wulin to study blacksmithing under Mang Tian in order to earn enough money to buy a spirit soul. I'll be up to Tang Wulin, weather he gets accepted as an apprentice or not.

After returning home from work the next day, Lang Yue wanted to talk to him in private. Lang Yue didn't want Wulin to work under Mang Tian after seeing him covered in bruises when she went to pickup Wulin from his first day at Mang Tian's workshop, but Tang Ziran managed to convince her otherwise. They returned to the living room, only to be dumbfound and shocked with the scene of Na'er feeding Wulin. Two beautiful children were sitting there beaming with an intense radiance. They officially adopted Na'er into the family.

In the dead of night, Tang Ziran sneaked into Wulin's and Na'er's room to rub ointment on the bruises Wulin got from working Mang Tian, only to discover that it was completely healed with no sign of a bruise being there in the first place.

Tang Wulin reaching rank 10

Tang Ziran was at home with Lang Yue and Na'er, when Tang Wulin came home, telling them that he saved enough money to buy a spirit soul. Tang Ziran congratulated Wulin. Early, the next morning, he found out Wulin made a breakthrough to level 10.

The next day, Tang Ziran took Wulin to the Spirit Pagoda in Glorybound City. They found out that Wulin only has enough to do the random spirit soul selection. All of Wulin's excitement was obliterated at that momment. Ziran suggested for Wulin to do the random spirit soul selection, since bluesilver grass's adaptability is very high and it should be able to fuse with most spirit souls.

If Tang Wulin didn’t have the martial soul of Bluesilver Grass, Tang Ziran might not have opted to take this risk. After hearing that there are defective spirit souls in the selection, Tang Ziran tried to convince Wulin to come back another day after they gathered enough funds to buy a ten year spirit soul, but Tang Wulin decided to do the selection. He waited in the lobby, while Wulin went to get his spirit soul. After returning, Ziran watched as Wulin opened the spirit soul ball containing his spirit soul. Tang Wulin got a defective spirit soul, a Grass Snake. Ziran felt terrible seeing Wulin devastated, no life in his eyes. They went home with the spirit soul.

Tang Ziran hugging Tang Wulin after he absorbed a spirit soul.

Ziran decided to accept a commission in order to get Tang Wulin a better spirit soul. Once he got back home, he found out from Na'er, Wulin was already fusing with the spirit soul. He stumbled a few steps backwards and collapsed into a chair. His expression changed in an instant as pain colored his face. The Federation coins in his hand falling on the table. After finding out its been 7 to 8 hours since Wulin started the fusion process, they went into the bedroom to check on Wulin. They saw him laying on the bed, his clothes soaked, and his brows creased. Two streams of tears flowed down his cheek as Tang Ziran tightly embraced his son. He felt incompetent.

An excited audience waiting for Wulin to show his spirit ring

In the evening, Tang Ziran, Lang Yue, Na'er, and Mang Tian entered the bedroom, after Tang Wulin woke up. Tang Ziran let out a sigh. The fusion was a success and Tang Wulin is now rank 11. Ziran decided not to tell Wulin, he had secured the money to buy him another spirit soul. Tang Ziran’s eyes finally regained some determination, seeing Wulin release his spirit. He was glad to know Wulin has promise in becoming a spirit master because of Wulin's spirit mutation and hearing Mang Tian explanation on the matter.

In the manhua, Tang Ziran was surprised to see Mang Tian and Long Ge inside the house. He suspected Mang Tian knows how to pick a lock. He brought popcorn to the demonstration. When Wulin released his spirit, he and Lang Yue started cheering and praising Wulin.

Lang Yue and Tang Wulin found out the next morning that Na'er disappeared, leaving a letter and a few items on her bed.

Tang Ziran goes to Mang Tian's workshop when Tang Wulin did not return home for so long. Tang Wulin was in the process of thousand refining a piece of heavy silver. Ziran stood outside of the forging room’s doorway and waited, just in time to see his son dripping with sweat.

This was the first time Tang Ziran saw his son forging. He did not expect his son to reach such a high level in forging, when he is only nine years old. Tang Ziran had met his fair share of master blacksmiths before, and now he could discern the aura of a master blacksmith coming from Tang Wulin!

Tang Ziran didn’t dare disturb him. An hour went by. As soon as Tang Wulin finished forging, Mang Tian cut Tang Wulin's wrist for blood to drop onto the heavy silver and bandaged the wound. Wulin collapsed onto the floor. Tang Ziran rushed into the room to hold him up. Wulin is already asleep. He carried Tang Wulin home on his back.

A day later, he and his wife stared speechlessly as Tang Wulin gorged himself on an entire fat chicken, along with a pot of chicken soup, 5 buns, and 2 plates of vegetables. In addition, it looks like he can eat more. He is eating his sixth bun. Lang Yue had to cook more dishes. After Tang Wulin finished eating, Tang Ziran inspected the wound on his son's wrist. The wound has already healed.

At Wulin's request, Tang Ziran took him to Mang Tian's workshop, even though it is already night time. Mang Tian greeted them at the entrance and lead them inside to Wulin's workshop. In the workshop was the piece of heavy silver Wulin thousand refined. When Mang Tian praised Wulin for his accomplishment, Tang Ziran looked at him in astonishment. He understood this old friend of his. With his personality, being able to praise someone with such high regard was something that happened rarely.

Tang Ziran made the decision to help his son as much as he can to continue on the path of a spirit master. Besides that, he had already accepted the commission. Tang Ziran and Lang Yue will not be able to see Tang Wulin for a long time.

After Tang Wulin graduated, Tang Ziran bought Tang Wulin a train ticket to Eastsea City to enroll at Eastsea Academy. They saw Tang Wulin off at the train station and left the Douluo Continent for Dou Ling Continent. Before leaving, he informed Mang Tian about the matter of him accepting a commission on Dou Ling Continent and handed a letter for him to give to Tang Wulin.

characters.title: Taotie
characters.introText: Taotie is the fifth of the nine sons of the Dragon God. It is also called the Earth Dragon King.
characters.appearance: It looks like a creature with a goat’s body, a human face, and a tiger’s teeth and claws. It has large eyes under its armpits. It appears surrounded by auspicious clouds.
characters.history:
The Dragon God had split, and turned into the Golden Dragon and Silver Dragon. They had inherited the physical and spiritual strength of the Dragon God, respectively.

Before the Dragon God split, he had had nine sons, who had also inherited part of his abilities and bloodline. Among them, there was the ancestor of the Earth Dragons, and the chief of the Flying Dragons, while there were those who entered deep valleys and slept in volcanoes.

The Dragon God’s nine sons weren’t able to procreate. However, they were very strong once. When the Golden and Silver Dragon Kings were still young, they had once led the dragons to rule the Douluo Continent.

However, they passed away one by one, and their bloodlines were partially passed down to future generations.

The rule of dragons stopped when the Golden Dragon King died accidentally, and the Silver Dragon King disappeared, leaving the dragons leaderless. The spirit beasts that they ruled started a rebellion and overthrew them.

However, even until this day, humans and spirit beasts still recognized dragons as immensely strong. Human historians still believed that the dragons’ rule did not stop because of how strong the rebelling spirit beasts were. Rather, it was because of some issues with the passing down of their bloodlines.

The Taotie bloodline passed from generation to generation until the Taotie Douluo, Xuan Zi.

They were found by the Purple Pearl Pirates drifting in the ocean and  were brought to Purple Pearl Island where they were tied to a pole and exposed to sunlight to remove the ice poison. As the process of exposure to sun was too slow, Tang San used the Neidan to instantly warm the Shrek Seven Devils and Bai Chenxinag and removed the ice posion.

Third Elder is the shortest elder among the Clear Sky Clan's first generation elders who always appears to be floating.

He has explosive scarlet hair accompanied by a bored face. He wears a red and scarlet cloak that goes up to his noes, covering his mouth.
characters.history:
The elders prevented Tang San from being inducted into the clan, and he recognized the Deathgod Domain when Tang San used it. He was surprised that Tang San had already reached Level 59 at the age of 20. He was shocked to learn that Tang San possessed Twin Martial Souls and witnessed him confirm it by activating the Clear Sky Hammer.

He was shocked by the ease with which Tang San defeated Tang Hu and admitted that Tang San had earned his arrogance. He was stunned by the implications of the Soul Bones sent back to the clan by Tang Hao. He heard the general circumstances regarding Tang San and his Soul Bones from Tang Yuehua, causing his attitude toward Tang San to become softer.

He witnessed the entire battle and was speechless upon seeing Tang San fly back to the main courtyard.

He became displeased when Tang San asked about paying respects to the late Patriarch. He agreed with the Second Elder's proposed tasks and rewards for Tang San.

The Elders were shocked when Tang San revealed that the 6th Soul Ring of his Blue Silver Emperor was a 100,000+ years Level Soul Ring, so they agreed to let Lou Gao remain in Clear Sky Castle as Tang San's guest. They also approved teaching the Clear Sky Nine Absolutes to Tang San.

The Elders were convened by Tang Xiao at Tang San’s request. They became angered when Tang San berated the Clan by criticizing its current reputation on the Continent. They were shocked when Tang San easily defended against the Seventh Elder’s attack.

The Elders were angered and surprised when Tang San defeated the Seventh Elder’s Twin Clear Sky Avatars using only a Soul Bone Ability. They accepted Tang San’s challenge with the intention of testing his full capabilities and were shocked to see the Soul Rings of his Blue Silver Emperor. They were restrained and injured by Tang San during the battle.

The Elders were defeated by Tang San without being able to attack. They were surprised when Tang San presented Tang Chen’s token, which symbolized the position of the Clan’s Grand Elder. They bowed to Tang Chen’s token following the Second Elder. The Elders were uncomfortable upon learning that Tang Chen had opposed the decision to seclude the Clan and saddened to hear that he would not return. They unanimously agreed to make Tang San the Grand Elder of the Clan. They also agreed to Tang Hao’s return to the Clan and to return the Soul Bones he had previously extracted. They accompanied Tang Hao and Tang San when they paid their respects to the previous Patriarch.

The Elders were shocked to learn about the situation on the Continent and that Bibi Dong had already reached Level 99. They decided to prepare the Clan to end its seclusion and for a Continental War. They witnessed Tang San restore Tang Hao’s limbs to their peak state by replanting the Soul Bones.

characters.introText: He was a Level 96 Peak Douluo with the martial soul White Armored Dragon, and the fourth and fifth worship were blocked by the level 97 Tang Xiao, unable to rush out of the city gate. In the Battle of the Two Gods, he was severely injured by a 96-level Xiao Wu when she used the Peacock Feather Plume in the battle of the two gods, and was subsequently killed by Xiao Wu's spirit skill before he could fight back.
characters.history:
He was a Level 96 Peak Douluo with the martial soul White Armored Dragon, and the fourth and fifth worship were blocked by the level 97 Tang Xiao, unable to rush out of the city gate. In the Battle of the Two Gods, he was severely injured by a 96-level Xiao Wu when she used the Peacock Feather Plume in the battle of the two gods, and was subsequently killed by Xiao Wu's spirit skill before he could fight back.

He was a Level 97 Green Luan Douluo who first appeared in episode 236 of the Donghua, where he arrived with his, Golden Crocodile Douluo, Mighty Lion Douluo, Glowing Feather Douluo, Falling Devil Douluo and Fifteen Ton Douluo as a backup to assist the defeated Bibi Dong in defending Jialing Pass on the orders of Qian Daoliu. He used his 8th ability to battle against Chen Xin in attempt to distract and stall him, so that Glowing Feather Douluo may attack the main army of Heaven Dou Empire with no obstacles. After Glowing Feather Douluo's attack was stopped by Tang Xiao, he and Mighty Lion Douluo joined Glowing Feather Douluo to attack Tang Xiao, who relied on the Clear Sky Formation, the Clear Sky Nine Absolutes and the Disorder Splitting Wind Hammer techniques to stall them. He, Mighty Lion Douluo and Glowing Feather Douluo retreated after sensing Golden Crocodile Douluo's defeat at Tang Hao's hands. He along with the rest of the priests then ordered Bibi Dong to retreat to Spirit City, with the aim to wait out Qian Renxue's arrival post ascension.

He along with the rest of the priests confronted Bibi Dong after she returned to the Jialing Pass with Yue Guan and Gui Mei as zombies. Together with the rest of the priests were presented the possibility of Qian Daoliu's resurrection by Bibi Dong after she became a god. The priests then resumed the war the next day to fuel the portal to the Rakshasa God's inheritance plane, with him confronting Ma Hongjun but was evenly matched due to the latter's superior Martial Soul.

He supported Glowing Feather Douluo to the ramparts of the Jialing Pass when Tang San returned as the Asura Demigod and used a strike to kill Jiang Long and Jiang Jun. He along with the other remaining priests survived the aftermath of the final battle.
characters.trivia: In the Novel and Live Action, he is known as Sacred Dragon Douluo due to his Sacred Dragon Martial Soul, however in the Donghua, he is known as Azure Luan Douluo as his Martial Soul is the Azure Luan.

characters.introText: The Thorn Dragon is a rare Dragon Spirit Beast, which is unusually formidable. It not only has a formidable attack power, but also controls Space element. In term of speed, it is extremely quick and it's a descendent of the Speed Dragon.
characters.appearance:
It's a slender beast. It looks very strange. It's full of spikes. It's about four meters long. Its hind legs are on the ground. Its spikes are all presented as black. But its eyes are strangely silver. The skin under the black spikes is also silver.

A tail is three meters long which indicates his 30.000 years. With this tail in mind, its overall length is more than seven meters.
characters.history: Thorn Dragon used to live in the Elven Planet. It chose Liu Feng and became his Spirit Soul because of the Space Element and White Dragon King bloodline.

characters.title: Three Eyed Golden Lion
characters.introText: The Three Eyed Golden Lion used to live in the Great Star Dou Forest. This soul beast had a very beautiful bright golden fur, and its body seemed semi-transparent; it gave off a very special feel. Its body was shaped like a lion, but its claws were that of a dragon. There were even golden flames coming off its dragon claws. Its mouth was longer than that of usual lion-type soul beasts, and there were fine golden scales beneath its fur. The most peculiar thing about the three eyed golden lion is that, it had a vertical slit on its forehead where its third eye rested. Its two ordinary eyes were gold, but its third vertical eye emitted a bewitching red glow.

characters.introText: The Thunder Hell Prison Vine was a creature born with wisdom and known as the strongest plant-type spirit beast. There’s a saying that the Thunder Hell Prison Vine was a plant that had the Thunder God’s bloodline. It’s the true destroyer of the plant world. It was the nemesis of the Emerald Demon Bird.
characters.appearance: At birth, it was like a bamboo shoot with a single segment. As it grew, they became scores of vines. Unlike the Blue Silver Emperor vines, these dark purple vines were segmented like bamboos.
characters.history:
According to the legends, there was a 1st class god called the Thunder God before the Divine Realm disappeared. Thunder God had fallen in one of the Divine Realm wars and dropped onto our Douluo Continent. Plants like the Thunder Hell Prison Vine had only made their appearances after that incident.

There had never been a 100,000 year cultivation base Thunder Hell Prison Vine recorded in history. The reason why it wasn’t able to cultivate to a hundred thousand years is that it might really reawaken its Thunder God bloodline once it cultivated to that level. It might even be able to continue growing without the threat from divine punishment. The plane wouldn't allow this to happen. Hence, it had been suppressing the Thunder Hell Prison Vine all this while. They weren’t allowed to live for more than fifty thousand years.

Once the Thunder Hell Prison Vine attained a certain level of cultivation, its destructive power was extremely terrifying. It created a huge lightning pool whereby it expanded and strengthened itself until it devoured everything around it.

characters.personality: He is very calm and patient and has great intelligence. He is also very lazy but is determined and funny.
characters.history:
As Huo Yuhao comes to the outskirts of the Star Dou Forest, he senses his presence and comes to him at once. He introduces himself and immediately begins the process of becoming his Spirit Ring while separating his power into 10 balls of light and sealing them away until he is strong enough to use them.

After becoming successful in his process, he tells Yuhao his history, recruiting him to take revenge for the atrocities committed to him in the past. He becomes a conscious Spirit Ring, advising Yuhao. He also gives him a second spirit, which is Ultimate Ice. He then goes to sleep, occasionally giving advise to Yuhao during the timespan.

When a person wearing a red mask attacks Yuhao and Wang Dong, he helps them by taking over Yuhao's body and counterattacking with an ice attribute skill. At the same time he notice Yuhao's body constitution improvement and comments that he can give Yuhao more power. After Yuhao regains his conscious, he tells Yuhao that due to his improvement he will be able to release the 1st of his ten seals but advises him not to get into any trouble since he will not be able to help out for a year, having had depleted much of his energy stopping the masked person.

After team Yuhao defeated team Huang Chutian, Yuhao and Wang Dong tried to perform Spirit Fusion. Daydream then went in and told them they are 100% compatible with each other for a triple essence fusion.

He appeared and became a spirit soul of Huo Zhanji.
characters.trivia:
He once saw a Scorpion Spirit Beast (Ice Empress) and fell in love with her.

He was the first one from his species to reach 100,000 years.

He didn’t undergo any Heavenly Tribulation until he reached one million years.

He was detained and his Heaven and Earth Origin Energy was absorbed for over ten thousand years by many 100,000 years spirit beasts in the Great Star Dou Forest, including Di Tian and the Golden Tortoise.

It should be Huo Yuhao that gave Tian Meng to his son Huo Zhanji as a spirit soul to ensure his son’s safety.

characters.appearance:
It seems a wild cat with a small frame, only two feet long. Its fur was greenish-black, while its eyes were purplish-red. Its fur had a pattern similar to that of a tiger’s, while the hues of the fur were unbalanced.

Seeing as its fur is greenish-black, its must have around two thousand years worth of cultivation at the very least. A Deviltiger Cat’s fur will turn completely black and show lustrous green glimmering patterns once it reaches ten thousand years worth of cultivation.

The Deviltiger Cat’s fur suddenly turned emerald-green, and a green radiance immediately expanded outwards. This expansion wasn’t forceful, and only reached about a foot from it, but it appeared as if the Deviltiger Cat’s entire body was also expanding. It was initially a little more than a meter long, but as its entire sparkled with green light, it grew to the point where it was now more than two meters long. It also looked burlier than before, as if it were an actual fearsome tiger. Even the purring sounds from its mouth became more like a tiger’s roar.

characters.title: Titan Giant Ape
characters.introText: The name Titan, in the Douluo Continent’s ancient era, represented the God of Earth. The Titan Giant Ape, by another name, was the Child of Earth. This was also an important reason why the Titan Giant Ape could become the forest king, become a peak level spirit beast. So then, Blue Silver Emperor most controlled all blue silver grass, and as long as it was on the ground, the Titan Giant Ape could control the strongest force. The difference between them wasn’t easy to see.
characters.appearance: Its muscles were even tougher than granite. Even though it was such an enormous animal, it didn’t make any noise while walking, not even the sound of breathing. Titan Giant Ape had tyrannical attack and defense. Although its body was enormous, its speed was still extremely terrifying. The eyes were one of its rare weaknesses.
characters.history:
The Titan Giant Ape and the Diamond Baboon were mortal enemies. In ancient times, Diamond Baboons were subservient to Titan Giant Apes. Titan Giant Apes were individually stronger than Diamond Baboons, but the baboons far outnumbered their lords, and one day, an exceptionally intelligent Diamond Baboon was born. With a leader to rally them, the Diamond Baboons rose up against the Titan Giant Apes. The resulting rebellion led to many losses on both sides and started a war between the two races that rocked the world of soul beasts. Titan Giant Apes were peak-level soul beasts, while Diamond Baboons only fell slightly short of them. A war between such powerhouses shocked the heavens as well!

This war continued for hundreds of years until the Titan Giant Apes paid a steep price to kill that intelligent Diamond Baboon. Without a leader, the Diamond Baboons collapsed. Yet the Titan Giant Apes paid dearly for their victory. A great number of them died because of the war, and they lost their position as one of the ruling factions in the world of soul beasts. Although they still held onto their power as kings of the forest, they no longer acted as boldly as before. Anyone well-versed in soul beast history knew of the grudge between these two races. Saying that this grudge ran as deep as the sea would be an understatement!

Even back when soul beasts littered the land, Titan Giant Apes and Diamond Baboons would be at each other’s throats the moment they laid eyes on each other. Diamond Baboons knew they couldn’t kill the Titan Giant Apes, but they would rather die trying.

characters.appearance:
Titanohippo is a spirit beast with a massive body; it is over 5 meters wide and 1.8 meters tall. It is plump with a huge head and a tiny tail. Its eyes are on both sides of his head which shake as it walks.

A gigantic and shockingly strong spirit beast which is also particularly gentle; it wouldn’t lose its temper even if a few smaller spirit beasts play around it. Also, it is a herbivore and likes water the most; it could swim faster in water than run on land and its favorite thing to do is to sleep.

Due to its large size, extraordinary strength and exceptionally thick skin, it doesn’t have any enemy. Among the spirit beasts, it is just like a typical person who tries not to offend anyone. Even those spirit beasts that are way stronger than it wouldn’t find trouble with it. There are many parasites on the Hippo’s body and carnivores don’t like that — it would cause them stomach aches easily.

Although it has a huge size and moves slowly, it has survived against many carnivorous beasts. Aside from its thick and coarse exterior, it possesses other means of deterrence. It is mostly herbivore but it could eat and digest meat in desperate times. Its innate ability is to devour and wield terrifying sucking abilities. Its gigantic mouth is large enough to devour half a Nether Wolf without a problem.

					What role does Tong Yu play in the Battle of Five Gods?
						
				
				
					
						Tong Yu represented the Star Luo Empire in the Battle of Five Gods, facing Tang Wulin in the third match, a Soul Battle of Soul Ring skills. Imprisoned for thirty-seven years at Monster Academy, Tong Yu showcased his nine hundred thousand year rings. His distinct appearance, with red and blue eyes and five colored scales, resulted from a spirit mutation.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					How does Tong Yu seek redemption for his past actions?
						
				
				
					
						Tong Yu seeks redemption by giving En Ci a five-colored pearl, a vital item from his cultivation. He does not seek forgiveness, recognizing their relationship as irreparable, but hopes En Ci can live without enmity and find happiness. Despite his despair, this act shows Tong Yu's wish to atone for past wrongs.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What is the significance of Tong Yu's quintessential item?
						
				
				
					
						Tong Yu's quintessential item is a five-colored pearl, symbolizing a lifetime of cultivation. He gave it to En Ci to alleviate past pain, hoping En Ci could live without enmity and find happiness, despite their irreconcilable relationship.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What impact did Tong Yu's actions have on Yu Tong?
						
				
				
					
						Tong Yu's actions deeply affected Yu Tong. Tong Yu, in despair after a personal rejection, attempted suicide by consuming poison. This act of desperation and his ongoing regret strained his relationship with Yu Tong. Tong Yu's inability to reconcile his past mistakes left a lasting impact on Yu Tong, creating a complex and troubled dynamic between them.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					How is Tong Yu connected to Tang Wulin?
						
				
				
					
						Tong Yu is linked to Tang Wulin through Tang Zi Ran, Wulin's father. Tong Yu sought Tang Zi Ran on the Douluo continent but found he had vanished years prior. During this search, he discovered Tang Wulin is the Tang Sect Leader and met Mang Tian, a blacksmith, who provided insights into Wulin's past.

characters.title: Tree Monster
characters.introText: The Tree Monster, a kind of spirit beast, is relatively common in the Star Dou Forest. With so many dense towering trees, the probability of cultivating wisdom is still quite high. Compared to animal-type spirit beasts, plant-type spirit beasts found it more difficult to survive. They grew slower than animal-type spirit beasts when they were young. Generally speaking, plant-type spirit beasts had to reach a thousand-year cultivation before they could protect themselves, whereas animal-type spirit beasts already possessed fighting strength at a ten-year cultivation.

characters.history:
Wan Yunchao was in the same class as Tang Wulin at Red Mountain Academy. When his martial spirit awakened, his innate spirit power was five.

Wan Yunchao happened to be beside Tang Wulin during class. When he found out Tang Wulin's spirit was Bluesilver Grass, he insulted and walked away. He told Wulin that his spirit is a knife and he is at rank 5.

From that day on, he looked down on Tang Wulin. One day, when he tried bullying Tang Wulin, he had the tables turned on him, and was instead pushed onto the floor by Tang Wulin and beaten senseless. Since that day, Wan Yunchao was well behaved and became Tang Wulin's shadow.

Wan Yunchao informed Tang Wulin that a classmate named Zhou Shao just broke through rank 10 and remained him, it will be hard to enter an intermediate academy without a recommendation letter, which will only be given to those who broke through rank 10.

Wan Yunchao challenged Tang Wulin to a battle in the grove next to the academy. He showed off his spirit ability, Knife Tip, and demonstrated it by cutting a tree sapling. This upset Tang Wulin, making him unleash his spirit and using the bluesilver grass as whips, he beginning whipping Wan Yunchao.

When the two individuals left the forest, out of the two it was Wan Yunchao who looked the most pathetic. His entire body was riddled with numerous lash marks. Tang Wulin had to support him. He asked Wulin why he was unable to beat him. He replied, saying that their teacher, Lin Ximeng told him, he suited for becoming an agility system spirit master, but Wan Yunchao was so fat that he was not agile. He then asked why he couldn't hack apart Tang Wulin's bluesilver grass. Tang Wulin told him, he would not be able to until all his spirit power is depleted. This caused Wan Yunchao to declare that he will lose weight. Wulin asked him what he's going to eat tonight. Yunchao responded with pork shoulder. Tang Wulin then escorted him home.

characters.introText: Wu Bingji is the eldest brother of the Redemption Academy. He is the oldest of all students and has the highest cultivation. Wu Bingji is responsible for managing the task list issued by the Redemption College and releasing tasks to other students. At the same time, Wu Bingji also undertakes the task of accompanying Tang San inside and outside the college and protecting Tang San's wholeness.
characters.appearance: Wu Bingji is a young man who is thin and tall, with a little bookishness and handsome. His voice is very beautiful, as if there is no fireworks. Obviously, he practiced the control of ice but not half cold, which is easy to make people have a good impression of him.
characters.personality: Wu Bingji not only has a calm and quiet personality, but also is gentle and elegant. He often has a faint smile on his face and is not arrogant in front of his juniors and sisters, which can reflect his style as a big brother. He is also very modest, and will not have negative emotions because his strength is not as good as that of people younger than himself. He sometimes shows the side of a money fan and miser. Although he loves money, he is not greedy for money. When danger comes, he is willing to sacrifice himself to cover his companions to retreat.
characters.history:
Tang San came to the first practical class after Redemption College and had a practical competition with Wu Bingji and other original students. Wu Bingji, as the finale of the most cultivated student at that time, ended the battle with Tang San. Although Wu Bingji's cultivation was higher than that of Tang San, his ability to control elements was much weaker than that of Tang San. The two were evenly matched and fell into a bitter battle. In the battle, Tang San tried to compress and control a special wind blade with strong attack power. In a hurry, the nine ice shields of the Wubingji were superimposed to defend with all his strength. Fortunately, after the first eight ice shields were broken, he relied on the ninth ice shield to block Tang San's attack, but it almost exhausted his strength. In the absence of Tang San's best and taking the initiative to admit defeat, Wu Bingji won the competition, but Wu Bingji also realized his shortcomings, so he later proposed to Tang San to ask him for element control.

Under the guidance of Tang San, Wu Bingji Maosai suddenly opened up and got great inspiration. Later, Wu Bingji received further guidance from Tang San, thus peeping at the essence of ice element. In the following practical class, Wu Bingji, who made a breakthrough, proposed to have another actual combat with Tang San to test the results of his feelings in the past few days. Compared with the last competition, Wu Bingji and Tang San have been greatly improved. The fighting rhythm between them is very fast. Both sides do their best, and the outbreak is very fierce. After a fierce collision, at Tang San's suggestion, the competition ended in a draw.

At Tang San's proposal, Wu Bingji, Tang San, his hometown, Cheng Zicheng and Du Bai teamed up to take over the task of hunting the winged tiger, and Wu Bingji served as the captain of the team. On the way, the five-person team was attacked by monsters many times. Under the command of Tang San, Wu Bingji gave full play to his combat effectiveness. Everyone easily killed the enemy and gained a lot. After that, everyone successfully hunted and killed a sixth-order winged tiger with tacit cooperation. However, when the five people could not evacuate, the parents of the sixth-order winged tiger, a nine-order winged tiger king and a seventh-order winged tiger appeared in front of everyone. Zhang Haoxuan, who secretly followed the protection of the five people, resisted the ninth-order winged tiger king, but he had no time to take care of the other seventh-order winged tiger. The five people were in a life-and-death crisis. Under the scolding of Wu Bingji and Tang San, Cheng Zicheng and Du Bai fled first, and Wu Bingji, Tang San and his hometown left behind. Tang San was forced to use his hidden strength. Wu Bingji and Du Bai burst out with all their strength to fight to the death, so that Tang San found an opportunity to go deep into the tiger's mouth and launched an attack from the inside out in the seventh-order winged tiger, successfully killing the seventh-order winged tiger. On the other side, under Zhang Haoxuan's attack, the ninth-order winged tiger king was severely damaged and escaped. After this battle, Wu Bingji was seriously injured. Under Zhang Haoxuan's treatment, his injury barely stabilized, and then was carried back to the college by Tang San and Cheng Zicheng on a stretcher. This mission earned Wu Bingji's five people a lot of income and took out some monster meat and bones to nourish the health of the students of the Redemption Academy.

Appearance[]
Wu Feng is a girl with a head of short, fiery red hair. Her eyes are a rare shade of red as well. She seems rather scary at a glance, however, one can see that her features are extremely delicate if observed more carefully. Even her skin is white as jade. However, her glance was extremely cold, enough to be compared to Zhou Yi.
characters.appearance:
Wu Feng is a student of Mu Jin, member of Class 9 and Team Ning Tian in the freshmen exam. She first appeared in the battle against Team Yuhao in round 32. When her teammates stared with wonder at Wang Dong's Goddess Butterfly spirit, she scoffed, saying it was useless to be just pretty. She declared her own spirit beautiful and strong, and clashed fiercely with her opponents. Despite being supported by a member of the Nine Treasure Glazed Tile Clan, she was eventually defeated by Huo Yuhao and Wang Dong's incredible teamwork combinations. 
After the fight, she begged Ning Tian to use her clan's power to take revenge against their opponents, but was turned down because they lost due to their own weakness, and had to take responsibility.

After the tournament, Wu Feng challenged Huo Yuhao to a battle over his position as class president. She called him an embarrassment to the academy in front of the entire class, because of his single 10 year Spirit Ring. Most of the class agreed, and their teacher decided to host the match.

During the battle, Yuhao kept his eyes closed, relying on his spirit eyes ability to dodge her furious close range attacks by a hair. He dodged neatly, and counterattacked by kicking Wu Feng in the butt, sending her fury to maximum levels.

Yuhao was able to get behind her again, and blast the small of her back with condensed spirit power. She declared she'd kill him then and there for daring to be the first one to touch her butt. Enraged, she cloaked herself with fire, making it nearly impossible for Yuhao to avoid all heat damage in close combat.

Yuhao desperately tried to counterattack, accidentally grabbing Wu Feng's skirt and flipping it up in the process. He claimed he saw nothing, but Wu Feng called him a bastard and kicked him in the face. Her killing intent almost made the referee stop the match entirely, but Yuhao was able to stop her fire with his mental shock abilities. Wu Feng didn't stop, attacking with a powerful headbutt instead, sending Yuhao flying.

She stands over his body, declaring she'd be his enemy forever and challenge him every day until the school expelled him entirely. To her shock, Yuhao is able to stand again, and the look in his eyes sent chills down her spine.

Yuhao unlocks a new ability with the help of the Daydream Ice Worm, and unleashes such a powerful mental stabbing attack Wu Feng collapses on spot, after his aura made her fear for her very life.

After the tournament, Wu Feng challenged Huo Yuhao to a battle over his position as class president. She called him an embarrassment to the academy in front of the entire class, because of his single 10 year Spirit Ring. Most of the class agreed, and their teacher decided to host the match.

During the battle, Yuhao kept his eyes closed, relying on his spirit eyes ability to dodge her furious close range attacks by a hair. He dodged neatly, and counterattacked by kicking Wu Feng in the butt, sending her fury to maximum levels.

Yuhao was able to get behind her again, and blast the small of her back with condensed spirit power. She declared she'd kill him then and there for daring to be the first one to touch her butt. Enraged, she cloaked herself with fire, making it nearly impossible for Yuhao to avoid all heat damage in close combat.

Yuhao desperately tried to counterattack, accidentally grabbing Wu Feng's skirt and flipping it up in the process. He claimed he saw nothing, but Wu Feng called him a bastard and kicked him in the face. Her killing intent almost made the referee stop the match entirely, but Yuhao was able to stop her fire with his mental shock abilities. Wu Feng didn't stop, attacking with a powerful headbutt instead, sending Yuhao flying.

She stands over his body, declaring she'd be his enemy forever and challenge him every day until the school expelled him entirely. To her shock, Yuhao is able to stand again, and the look in his eyes sent chills down her spine.

Yuhao unlocks a new ability with the help of the Daydream Ice Worm, and unleashes such a powerful mental stabbing attack Wu Feng collapses on spot, after his aura made her fear for her very life.

During the time Tang San was undergoing his exam as Jin Miaolin, he inspired all of the emperor pillars on parliament mountain, which drawled the attention of the emperors within the ancestral court. The Endless Emperor and the other emperors went to the parliament mountain to see the situation. After Tang San finished the baptism, the emperors tried examine him with their divine sense, but found nothing except his rich life energy.

After Tang San passed the exam, all the spirit emperors discussed Tang San's proposal of making the blue gold tree clan a natural clan.

He was the referee in the match of Mei Gongzi in the Batting of the Emperors. He stopped her Asura Sword Attack but didn’t use his full strength that caused him to be severely injured.

After Tang San and Mei Gongzi became emperors, they challenged all the existing emperors. He fought against Tang San but couldn’t stop his attack and was killed by one shot.

characters.history:
Wu Yuhan, Bi Ran and Lei Jun participated in the Skysea Tournament. They entered the team competition as a team of three and made it to the round-robin round of the competition. Their first opponents in the round were class zero, Tang Wulin, Gu Yue, and Xie Xie, from Eastsea Academy. 
As soon as the match started, Bi Ran charged toward class zero with Wu Yuhan and Lei Jun behind him on his left and right respectively maintaining their triangle formation. As soon as they saw Tang Wulin with a purple spirit ring, they decided to launched a pincer attack on him. Yuhan activated his first soul skill. His body transformed and lightning launched out of him toward Tang Wulin. Strands of grass shot at Wu Yuhan in an effort to bind his transformed body. Yuhan was the first to clash with Tang Wulin. Facing his variant Bluesilver Grass, he dared not be careless.

With this in mind, Wu Yuhan did not hesitate to activate his second soul skill. Electricity exploded from his body to form a spherical aura of lightning around him and repelled the Bluesilver Grass. Without the grass in his way, Wu Yuhan lunged at Tang Wulin. At that moment, however, one vine among the many brightened as gold color seeped into its veins. It swerved around the electric barrier, circling the perimeter and quickly tightened, breaking through the lightning to bind Wu Yuhan. Xie Xie then appeared him and attacked Yuhan with his Light Dragon Storm. The referee had to protect Wu Yuhan from the unnoticed Light Dragon Storm. He was then eliminated from the match. The referee called an end to the match with victory going to class zero since Lei Jun was incapacitated and Bi Ran was struggling to endure Tang Wulin's attacks.

characters.introText: Xian Lin'er, titled the Martial God Douluo, is a Rank 96 Super Douluo, Class 8 Soul Engineer, senior elder of Shrek Academy, and former Dean of the Spirit Guidance Department. She is the daughter of Elder Song, the wife of Qian Duoduo, and one of Mu En's disciples. She possesses the Azure Flame Dragon, a rare mutated Wind-attributed dragon martial soul whose distinctive azure-green energy resembles flames while being formed from highly compressed air.
characters.appearance:
Xian Lin'er is approximately 1.7 meters tall and appears to be a woman in her early fifties despite already being more than eighty years old. She has fair skin and retains an elegant, mature appearance that still reflects the beauty of her youth.

In the novel, she has black hair neatly arranged behind her head and wears white clothing trimmed with gold, giving her a capable and experienced appearance. The donghua likewise depicts her with black hair, while the manhua portrays her with green hair. Her eyes are blue in the donghua.
characters.personality:
Xian Lin'er is direct, forceful, competitive, and hot-tempered. She favors decisive action and possesses an aggressive combat style centered on close-range attacks, spear techniques, and the overwhelming offensive power of her Azure Flame Dragon.

She is deeply devoted to Shrek Academy and takes considerable pride in both traditional soul-master cultivation and Soul Engineering. As Dean of the Spirit Guidance Department, she strongly supported the development of Soul Tools and frequently clashed with Yan Shaozhe over the competing priorities of the Spirit Guidance and Martial Soul Departments.

Xian Lin'er and Yan Shaozhe were romantically involved during their youth before separating. She later married Qian Duoduo. Their marriage initially remained largely nominal, but their relationship deepened during the Beast Tide after Qian Duoduo protected her in battle and openly expressed his feelings.
characters.history:
Xian Lin'er first appears during the dispute between the Martial Soul and Spirit Guidance Departments concerning Huo Yuhao. As Dean of the Spirit Guidance Department, she strongly supports Huo Yuhao's development as a Soul Engineer and opposes Yan Shaozhe's attempts to claim him exclusively for the Martial Soul Department.

She remains heavily involved in the development of Shrek Academy's Spirit Guidance Department and participates in major decisions as a member of the Sea God Pavilion.

During the journey back to Shrek Academy following events in the Sun Moon Empire, Xian Lin'er confronts the evil soul master Zhang Peng. Their battle displays the unusual properties of her Azure Flame Dragon, whose azure-green energy is produced from highly compressed Wind power and possesses powerful splitting and decomposition effects. She combines these abilities with a Class 8 close-range Soul Tool spear, reflecting her preference for integrating Soul Tools directly into close combat.

During the Beast Tide, Xian Lin'er continued serving as Dean of the Spirit Guidance Department while Xuan Ziwen served as its Executive Vice-Dean. She participated directly in Shrek Academy's defense and fought alongside its other senior experts.

Xian Lin'er was later appointed commander of the Tang Sect Soul Engineer Legion, with Qian Duoduo serving as deputy commander. The elite legion consisted of two hundred powerful soul masters and initially included ten Titled Douluos provided by Shrek Academy.

As the continental war intensified, Xian Lin'er continued participating in Shrek Academy's military preparations and major operations while advancing her cultivation.

Xuan Ziwen later succeeded her as Dean of the Spirit Guidance Department. Xian Lin'er continued serving as an elder of Shrek Academy and the Sea God Pavilion, while also commanding the Tang Sect Soul Engineer Legion.

					What is the significance of Xiao Bai's role as the guardian of the Sea God Island?
						
				
				
					
						Xiao Bai, the Demon Spirit Great White Shark Queen, holds the crucial role of Sea God Island's guardian and the former Sea God Poseidon's mount. As the leader of her clan, she ensures the island's tranquility. She is the Sea Woman Douluo's chosen student and the successor of the Seven Children of the Sea God. Besides her guardianship, Xiao Bai supports and accompanies Oscar throughout his journey.

					How does Xiao Bai's appearance differ when she is in her human form versus her shark form?
						
				
				
					
						Xiao Bai, in her human form, is a tall woman comparable in height to Tang San, with a well-defined physique highlighted by her white leather clothing. Her long, grey-blue hair falls down her back. As a Demon Spirit Great White Shark, she is more than forty meters long, possessing a slender dragon tail and short wings, inadequate for flight. Her transformation also includes a change in hair and eye color from dark blue to sky blue.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					Who is the former Sea God Poseidon that Xiao Bai serves as a mount for?
						
				
				
					
						Xiao Bai, the leader of the Demon Spirit Great White Shark Clan, is the mount of the former Sea God Poseidon. Poseidon met Tang San via the Vast Sea Cosmic Shroud, and chose him as his successor. Tang San assumed the role of Sea God after successfully completing the Sea God Trials.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What is the history of the Demon Spirit Great White Shark Clan led by Xiao Bai?
						
				
				
					
						The Demon Spirit Great White Shark Clan, led by Xiao Bai, is a group of oceanic Spirit Beasts known for their speed and tracking skills. They are one of the top three sea overlords, albeit the weakest after the Demonic Whales and Evil Spirit Orcas. For over 100,000 years, they have protected the Seagod Island. Xiao Bai, a 100,000-year-old Demon Spirit Great White Shark Queen, serves as the island's guardian and was the mount of the former Sea God Poseidon.

characters.personality:
She was the main obstacle of the 2nd Trial of the Shrek Seven Monsters and was tasked with preventing them from reaching the outer shore of the Ring Sea. She blasted Tang San out of the Ring Sea after he repelled the school of 1,000+ years Arrow Fish Sea Beasts. She then blasted both Tang San and Dai Mubai out of the Ring Sea within 5 minutes during their second attempt.

She rushed to the shore of the Sea God Mountain, transformed into Human Form, and observed Xiao Wu's body, recognizing her as a Soft Boned Rabbit. She became furious when she realized that Xiao Wu's Soul was with Tang San and attacked without hesitation, thinking he had not only assimilated her Soul Ring and Soul Bone but also enslaved her Soul. The Shrek Seven Monsters, apart from Xiao Wu, jointly defended against her attacks before she was stopped by a projection of the Sea God Trident appearing behind Tang San. After Xiao Wu resolved the misunderstanding, she told the Shrek Seven Monsters that she would not go easy on them to prevent them from reaching the outer shore of the Ring Sea. She also informed them of her name and that 100,000+ years Sea Soul Beasts could temporarily transform into Human Form, along with the associated limitations, before leaving.

She sparred with the Shrek Seven Monsters, except for Ma Hongjun, and Bai Chenxiang for the next 3 months to increase their combat experience. She formed a light friendship with Ning Rongrong and Zhu Zhuqing, but remained the target of Xiao Wu's anger. She specifically targeted Oscar for making fun of her nickname.

She observed Ma Hongjun digesting the Inner Core of the Ten Headed Fierce Yang Serpent and felt bloodline suppression. She had informed Tang San of the best possible method to revive Xiao Wu, leading him to give the Inner Core to Ma Hongjun. She was alarmed when Ma Hongjun displayed his Seven Headed Fire Phoenix Avatar.

She was hoodwinked by the Shrek Seven Monsters, who forced her into inertial thinking through their sparring sessions. She used her Demon Shark Domain to suppress them, only for it to be blocked by the Fire Phoenix Domain. She was shocked when Oscar aided the Fire Phoenix Domain. She tried to use advanced abilities of her Demon Shark Domain to stop the Shrek Seven Monsters, but the Hell White Tiger broke through them before she was temporarily knocked out by the Disorder Splitting Wind Hammer. She chased after the Shrek Seven Monsters after waking up, only for them to reach the outer shore. She snapped at them for tricking her before being shocked when they thanked her. Oscar provided her with various Sausages to help with her injuries, and she warned the Shrek Seven Monsters to pray that she would not be assigned to their future Trials.

She was notified by members of her Clan when the Shrek Seven Monsters wanted to find her for their 4th Trial. She informed them about the Evil Spirit Orcas, carried Tang San on her back, and had the next strongest members of her Clan carry the rest of the Shrek Seven Monsters. She did not allow Bai Chenxiang to be carried by a member of her Clan, as the latter was not assigned the same task. She and Tang San separated from the formation to assassinate the Evil Spirit Orcas.

She helped Tang San locate the Clan of the Evil Spirit Orcas before he assassinated multiple 10,000+ years Evil Spirit Orcas. She signaled her Clan to intercept the Clan and prevent it from escaping, initiating the battle.

She suppressed Xie Hu from the start under the amplifications from Ning Rongrong and Tang San. She warned Tang San that Xie Hu wanted to self-destruct after being blasted back. After Tang San killed Xie Hu, she prevented the surviving Evil Spirit Orcas from self-detonating. She and the rest of her Clan trembled when Tang San gained access to the Sea God's Light. She thanked the Shrek Seven Monsters on behalf of her Clan before urging Tang San to assimilate the Soul Ring and Soul Bone from Xie Hu's corpse. She had one of her Clan members assist Bai Chenxiang in identifying a suitable Evil Spirit Orca for her 5th Soul Ring. She froze the sea surface to stabilize Tang San while he assimilated the Soul Ring, acting as his mount and reminding him to use the Sea God's Light.

She voluntarily helped the group prepare for the next Trial of the Shrek Seven Monsters by using her strongest abilities against them at the required strength. She was eventually scared away when Tang San became proficient in using the abilities of his new Soul Ring and Soul Bone.

She helped Dai Mubai search for a suitable Sea Soul Beast to provide him with his 8th Soul Ring. She prevented Zhu Zhuqing from helping Dai Mubai by leaving Sea God Island as she had completed her Trials. On the day of the 6th Trial, she and her Clan sent the group to Sea God Mountain and asked Tang San to tell her about the Trial’s process if they survived.

She congratulated Tang San on gaining the approval of the Sea God Trident. The Demon Soul Great White Sharks escorted Tang San’s group to the Douluo Continent in three days due to their speed in water.

After the Battle of Jialing Pass, she aided them one more time in Tang San's eighth trial to kill the Deep Sea Demonic Whale King, which gifted her with several benefits including the promotion of her cultivation. By absorbing the energy of Deep Sea Demonic Whale King, it was hinted that she would soon breakthrough to 200,000+ years and her seven clansmen to 100,000+ years. The whole time, she provided Tang San and the other Seven Devils advice and knowledge about all sorts of things related to the sea while occasionally acting as a mount for Tang San.
