					How does Xiao Bao's appearance differ from typical dragons?
						
				
				
					
						Xiao Bao stands out from typical dragons due to his human-like appearance, being only a foot tall with a large head. He lacks the usual dragon traits like scales and wings.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					How did Xiao Bao serve the Dragon Clan's Divine Gardens?
						
				
				
					
						Xiao Bao was responsible for the Dragon Clan's Divine Gardens as a top cultivated parasite beast, sustained by the Dragon God's Aura. He managed the nursery garden with significant authority in the Divine Dragon Domain and was a close minister to the Dragon God. Over time, his abilities have waned but can be restored with Dragon God qi or qi from the Divine Realm.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What role did Xiao Bao play in the Divine Dragon Domain?
						
				
				
					
						Xiao Bao was a divine beast in the Divine Dragon Domain, acting as a top cultivated parasite beast under the Dragon God. He managed the Dragon Clan's Divine Gardens and lived on the Dragon God's Aura. Xiao Bao held significant authority as a close minister to the Dragon God.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What is the significance of Xiao Bao's large head and eyes?
						
				
				
					
						Xiao Bao, a divine beast from the Divine Dragon Domain, is characterized by a notably large head and eyes. These features are significant as they contribute to his imposing presence and reflect his role as a top cultivated parasite beast under the Dragon God, responsible for managing the Divine Gardens.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What is unique about Xiao Bao's relationship with the Dragon God's Aura?

Appearance[]
He looks like a human with only a foot high. He has a very big head, accounting for almost half of the whole body. The eyes are also very big, the eyes are dripping around, and a pair of wind-catching ears tremble, which looks very strange. Originally, if it were just like this, it would be cute, but it also had a pig nose on its face. It's strange to look at it. There are still a few yellow hairs on the head, floating gently.
characters.appearance:
He was hiding in the cave where 10,000+ year soul bones were kept in the Forest Luo Planet. While he was thinking of an escape plan, he met with Qian Lei who was there to pick a soul bone. He pretended to be a skull bone of the Light Holy Dragon and fused with him. Unable to remove him out of Qian Lei, Tang Xuanyu showed his Dragon God’s aura to scare him off. Being a parasite of the former Dragon God, he immediately asked Tang Xuanyu to let him follow again. He resided under a soul slave contract to live in Tang Xuanyu, later lived in his newly created Dragon God Core.

He helped Tang Xuanyu towards his cultivation as the next Dragon God by finding Heaven and Earth Treasures (materials, minerals & immortal herbs) for him to use as well as assisting him during breakthroughs.

characters.history:
He was one of the six plant great beasts that were able to cultivate past 100,000 years and survive the heavenly tribulation. When the seven devils, Gu Yuena, and Zang Xin showed up at the Ice Fire Yin Yang Well, they were not happy to see them. When Zang Xin demand a hundred thousand years immortal herb for each of the devils including Yuena, they tried to chase them away using the remnant souls of the Water and Fire Dragon Kings, but was stopped by Gu Yuena. They tried again, only to be stopped and intimidated by Zang Xin and forced to agree.

The Great Beasts guided them around the well. Although Damask Tulip offered to become the spirit soul, he didn't at first. Only after Wulin revealed his status as a child of nature, the six spirit beasts began arguing on who should become Wulin's spirit soul. Each of the great beasts presented their abilities to Wulin. He was 3rd in line. In the end, Damask Tulip was chosen.

Wulin made an contract with the Great Beasts in exchange for them to become spirit souls for him and his friends. They resided themselves in Wulin's spirit sea next to the seed of nature until the devils are ready to break through. Origin Energy Immortal Herb gave his seed to Wulin and became Xu Lizhi's spirit soul.

He became the Spirit Soul of Xu Xiaoyan after the Shrek Seven Devils returned from the Star Luo Continent.

He and the other plant Spirit Beasts' seeds were given by Wulin to the Eternal Tree be planted around the Eternal Tree.

He was one of the God Rank plant spirit beasts residing in the Land of Immortal Spirits, together with other immortal herbs.

characters.history:
After their mother was killed by Zhongli Tian, Zhongli Di and Zhongli Ren, they were adopted by Huo Yuhao and brought them back to the Tang Sect.

They were almost bankrupting the Tang Sect with the amount of food that they ate. However, they deliberately acted cute all the time. At one point, his brother Da Hei even secretly ate the medicine that Shrek Academy gave to Teacher Xuan and shared with him. After eating the medicine, they became much more obedient, and fell asleep for a few days. However, their appetite became even more voracious after they woke up.

After they were sent to the Ice and Fire Yin Yang Well, they ate many 1,000+ years herbs and plants. They even wanted to take action on the 100,000+ years Immortal Herbs such as You You and Xiao Huo. In less than a year, they had grown to 1,000+ years. There they met with the Ice Bear King who later became their big brother.

characters.appearance:
She was a lady dressed in red who had beautiful looks.

She was a very beautiful woman, wearing a red dress and her whole body was emitting a faint red glow. But wherever she passed, the air around her was slightly distorted, as if the entire space was rejecting her.

It was a plant completely fiery-red. It didn’t really look like a flower, and was instead extremely tall. It was almost ten feet tall, while the open flower was slightly smaller than the Delicate Silk Immortal in diameter, and in the shape of a cabbage. Its entire body seemed like it had been sculpted from red rubies. It glowed once more, and the temperature of the air inside the valley rose a little bit.
characters.personality: She had a hot temper.
characters.history:
Huo Yuhao took away her essence and badly damaged her cultivation base. On two separate occasions, he took a half of her Blazing Rubber, each being a fist sized ball of red rubber condensed by Xiao Huo from the energy of the Blazing Sunspring. This was intended to help her breakthrough her next breakthrough tribulation.

She met with the Shrek Seven Devils and Zang Xin when they came to the Ice and Fire Yin Yang Well. She and the other plant system spirit beasts were not pleased to see them. Zang Xin told them about the destruction of Shrek Academyand Tang Sect headquarters. When Zang Xin asked for a hundred-thousand years heaven and earth treasure for each of the devils, they refused. They tried to expel them from the well using the remnant souls of the Water and Fire Dragon Kings, but was stopped by Gu Yuena. Nevertheless, they still tried to expel them, but they intimated by Zang Xin and were forced to agree to his demands. They showed them around the well introducing each herb.

After Beautiful Silk Tulip offer to become a spirit soul for one of the devils was rejected by four of them, she was asked by Yue Zhengyu to become his spirit soul, which she rejected. When Tang Wulin revealed his status as a child of nature, she offered to become his spirit soul. In the end, Wulin chose Beautiful Silk Tulip. The six great beasts and the Chaotic Element Immortal Herb left their seeds to Wulin to later be planted around the Eternal Tree after making a contract with him. They then housed themselves within Wulin's mind by the seed of nature.

When Yue Zhengyu reach rank 80 and became a Soul Douluo, she became his spirit soul.

Apricot and the others' seeds were given to the Eternal Tree by Wulin.

She was one of the God level plant spirit beasts that resided in the Land of Immortal Spirits within the Eternal Sky City. After Tang Xuanyu and his friends came to pick the Immortal herbs and Xiao Bao persuaded them to go with them, she appeared and negotiated with Wang Tianyu.
characters.trivia: Her cultivation was badly damaged by Huo Yuhao in SL2, otherwise, she should have already become 200,000+ years in SL3.

characters.introText: Shan Liang was one of the three human god kings that resided in the divine dragon domain along with the Xie E and the asura god. Five other races and ten dragons are also god kings with the dragon god as the only supreme god king.
characters.history:
Shan Liang was one of the three human god kings that resided in the divine dragon domain along with the Xie E and the asura god. Five other races and ten dragons are also god kings with the dragon god as the only supreme god king.

When the dragon god was at the final step in transforming the divine realm into a divine planet, during the process, his son scarified himself to help his father stabilize himself. When the dragon god noticed that his son died, he halted the ceremony and reversed time to investigate what happened. Finding the killers, the dragon god went mad and caused an eruption of immortal spirit energy from ceremony, badly damaging the divine realm and receiving backlash from the ceremony himself. The god kings fought the mad dragon god, losing nine of the god kings, but they managed to heavily injure the dragon god, causing him to be unable to move. Knowing they need to kill the dragon god to save the divine realm, of the remaining three dragon god kings, the light dragon king killed the water dragon king before committing suicide with the dark dragon king because they can't bring themselves to kill the dragon god. Regaining a trace of clarity and seeing the death of the last three dragon kings caused him to cry out in anguish and enter a stupor.

Just when the asura god was about to end it, the dragon slaying saber intervened and misunderstood the situation, which triggered the divine war between the divine beasts and other gods. In the aftermath, the human god kings were the only god kings left. The divine realm arrived at the brink of collapse due to the war. The dragon god woke up at the end and managed to repair the broken divine realm, reducing its size. He also absorbed all the negative intent and emotions within his raising dragon pillar and sealed it inside himself before asking the asura god to cut out his positive thoughts and negative thoughts. He also placed a seal on soul beasts from becoming gods. Afterwards, the dragon god left the divine realm for the dragon realm with the corpses of all the dead dragons. Following the last instructions of the dragon god, the negative thoughts were sealed within the divine realm to be wearied down over time, while the positive thoughts was allowed to leave the divine realm. The three god kings now took charge of the new divine realm forming a divine council.

Shan Liang and Xie E reincarnated themselves after passing down their god positions. They are currently experiencing many different worlds, reincarnating over and over again, and whenever they reached the peak of their cultivation and regained some of their past memories as god kings, they refuse to come back to the divine realm.

characters.history:
He was the target of the 4th Trial of Tang San's Sea God Nine Trials.

He was infuriated by the fact that his Clan was unable to find the assailant as multiple members of the Clan were gradually assassinated. He killed a few of them himself to prevent them from attacking the rest under the torture of the Spring Water of the Ice and Fire Yin Yang Well. His Clan was prevented from escaping by the Demon Soul Great White Sharks, starting the battle.

He targeted Xiao Bai from the start of the battle and realized that she was stronger than usual before noticing that Ning Rongrong was amplifying her. He noticed Tang San using the Asura Hell to amplify the Demon Soul Great White Sharks and suppress the Evil Spirit Orcas, resulting in increasing casualties. He attacked Tang San with his Water Pillar, which was blocked by the latter, making him realize that Tang San was chosen by the Sea God. He prepared to detonate himself after realizing that his Clansmen had no chance of escaping, intending to kill the Demon Soul Great White Sharks and the Shrek Seven Monsters by trapping them inside his Intangible Barrier. His detonation was stopped, and Tang San killed him by pouring the Spring Water of the Ice and Fire Yin Yang Well into his blowhole after it broke through the Intangible Barrier.

characters.appearance:
Xie Xie enrolled at Eastsea Academy at the same time as Tang Wulin. The first time they encountered each other was at the train station. The second time was when they became roommates in room 205, along with Yun Xiao and Zhou Changxi. When he walked into the room, he stepped on the blanket that Na'er made for Wulin, causing him to attack Xie Xie. Xie Xie ended up being punched in the face, though he did dodge Wulin's attacks a few times and was able to trip and kick him.

After that, Xie Xie, Tang Wulin, Yun Xiao and Zhou Changxi were sent to the Dean's office. As punishment, they were fined 34,000 Federation dollars for the damages during the fight and were sent to first-year class 5, the weakest class. Xie Xie offered to pay the fine if Wulin agreed to fight him again. Wulin accepted.

The next day, in class 5, all the students were introduced to their teacher, Wu Zhangkong, and introduced themselves.

characters.title: Xie Yinling
characters.introText: Although Xie Yinling couldn’t be called handsome, he had a refreshing aura to him.
characters.appearance: Although Xie Yinling couldn’t be called handsome, he had a refreshing aura to him.
characters.history:
Yinling was Tang Wulin's first opponent for his Final Exam. When Wulin released his spirit rings, Yinling was startled at the sight. Once the match started, he immediately ascend into the air, only to see Wulin leap at him with the help of his bluesilver grass. He used his second soul skill, and tried to use his third, but Wulin deflect the second soul skill and binded Yinling before aiming a golden dragon claw at his chest. The claw disrupted his internal soul power circulation. Next thing he knew, he was thrown on the ground ending the match. Yinling was speechless.

He was frustrated by how helpless he had been throughout the entire battle. He had only been able to use one soul skill before losing, the battle having ended too quickly. It pained him to swallow the bitter pill of reality. He had lost. Admitting it wasn’t easy, especially since he hadn’t been able to work out Tang Wulin’s martial soul.

This is to the point where she even rivals the looks Jiang Nannan and Wang Dong’er as a top-tier beauty. Furthermore, she was a few years older than Jiang Nannan, and her body was much more mature. The combination of her flowing red dress and her pale white skin gave onlookers a feeling of perfection.

Later on, when she appeared to introduce the last item for the top-ranked auction of the Starlight Auction House, She wore a long, golden skirt and her milky-white skin didn’t lose its beauty and elegance when paired with the graceful and luxurious golden palace skirt. characters.personality:
She was an odd girl with the most unpredictable temperament. She was frank, upright and hot-tempered but was actually exquisite within. She was cold and volatile, like a volcano that could erupt at any moment. Perhaps this had something to do with the soul tools that she held so dear to her heart.

After she worked as a teacher at the Monster Academy, she became friendly and cheerful, opposite of Long Yue’s taciturn nature. In a sense, she made up for what Long Yue lacked.
characters.history:
Xu Mi'er participated in the Sea God's Fate Match-making Convention. After she challenged all the men, Long Yue stood up and accepted to challenge her. She lost and chose him.

Note: There was a plot hole in the novel regarding what happened after the blind date festival. Please treat what happened in this volume as non-canon.

Xu Mi'er survived the destruction of Shrek Academy with the other inner court students and took shelter in the Tang Sect Headquarters in Heaven Dou City with the rest of the inner court.

After the blind date festival, Xu Mi'er decided to stay at Shrek Academy instead of going to the Star Luo Empire with Long Yue. After Shrek Academy was destroyed, they lost touch with each other. She told Tang Wulin about this.

After reuniting and becoming a couple with Long Yue, she became a teacher at Monster Academy. She had an extremely famous moniker in Monster Academy, Guns and Roses. If she was not Long Yue’s lover, there were many who would have tried to win her over.

characters.history:
Shrek Academy Outer Court 5th year Soul Elder student age 15 Xu Sanshi saw Huo Yuhao refusing to sell fish to Jiang Nannan. He becomes extremely angry and throws a gold coin at him and tries to get the last remaining 2 fish which were reserved. However Yuhao does not allow them to be snatched causing Xu Sanshi to become angry and destroy Yuhao's fish stall. As he attacks Yuhao, he is stopped by Tang Ya who shoots him with a Dragon Beard Needle and Beibei who interrupts him from attacking Yuhao. Thus they take their battle to the Spirit Battle Arena.

At the Spirit Battle Arena resting area he is swindled by Beibei to part with Mystic Water Pill for removing the Dragon Beard Needle embedded in him. Then they make another bet for the outcome of the battle with the wager being another Mystic Water Pill. Soon after the start of the match Xu Sanshi is attacked by a barrage of attacks as well as a soul shock which leaves Xu Sanshi defeated. He becomes aware that Beibei cheated but is unable to provide evidence to call it out.
characters.trivia:

Appearance[]
He was a young man seemed to be in his late twenties. His attire was very simple, and his eyes were full of energy. Although he wasn’t very handsome, he had the aura of an authoritative figure. His tanned skin revealed a healthy glow. He was seated in a wheelchair. He had practically no legs at all.
characters.appearance: He was a young man seemed to be in his late twenties. His attire was very simple, and his eyes were full of energy. Although he wasn’t very handsome, he had the aura of an authoritative figure. His tanned skin revealed a healthy glow. He was seated in a wheelchair. He had practically no legs at all.
characters.personality: He was ambitious and determined. He didn’t lose his sharpness due to his disability, but he seemed very sinister and vicious. Despite having a calm, authoritarian, and seemingly kind personality on the surface, he's simultaneously both a madman and a genius who had become so suspicious of everything due to the failed ambush that led to the disability of both his legs.
characters.history:
He helped Huo Yuhao when he was detained by Xu Mochen because Ju Zi asked for help. Since he was infertile, he forced his wife, Ju Zi to become pregnant with the sperm of another man Xu Tianhe. He raised the son as if it was his anyways, but always held a little bit of contempt for him in the back of his mind.

He was the one who devised sinister plans to start and declare war on the kingdoms and empires of Douluo Continent by entrapping them in a specialized prison underground after the . He eventually regained his mobility thanks to the development of Human-shaped Soul Tool. During the war, he managed to thwart the frontal assaults of the Tang Sect on the capital, Bright City, then the first assassination attempt from Du Busi and his joint forces, but was later killed by the next assassination attempt by Huo Yuhao and Ju Zi.

He was accepted as Kong Deming’s disciple. He was introduced to soul tools at a young age, while he began cultivating soul power in the most foundational fashion. It wasn’t hard to imagine what his future would be like with top-tier soul engineers supporting him. Ju Zi believed that he would be very talented in the future.

After Ju Zi broke the promise and started a war on Star Luo Empire, Huo Yuhao intervened and saved the Star Luo Empire. But Ju Zi kept asking to hand over Dai Hao to take revenge, otherwise she will massacre the people of the three empires. At last, Huo Yuhao revealed Xu Yunhan whom he kept in the demiplane. Afraid of hurting her son, Ju Zi disclosed the secret that his biological father was Huo Yuhao.

Due to a previous guardian mission in which majority of the shrek guardians died, and the events shortly before the Continental Advanced Academy Soul Dueling Tournament, he considers himself unworthy to be at Shrek Academy and unfit to watch over the students in the school. However, with some encouragement from Elder Mu, he becomes one of the pillars of Shrek Academy and guides the junior generation of Shrek Seven Monsters to their greatest potential. He is also inherently gluttonous as his martial soul, the Godly Taotie Bull requires him to eat constantly in other to gain more power.

characters.history:
She was a student at the Zhongtian Comprehensive College and fellow member of the Holy Alliance. Right as she was about to reach the door to the graduation ceremony, she was knocked to the floor by Tian Hen and missed the deadline for entrance, forcing her to repeat a year by default, even though she was failing more than half her classes. She would come back for revenge a few times, but eventually grew close to Tian Hen as they kept encountering each other. It was around the time they stayed in a hotel together for one week where they bonded and she revealed herself to be a Manipulator of the fire element.

She was kidnapped along with a few other people from Zhongtian Star close to Tian Hen and tortured to death by the Footbasin clan, the same people who killed Tian Hen's biological parents many years ago. Later she was revived by Tian Hen and she became his fifth wife. She inherited the will and powers of the ancient god of fire, .
characters.trivia: In the process of her resurrection, her body was reconstructed with pure energy and fire elements from the Earth Fire Dragon King, bringing her cultivation directly to the level of a Judge the day she was resurrected.

characters.introText: Xue Qinghe was the eldest son of the Emperor Xue Ye and the Crown Prince of Heaven Dou Empire.
characters.appearance:
When portrayed by Qian Renxue, Xue Qinghe looked about 27 or 28 years old. Although he was not as handsome as Oscar, he had a straight nose and square mouth. His long black hair was worn tied back in a neat tail with blue cloth. He exudes an aura of extraordinary charisma, giving off a fresh and cool feeling.

In the Manhua, he was portrayed as pale silver-gold hair and clear teal eyes, wearing white robes instead of blue.

In the Anime, he is portrayed as a blond youth of medium build, wearing ornate red and gold adorned robes.
characters.personality: Not only is he not as arrogant as a prince, but the feeling of being approachable is very acceptable. He is talkative but open minded.
characters.history:
When he was young, Xue Qinghe was assassinated by Martial Soul Hall, and secretly replaced by Qian Renxue who was the same age. The imposter referred to Ning Fengzhi, the Patriarch of the Seven Treasure Glazed Tile Clan as his teacher, though it was unknown if the original Xue Qinghe was studying beneath him before his untimely assassination.
Extra Chapter 14 (Manhua)

A year before the tumultuous events that changed everything, Prince Xue Qinghe's life seemed destined for greatness. During a routine patrol outside the palace, he encountered a young woman under attack by a vicious Spirit Beast. Driven by his sense of duty and compassion, the prince valiantly saved her and brought her back to the palace as his servant. Little did he know, this woman, Qian Renxue, set it all up.

Over the next year, Xue Qinghe was impressed by Qian Renxue's dedication and keen observation skills. She quickly learned his routines, mimicking his mannerisms, and understanding even the most nuanced aspects of his personality. He often joked that she knew him better than he knew himself. Her presence became a comforting constant, and he trusted her implicitly.

The fateful day arrived during a grand hunting competition, organized by the Emperor to celebrate the prince's birthday. Nobles and dignitaries from across the empire gathered to partake in the festivities. In the midst of the event, chaos erupted as a Soul Beast appeared, followed by an unexpected attack from an assassin targeting the Emperor. Instinctively, Xue Qinghe and his guards sprang into action, chasing the assailant through the dense forest.

Separated from the safety of the crowd, the prince found himself alone with Qian Renxue, who had followed closely. It was then that she revealed her true intentions. In a shocking betrayal, Qian Renxue dropped her guise of a loyal servant, unveiling her Seraphim Martial Soul and her allegiance to the Martial Soul Hall. The realization hit him like a physical blow – the woman he had come to trust was an enemy infiltrator.

Before he could react, Renxue's domain power surged, trapping and overwhelming him and his guards. Helpless against her might, Xue Qinghe witnessed the end of his aspirations and the betrayal of someone he had once saved. As his life faded, he saw her cold resolve and the truth of her ambition: to usurp his identity and seize the empire for herself.

Being the brother of the Emperor he is arrogant, haughty and disrespectful. He also does not care much for human beings, even buying them as slaves. It was later revealed that his arrogant act was a measure of self preservation due to the unsolved deaths of two of his nephews.

characters.history:
Xue Xing seems to be partial to the fourth Imperial Prince Xue Beng, helping him in order to weaken the other Princes. Though later revealed that he was tasked by Xue Ye to investigate the mysterious deaths of the Second and the Third Prince, and he found clues linking the deaths indirectly to Xue Qinghe, thus advised Xue Beng to act like a pampered and unruly Prince to protect himself. He also advised Xue Beng to stall his Cultivation as a means to not attract attention.

He was also in charge of the Heaven Dou Imperial Academy as the representative of his brother who was the Dean of the Academy.

At some point in time, he saved the life of the Poison Douluo: Dugu Bo, resulting in the latter becoming the Heaven Dou Empire's Guardian Douluo, and given a Noble Title, with Dugu Yan being allowed to study at the Heaven Dou Imperial Academy.

Quick Answers
		
		
	
	
			
				
					How does Ya Li's Battle Armor enhance her abilities?
						
				
				
					
						Ya Li's Battle Armor boosts her soul power and triples her ice power. It includes a flying tool for efficient flight and has a regenerative feature for minor repairs, enhancing her support role as an Auxiliary System Spirit Master.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What makes Ya Li the only healing system Limit Douluo?
						
				
				
					
						Ya Li, the Holy Spirit Douluo, is the only healing system Limit Douluo due to her unmatched skills as an Auxiliary System Spirit Master. She has saved countless lives with her powerful healing abilities, despite being unable to heal herself. As the highest-ranking Recovery System soul master, she serves as the dean of Shrek Academy's inner court and an elder of the Sea God Pavilion, highlighting her unique role.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What role does Ya Li play at Shrek Academy?
						
				
				
					
						Ya Li supports Shrek Academy by healing injured students during events like the first-grade selection tournament. She also attends competitions, including the first vs. second-grade contest, observing activities such as blacksmithing.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					How is Ya Li connected to the Sea God Pavilion?
						
				
				
					
						Ya Li is linked to the Sea God Pavilion through her association with Yun Ming. They were observed together on Sea God Island, part of the Pavilion's setting. The Pavilion is located in a sub-realm on a small island in the Lake of Life, beneath the Ancient Golden Tree.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What is unique about Ya Li's appearance and demeanor?
						
				
				
					
						Ya Li stands out with her pure beauty, long evergreen hair, and lively complexion, appearing youthful. Her demeanor is defined by kindness and equality towards all, but she harbors a deep hatred for Evil Spirit Masters following Yun Ming's death.

characters.history:
Even though he was a lower level dragon, he was able to ascend onto the Rising Dragon Pillar, signifying his strength compared to other lower level dragons.

He was Tang Xuanyu's first opponent (who disguised as Blue) during the qualifying round of Rising Dragon Competition. Instead of fighting against him, he surrendered right away saying that he wanted to be his most loyal servant, then signed a master-servant contract with him that automatically promoted him from being a lower level dragon to a middle level dragon, raising his cultivation base equivalent to a Titled Douluo.

After Tang Xuanyu's Dragon Force Hall was built and attracted the dragon power from the Dragon Realm on its opening ceremony, the dragon that had obvious changes was Yan Cheng. Among the dragons present, he had the lowest cultivation.

After feeling the dragon god energy from Tang Xuanyu, his bloodline was aroused. The difference between lower level dragons, the middle level dragons and the upper level dragons was the purity of the bloodlines. It was a feeling of purity and transformation of his bloodline, as if he was reborn. This was the benefit he got because of concluding a master-servant contract with Tang Xuanyu. From being a lower level dragon to middle level dragon then purifying his dragon bloodline.

He finally advanced to god level. Later, the Crimson Mother attacked Heavenly Horse Planet and helped Tang Xuanyu resist. He received the fatal blow of Crimson Mother for his master and died.

Appearance[]
Yang Wudi is tall and slim with black hair despite his old age. He is somewhat similar to Bai He but a head taller than him and also has a rosy complexion. He usually has a somewhat gloomy expression and cold eyes giving the feeling of a vulture.
characters.appearance:
He arrived with the entourage of the Breaking Clan at the Mansion of the Defense Clan for the biennial meeting of the four Single Attribute Clans. He objected to Tang San and Ma Hongjun's presence before relenting because Niu Gao was the host. He mentioned that one of the Lower Four Great Clans was located in the town where the Breaking Clan lived and had threatened them to join their Clan and serve the Martial Soul Hall. He proposed joining the four Single Attribute Clans to form a Sect and fight the Martial Soul Hall. He mentioned that he had contacted the Star Luo Imperial Clan for protection in Star Luo City and proposed establishing the headquarters there. He was informed by Tai Tan about Huyan Zhen's threat to the Defense Clan and the decision to establish the Sect in Heaven Dou City. He was skeptical of Tai Tan's ability to financially support the descendants of the other three clans long term. He was furious after learning that Tang San was Tang Hao's son and prepared to leave. He demanded that Tang San leave for him to stay and threatened to kill him if he did not. He told Bai He that he would leave Tang San on the verge of death after the latter challenged him.

He accepted the challenge after Tang San provoked his ego. He was shocked by the Soul Rings of Tang San's Blue Silver Emperor and learned that the Eight Spider Lances was an External Soul Bone. He gradually suppressed Tang San during the battle before the latter used his own body as bait to strike him with the Clear Sky Hammer.

He was still shocked by the attack of the Clear Sky Hammer when Xiao Wu's Soul executed her Eight Stage Drop on him, injuring him. His life was spared only after Tang San told Xiao Wu's Soul to stop, but he fainted from his injuries. Niu Gao and Bai He supported him before he woke up. He became momentarily depressed thinking Tang San had died when he did not see him there, but was shocked to learn that Tang San's injuries had already healed. He retired to his assigned room to rest and recover.

He recognized the Crystal Blood Dragon Ginseng from Bai He's description and agreed to lead the Breaking Clan to join the Tang Sect after obtaining it. He was shocked to see Tang San lead Xiao Wu to the meeting hall. Curious about Xiao Wu's condition due to her body being at its peak, he asked about her. He anticipated receiving the Crystal Blood Dragon Ginseng but was overjoyed when Tang San gave him an Aromatic Silk Beauty instead. He told Tang San that they would not have fought if he had presented the Aromatic Silk Beauty earlier and agreed to join the Tang Sect. He told Bai He that the Aromatic Silk Beauty was more vital to him than the Crystal Blood Dragon Ginseng, even though the latter was more valuable. He led the Breaking Clan's entourage back home before they traveled to Heaven Dou City.

He, Bai He, and Yang Wudi received the group when they returned from Gengxin City with Lou Gao.

He was shocked when Tang San formally introduced Oscar, Ma Hongjun, and Ning Rongrong. He was alarmed to hear that Xiao Wu was a 100,000+ years Level Soul Beast and shocked that she had used Sacrifice to save Tang San, along with the fact that she had obtained the recognition of the Yearning Heartbroken Red. He agreed with Tang San's arrangement for the various Halls and Tai Tan's additional proposal.

infobox.Title: Yao Ling
infobox.name: Yao Ling
infobox.occupation: Ranked 8 Blacksmith (Saint Craftsman) Mingdu Branch’s President

characters.introText: Although Yao Ling and Mu Chen were both Saint Craftsman, as Mingdu branch’s president his position in the Blacksmith’s Association could be described as being a subordinate to one person while ruling over thousands. If Zhen Hua was not around, he would be the person in charge of the Blacksmith’s Association. He had been at the level of a rank-8 Saint Craftsman for many years now, was only a small step away from becoming a Divine Craftsman.
characters.appearance: He was a very old man but his eyes were glimmering with vigorous spirit. He spoke in a straightforward manner.
characters.history: Yao Ling was not overly shocked when he heard that a Saint Craftsman had come to his branch. After all, as the biggest city on the continent, Mingdu City would occasionally be visited by Saint Craftsman. However, he was greatly shocked when he saw Tang Wulin’s product. He wanted to keep the two Soul Refined products of Tang Wulin to research and asked if he could. More importantly, this piece of Soul Refined metal had triggered something in his long-stagnant bottleneck. He faintly felt that he was about to grasp the path of a Divine Craftsman just by looking at it.

Quick Answers
		
		
	
	
			
				
					What are Ye Lingtong's distinctive physical features?
						
				
				
					
						Ye Lingtong features long, flowing silver hair styled into two-tails and large orange eyes, sometimes depicted as gold. In some accounts, she has light brown hair and green eyes. Her build is average for her age.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					How does Ye Lingtong's personality reflect a tsundere archetype?
						
				
				
					
						Ye Lingtong embodies a tsundere archetype with her petty and jealous nature. She is competitive, confident, and analytical in battles, even against her crush, Xuanyu. Her use of underhanded tactics, like stealing kills, underscores her tsundere traits. As she matures, Lingtong grows out of this personality, showing the ability to acknowledge her past behavior.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					How do Ye Lingtong's eye colors vary in different adaptations?
						
				
				
					
						Ye Lingtong's eye color changes in different adaptations. In the novel, she is described with green eyes, while other versions show her with large orange or gold eyes.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What causes Ye Lingtong to become jealous easily?
						
				
				
					
						Ye Lingtong's jealousy stems from her pride and need for attention. She finds it difficult to accept her emotions, especially her feelings for Tang Xuanyu. Her competitive spirit and ambition further fuel her jealousy.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What is the significance of Ye Lingtong's hairstyle in the manhua?
						
				
				
					
						Ye Lingtong's hairstyle in the manhua features long, flowing silver-white hair styled into two-tails. This distinct style, along with her large orange or gold eyes, enhances her unique appearance and sets her apart in the series.

Lingtong debuted during Xuanyu's elementary school admission and  developed a one-sided rivalry with him due to him being only one in their year with a higher Spirit Rank. This would lead her to challenge him to several mock battles, only to lose each time due to the power of the Dragon God within him suppressing her own Dragon-type Spirit.

Despite her antagonism, however, Lingtong actually just seemed to have a crush on Xuanyu, but was unaware of her own feelings. Unfortunately, Xuanyu had developed a dislike for Lingtong, being annoyed by her constantly challenging him.

characters.introText:
Quick Answers
		
		
	
	
			
				
					What is the significance of Ye Xishui's title, the Death God Douluo?
						
				
				
					
						The title of Death God Douluo, held by Ye Xishui, signifies her exceptional power and high status. She is one of the three Ultimate Douluos, and a Class 9 Spirit Engineer nearing Class 10. Ye Xishui also holds prominent positions including Supreme Sect Leader of the Holy Ghost Church, Hallmaster of the Illustrious Virtue Hall, and Supreme Elder of the Sun Moon Empire.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					Who are the other two Ultimate Douluos alongside Ye Xishui?
						
				
				
					
						Alongside Ye Xishui, the Ultimate Douluos include Dragon God Douluo, Mu En, and Dragon Emperor Douluo, Long Xiaoyao. They were once students who competed in a tournament on separate teams. Mu En and Xiaoyao, being best friends, had the ability to perform Martial Soul Fusion.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What is the role of Ye Xishui in the Holy Ghost Church?
						
				
				
					
						Ye Xishui, known as the Death God Douluo, holds several roles in the Holy Ghost Church, including Supreme Sect Leader, Hallmaster of the Illustrious Virtue Hall, and Supreme Elder of the Sun Moon Empire. She was involved in a complicated love triangle with Mu En and Long Xiaoyao, which led to tension within the church. Following Zongli's death, she ascended to the position of Ultimate Douluo of the Holy Ghost Church. She possessed twin martial souls, with the second one, the Bright Phoenix Martial Soul, only revealed upon her death.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What is the meaning of being a Class 9 Spirit Engineer in Soul Land?
						
				
				
					
						In Soul Land, a Class 9 Spirit Engineer represents an advanced level of proficiency in handling Spirit Guidance Devices. The classification system ranges from level 1 to 10, each reflecting the capacity to control Spirit Guidance Devices of the corresponding level. Thus, a Class 9 Spirit Engineer can operate Class 9 Spirit Guidance Devices. Advancement to higher classes demands greater cultivation and skill, with a level 10 Spirit Guidance Master requiring Hyper Douluo status above level 95.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom

She was very beautiful when she was younger. In fact, she did not pale in comparison to Tang Wutong at all.
characters.personality: She was a very proud and impatient person.
characters.history:
Ye Xishui first appeared defending the Ming Dou Mountain Range with her self-created soul tool when Huo Yuhao and his team breached the Sun Moon Empire's defenses and approached the Death God Pagoda. Her appearance shocked the world, as many believed she had long since perished. She attacked Huo Yuhao with lethal intent, but at the critical moment, Di Tian's reverse scale on Huo Yuhao's body blocked the fatal strike. Di Tian then directly controlled Huo Yuhao's body to battle her. Uncertain whether Di Tian could truly descend in his true body, Ye Xishui chose to retreat.

The alliance between the Holy Spirit Cult and Sun Moon Empire eventually collapsed when Xu Tianran realized Ye Xishui and the cult had grown beyond his control. He conspired with Ju Zi to set an elaborate trap in the palace specifically designed to kill a Limit Douluo, mobilizing numerous Titled Douluo and soul engineers. They detonated ten Class 9 soul tools in an extremely confined space in their assassination attempt. The explosion completely obliterated everything connected to her evil soul master powers—the Death God Pagoda, her Bloody Demon Puppet martial soul, and her physical body.

Long Xiaoyao disregarded his own safety and rushed into the trap to save her. Though both were mortally wounded in the catastrophic blast, Ye Xishui's cultivation was powerful enough that her soul remained intact. Using her never-before-revealed second martial soul—the Bright Phoenix—she maintained her soul body through phoenix rebirth energy while also protecting Long Xiaoyao. When the explosion's intensity decreased, Huo Yuhao received a telepathic message from Long Xiaoyao and, after hesitation, helped cover their escape. However, their life force had already been severed.

In their final moments together, Ye Xishui confessed everything to Long Xiaoyao. She revealed that Yan Shaozhe was descended from their son and had inherited her Bright Phoenix martial soul. She also admitted deliberately walking into Xu Tianran's trap—exhausted from her burdensome life, she sought her final resting place while simultaneously testing Long Xiaoyao's devotion. She hadn't anticipated that Long Xiaoyao's previous injuries would compound with the new ones, bringing his life to an end as well.

To atone for the pain she had caused Mu En, Ye Xishui followed Long Xiaoyao's guidance and transferred all her cultivation to Tang Wutong. Working together, they moved Tang Wutong's first soul core from her dantian to her chest and constructed the foundation of a third soul core in her dantian. After completing this final act, Ye Xishui transformed into an ethereal luminous form that rose and merged with Long Xiaoyao's body. Together, carried by a gentle breeze, they turned into brilliant points of light and ascended into the sky as one.
characters.trivia:
It was later revealed that she had a child with Long Xiaoyao who was Yan Shaozhe’s father.

At some point she had confirmed that Yan Shaozhe was her and Long Xiaoyao's descendant, by testing his blood after hearing he had the Radiant Phoenix martial soul.

Ye Yingrong is the teacher of first grade class three. She observed the battle between class four and class five along with her participating team, Gu Tianri, Gu Tianming, and Gu Tianyue the day before class three's match with class five. She was surprised that students with hundred year rings are in class five when there are none in her class.

On the day of their match with class five, she came to the competition stage early with her students. When class five arrived, she greeted Wu Zhangkong before Teaching Director Long Hengxu called for the match to start.

The three brothers and Tang Wulin, Gu Yuena, and Xie Xie went on the stage. When the match ended, it was a total defeat for class three. Ye Yingrong was stunned by the outcome. She calmed herself down and congratulated Wu Zhangkong on the class's victory.

Ye Yingrong watched the trio from class five head off for the dining hall, dumbstruck with silence. She overheard their conversion. They improvised during the whole match! She took out a soul communicator from her pocket and punched in a number. She was calling her sister, Ye Yingluo, telling her the result of her match and warning her that class five might pose a challenge for her class.

A commotion took place at the front gate of the academy.

characters.history:
He was a Class 9 Soul Engineer of the Sun Moon Empire known as the Starsky Douluo. There was a reason why he was called the Starsky Douluo. When it came to pure fighting power, Ye Yulin was definitely one of the best in the Sun Moon Empire. After his stars gathered in the sky, he locked his spiritual power on the incoming enemies.

In terms of Spirit Guidance Devices creation, he was a genius. He was comparable to Jing Hongchen, and specialized in creating all types of high-altitude Spirit Guidance Devices, which was how he had gotten his title.

It was rumored that his spirit tools could turn into stars during a war, unleashing great offensive strength. He could even tap into celestial phenomena to attack. His namesake spirit tool was called the Sunmoon Divine Needle. It was ranked as having among the highest levels of offensive power of all Class 9 spirit tools. He had the ranked knife Morning Star. The protective soul tool that Ye Yulin owned and had just unleashed was called the Starsky Barrier. It was his strongest defensive soul tool at Class 9. He also possesses a class 9 defensive soul tool in the form of a black circlet on his head that can defend up to 3 spiritual attacks.

He arrived at the hotel with seven students of the Blue Sunshine Academy and started bossing around. He caught the student who was blasted back by Dai Mubai. He asked the Shrek Seven Monsters about the Academy they belonged to. He ordered the rest of the students to fight the Shrek Seven Monsters after Dai Mubai ignored his question.

He reminded his students to activate their Martial Souls after two of them were thrown away by Xiao Wu, who had distracted them. He ordered his students to withdraw after seeing the configuration of Soul Rings on Dai Mubai, Tang San and Ma Hongjun, before formally asking the Shrek Seven Monsters about their Academy. He stated that he never heard about the Shrek Academy when Ma Hongjun announced it. He was relieved to hear that the Shrek Seven Monsters are not from some famous clan, before he felt powerless that they were stronger than his students. He activated his Black Turtle to earn back the respect for the Blue Sunshine Academy as his students were much weaker, to suppress Dai Mubai, Tang San and Ma Hongjun, before telling them to call their teacher. He told the Shrek Seven Monsters that they would fight outside after the owner of the Hotel told them not to destroy it. He told the Shrek Seven Monsters that he would give them another chance to admit their wrongs. He was shocked by the coordination between Dai Mubai, Tang San, Ma Hongjun and Zhu Zhuqing even though their Soul Power was lower, before wondering about the Shrek Academy. He asked Zhao Wuji to give him an explanation about the Shrek Seven Monsters mocking the Blue Sunshine Academy.

He was sent flying after Zhao Wuji slapped him without even activating his Martial Soul, causing the shell of his Martial Soul manifestation to crack. He was shocked that he was injured even after the opponent didn't activate his Martial Soul and realized that Zhao Wuji was stronger than him by at least 15 Levels.

characters.appearance: It is a seemingly common white flower, palm sized, a bit like a tree peony, without leaves, the stalk connecting to a big rock. That stone was completely pitch black with an astonishing weight. On that white flower are a few flecks of red, scarlet red like blood.
characters.history:
Tang San originally meant to gift a Yearning Heartbroken Red to Zhu Zhuqing. However due to her wavering heart, she was unable to become its master. Yu Xiaogang also tried, but failed again. Then, Xiao Wu tried with unwavering feelings of love about Tang San and became its master. However, Xiao Wu refused to eat, but wished to keep it with her at all times because it could cover her soul beast’s scent, even from a Titled Douluo.

After she sacrificed herself for Tang San, she ate this Yearning Heartbroken Red that helped her rebuild her body so that Tang San was able to resurrect her later.

Huo Yuhao and Wang Qiu'er came to the Ice and Fire Yin Yang Well to pick up a Yearning Heartbroken Red for Tang Wutong. Although two immortal herbs appearing at the same time wasn’t possible, there were two of them. Both were able to pick up each of them successfully. Wang Qiu'er used this immortal herb for Huo Yuhao while Huo Yuhao used it for Tang Wutong respectively.

Tang Wulin successfully picked up a 100,000+ years Yearning Heartbroken Red in the Ice and Fire Yin Yang Well but gifted to Gu Yuena. After his heart was destroyed by the Abyssal Sage King, Gu Yuena used this immortal herb to rebuild Tang Wulin’s heart and revive him.

characters.history:
He arrived at the academy with his father before the test. His mother wasn't there, supposedly if she went, he could have been exempt from the test. This spurred on his first interaction with Dai Ying, who said Shrek was always fair. His first impression was that she was very scary.

He wanted to join the Star-Command Department and be a Warship Commander. His father recommended he take another Department and learn Star-Command on the side. Yi Zichen advised the Holy Light or Awakening Department. Zhou Weiqing wanted to recruit Yi Zichen at first to his Mechanics Department.

During the first test, he struggled and his blood seemed to boil. A very strong aura of oppression, one that was cold, strong and heavy. He and Dai Ying had the most pronounced changes around them. For the second test, he was in the second batch. Dai Ying proposed to race him. He ended up being the last to leave the shore, however after releasing his soul rings and using his martial soul, he blasted off like a cannonball, destroying the area around him and scaring even the teacher. He caught up to the other students rather quickly, with many just trying to leap out of his way. He narrowly avoided Dai Ying's attack as he caught up to her.

As he passed her and she quickly caught up to him, he ended up using his second soul skill which seemed to enhance his fist in order to fight back. After being hit by her Golden Road and being weakened, he resumes the chase. He arrived in 38th place.

He became the disciple of Lei Xiang, the Mad God at the Awakening Depatment. He was called out rather quickly with "Come on" and "Let's go" being the only sentences spoken when he was recruited. His spirit was later broken by Lei Xiang and inherited the Mad God Art and Heavenly Demon Art.
characters.trivia: He teamed up with Dai Ying and finished second during the final examination.

Yi Zichen awakened with innate full spirit power during his awakening ceremony. After his spirit got awakened, all the people in his village collected money for his parents to buy a hundred year old spirit soul for him. He was very talented in the Elementary Spirit Master School near his village. After graduating from the school before 12 years old, his spirit power had reached rank 29. Thus, his father brought him to Shrek City to enroll in Spirit Academy, a school belonging to the Spirit Pagoda because there were benefits for talented students that are enrolled in the school and he was not sure about enrolling Yi Zichen at Shrek Academy.

When in line for the registration, he was said he was screened for the special class. Actually, it was the robbing of the talented students from the Spirit Academy, acted by Xie Xie, Yue Zhengyu with the help of 7 Old Demons and Eternal Tree. Thus, Yi Zhicen was included. After entering Outeryard Shrek, Yi Zhicen was selected as Class Leader of first year. He was very diligent and smart, every morning he went running at the track provided by School. Before run he often see Chen Xinjie. After collision between Spirit Pagoda and Shrek Academy, he idolized Tang Wulin, and wanted to be as strong as Tang Wulin and Sea God Pavillion Master.

After invasion of Abyssal Plane, he was still do his daily run every morning and often see Chen Xinjie flatered Long Yeyue.

characters.introText:
Quick Answers
		
		
	
	
			
				
					What powers does the Yin-Yang Chaos Bird possess?
						
				
				
					
						The Yin-Yang Chaos Bird wields powers from chaos, yin-yang, and Qi energy. It can execute Yin-Yang Fusion techniques like Chaos Gold and Chaos Fire, merging Yin and Yang elements to unleash destructive forces. These abilities can destroy parts of powerful beings, such as a sixth rank Star Tyrant Source Dragon. It also absorbs muscle strength and weakens defenses, using spatial power to inject a yin-yang vortex into targets, causing internal chaos.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					Why is the Yin-Yang Chaos Bird called the Bird of Destiny?
						
				
				
					
						The Yin-Yang Chaos Bird is known as the Bird of Destiny because it embodies chaos, yin-yang, and Qi from the universe's creation. Its rarity, with only one per planet, and its historical role in the Divine Realm's Rebellion of Divine Beasts highlight its significance. Currently, it lives on the Elven Planet as Tang Yuge's Spirit Soul, destined to be a Great Beast.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					How does the Yin-Yang Chaos Bird embody chaos and yin-yang energy?
						
				
				
					
						The Yin-Yang Chaos Bird embodies chaos and yin-yang energy through its origin as a mix of chaos, yin-yang, and Qi from the start of heaven and earth. Each planet hosts only one, marked by its half black, half white body with gold and silver highlights. Its ancient bloodline stems from chaos and yin-yang remnants. It participated in the Divine Beasts' Rebellion and became Tang Yuge's Spirit Soul on the Elven Planet. Its abilities include Yin-Yang Fusion, merging Yin and Yang elements for powerful attacks.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What is the significance of the Yin-Yang Chaos Bird's unique coloration?
						
				
				
					
						The Yin-Yang Chaos Bird's unique coloration, half black and half white with gold and silver accents, represents the balance of chaos, yin-yang, and Qi from the start of heaven and earth. This rare bird, with only one per planet, signifies its ancient lineage and role in the Rebellion of Divine Beasts. Its coloration underscores its destiny as a Great Beast and its significance as Tang Yuge's Spirit Soul.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					How does the Yin-Yang Chaos Bird relate to the concept of yin-yang?
						
				
				
					
						The Yin-Yang Chaos Bird represents yin-yang through its half black, half white body, symbolizing balance. Originating from chaos and yin-yang energy from the creation of heaven and earth, it can divide anything into yin and yang. This connection is further shown in its role in the Divine Realm and as Tang Yuge's Spirit Soul.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom

Description[]
The Yin-Yang Chaos Bird is a Spirit Beast with ancient bloodline. It's also called Bird of Destiny.
characters.appearance: It is shaped like a hawk and falcon, about two meters long, with a wingspan of four meters. It's whole body from the head all the way back, unexpectedly is half black, half white. It has gold between the hairs on one side of its white body, and silver between the hairs on the other side of its black body.
characters.history:
The Yin Yang Chaos Bird bloodline was born from the remnants of the chaos yin and yang energy left behind when heaven and earth were born. An ancient Yin-Yang Chaos Bird followed the Dragon God in the Rebellion of Divine Beasts battle in the Divine Realm.

In SL 4, there was one Yin-Yang Chaos Bird living in Elven Planet that chose to became the Spirit Soul of Tang Yuge. It was destinated to be one of the new generation of Great Beasts.

characters.personality:
The Emperor Team were invited by the nobles of Suotuo City to compete in the city's Great Spirit Arena, and won two matches consecutively, making their sponsors win large amount of money by betting on them.

The members of the Emperor Team were told about the Shrek Seven Monsters and given their information by Qin Ming. He commented that the Shrek Seven Monsters probably encountered easy opponents hearing about their record. He carefully read the information after Yu Tianheng pointed out that the Soul Power of the members of the Shrek Seven Monsters were too low. The Emperor Team entered the main stage from the opposite side of the Shrek Seven Monsters and they were given a minute to activate their Martial Souls.

He used his Wind Edge to attack Xiao Wu after she had bypassed Shi Mò and Shi Mó. He was shocked when Xiao Wu was pulled back. He tried to attack Tang San before retreating when Dugu Yan used the Jade Phosphor Violet Poison. He charged at Ao Sika and Ning Rongrong after Yu Tianheng's order. The members of the Emperor Team consumed the antidote for the Jade Phosphor Green Poison when Dugu Yan used it.

He suppressed Ma Hongjun by attacking the latter at tricky angles. He increased his offense against Ma Hongjun to prevent the latter from helping Tang San. He used his Air Surge to try and block the Phoenix Fire Line after his Wind Chime Bird was suppressed at the most basic level by the Evil Fire Phoenix due to Ma Hongjun's anger. He was restrained by the Blue Silver Spider Web and fell down.

He was shocked when Tang San used Yu Tianheng as a meat shield.

He supported Shi Mò and Shi Mó as they were going towards their hotel, as he was in relatively better condition. The rest of the Emperor Team left Yu Tianheng behind when they realized that Yu Xiaogang was his uncle.

characters.trivia:
In the Manhua, Yu Feng is a girl disguised as a boy.

She has a contest against Ma Hongjun, which comprises of eating a huge burger, spicy meatballs and smelly tofu. Ma Hongjun manages to win it.

She is part of the Shrek Academy Fans Club and receives money from Yu Tianheng to provide money to stop the Shrek Academy students from doing various advertisements and damaging their reputation.

During the dream sequence of Bai Chenxiang's yellow 1 trial, it is revealed that Yu Feng is actually Bai Chenxiang who disguised herself when she left the Bai clan to train.

The reason her spirit is different, as well as the scar on her face, is linked to the secret arts that the Bai clan practices that replaces the spirit and all its soul rings for another spirit. This is done because all Bai clan members, have an extremely accelerated soul growth under soul level 40, but will stagnate upon reaching soul level 38. In order for them to continue cultivation, they have to replace the spirit and its soul rings. A side effect is that her mind was affected, causing her to lose her memories. However, during her time on Sea God Island, she regained her memories and former abilities, along with her feeling for Ma Hongjun.

characters.history:
At age 12, Yu Tian first meets Lan Xuanyu and his team during the second round of the Shrek Preliminary Sea Exam. He later meets them at the Spirit Pagoda, where he and his friends, Bing Tianliang and Lin Donghui, come to acknowledge and respect Xuanyu for his auxiliary system effects and profound mind. Later at Douluo Planet, Yu Tian successfully enters Shrek Academy.
By the 1st year Outer Court 1st semester final exam, Yu Tian reached Spirit Ancestor Rank. During the 2nd semester, he obtains a 50,000 years Tree Snake as his spirit soul on Elf Planet. His class is also noted to have shrunk to 33 students.

With the 2nd year, he possesses a Xuanyu quality forged 1-word Battle Armor and learns Battleship and Fighter piloting.

By age 15 as of the 4th year 2nd semester, Yu Tian became a Spirit Emperor. Alongside his other 32 classmates, he created the 33 Sky Wings interstellar combat group under Xuanyu's leadership, with Yu Tian under the alias Eleventh Sky Wing. Excluding the original Seven Monsters, the other Sky Wings including Yu Tian anticipate their Sky Wing mechas by hording necessary rare metal resources.

Yu Tian made a comment if Qian Lei is obedient to Lan Mengqin out of fear.

At age 18, Spirit Sage 6th year Yu Tian graduated Shrek Outer Court, has a Purple rank Sky Wing Mecha, and enters the Inner Court with the entire 33 Sky Wings group. His Battle Armor also is upgraded to 2-word with Xuanyu quality forged spirit refined materials, months before the graduation exam, and Yu Tian has also condensed his first soul core. When Tian Long attacked the 33 Sky Wings group during the 3rd part of Outer Court Graduation Exam, Yu Tian came to acknowledge the reality of his insignificant power to God-tier beings.

As part of the Inner Court Elimination Trials, Yu Tian passed the Blood Trial in Douluo World at least to the second level. By Shrek Academy arrangements, Yu Tian alongside his fellow classmates entered a 1-2 year military trial period beginning as a Lieutenant Colonel. He is in a 6-man team with Bing Tianliang, Lin Donghui and the three Sea Spirit Masters of the 33 Sky Wings. Yu Tian's team is sent with other 33 Sky Wings' teams to other fleets to begin their military careers as scouts.

After Xuanyu's return from breaking through and obtaining the Space element on Douluo Planet, each of the Sky Wings is assigned a physique compatible Hundred-Thousand immortal herb-plant life-partner (total 45 herbs + Old Shu) from the Land of Immortal Spirits by Treasure Hunter Beast Xiao Bao's decisions for later equal contracting as spirit souls. Xuanyu instructs Yu Tian and the other Sky Wings that he will guide them to reach God threshold together, work hard on their cultivation and 1 year later construct their 3-word battle armor. Xuanyu also assists the Sky Wings by requesting 3 things from the military:

All groups of Sky Wings are unified under Xuanyu, following his military orders.

The military provides a small region of space for the 33 Sky Wings' activities that without Xuanyu's permission, others cannot enter the region.

With the excess resources Xuanyu's group obtains, the Federation will coordinate with Tang Sect to build Divine rank mechas for each of the 33 Sky Wings.

After waiting in the 33 Sky Wings Battleship in space, Yu Tian and the other Sky Wings secretly infiltrate a Qian Lei & co. rented shop and Old Shu's hidden place with the assistance of Xuanyu's Space element and Xiao Bao's concealment to begin cultivating and improving one's foundations to the God level for a certain future God-rank cultivation path. Excluding Xuanyu's 7 member squad, Yu Tian and the other Sky Wings secretly cultivate at Old Shu's hidden place and are constantly fed their respective compatible 100,000+ years immortal herb plant spirit beast's attribute-life fruits for their cultivation. They also later learn of the Golden Dragon Princess idol Miss Lan, giving the Princess strange looks.

With Miss Lan providing condensed immortal dragon qi liquid and dragon blood for body quenching, while not increasing much in cultivation rank while still being a Spirit Sage/Saint, Yu Tian's physical and spiritual foundations improve more than his period as an Outer Court student as he stays with the other Sky Wings at Old Shu's hidden base. Yu Tian eats his attribute-life fruits constantly and receive life energy nourishment. His bloodline quenching uses his Mo Sword's momentum, increasing his spiritual and body endurance, similar to Tan Xiaodao's killing aura quenching the bloodline needing spiritual fortitude.

About half a year after graduation, Yu Tian and all Sky Wings have at least achieved Spirit Sage level, attained incomplete bloodline quenching and eaten their respective compatible attribute-life fruits for so long. They then return to Shrek Academy, arriving at its city boundary in their Sky Wing mechas due to the no-flying mecha zone since SL3. Yu Tian and the 33 Sky Wings accompany Wang Tianyu's small welcoming group by surprising the Shrek elders with their ability to fly (Rank 70+ ability) to the Eternal Tree without using their 2-word battle armors. Yu Tian and the Sky Wings wait in the Land of Immortal Spirits for Xuanyu's return. Xuanyu plans to have, excluding his 7 member squad, Yu Tian and the other Sky WIngs to cultivate at Shrek Academy for the next three months to solidify their cultivation paths under top experts.

During the two days before the Shrek God Fate Blind-Date, Yu Tian and all Sky Wings accelerated their breakthroughs to the next cultivation rank with Xuanyu's assistance and resources, notably Xuanyu's Shrek Seven Monsters' group attaining Rank 90+.

Two days after returning to Shrek Academy, the 33 Sky Wings attend the Inner Court's 30,000 year old tradition, the Sea God's Fate Match-making Conference. Based on lower position Sky Wings Tan Xiaodao and Piao Xiaoxu displaying Rank 80+ ability and Xuanyu's 7 member Titled Douluo group, as Yu Tian is a top position Sky Wing, it indirectly implied Yu Tian has also reached Spirit Douluo cultivation rank. He also learns of Xuanyu's true parentage.

Yu Tian did not get a date. However, he witnessed fellow Sky Wings Tan Xiaodao, Qian Lei, Liu Feng and Captain Xuanyu succeed with their dates. He also spectated the anti-Ding Zhuohan united female group revenge move, learning the terror of vengeful women against a multi-two timing scumbag playboy. It is revealed during Liu Feng's date moment, Outer Court student Yu Tian once attempted to pursue Xing Xuan, but was rejected and later ridiculed by Lin Donghui and Bing Tianliang about it for a long time.

He watches with the other 33 Sky Wings the Shrek Seven Monster's 7 Bouts, during which he witnesses Xuanyu's Shrek Seven Monsters' combat prowesses and Chen Wuzhu's complete tribulations breakthrough to Rank 100. The 7th Bout was canceled due to time constraints.

After the event, it is revealed Yu Tian and other 33 Sky Wings no longer respect Xuanyu, but worship him as a God.

By Book 22, Yu Tian's military rank upgraded to Colonel alongside other 33 Sky Wings (Xuanyu became a Lieutenant General). The 33 Sky Wings' 3-word battle armours are also planned to be soul-refined and forged by the Divine Craftsman Tang Wulin.

By Book 26, Yu Tian and some other Sky Wings have broken through to Rank 90+.

Yu Tian and other Sky Wings witness the breakthrough of Gods Tang Yuge and Qian Lei, giving them determination to become Gods.

By Book 27 Chapter 1590, Titled Douluo Yu Tian fights by riding on his huge spirit soul, holding the Mo Sword in front of him. Indomitable is his way of fighting, with one cut it is often within a hundred meters he cuts out a piece of space like a plow.

characters.appearance:
Yu Tianlong was a good 2 meters tall youth around 20 years old. Two Wu Yifans could almost fit inside his opponent’s mountain-like body. The young man’s hair was short and needle-like as well, but deep blue in hue. His shirt had no sleeves, and his muscular arms looked like they had been sculpted from stone. His entire body emitted a terrifying aura. His indifferent expression was cold and emotionless.

Yu Tianlong was tall and burly. His looks were decent too, and his abilities were strong. He didn’t seem to be inferior to Huo Yuhao at all.

Yu Tianlong lifted his right hand, and arcs of blue electricity started to spread across his body. Bluish-purple scales appeared, and his body grew as he advanced. With each step, his body would expand. When he reached the center of the arena, he was already two and a half meters tall, and his shoulders a meter and a half across. The terrifying but majestic scales on his arms were extremely thick, and arcs of bluish-purple electricity crackled around him. He like a human-shaped monster now, and even his eyes had turned bluish-purple.

Yu Tianlong was already very confident in his control over his martial soul. However, he wasn’t able to make his eyes identical to that of his martial soul.
characters.personality:
Yu Tianlong is tempermental, arrogant and domineering because of his upbringing as the genius future Heavenly Dragon Sect Master. Its results in an unyielding perspective and berserk tendency if pridefully provoked. Yu Tianlong was very stubborn towards contracts and agreements. He possessed a natural charisma, charming his entire Heavenly Dragon Sect.

Yu Tianlong acted very masculine. He was a straightforward person, and gave off a very mighty feeling. He was most adept at close-combat fighting. He had always been very proud of his strength. He believed himself to be extremely adept in terms of offense, and he loved to attack in combat. When in doubt of his strength, he pride was stirred.

Yu Tianlong didn’t feel depressed because of all the shouting and screaming for Shrek. Rather, a passionate gaze glowed in his eyes. His thinking was evidently different from an ordinary person’s. Wang Qiu’er’s popularity only made him more even excited. He was thinking how great it would be if Wang Qiu’er could become his woman. The feeling of making everyone’s goddess his woman was…Finishing his train of thought, Yu Tianlong revealed a smile on his face. Just as everyone was cheering on his opponent, he smiled instead. Titled Douluo referee Zheng Zhan thought it was a little weird, and couldn’t help but shudder. Yu Tianlong was a natural Alpha M.

He prefers strong, cold beautiful women. Despite his pale face after his fight with Wang Qiu'er, he still walked with a confident gait. One could not tell that he was injured. Because of his unwilling incarceration, he held negative towards the Holy Spirit Cult and the Sun Moon Empire.
characters.history:
Yu Tianlong participated in the Continental Elite Youth Soul Master Tournament as Heaven Spirit Empire's notable sect, the Heavenly Dragon Sect's team captain. Yu Tianlong’s abilities seem better than the rest of his teammates and is their strength pillar. He’s also the next sect leader of the Heavenly Dragon Sect. He holds a high status in his sect. In the Heavenly Dragon Sect, he was a leading figure who was respected by all.

Until encountering the Powersword Sect in the tournament, Yu Tianlong's team had its member Spirit Emperor Xing Yan participate as the "strongest" popular Heavenly Dragon Sect member while Yu Tianlong sat along the way. When Yu Tianlong went to fight, everyone on their team, regardless of whether they were on the main team or the reserves, all looked at him in admiration.

In terms of overall abilities, Yu Tianlong didn’t think his sect was inferior to Shrek in the Semifinals. They might even be better. However, the Heavenly Dragon Sect’s problem was similar to Shrek Academy’s. As the team leader, his cultivation was far superior to those of his teammates, making cooperation difficult. He was unsure of his team’s chances in the team round against Shrek.

In the tournament, he fought against:

Powersword Sect:
Individual Second Round Wu Yifan - Captain

3 other individual members

The Heavenly Dragon Sect was thus able to progress to the next round and become the second team to enter the top eight. In the semi-finals, it was likely that they would challenge the team from Shrek Academy, led by Wang Qiu’er.

Shrek Academy:
Individual First Round Wang Qiu'er - Captain

He made a bet of if she loses, she’ll join the Heavenly Dragon Sect after she graduates. If he lose, he’ll be her servant for three years. The bet's result was afterwards agreed to be voluntary.

The Heavenly Dragon Sect wasn’t confident of winning in the team round against Shrek Academy.

However, Yu Tianlong felt as if his martial soul were being suppressed now. How could he not panic? Before today, he hadn’t expected his Blue Lightning Tyrant Dragon to ever be suppressed by another martial soul. Furthermore, it was even another dragon-type martial soul! His unyielding desire to win suddenly took a huge blow, and he wore a solemn expression on his face.

The Heavenly Dragon Sect that lost against Shrek Academy was eliminated despite having entered the top four.

Yu Tianlong was not far from becoming a seven-ringed Soul Sage based on his beast spirit's appearance upon using his fourth ring. The strength of his lightning was even superior to ordinary seven-ringed Soul Sages! The closer the changes to his martial soul, the better a soul master was able to unleash the strength of his martial soul. Right now, Wang Qiu’er’s tangible Golden Dragon transformation was warning Yu Tianlong that her degree of fusion with her martial soul was undoubtedly greater than his.

Near the ending of the tournament, his Heavenly Dragon Sect team and many others were captured and poisoned by the Holy Spirit Cult and the Sun-Moon Empire. His sect team and others were eventually freed by a rescue team lead by Huo Yuhao. Yu Tianlong and his Heavenly Dragon Sect returned to the Heaven Spirit Empire's Dragon City.

Two years later during the early stages of the Sun-Moon Empire's invasion of the other three empires, his sect and many other sects in the Dragon City were eradicated due to rebelling, kidnapped as materials or submitted for sect survival, against the invaders. When the Sun Moon Empire’s troops arrived, Yu Tianlong's Titled Douluo sect master led his sect to defend the city along with the Dragon City Defense Army and he killed many enemies. After the city was breached, the Heavenly Dragon Sect suffered massive losses, and Old Tianlong died in battle. Yu Tianlong disappeared after the battle and was never heard again.

Based on his potential, abilities and duration of two years, it is certain Yu Tianlong was a Spirit Sage when he fought against the invaders of Dragon City.
characters.trivia:
He is a lightning element specialist equal to Bei Bei.

He looks favorably on Bei Bei as fellow variants of the Blue Lightning Tyrant Dragon lineage, the previous focus on destruction, the latter focus on light.
Yu Tianlong was completely still. As a fellow Dragon martial soul soul master, and as someone with the Blue Lightning Tyrant Dragon martial soul, he now truly understood how powerful Bei Bei’s attack was. This was a soul skill that surpassed even that of an ordinary Soul Sage. He knew that he was definitely not Bei Bei’s opponent.

characters.introText:
Quick Answers
		
		
	
	
			
				
					What is the significance of Yu Xiaogang's lazed manner and half-open eyes?
						
				
				
					
						Yu Xiaogang's seemingly indifferent demeanor and half-open eyes symbolize his intellectual and caring nature. He is a Spirit Master who highly values knowledge and intelligence. Despite his lazed appearance, he is a strategic thinker and a devoted protector when his loved ones are threatened.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					How does Yu Xiaogang's pride in intelligence and knowledge influence his actions?
						
				
				
					
						Yu Xiaogang's intelligence and knowledge shape his actions and relationships significantly. His pride in these attributes manifests as stubbornness and an unyielding attitude, leading to a berserk tendency when provoked. His charisma, derived from his intelligence, captivates his Heavenly Dragon Sect. His knowledge is also used to mentor Tang San, aiming to shape him into an unparalleled genius. In situations where loved ones are threatened, his intelligence transforms him into a resolute protector, ready to save or avenge them.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What triggers Yu Xiaogang's transformation into a harsh and reliable person?
						
				
				
					
						When those dear to Yu Xiaogang face danger, he becomes a stern and dependable figure, going to any lengths to protect or avenge them. His transformation is shaped by his past, including his expulsion from the Blue Lightning Tyrant Dragon Clan for a weak spirit, and his bond with Bibi Dong, a disciple of the Supreme Pontiff.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What is the difference between Yu Xiaogang's character in the Manhua and the original?
						
				
				
					
						Yu Xiaogang's character in the Manhua differs from the original webnovel in several ways. His age and appearance are altered, with the Manhua depicting him as a fifty-year-old man with white hair, in contrast to the webnovel's forty-year-old man with black hair. His respect for Xiao Wu's knowledge of Spirit Beasts, which surpasses even his own, also contributes to his prowess as a Spirit Master.
