Appearance[]
He has an average figure and is somewhat thin looking. He is somewhere around forty years old (fifty in the Manhua), with short black hair (white in Manhua). His body possesses a somewhat lazed manner with both eyes half open.
characters.appearance:
He prevented the escalation of the confrontation between Tang San and the guard of the Nuoding Academy. He asked Jack for the Certificate issued by the Martial Soul Hall and declared that it was genuine. He asked Jack to leave Tang San under his care after apologizing on the behalf of the Academy.

He warned the guard that it would be his last offense, and he would be fired if there was another violation. He led Tang San inside the premises of the Nuoding Academy. He refuted Tang San's guess about him being either a teacher or the Principal of the Academy, telling him that he was only a freeloader in the Academy. He offered to teach Tang San about Soul Master cultivation, and was indirectly asked by the latter if he could really do it. He revealed to Tang San that the latter was the third person having Twin Martial Souls in the past 100 years. He explained to Tang San that he deduced it from the Certificate issued by the Martial Soul Hall; he had investigated more than 600 people having Blue Silver Grass as their Martial Soul, with only 16 people having Innate Soul Power at Level 1 at maximum; Tang San had Innate Full Soul Power, thus he must have another Martial Soul, which must be a very strong one. He told Tang San that even though the latter was the third person in the last 100 years to have Twin Martial Souls, there were 19 people who had Innate Full Soul Power throughout the Continent at the same time; each one of them had formidable Martial Souls; 14 of them had inherited strong Martial Souls through their Clans while the remaining had strong Variant Martial Souls; while Blue Silver Grass itself had never produced such variations. He explained the origins of the Variant Martial Souls to Tang San, before the latter kowtowed to him to make him his master. He takes Tang San to register in the Academy, before leaving him with the staff there.

He sent Mo Hen to deliver a bedding to Tang San. He invited Tang San to have a meal on the 2nd Floor of the Canteen with him, but was refused. He told Tang San to wait for him by the gate of the Canteen. He reached Tang San along with the Principal of the Nuoding Academy, with the latter wishing him success. He took Tang San to his Office, before giving him some food to eat. He asked Tang San to activate his other Martial Soul for him to take a look. He was shocked to see that Tang San's second Martial Soul is the Clear Sky Hammer and connected his origin to be the Clear Sky Clan. He told Tang San not to assimilate Soul Rings to the Clear Sky Hammer without his permission. He asked Tang San about Tang Hao's occupation before calming down. He told Tang San to follow him the next day to assimilate a suitable Soul Ring to his Blue Silver Grass; he will take care of the paperwork of the Academy. He asked Tang San about the latter's feelings about Blue Silver Grass. He told Tang San about the classifications of the paths the Soul Masters take to advance their Martial Souls.

He told Tang San that when assimilating Soul Rings in the future, the latter must try to obtain them having similar attributes, thus reducing the conflict between the Souls Rings. He was asked by Tang San about the path to be taken for the cultivation of the Blue Silver Grass. He told Tang San to cultivate his Blue Silver Grass as a Control System Soul Master, before he was asked about it. He told Tang San the advantages of having Blue Silver Grass as Martial Soul. He explained Tang San about the concept of Martial Souls rejecting Soul Rings. He told Tang San that the Ability of the 1st Soul Ring of his Blue Silver Grass should focus on binding opponents, thus the Soul Ring should provide adequate toughness and poison to the Blue Silver Grass. He told Tang San that the Blue Silver Grass will continue to strengthen along with the increase in his Soul Power. He took Tang San with him in the next morning for the latter to obtain his 1st Soul Ring. He told Tang San that they are going to a Soul Beast Forest 200 km northeast of the Nuoding City, before he was asked about Soul Beasts. He explained to Tang San about the cultivation levels of the Soul Beasts and their relation to the color of Soul Rings they produce when killed by humans. He told Tang San that the majority of the Soul Beasts in the captive Soul Beast Forests have cultivation ranging from the 10+ years Level to the 100+ years Level, with a very few at the 1,000+ years Level.

He told Tang San about the requirements for assimilating Soul Rings and the limits of the cultivation level of the 1st Soul Ring. He gave Tang San the Twenty Four Moonlight Bridges, which the latter subsequently named. After reaching the vicinity of the Soul Beast Forest, he told Tang San about teams of Soul Masters operating together. He told Tang San about the requirements to enter the Soul Beast Forests to hunt for Soul Rings. He told Tang San to remember the patterns of his Rank 4 Martial Soul Hall Token and the significance of each symbol on it. He told Tang San that the symbols on the toke represent the six strongest Titled Douluos of their class. He activated his Martial Soul, Luo Sanpao and showed it to Tang San, before telling him that it manifested as such due to a variation. He told Tang San about Luo Sanpao's characteristics and its advantages even though it was weaker. They encounter a 10+ years Level Multicolored Cat, which Yu Xiaogang tells Luo Sanpao to ignore. He explained to Tang San the method to identify the cultivation of Soul Beasts, using a Solitary Bamboo as example. He told Tang San that they will hunt the Solitary Bamboo as the last resort if they cannot find anything more suitable or stronger. He told Tang San that they should always try to assimilate Soul Rings having cultivation as high as possible under the limits. They made a tent for the night and used Snake Repelling Powder as a precaution. He quizzed Tang San about the subjects they discussed during the day.

He was explaining about the importance of cultivation of Soul Masters before the age of 20 to Tang San, when they were surrounded by a pack of 10+ years Level Ghost Wolves. He used the Shocking Thunder via Luo Sanpao to attack the Ghost Wolves; after taking out two masks to cover their noses. He told Tang San the characteristics of Wolf and Dog type Soul Beasts, before demonstrating how Soul Rings appear, and the process to assimilate them when required. He was alerted by Luo Sanpao about incoming danger, before Tang San pinpointed the direction. He tossed a flare to observe and declares that it was a Datura Snake. He explained to Tang San about the characteristics of the Datura Snakes, before he told the latter that if the Datura Snake was of the 10+ years Level, they will fight it, but if it was of the 100+ years Level, they would flee. He used the Shocking Thunder as a probing attack, before he told Tang San to run as the Datura Snake was of the 100+ years Level. He used the Mesmerize to try to keep the Datura Snake from chasing them, which it evaded. He ordered Luo Sanpao to block the Datura Snake for a moment as it continued chasing them. He was poisoned by the Datura Snake after Luo Sanppao was bitten. He was shocked to see Tang San strike the Datura Snake with Radishes. He was shocked by Tang San's accuracy while throwing Radishes to block the Datura Snake from reaching them. He reprimanded Tang San for not following his instructions. He told Tang San to wait for some time to see if the Datura Snake is dead. He told Tang San that he would be getting the 1st Soul Ring of his Blue Silver Grass after he witnessed the death of the Datura Snake. He told Tang San that the cultivation of the Datura Snake was 400+ years Level, perfect within the limits of the 1st Soul Ring. He told Tang San that the nature of the Blue Silver Grass would not reject the Soul Ring from the Datura Snake. He protected Tang San while the latter started the process of assimilating the Soul Ring on his Blue Silver Grass.

He was unconscious by the time Tang San woke up after assimilating the Soul Ring. He remained unconscious for 3 days due to high fever after Tang San drained the poisoned blood out of his body. He chided Tang San for experimenting on him, before asking if he had succeeded. He asked about the various effects the Soul Ring had on Tang San's Blue Silver Grass. He told Tang San that they succeeded in their task. He was carried by Tang San out of the Soul Beast Forest and they took a carriage to the Nuoding City. Tang San escorted him to his room after they reached the Nuoding Academy. He gave Tang San a book which recorded his ideas about Soul Power Cultivation Techniques. He told Tang San to go the Nuoding City's Martial Soul Branch Hall to authenticate himself as a Soul Master and register, so that he could receive stipend each month.

He was visited by Tang San after the latter completed his Advanced Appraisal and told him study according to the curriculum of the Academy for the next few days.

He instructed Tang San in the evening as the latter's schedule was packed daily. The people from the Martial Soul Branch Hall came to visit him after Tang San was registered. He rejected Tang San's offer of visiting the latter's home. He was visited by Tang Hao and was shocked when the latter stated his identity. He was entrusted with Tang San's care by Tang Hao. He was given the Rank 1 Martial Soul Hall Token passed down among the Clear Sky Douluos by Tang Hao. He lamented at Tang Hao's condition after the latter left.

Five years later he sent Tang San to enroll in Shrek Academy. He told Tang San that he would visit the Heaven Dou City in the meantime. It was mentioned that he selected the Ghost Vine as the source for the 2nd Soul Ring of Tang San's Blue Silver Grass and asked the Principal of the Elementary Division of the Nuoding Academy for help.

characters.history:
He told the members of the Shrek Academy's Team that the hideous uniform would help train their mentality, but himself refused to wear it.

He found Tang San after the latter returned, and told him to cultivate the Heart Separation Control with Ning Rongrong, and told her to work hard on it to better use her Nine Treasure Glazed Tile Pagoda. He and Tang San discussed about the conversation the latter had with Ning Fengzhi and Xue Qinghe.

He guided Tang San when the latter had difficulty mastering the Three Aperture Governing Heart, and was surprised when the latter triggered the peak mimicry cultivation of his Blue Silver Grass. He asked Tang San about the experience when the latter woke up. He and Liu Erlong revealed to the team that they were matched up against the Elephant Armored Academy's Team in the second round, and they discussed about it.

He understood Tang San's plan when the latter proposed to replace Tai Long and Jiang Zhu with Ao Sika and Zhu Zhuqing. He, Fu Lande and Liu Erlong listened in on the tactics without interfering.

He informed the team that their opponent for the seventh round, the Othello Academy's Team which had only won 2 of their first six matches, had surrendered. He told the team to watch the match between the teams of the Thunderclap Academy and the Elephant Armored Academy. The group encountered the Blue Sunshine Academy's group while going to the stands to watch the match. He told the team about the teams from the five Elemental Academies, which could threaten them. He and Tang San discussed about the philosophy of the Soul Master cultivation. He let Tang San leave for the Academy to cultivate.

The group was alerted about Tang San's danger by Xiao Wu, and they left the Great Spirit Arena to search. The group reached the Academy and ascertained that Tang San had not reached there, before spreading out to search. He was shocked to hear about the incident and asked Tang San to show the Left Arm Bone obtained from Shi Nian. He inspected the Soul Bone and praised Tang San for not assimilating it. He told Tang San never to reveal the incident and the Soul Bone to anyone, as it would attract danger to them. He told Tang San that strength type and plant type Soul Bones suit Tang San the best, while the gem type was not suitable. He told Tang San to wait for either Tang Hao or the support of the Clear Sky Clan to safely trade the Soul Bone. He informed the team about the team from the Blazing Academy, that the latter had Power Attack, Agility Attack, Control, and Auxiliary System Soul Masters of the Fire Element Martial Souls, and advised them to concede the match.

He had withheld information about the Blazing Academy's Team from the Shrek Academy's Team to cultivate Tang San's ability to judge the opponents.

He told Tang San that the latter had showed off too much, such that the other Academies and the VIPs were paying more attention. He suggested to benching Tang San till the finals. He gave Tang San instructions about dealing with the later matches. He suggested for Tang San to enter a long period of secluded cultivation after the Tournament, to make the rest of the continent forget about him.

He prevented Fu Lande from acting out stating that the Seven Asura Dreamland was a Seve-in-One Martial Fusion instead of a Seven-in-One Martial Soul Fusion. The group returned to the Academy under the pretext of treatment. He commented that no one could defeat Fu Lande in terms of villainy when the latter arranged for the aftermath.

He and Liu Erlong accompanied Fu Lande to welcome the Investigation Committee into the Shrek Academy. He presented the Rank 1 Martial Soul Hall Token to make Sa Lasi wrap up the investigation without harming the Shrek Academy. He revealed to Liu Erlong that the Rank 1 Martial Soul Hall Token was given to him by Tang Hao, calming her down.

He told the team to work on their own deficiencies during the gap of a month between the Preliminaries and the Qualifiers.

He let Tang San enter seclusion as he was unable to help. He told the rest of the team that they would undergo special training. He made the team face Liu Erlong for the training to increase their adaptability.

He explained to Liu Erlong about how she was defeated by the Shrek Seven Monsters, along with the fact that they had held back. He let Liu Erlong vent her anger on the whole team.

The group reached the Heaven Dou Imperial Hunting Grounds for the Qualifiers and were taken to their allocated spot to rest. He wanted to refuse Ning Fengzhi's offer but was signaled by Fu Lande to accept it.

He decided to send out only Xiao Wu, Tang San and Dai Mubai for the bouts in the first match. He was shocked when he couldn't identify the Yearning Heartbroken Red being triggered.

He decided to send out Tang San, Ma Hongjun, Zhu Zhuqing, Xiao Wu and Dai Mubai for the match against the Blazing Academy's Team. He realized when Huo Wu started her Soul Ring Merging to power her Brilliant Sun. He rushed to the stage when Tang San bore the burnt of the Brilliant Sun. He commented that Tang San's decision during the match was correct as it prevented a lasting enmity against the Blazing Academy.

He rejected Tang San's desire to participate in the matches after healing for 3 days. He let Huang Yuan, Jing Ling and Tai Long fight first against the Botanic Academy's Team to prepare Ma Hongjun for a clean sweep. He chided Ma Hongjun when the latter started bragging about winning the remaining matches himself. He let Tang San leave with Huo Wu when she asked for a chat.

He refused to let Tang San participate against the Thunderclap Academy's Team to be on standby to face the Godwind Academy's Team. He nominated Tai Long, Jing Ling, Huang Yuan, Xiao Wu, Dai Mubai, Zhu Zhuqing and Ma Hongjun for the match. He told Tai Long to stall and waste the opponent's Soul Power, told Jing Ling to dodge the opponent's attacks, told Huang Yuan to stall, and told Xiao Wu to dodge during their bouts in the match.

He conceded the eighth bout on behalf of Xiao Wu when she was electrocuted by Lei Dong. He recognized Yu Tianxin when the latter went up to face Dai Mubai in the tenth bout.

He agreed to the proposal from Feng Xiaotian to decide the next match in a single bout.

He left for the Martial Soul City the day after the Qualifiers ended to meet Bibi Dong regarding Tang San's Twin Martial Souls.

He asked Bibi Dong how she managed to overcome the danger of cultivating her Twin Martial Souls, before she informed him that she knew about Tang San and had sent people to assassinate the latter. He became furious and vowed to destroy the Martial Soul Hall if anything happened to Tang San. He severed ties with her and left the Supreme Pontiff Palace after learning that the assassination failed. He apologized to Tang San stating that he should not have let the latter participate in the tournament, which caused the latter to be hunted. He informed the team about the rules of the Finals and declared that the Shrek Seven Monsters would comprise the lineup. He and Liu Erlong chatted about Bibi Dong.

He was shocked to hear that Fu Lande drew the Blazing Academy as opponents in the 1st round and they forfeited the match. They were shocked seeing members of the Blazing Academy's Team appearing as participants of the Godwind Academy's Team. He realized that the Blazing Academy and the Godwind Academy were exploiting a loophole in the rules, and no other team can do it anymore as the Finals had started. He witnessed Dai Mubai and Zhu Zhuqing narrate their past and the dangers they faced.

He told the Shrek Seven Monsters to erupt instantly when their opponents underestimated them during the match. He listened to Dugu Bo's comments about Xie Yue, Hu Liena, and Yan, wondering if it was Bibi Dong's test for him.

He sent Jing Ling to open for Shrek Academy's Team in the three-way match of the 5th round. He realized that God Wind Academy's Team and the Martial Soul Hall Academy's Team had colluded to weaken Shrek Academy's Team before the finals after Sun Chuantao forfeited his bout against Huo Wushuang.

He forfeited the three-way match on behalf of Shrek Academy's Team and called Jing Ling back. He was protected by Bibi Dong, who addressed him as an Elder of the Martial Soul Hall due to his Rank 1 Martial Soul Hall Token. He told Tang San to explain the situation to the rest of the team after they returned to the hotel. He personally set the tactics for the Shrek Seven Monsters' match against God Wind Academy's Team and inwardly praised Feng Xiaotian for identifying Ao Sika and Ning Rongrong as the core of their Seven-in-One Martial Fusion.

He was shocked by the implication of Tang San triggering the Clear Sky Hammer Avatar and had Jiang Zhu continuously heal the Shrek Seven Monsters after the match. He commented that if he had known Tang San could activate the Clear Sky Hammer Avatar with sufficient Soul Power, he would have advised the Shrek Seven Monsters to use different tactics and reserve it for the Grand Finale. He informed the Shrek Seven Monsters about the possible side effects of prematurely using the Clear Sky Hammer Avatar twice in quick succession. He and Tang San discussed tactics against the Martial Soul Hall Academy's Team for four hours.

He was shocked by Tang San's injuries after the Chaos Fog dissipated due to the Charm Demon's de-fusion.

He, Flender, and Liu Erlong rushed to the stage to support Tang San after Ning Fengzhi healed his injuries. He distributed the Mind Condensing Wisdom Skull to Tang San, the Immolation Flame Right Arm to Ma Hongjun, and the Wind Chasing Left Leg to Zhu Zhuqing before instructing Tang San to give the Fantasy Wisdom Skull to Ning Rongrong. He took out the Rank 1 Martial Soul Hall Token and formally questioned Bibi Dong's order to capture Xiao Wu, and was shocked by her answer. He and Liu Erlong followed Flender in initiating their Martial Soul Fusion to protect Xiao Wu. He revered Tang Hao's attitude toward the Martial Soul Hall.

He was protected from being knocked out during Tang Hao's confrontation against 7 Titled Douluos of the Martial Soul Hall due to their Martial Soul Fusion. They stopped their Martial Soul Fusion after Bibi Dong allowed the Shrek Academy's group to leave Martial Soul City. The Golden Iron Triangle woke the remaining students with help from Dugu Bo, Ning Fengzhi, and Chen Xin.

He was conferred the title of Count and appointed as the Commander of the Imperial Soul Masters by Xue Ye to train the Imperial Soul Masters. He and Flender refused Xue Ye's proposal to merge Shrek Academy with the Heaven Dou Imperial Academy. He was visited by Tang San once during the latter's training in the Moon Pavilion, who assured him.
characters.trivia: The Light Holy Dragon was easily suppressed by Bibi Dong and forced to defuse before Tang Hao appeared.

					How is Fengyu related to Yuanen Huihui?
						
				
				
					
						Yuanen Fengyu is Yuanen Huihui's father. Fengyu, from the Soul Beast family, fell in love with Yun Liao, the Elf clan princess, on the Elven Planet, leading to Huihui's birth.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What role did Fengyu play in the Elf Planet exploration?
						
				
				
					
						Fengyu joined the exploration team to the Elf Planet, where they discovered the Elf Race. He was involved in negotiations about colonization and met Huihui's mother there.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					Who did Fengyu meet on the Elf Planet?
						
				
				
					
						On the Elf Planet, Yuanen Fengyu met the Elf Race and took part in colonization talks. He also met Huihui's mother, Yun Liao, a princess of the Elf clan.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What event marked Fengyu's first appearance?
						
				
				
					
						Yuanen Fengyu's first appearance occurred when Yuanen Huihui was in a coma due to a bloodline mutation caused by Tang Xuanyu.

					What was Fengyu's involvement in the Elf Race negotiations?
						
				
				
					
						Fengyu joined the exploration team on the Elf Planet for colonization efforts. He was involved in negotiations with the Elf Race and met Yuanen Huihui's mother, Yun Liao, during this time.

characters.introText: It was hard to imagine how a boy could actually look so delicate and beautiful. The first impression he left everyone was his skin that was as fair as snow, his clothes fresh and clean, and had gentle features. It could be said that he was a boy that was much prettier than girls; it wouldn’t be an exaggeration to say that he has the body of a boy but the face of a girl. It was worth noting that he has a pair of distinctive and pointed, long ears, and silky long hair: there were a few strands of fringe over his forehead, and his long hair was tied up loosely at the back of his head. His hair roots were milky white, while the ends were pale pink. Those two demonic eyes almost didn’t have any white in them; but what was weirder was that his left eye was a faint, violet color, while his right eye was a bewitching purplish-red. There was always a subtle smile on his peachy, red lips.

He is also introverted and has his own persistence. By Qian Lei’s view of him is that he's too simple and once he was sold on something, he would help out.
characters.history: He first makes his appearance at the entrance exams of Shrek academy. To everyone's surprise, he had five Soul Rings instead of three or even four like everyone else. He instantly took down 3 of opponents who were more than Rank 30 in rank in one second. With more than 700 spiritual power, he was known as the strongest spiritual power in the current age group and he's only twelve years old. Later, in the final comprehensive examination for admission, he killed hundreds of ordinary monsters and two lord-level monsters by himself, shocking the trailing protagonist group. Later, because Lan Xuanyu extended a helping hand when his life was in danger, Yuan Enhuihui fully trusted Lan Xuanyu and called him Brother Xuanyu". Together with Xuanyu and his team, they killed thousands of ordinary monsters, more than 20 chieftain-level monsters, and a lord-level monster, but later he became unconscious after exhaustion and revealed his secrets after nightfall. He won the second place in the comprehensive examination and was elected as the deputy monitor of the same grade in the Shrek Academy. He is the strongest in the first grade of Shrek Academy.

After possessing Soul Douluo-ranked cultivation base, he began to venture outside and wandered from place to place. He met Ye Hui and brought her home. He was severely injured by her when she transformed into a demon. He stopped his father not to kill her which led a tragedy in his clan. When Ye Hui sacrificed herself, he wanted to detonate his soul core and die together. It was stopped by his father and he became a cripple and a mad man.

He was cured and broke through to limit douluo after Er Ming gave him a drop of his essence blood. He later became a teacher at the Shrek Academy together with his father and brother.

After dealing with the Demon Plane and reuniting with her family, she has become more cheerful.

characters.introText:
Quick Answers
		
		
	
	
			
				
					What is the meaning behind Yue Guan's title, the Chrysanthemum Douluo?
						
				
				
					
						Yue Guan holds the title of Chrysanthemum Douluo, reflecting his spirit, the Chrysanthemum. This plant type tool spirit, also an Immortal Herb, materializes as a yellow flower. Its petals, acting as blades, and its fragrance serve as offensive mechanisms. The Chrysanthemum spirit can expand and simultaneously target multiple opponents.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What is the significance of Yue Guan's feminine appearance and voice in the Spirit Hall?
						
				
				
					
						Yue Guan's feminine voice and appearance, characterized by his flowing female robes, high ponytail, and sunny eyes, are integral to his distinct persona in the Spirit Hall. He has a fascination with flowers and a deep understanding of immortal herbs. His habit of assigning nicknames to his peers, though often irritating to the Titled Douluo, further emphasizes his unique character. While he appreciates female beauty, he does not identify as trans.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					How does Yue Guan's fascination with flowers and herbs reflect in his character?
						
				
				
					
						Yue Guan's fascination with flowers and herbs manifests in his comprehensive understanding of these, particularly immortal herbs. This interest shapes his personality, as he often assigns nicknames, possibly inspired by his botanical passion. His abilities, tied to his herb knowledge, enable him to identify unique features of all heaven-and-earth spirit items. His scent can expel all poisons, likely due to his profound knowledge of herbs.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What is the reaction of other Titled Douluo to Yue Guan's habit of giving nicknames?
						
				
				
					
						Yue Guan, noted for his feminine demeanor, frequently assigns nicknames to his acquaintances. This playful behavior, however, is a cause of irritation among his peers, the Titled Douluo.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					How does Yue Guan's influential presence manifest in the Spirit Hall?
						
				
				
					
						Yue Guan, a loyal and high-ranking member of the Spirit Hall, has cultivated his skills to become a Titled Douluo and a level 95 Super Douluo, earning him a position as an elder. His influence is evident in his participation in crucial battles, such as the one against Tang Hao. His 60-year companionship with Gui Mei further highlights his significant role within the Spirit Hall.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom

Appearance[]
He has an extremely feminine voice and a feminine appearance. Yue Guan wears flowing female robes, has a high ponytail and big sunny eyes.
characters.appearance:
He led 1,500 Soul Masters to ambush the convoy of the Heaven Dou Empire, to kill Tang San along with injuring the rest of the students before the Finals of the Continental Elite Young Soul Master Tournament. He was alerted by Luo Diyala about the interruption from Meng Shu and Chao Tianxiang, in dealing with the group from the Shrek Academy, and he forced them to retreat. He restrained the Shrek Seven Monsters using his Aura Binding Realm, and was shocked when the Yearning Heartbroken Red freed them from its effects. He was rejected by the Yearning Heartbroken Red and he forbid his subordinates from killing Xiao Wu. He detected the energy signature of the Singular Velvet Sky Chrysanthemum in Dai Mubai's blood, and used his own Soul Power to probe, before forbidding his subordinates from killing the latter too. He offered to take Dai Mubai as his disciple.

He agreed to Dai Mubai when the latter negotiated regarding Zhu Zhuqing, but rejected the offer when it included Tang San. He decided to kill Tang San, and kidnap the rest of the Shrek Seven Monsters to train them. His attack was blocked by Liu Erlong, who was injured as a result, and he mocked her Martial Soul. He was shocked to see Dugu Bo appearing to protect Tang San, and was warned about retaliation from Tang Hao. He hesitated to attack Dugu Bo as the latter could kill many his subordinates. He was told by Gui Mei to complete the mission as the latter would block Dugu Bo. He went in for the kill, but was blocked by Chen Xin, who declared the intention to save Tang San. He signaled the retreat for the forces of the Martial Soul Hall.

He accompanied Bibi Dong alongside Gui Mei, Chen Xin, and Ning Fengzhi before the 5th round of the Finals. He identified Tang San among the Shrek Seven Monsters and informed Bibi Dong.

He asked Bibi Dong why she was concerned about the Grand Finale, as the Martial Soul Hall Academy's Team held an overwhelming advantage.

He was glad to see Tang San's injuries after the Chaos Fog dissipated due to the Charm Demon's de-fusion. He recognized Xiao Wu as a Soul Beast when the Yearning Heartbroken Red fell from her body, exposing her true energy signature.

He became glad about Xiao Wu's identity, which overshadowed the Martial Soul Hall Academy's Team's defeat. He was shocked to see Tang San had another Soul Bone when he took out the Fantasy Wisdom Skull for Ning Rongrong. He and Gui Mei were ordered by Bibi Dong to capture Xiao Wu and kill anyone who resisted after the Shrek Academy's group distributed the Soul Bones. He and Gui Mei charged at the Shrek Academy's group with Dugu Bo suppressed but were blasted back by Tang Hao.

He, Gui Mei, and four other Titled Douluos alongside Bibi Dong were forced by Tang Hao to protect the Supreme Pontiff Palace instead of attacking him. He asked Bibi Dong about the rest of the Shrek Academy's group.

characters.introText: Yue Qingling is a spirit master who found Tang Wulin unconscious on the beach one day. She later becomes the manager of a Pop-star Tang Wulin.
characters.appearance:
Le means "music, laugh, happy, glad, amused, cheerful" (乐).

Qingling means "minister, thou" (卿) (qing) and "spirit, bier, elf/elfin, intelligence, alert, lark, departed soul, wagtail, clever, effective, efficacious, sharp, quick" (灵) (ling).
characters.history:
Yue Qingling found a man washed up upon the shore wearing nothing. The man was named by her as Tang Yue who was the amnesiac state of Tang Wulin. She later took him in and became his manager for his idol career because she wanted use him to earn money and became rich.

She later developed love feelings for Tang Yue after he became an idol but the latter doesn't respond to her and only sees her as his benefactor and little sister. With the addition of Nana, Tang Yue began chasing after Nana as she appeared in the fragments of his memories. Qingling's feelings of love became uneasy.

In Volume 14, Tang Wulin decided to leave and give all his money to Qingling to thank her for helping him all these years He doesn't want to sing anymore and just wants to live near and be close with Xuanyu and Gu Yuena.

characters.history:
The life of the elves is long, but the problem is that it is difficult to have offspring, especially within the elves themselves, and the probability of offspring is more difficult. She accidentally had sex with Yuanen Fengyu during his Elven Planet Adventure, but she didn't expect that she was pregnant.

According to the normal situation of the elves, she is likely to be pregnant for about thirty years before she can give birth to Yuanen Huihui. But she doesn't want to take that long, because during pregnancy, elf women need to recuperate in a special way to ensure the survival of their children. After all, in thirty years, the probability of accidents is still very high.

But Yun Liao was reluctant to give up her lover, so she sneaked into the elf cave and forcibly accelerated the birth with the help of the elf dragon breath. In fact, it only took eight months for Yuanen Huihui to be born thirty years after a normal elf woman was born, even shorter than a human woman. In this process, although Yuanen Huihui absorbed enough energy, she didn't know what went wrong, so that there was a gender difference between day and night. That's why she felt that she always owes her son in her heart.

Yun Liao regretted this extremely much, but there was no other way. It can only be claimed to be a child born in the thirty years of pregnancy within the elves. That's why she, who was the heir of the next generation of elf queen, gave up her inheritance rights, came to the human world, and took her child to find her father. This also led to a series of family changes after the Titan family, and Tang Yuge's mother ran away with her. That's why Tang Yuge is hostile to Yuanen Huihui.

However, in the more than ten years since she came to the Titan family, she has lived in a simple life and never participated in anything in the family. She just took care of her husband and children and did her duty as a mother and wife. She was gradually accepted by the Titan family.

characters.introText:
Quick Answers
		
		
	
	
			
				
					What is the significance of Yun Ming's title, the Atlas Douluo?
						
				
				
					
						The Atlas Douluo, Yun Ming, is recognized for his exceptional natural abilities, considered the most potent in the contemporary world. His title signifies his spiritual leadership and immense power, which grants him longevity and the capacity to share his life force. This is evident when he prolonged the life of a top-ranking Recovery System soul master. The Atlas Douluo title is also linked to the Atlas Divine Spear, a divine weapon created by Yun Ming.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What achievements led Yun Ming to become the Sea God Pavilion's Master?
						
				
				
					
						Yun Ming's rise to the Sea God Pavilion's Master was marked by notable feats. He combated many spirit masters and an enigmatic group for his marriage to Ya Li. His roles as a Shrek Academy teacher and Sea God Pavilion elder further solidified his standing. Additionally, he mentored Na'er, demonstrating his commitment to the organization's future.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What does it mean to be a four-word Battle Armor Master like Yun Ming?
						
				
				
					
						A four-word Battle Armor Master, such as Yun Ming, has survived a perilous process to create a four-word battle armor. This involves engraving a soul circuit and possibly sacrificing a significant portion of their blood. The creation of these armors is exclusive to Divine Blacksmiths, who face a low success rate due to the demanding process, including an elemental thunder tribulation.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					How does Yun Ming's appearance contrast with his status and achievements?
						
				
				
					
						Yun Ming's appearance is deceptively ordinary for a man of his stature and accomplishments. He appears to be in his late twenties, with a gentle gaze, faint smile, and black hair. Dressed entirely in white, he lacks the powerful aura typically associated with individuals of his status. Despite this, his character is marked by decisiveness, integrity, and selflessness, and he is known for his easygoing personality.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom

characters.history:
He appeared during the Battle of the Five Gods against Tang Wulin in the Spirit Souls battle. Not only did he lose this battle, but also his spirit soul, the Thunderclap Nether Vine to Tang Wulin, causing his cultivation level to drop back to the Soul Douluo rank. He would naturally fail to fulfil his lifelong ambition of becoming a Limit Duoluo due to this. After losing the battle, he became enraged and thus charged towards Tang Wulin to attack, however not only did his attack fail, but he also very nearly lost his hand to the Golden Dragon Spear if he hadn't reacted timely enough.

After the battle, his desire to kill Tang Wulin, had him approach the Holy Spirit Cult to help him achieve this, which ultimately also failed.
characters.trivia: Losing the Thunder Hell Prison Vine was not just as simple as losing a spirit soul. The three soul skills given to him by it would be reduced by at least 50% which was very harmful to his overall strength. This was not the lack of a spirit soul that could be re-integrated. Less was less. The spirit soul had solidified, and the soul skills had been solidified, which could not be replaced.

She was part of the team from the Martial Soul Hall Academy and participated in the 2nd round of the Finals after skipping the 1st round as a seeded team, before facing the Heaven Dou Imperial Academy's Main Team in the 3rd round. He did not take any action during the match.

The team advanced to the 5th round after winning their match of the 4th round easily. The team advanced directly to the Grand Finale after the teams from Shrek Academy and God Wind Academy forfeited the three-way match. She watched the match between Shrek Academy's Team and God Wind Academy's Team.

The team was told by Bibi Dong how to counter the Shrek Seven Monsters' Seven-in-One Martial Fusion and was threatened by Gui Mei with three years in the Disorienting Grand Canyon if they lost. They tried to demoralize the Shrek Seven Monsters before the match and used their usual 3-4 formation.

She, Li Kai and Sun Chuantao were forced to block Ma Hongjun and Xiao Wu. She and Li Kai attacked Xiao Wu when she blasted Sun Chuantao towards Ma Hongjun.

She was glad to see Tang San's injuries after the Chaos Fog dissipated due to the Charm Demon's de-fusion. She and Li Kai were defeated by Ma Hongjun and Xiao Wu. She was poisoned by the fragments of the Eight Spider Lances and was forced to suppress the poison before being knocked out.

Her Soul Power was amplified by Ning Fengzhi to help her temporarily suppress the poison. She was detoxified by Tang San, who also stole some of her Soul Power in the process. The team was taken away to rest and recover.

characters.history:
Zhang Zhenpeng came to the Skysea Alliance Tournament with his students from Sealand Academy. He met with his friend, Long Huantian, the schoolmaster of the Skysea Academy at the tournament within box one. He wanted to ask Huantian for three quotas for his students to take the Shrek Academy entrance exam. Huantian believed Zhenpeng wanted three normal quotas, but he corrected him and said he wanted three inner court quotas. Huantian was shocked and reluctant, but Zhenpeng convinced him to watch his students' match against class zero from Eastsea Academy before deciding.

As the two teams entered the arena, he introduced his team to Huantian. He even gave a high evaluation of class zero, which Huantian was skeptical of. The two watched as the match begin.

Zhenpeng was confident that his team would win the championship, but he was amazed by class zero's ability. He originally thought Tang Wulin was the strongest, but it turned out to be Gu Yue. When the Zhou sisters, Hanyou and Tian'er were about to use their martial soul fusion skill, he immediately rushed out of the box with Huantian to stop them, but was too late. Tang Wulin was severely injured before Gu Yue transported them outside the arena. She started to use her own lifeforce to heal him, wrapping them in a cocoon of light.

Zhang Zhenpeng was second to arrive on the scene when the skill was finished. He reprimand them for using their fusion skill when they couldn't control it. Feeling jittery, he was confronted by an furious Wu Zhankong, who targeted him instead of the twins, since they were children and it is the teacher's fault for not teaching them correctly. He then questioned Wu Zhangkong in a belittling manner, causing him to immediately attack him. He was horrified, the moment he saw Wu Zhangkong's soul rings. Unable to explain himself under Wu Zhangkong's pressure, he summoned his spirit in defense. He raised his hands to the sky and called forth a ball of lightning and radiant light that struck the wheel-array of swords spinning toward him.

He understood the difference in power between them after their first clash. He was not able to obstruct the swords with his attack as they reach him in a blink of an eye. He unleashed his fifth soul skill. At the same time, Long Huantian arrived at his side and helped him block the attack. In the aftermath, they retreated ten steps, with blood painting Zhenpeng's mouth and Long Huantian pale.

All of a sudden, giant figures swooped down from the sky. A purple mecha, four yellow mechas, and fifteen white mechas appeared. They aimed their guns at Wu Zhangkong and surrounded him. Wu Zhangkong unleashed his battle armor, causing the mecha pilots to lower their guns, not daring to confront him. Zhang Zhenpeng paled in front of Wu Zhangkong. Everyone stood there in shock as Wu Zhangkong was able to attack until Shen Yi stopped him. In the process, Wu Zhangkong broke through to Soul Sage. Seeing that that the cocoon of light was disappearing, they went down to examine them. When they left the arena with Wulin and Gu Yue, nobody stopped them.

characters.introText: Zhen Hua is a tall man with black eyes, long legs and lean muscles. His thick black hair accentuated his features, drawing out his chiseled jawline and fierce gaze. He doesn’t look to be more than thirty years old, but his eyes betray the wisdom of one has experienced many decades. characters.appearance:
Zhen Hua is a tall man with black eyes, long legs and lean muscles. His thick black hair accentuated his features, drawing out his chiseled jawline and fierce gaze. He doesn’t look to be more than thirty years old, but his eyes betray the wisdom of one has experienced many decades. The hair at his temples is a snowy white, contrasting with the rest of his dark mane.

But the most striking of all are his hands. They are much larger than an ordinary person’s. The joints are inconspicuous, fair and slender like a maiden’s, and his palms are as translucent as jade.
characters.personality:
Zhen Hua is pretty crafty. He and Mu Chen have a competitive streak with each other. He is also ambitious, for his goal to become a divine blacksmith, he used many heaven and earth treasures to forcefully elevate his cultivation rank to Titled Douluo just so he can meet one of the criterias for the blacksmith rank. However, causality resulted with himself disappointed that his divine craftsman tier is of the lowest rank. Even if he can forge heavenly-refined metals for many four-word battle armors, Zhen Hua is haunted with the truth that as divine blacksmith, he can never improve his heavenly-refined metals' quality to the level of a divine tool's.

As a blacksmith, Zhen Hua possesses integrity and pride as the only Divine Craftsman, and as the teacher for the next Divine Blacksmith.

Zhen Hua was a man worthy of respect and admiration. He can also be the only friend of the Body Sect's tempermental selfish sect master, Mu Ye.
characters.history:
Zhen Hua went to the Eastsea City blacksmith association when he heard about Mu Chen wanting to resign as president of the association. They ended up arguing until Mu Chen compromised with transferring to the blacksmith association branch in Shrek City, otherwise he will leave the association. He asked how Bao'er was and warned Mu Chen not to anger Feng Wuyu. Zhen Hua helped him with the transfer procedures and got Mu Xi into Shrek Academy.

Zhen Hua held a lecture in the blacksmith association in Heaven Dou City during the time Tang Wulin visited the association. He rarely gave lectures because of his busy schedule. He talked about how to lower the difficulty of alloy forging. When he finished, he noticed Wulin in the front row of the quiet hall because of him talking.

Zhen Hua was astonished when Wulin asked to try out the technique he just talked about. He agreed, even though a clerk did try to stop Wulin, because he can see Wulin's love for blacksmithing in his eyes. Tang Wulin asked for heavy silver, star iron, and skymoon powder. Zhen Hua gestured a staff member to get them.

Tang Wulin surprised him. In addition to a deep-rooted passion for blacksmithing, his eyes showed unwavering confidence. Not even the tiniest bit of stage fright could be seen on his face.

Zhen Hua also noticed that the boy’s hands were larger than average, and his fingers moved in a steady patterns. This was a clear identifier of an experienced blacksmith, a sign of Tang Wulin’s deep understanding of blacksmithing.

Very few things could catch Zhen Hua’s attention, but now his interest was piqued. He wanted to see just how high this child could reach.

Zhen Hua was stunned when Tang Wulin asked to borrow his hammers, as was the entire audience. He agreed and gave him a pair of spirit refined hammers made from cloud gold, an alloy composed of cloud copper, and platinum crystal. He even promised him to give them if he forged an alloy.

Although he didn’t believe Tang Wulin would succeed, he still wanted to encourage him. He himself had set a new record when he became the youngest sixth-rank blacksmith in the world at eighteen years of age. He knew from experience that such miracles were possible, and wasn’t as critical of Tang Wulin as the rest of the crowd. He could also sense that Tang Wulin had a solid foundation in blacksmithing. Yet he couldn’t fathom why Tang Wulin didn’t have his own forging hammers with him. A blacksmith’s hammers were their life. A proper blacksmith would never be without them. This was one of the first things a blacksmith learned.

He watched Wulin start forging with a face on his face. His smile finally cracked when Wulin started tapping on the metal with the hammers. The lower level blacksmiths in the hall might not have understood what Tang Wulin was doing, but as a Divine Blacksmith, it was impossible for him not to.

Tang Wulin was listening to the heavy silver, conversing with the metal and deepening his understanding of it. But, more importantly, he was listening to the voice of the hammer. Forging with hammers they had never touched before was a massive challenge for a blacksmith. Listening to a hammer’s voice was one way for a blacksmith to get familiar with it. Only after understanding the character of a hammer could a blacksmith use it.

Zhen Hua had been testing Tang Wulin from the moment he handed the boy his hammers. The weight was merely the first part of the test. How Tang Wulin would use these hammers was the next, more important part. Zhen Hua wanted to see if Tang Wulin could bring out their full potential.

As he watched Wulin forge away, Zhen Hua’s amicable smile gradually grew concerned. A trace of doubt flickered in his eyes. He straighten his back slightly when he saw Wulin hundred refine a metal in seven strikes. Next came shock when he started duel forging and then alloy forging.

As Zhen Hua watched Tang Wulin assault the metals like a raging tempest, he subconsciously stepped forward to get a better look at the metals on the table. The heavy silver and star iron gradually fused into one, their resplendent auras merging together as well.

Zhen Hua furrowed his brows when Tang Wulin finished forging an alloy. Putting on a stern expression, he questioned Wulin on how old he was and his teacher. Zhen Hua’s chest huffed as he listened to Wulin say he is fourteen and his teacher is Mu Chen, but a blank look crossed his face at the mere utter of Mu Chen’s name. He then asked Wulin where his badge is and his rank.

Even as the President of the whole Blacksmith’s Association, Zhen Hua couldn’t help but harbor some doubts regarding Tang Wulin’s blacksmith rank. With his discerning eyes, he picked out an amazing fact: the harmony rate of the star silver Tang Wulin forged was over ninety-five percent!

Zhen Hua smiled as he heard Wulin say he is a fifth-rank blacksmith cursing Mu Chen for hiding Tang Wulin from him. He told Wulin, his hammers are his now, but when Wulin asked to trade them back for money, Zhen Hua couldn’t maintain his poker face anymore. His jaw dropped, utterly dumbstruck. He started thinking Tang Wulin came here to cause trouble because Mu Chen told him to.

Although he was a little pissed, he agreed to Wulin's request and took Wulin with him as he left the hall. While in the elevator, he learned that Wulin is in the middle of an semester exam for Shrek Academy, realized why Mu Chen asked to be transferred to Shrek City, and got a little upset at learning that Feng Wuyu is also teaching Wulin blacksmithing. He helped Wulin with his semester exam by arranging an opponent for him to battle, giving him travel expenses, and treated him to some food in his personal dining hall.

He left Wulin in the dining hall and called Mu Chen. He demanded to know why he never told him about Tang Wulin. Mu Chen refused to give Wulin to Zhen Hua, with Zhen Hua trying to convince him, until Yuan Bao'er interrupted their chat and threatened Zhen Hua. She immediately hanged up the phone on Zhen Hua and he went back to the dining hall, with the attempt to temp Wulin to take the express Divine Craftsman route (unstable cultivation).

With Mu Ye as his bodyguard, Zhen Hua was saved from being assassinated by the Holy Spirit Cult and they escape to a Body Sect safehouse outside the Heaven Dou City, however, he was injured with an evil spirit master's evil spirit that required him to use his 4-word battle armor to help him endure the gradually fatal situation. He was later cured by Holy Spirit Douluo Ya Li and the recovering him imparts Wulin and the other Shrek Monsters the current reality of their path to reconstruct Shrek Academy. Zhen Hua advised them to secretly disguised to enlist in the military to grow and acquire help from Tang Sect. He also assisted as a professional advisor for Wulin, Gu Yuena and the Shrek Monsters during their upgrade from 1-word to 2-word battle armor.

characters.introText: Zhongli Wu, titled the Death God Douluo, was the leader of the Holy Spirit Cult, Imperial Preceptor of the Sun Moon Empire, and one of the strongest dark spirit masters of his era. At his peak, he was a Rank 98 Super Douluo who possessed the Death God Demon Puppet martial soul and commanded numerous powerful beast spirits. He was the son of Ye Xishui and the former Holy Spirit Cult leader Zhongli Old Ghost, the husband of Feng Ling, and the master of Yan Feng. As Imperial Preceptor, Zhongli Wu held considerable political and military authority within the Sun Moon Empire and later served as an army supervisor during its campaigns against Shrek Academy.
characters.appearance: Despite being at least one hundred and eighty years old, Zhongli Wu retained an unusually youthful appearance. He had short silver hair that was extremely fine, dense, rigid, and sharp, resembling steel needles, together with thick eyebrows, handsome and well-defined facial features, and dark-purple eyes that possessed a deep and profound quality. Without his silver hair, he could easily have been mistaken for a middle-aged man, and his outward appearance contained almost none of the sinister characteristics normally associated with evil soul masters, making it difficult to recognize either his identity or cultivation merely by looking at him. In the donghua, Zhongli Wu wears black armor and a distinctive mask associated with his position as leader of the Holy Spirit Cult.
characters.personality:
Zhongli Wu was ruthless, calculating, arrogant, and highly ambitious, viewing human souls and the souls of powerful soul beasts primarily as resources that could be transformed into weapons, beast spirits, or sources of cultivation. As leader of the Holy Spirit Cult, he placed the organization's survival and expansion above ordinary moral restraints and willingly cooperated with the Sun Moon Empire whenever doing so strengthened the Cult's political or military position. He was particularly obsessed with acquiring exceptionally powerful beast spirits, and his desire to transform powerful soul beasts into undead or enslaved entities eventually led him to pursue Di Tian, whose strength far exceeded his expectations.

Despite his cruelty, Zhongli Wu displayed genuine attachment toward his wife, Feng Ling, whom he frequently addressed as Xiao Feng. He showed concern for her safety and treated her as one of the Cult's most important combatants, although he remained the dominant figure in their relationship and exercised considerable authority over her actions.
characters.history:
Zhongli Wu's name is first revealed during the later stages of the Continental Elite Youth Soul Master Tournament through information provided by Ma Xiaotao. He later appears personally as the leader of the Holy Spirit Cult and Imperial Preceptor of the Sun Moon Empire. The death of his disciple Yan Feng at the hands of Huo Yuhao contributed to his growing hostility toward Huo Yuhao, while Ma Xiaotao's later disappearance after pursuing him further intensified the conflict between the Holy Spirit Cult and Shrek Academy. Zhongli Wu subsequently appeared before Xu Tianran as Imperial Preceptor and represented the Cult in negotiations concerning the incident, demonstrating the political influence he possessed within the Sun Moon Empire.

During the Sun Moon Empire's later military campaigns, Zhongli Wu served as an army supervisor and exercised considerable authority over imperial operations, allowing him to supervise commanders and influence important military decisions. He later participated in an attack against Di Tian alongside eleven other powerful evil soul masters. Together, the twelve activated the Blood Sea Wraith Spear, burning tens of thousands of newly deceased resentful spirits to create a vast sea of blood, seal the surrounding space, and condense its power into an enormous blood-red spear capable of piercing the Beast God's body. Although the attack successfully injured Di Tian, it failed to defeat him. The Beast God retaliated with overwhelming force, inflicting severe losses on the Holy Spirit Cult, killing several high-ranking evil soul masters, and forcing Zhongli Wu to retreat after suffering injuries of his own.

Zhongli Wu later entered the series of consecutive battles between Huo Yuhao and the Sun Moon Empire's forces as the fifth combatant. He accepted the challenge partly because of his interest in Huo Yuhao, the Ice Bear King, and the Morning Dew Dagger, while still hoping to recruit Huo Yuhao as the Holy Spirit Cult's Holy Son because of his unusual ability to command powerful spirit and undead creatures. Upon entering the battle, Zhongli Wu revealed six black and three red Spirit Rings and summoned his strongest beast spirit, the Bone Dragon King. The Bone Dragon King's Wind and Fire elemental control approached the Ultimate level and allowed Zhongli Wu to pressure Huo Yuhao with exceptionally powerful elemental attacks. Huo Yuhao nevertheless succeeded in destroying it, and because the Bone Dragon King was Zhongli Wu's life-bound beast spirit, its destruction inflicted severe backlash upon him.

After withdrawing from the battlefield, Zhongli Wu secretly left his Death God Demon Puppet attached to the death aura surrounding Huo Yuhao. The martial soul remained concealed while Huo Yuhao exhausted himself through repeated battles before suddenly launching a surprise attack. Tang Wutong intercepted the otherwise fatal strike and fell into a coma, after which Huo Yuhao retaliated and destroyed the Death God Demon Puppet. As Zhongli Wu's true martial-soul body, its destruction inflicted an effectively irreversible injury upon him and immediately caused his soul power to fall by two ranks, from Rank 98 to Rank 96. Zhongli Wu was forced to retreat and abandoned his previous desire to recruit Huo Yuhao, thereafter regarding him solely as an enemy who had to be eliminated.

After discovering the location of the Holy Spirit Cult's headquarters beneath the Evildemon Forest, Huo Yuhao and Tang Wutong launched an assault intended to destroy the organization completely. During the final battle, Feng Ling burned her soul power, martial soul, and soul before transforming into black-red phoenix flames and merging with Zhongli Wu through one of the Cult's secret fusion techniques. The fusion greatly increased Zhongli Wu's power, but Huo Yuhao and Tang Wutong responded with Fading In Radiance, Golden Road, which stripped away their fused martial-soul power and rapidly consumed their life force. Feng Ling's remaining power disappeared together with her soul, leaving no trace, while Zhongli Wu survived only temporarily. Most of his remaining soul power was destroyed, his life force rapidly declined, and his appearance aged by decades within moments.

With the Holy Spirit Cult's remaining experts eliminated, Zhongli Wu attempted to rely upon the Evil Emperor, whose territory surrounded the Cult's headquarters. When the Evil Emperor appeared, Zhongli Wu immediately called upon it to attack Huo Yuhao and Tang Wutong, but Huo Yuhao struck him with a powerful spiritual attack before the situation could change, killing him outright. Zhongli Wu's death, together with the destruction of the Cult's remaining leadership and headquarters, marked the final collapse of the Holy Spirit Cult.

Zhou Tian'er pointed at the strands of bluesilver grass aiming at her, shooting a group of green lights at them, turning them lifeless to attack anymore.

						Zhou Yi adopts the guise of an elderly woman to gain respect and seriousness. She highly regards diligence and integrity, and is notably strict, leading to her demotion from a 3rd grade teacher in Shrek Academy's Outer Court to a freshmen instructor. Her spouse is Fan Yu.

Appearance[]
Zhou Yi is tall and has the appearance of a beautiful young woman, with silky silver hair and light copper eyes. She has fair, flawless skin, and wears soft white clothing.
characters.appearance:
After arriving at the class, she immediately states she only wants to raise monsters and will unhesitatingly expel any who can't meet her standards. Her day one assignment is to run around Shrek Plaza 100 times within one hour, or be expelled. She expels 9 cheaters who pretended to run 100 laps, ignoring their excuses.

After class, she finds out about Huo Yuhao's rare mental attribute spirit and takes him to the Spirit Guidance Test Area. She introduces him to her husband, Fan Yu, who is pleasantly surprised by Yuhao's potential.

In the afternoon class she gathers her students in the plaza and announces Wang Dong as the Class President due to having the best cultivation, and says anyone who defeats him will become the new class president. Then she makes everyone wear 30kg armor and run until the class ends 2 hours later. She also states that the person who arrives last will be expelled. She is surprised by Yuhao's determination to keep running forward even when all others had ceased, which also acts as a motivation for the other students to run alongside him. 					Does Zhu Zhuqing's personality reflect in her appearance?
						
				
				
					
						Zhu Zhuqing's physical attributes mirror her personality traits. Her beauty and well-proportioned figure, along with her purple eyes and hair, reflect her heroic spirit. In her spirit state, she has grey-blue scales, symbolizing her power and pride. Her fearless and ruthless nature is also evident in her appearance.

					How does Zhu Zhuqing's physical appearance contrast with her age?
						
				
				
					
						Zhu Zhuqing is a striking figure with a well-proportioned physique, big purple eyes, and short, neat purple hair. Despite her youthful appearance, she is actually 35 years old. In her spirit state, her skin takes on a grey-blue scale-like appearance. Her body enhancement causes her eyes to change color, with the left turning dark green and the right clear blue. Her mature figure contrasts with her age, creating an impression of an older woman.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What is the significance of Zhu Zhuqing's cold and indifferent demeanor?
						
				
				
					
						Zhu Zhuqing's demeanor, characterized by cold indifference, is deeply ingrained in her personality. Her facial expressions exude a chilling coldness, with her black eyes lacking any trace of vitality. This demeanor is not superficial but originates from her core, radiating a chill perceived by others. Even after her Spirit Transformation, which alters her eye colors, her cold demeanor persists, signifying a consistent personality trait.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					Is there a connection between Zhu Zhuqing and Zhu Zhiling?
						
				
				
					
						Zhu Zhuqing and Zhu Zhiling are related as siblings from the same Royal Family. Their bond is strained due to a family tradition requiring one sibling to die by the other's hand. Zhu Zhiling feigns kindness but secretly holds Zhu Zhuqing in contempt, convinced she cannot overcome her.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom

characters.history:
The Shrek Seven Monsters followed the teachers to run after Fu Lande told them to keep up with his speed. She and Xiao Wu took turns carrying Ning Rongrong as the latter was not able to maintain such speed. The Shrek Seven Monsters depleted their Soul Power within 2 hours of running, and they had to consume a Large Recovery Sausage to recover. The group ran about 400 km in day. The female students shared a room after Fu Lande booked only 3 rooms in the hotel for the night. The group reached Silves City the next day. The Shrek Seven Monsters were ordered by Fu Lande to participate in a team match in the Great Spirit Arena of the Silves City. The Shrek Seven Monsters were arranged to fight the Fiend Team in the Level Surpassing Challenge by Yu Xiaogang.

The Shrek Seven Monsters were told by Yu Xiaogang to end the match quickly. The fired their Godly Zhuge Crossbows when the match was declared to have started, instantly killing the members of the Fiend Team. She was the first to leave the stage to puke. The Shrek Seven Monsters gradually calmed down after reaching the hotel.

He is a tall burly man with purple hair and eyes. He is over two meters tall and looks much more mature than Ye Yinzhu. He carries a cold and regal attitude that almost contrasts his violent nature. Later in SL4, he has short purple hair.

In behemoth form, he is over 10 meters tall, with amethyst colored hair covering his bodies. Despite his smaller body, he wields much more power in his body than the golden behemoths. He possess huge soles of feet that would cause the earth to tremble violently every time they landed on the ground. The muscles covered by the hair can only be described as terrifying. At the end of his thick arms, each of the hundred-inch long claws can rival the dragon lances of the human country's dragon cavalry. The high magic resistance that is completely immune to magic below purple level makes his body like a solid fortress.
characters.personality: He is rough and cold to others except his family and Ye Yinzhu, his life-death sworn brother.
characters.history:
Before the events of the main story, Zi was raised in the Thor's Hammer Fortress in the orc nation of the Northern Wasteland. His race of behemoths were trained by the orcs only for combat against the dragons. He was chased out and hunted by the orcs all the way to the extreme south until he hid in the special maze formation in the Azure Sky Sea set up by Qin Shang.

Zi was attracted to the music that the young Ye Yinzhu played from near the beginning and would silently accompany him in his lessons. He silently stuck with Yinzhu until he was 16 and left the Azure Sky Sea.

After Ye Yinzhu enrolled into the Milan Academy of Magic and Martial Arts, Zi suddenly appeared outside the school grounds to sign an equal life contract with him. The moment the contract is completed, the abilities of both parties will be selflessly dedicated to each other and will be complementary to a certain extent. Yinzhu was filled with brimming strength and Zi was granted great clarity of mind.

Zi, as the Purple Emperor, was summoned by Ye Yinzhu's contract call during his collision with Ji Dong and Lie Yan. He directly fought with them, even with his 1st Class God cultivation, through his God King level body.

Book 21 Chapter 1253: Zi received Qian Lei's Amethyst Summon. With that initial call, he locked the summon's spatial-temporal coordinates (Douluo Planet) to allow the Great God Circle Divine Realm navigation. Because Qian Lei's cultivation and spiritual power were not enough to support the summon, Zi passed his purple aura to induce a temporary Purple Behemoth transformation to the level Qian Lei's body and mind could support.

Zi also passed Qian Lei basic information concerning when he can safely induce Amethyst Summon properly and about the Behemoth clan.

characters.introText:
Quick Answers
		
		
	
	
			
				
					How did Zi Zhenzhu become the ruler of Purple Pearl Island?
						
				
				
					
						Zi Zhenzhu rose to power as the ruler of Purple Pearl Island by leading the Purple Pearl Pirates. Over a decade, she consolidated smaller pirate groups into a unified empire. Her strategy of redistributing wealth from the rich to the poor gained her significant respect among the allied islands in the Nine Star Sea. Her leadership is centered on Purple Pearl Island.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					Why is Zi Zhenzhu known for her heroic spirit?
						
				
				
					
						Zi Zhenzhu is recognized for her heroic spirit because of her fearless and commanding nature. She is respected on the seas for her bravery, never backing down in dangerous situations. Her striking appearance, with purple eyes and hair, complements her strong presence.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What makes Zi Zhenzhu a unique pirate leader?
						
				
				
					
						Zi Zhenzhu stands out as a pirate leader due to her fearless and ruthless nature. As the Pirate Queen, she leads the Purple Pearl Pirates with an iron fist, earning respect through fear. Known for her temper and cruelty, she tolerates no disrespect and holds grudges. Her power as a Sea Spirit master makes her formidable at sea. Despite her fearsome reputation, she enjoys gambling, once pausing an attack for a wager.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What role did Zi Zhenzhu play as a Sixteenth Saint of Spirit Hall?
						
				
				
					
						Zi Zhenzhu, or Zhenzhu, was the Sixteenth Saint of Spirit Hall in the manhua. She leads the Purple Pearl Pirates and governs Purple Pearl Island. Her role in Spirit Hall is exclusive to the manhua, where she achieved Spirit Emperor status at Rank 68, wielding the Illusion Sea Snake as her Martial Soul.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					How does Zi Zhenzhu's appearance reflect her character?
						
				
				
					
						Zi Zhenzhu's appearance mirrors her character with her striking features and commanding presence. She is a tall, slender woman with ash grey skin, wavy silver-blonde hair, and a black skull and crossbones headband. Her red tattoos and lipstick enhance her fierce look. In her spirit form, her legs become a bladed black tail, and her eyes glow red, reflecting her ruthless and fearless nature. Her beauty and heroic spirit are evident, aligning with her powerful and prideful personality.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom

characters.history:
She was forcefully hugging Xiao Wu's body when Tang San found the rest of his group tied outside her house.

She was threatened by Tang San with the destruction of the entire Purple Pearl Pirates when she tried to fight back. She was shocked by the Soul Rings on Tang San's Blue Silver Emperor. Tang San easily captured her, and she was too scared to speak with the Blue Silver Emperor Tyrant Spear pointing at her. She began cursing at Tang San after Ma Hongjun informed him of her goal before being forced to remain silent. She was suppressed, and her Sea Serpent was frightened when Tang San took out the Inner Core of the Ten Headed Fierce Yang Serpent. Tang San used her as a hostage to prevent the pirates from harming the group.

Tang San deliberately let her escape so he could defeat her openly, allowing the rest of the group to recover peacefully. She was tricked by Tang San into a bet due to her anger. She was captured again by Tang San using only the abilities of his Soul Bones and the Vast Sea Cosmic Shroud, even after ordering the rest of the pirates to delay him. She was depressed after losing to Tang San twice in quick succession and grew interested in him. She led the Purple Pearl Pirates in swearing loyalty to Tang San.

She used her flagship, the Purple Pearl, to transport the Shrek Seven Monsters and Bai Chenxiang to the vicinity of Sea God Island and left them there. Tang San asked her to help Ji Xiang hunt suitable Soul Beasts for his cultivation.

Pirate Queen, Zi Zhenzhu

(Manhua Canon Only) Originally, Zhenzhu had no intentions of saving the Shrek Seven Devil's, choosing to watch their boat be attacked by Wind Senior Spirit Beasts instead. However, after seeing Oscar attempt to fight them, she ordered her men to rescue the boat, falling for his handsome appearance.

Zhenzhu and her "Bride"

She brought Oscar to her chambers, dressed in a cutesy outfit with bunny ears. He tried in vain to bribe her into releasing them, offering money, power, and influence, but she laughed, saying she already had all of those things. She teases him, and goes ahead with the wedding ceremony as planned, calling him "Carls" or "Bride" as affectionate nicknames.

During the elaborate ritual before the wedding itself, which involved superstitious sea ceremonies like "swinging away bad luck" using ropes, and jumping over sea water basins, the Wishful Hundred Treasure's Purse fell to the ground, exposing the Shrek Seven Devils. Zhenzhu was taken with Xiao Wu's beauty, and decided to marry her as well! Her crew laughed about this, saying their leader's tastes were really varied. One asked how many marriages Zhenzhu had had, and joked that they'd all run away. Another corrected him, saying her ex-spouses were all dead.

Zhenzhu visits the 'Bridal Chamber', already drunk and singing a sea shanty. She kisses Oscar's forehead, calling him 'brother', and saying she'd truly missed him. At his confusion, she brought Oscar to meet her 'real' siblings, two large dolls on a red velvet bed. She revealed her brother and sister's souls were trapped within, and she needed host bodies to house their souls. And Oscar and Xiao Wu both resemble them strongly.

Zhenzhu tells a story about her ship being destroyed and her brother and sister being killed trying to save her. (Which later turns out to be a fabricated version of events) Oscar is moved, and she says that's good, as it made the soul transfer easier.

Oscar tries to escape, but is overpowered. He punches Zhenzhu in the face, succeeding only in making her furious. She wraps him in her bladed tail, saying she would have killed him if she didn't need his body, and brings to her 'brother' to resurrect him. She's interrupted by an attack from Haider, Captain of the Sea Devil.

Protecting her two "brides"

Haider reveals he isn't trying to attack Zhenzhu, but rather Oscar and his companions. He's searching for the mysterious object which mutated his spirit and healed his wounds after the battle against the Deep Sea Whale King destroyed the Sea Devil, theVast Sea Cosmic Shroud. He claims that according to pirate law, Zhenzhu has no room to obstruct his path. She admits this would be true under normal circumstances, but she wouldn't allow anyone to hurt her 'brides', Oscar and Xiao Wu. She protects them both from Haider's tentacle attacks.

She battles Haider violently, and with the help of Oscar, is able to win. She catches Oscar as he falls, holding him in her embrace, just in time for the two to be seen by Ning Rongrong, who passes out again afterwards.

Later, she interrogates Oscar over the Vast Sea Cosmic Shroud, but he feigns ignorance. Losing her temper, she says she'll get the information later, and orders Oscar to be bathed and sent to her chambers. She bathes Xiao Wu personally, admiring her beauty and remembering her sister.

After the Vast Sea Cosmic Shroud encases the house Tang San is in, she goes personally to investigate, and is defeated and captured by Tang San. He allows her to escape, knowing she would return with reinforcements.

After Zhenzhu returned with reinforcements, she tried to attack and kill Tang San with thousands of pirates. He defeated the entire army, and her, single-handedly, earning the respect and fear of the pirates. They served him, after that, waiting on them hand and foot.

Zhenzhu refuses to give them the map to Sea God Island, still angry over being defeated. She does however tell them she tried to go there once before, while serving under Spirit Hall, but her fleet was destroyed by Demon Great White Sharks.

Oscar tries to flirt the information out of her, meeting her on a clifftop under the moonlight. The two drink and exchange stories, and Zhenzhu admits she knew from the start her brother and sister couldn't be revived. It

Trying to seduce Oscar

was just an excuse to keep on living. She further states that they weren't really her siblings, they were her lover and a close friend, and comrades from Spirit Hall. Oscar eventually convinces her to give them information, even if she didn't have the map she spoke of earlier. Zhenzhu tries to seduce him, but is turned down.

Zhenzhu gives them a ship, and sees off the Shrek Seven Devils. She wishes them a safe journey, even if she considers their quest a fools errand.

cultivation.introText:
Quick Answers
		
		
	
	
			
				
					What is the significance of the Spirit Ranks in Soul Land Clash of Spirit Masters?
						
				
				
					
						In Soul Land Clash of Spirit Masters, Spirit Ranks represent a person's strength, enhanced through Spirit Cultivation. They range from Spirit Scholar to Titled God, the highest rank unseen for 10,000 years. Each rank, including Spirit Master, Spirit Grandmaster, Spirit Ancestor, Spirit King, Spirit Emperor, Spirit Saint, and Spirit Douluo, signifies a higher spiritual realm relative to the cultivation rank.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					How are the spirit rankings determined in Soul Land Clash of Spirit Masters?
						
				
				
					
						Spirit rankings in Soul Land Clash of Spirit Masters are determined by Spirit Cultivation, reflecting a person's strength. These rankings range from 1 to 100, with each rank representing a different level of mastery. The highest rank, Titled God, has not been seen for 10,000 years in Soul Land III.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					Who is the highest ranked spirit saint in Soul Land Clash of Spirit Masters?
						
				
				
					
						Ning Fengzhi, with a rank of 79, is the top-ranked spirit saint in Soul Land Clash of Spirit Masters. The spirit rankings extend beyond the Spirit Saint level, with Titled God as the ultimate rank, unseen for 10,000 years in Soul Land 3.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
					
					
				
			
			
				
					What are some of the top tier characters in the Soul Land Clash of Spirit Masters tier list?
						
				
				
					
						In the Soul Land Clash of Spirit Masters tier list, top-tier characters include those in the Spirit Douluo/Great Soul Land Master and Soul Douluo ranks. Notable characters in the Spirit Douluo/Great Soul Land Master rank include Ge Long, Salas, Yu Luomian, Meng Shu, and Zhao Wuji, all with ranks exceeding 80. In the Soul Douluo rank, Meng Hongchen, Du Weilun, Fan Yu, Mo Yunfei, and Yu Tao stand out, also with ranks above 80.
					
					
						Provided by: Fandom
